# 651: Kyogre: Who's Calling Me? (Two-in-One Chapter)

Johan stepped forward and picked up the quietly resting Friend Ball from the ground, showing some helplessness on his face.

"Tsundere... my reputation as a Pokémon psychologist almost got ruined."

He had used the [Pokédex] to check Snivy's status before.

But...

Everyone knew that tsunderes were moody, and the information the [Pokédex] showed one second could be vastly different from what it showed the next second.

[Snivy] [Type: Grass] [Ability: Contrary] [Known Moves: Tackle, Leer, Vine Whip, Wrap, Synthesis, Slam, Leaf Blade, Coil, Giga Drain...] [Mood: Nervous, anxious] [Status: Poor (exhausted, seriously injured, needs rest)] [Friendship: 60 (Hard to tell its true feelings from appearance alone)]

If not for the [Friendship] value giving Johan some confidence, he wouldn't have known whether to throw the ball at the end.

"So Contrary isn't just a move ability, but also a 'personality trait.'" Johan murmured half-jokingly.

What Snivy did versus what it truly thought in its heart really did match the "Contrary" trait.

As for the "Contrary" ability itself, it was incredibly powerful.

[Contrary: Pokémon with this ability experience reversed effects when their stats are changed - stat increases become decreases, and stat decreases become increases.]

Simply put, it reverses stat changes.

For example, Swords Dance could raise a Pokémon's Attack by two levels, but if a Pokémon with the "Contrary" ability used Swords Dance, not only would its stats not increase, they would actually decrease by two levels.

Even a powerful move like Swords Dance became trash in the hands of a "Contrary" Pokémon.

But the benefit of Contrary was that when opponents who didn't know about this ability tried to lower its stats, it would actually gain stat boosts instead.

Like the common "Intimidate" ability.

Of course, if used properly, this ability could be incredibly overpowered.

Snivy's final evolution was Serperior, and Contrary Serperior was a little combo Johan had encountered before, precisely because they could master one move - Leaf Storm!

The Grass-type move Leaf Storm had a terrifying power of 130, same as the Dragon-type ultimate move Draco Meteor. After use, it would severely lower the user's Special Attack.

But combined with "Contrary," what you got was a massive Special Attack boost instead!

That was terrifying.

Dealing super-high damage while continuously boosting your own stats.

It was one of the optimal uses of this ability.

Additionally, after the ninth generation's Terastallization appeared, more precisely after "Stellar Tera" appeared, using "Tera Blast" became another solution.

In any case.

Whether for Snivy or its final evolution Serperior, Leaf Storm was a crucial move.

But unfortunately.

The little one hadn't learned it yet.

However, precisely because of this, Snivy made Johan value it even more.

Without knowing Leaf Storm, it could still take on Froslass one-on-one and display such strength...

More importantly.

It had hardly been trained by any trainer.

Snivy's potential was definitely quite good.

Of course, to achieve such strength, Snivy must have endured considerable hardship.

Naturally, for Johan, the most important thing was that Snivy was a Grass-type Pokémon!

And it had Synthesis in its move list.

Just looking at it... was very reassuring.

So satisfying~

Inside the Friend Ball, Snivy was somewhat restless and uneasy, frantically looking around.

Until it saw Johan staring at it through the transparent glass surface of the Poké Ball and caught that familiar scent, it finally relaxed.

It plopped down on the soft cushion, glanced at Johan again, then couldn't help curling its lip.

"Sni."

Idiot.

As it relaxed mentally, fatigue immediately washed over it.

It had been exhausted this day.

First half of the day battling Froslass, tracking Pokémon Hunters, then fighting alongside Zeraora against the Pokémon Hunters' Pokémon, getting injured and exhausted multiple times.

"Sni!"

Snivy wrinkled its nose.

If I wasn't tired, could he have caught me so easily?

Hmph!

Must be because I was too tired.

Thinking this way, Snivy's mind relaxed even more. It lay on the soft cushion inside the Poké Ball, slowly closed its eyes, and began breathing evenly.

Looking at Snivy falling asleep, Johan grinned.

Grass-type, hey, got one!

Actually counting, among his Pokémon, only Normal, Bug, and Psychic types weren't covered.

"Caught it?" Seeing Johan pick up the Friend Ball, Cynthia approached.

Then Gengar, Larvitar and other "Old Johan Family" Pokémon gathered around.

New family member!

"Ka-kaah."

Gengar rubbed its chin.

What kind of welcome ceremony should we give it later?

"Yoji~"

Larvitar was grinning stupidly.

This was a "real little brother," not like Victini and Regieleki who were simply and naively given the "little brother" title.

If Johan had noticed what Larvitar was thinking, he probably would have thrown cold water on it.

Who exactly was the "little brother" was still unclear.

"Caught it." Johan nodded, shrinking the Friend Ball and putting it back on his waist.

Let the little one rest well first, then introduce it to everyone when it woke up.

"They're still waiting for you over there." Cynthia glanced toward Mayor Ollivier and the others.

Right.

The Pokémon Catch Race!

Because of the sudden "Spore Medicine" outbreak, the "Pokémon Catch Race" had been forcibly interrupted.

But based on the quantity and quality of Pokémon Gengar had caught, winning was undisputable.

Z-Crystal!

When Johan walked over, Mayor Ollivier's secretary was already standing nearby holding an exquisite box.

This box was exactly what had been displayed during the "Pokémon Catch Race" earlier - the box containing the Z-Crystal.

"Teacher Johan, after our emergency calculations, you undisputedly won this 'Pokémon Catch Race' championship. Congratulations!" Mayor Ollivier smiled broadly and extended his hand in congratulation.

Originally, the Z-Crystal as a prize was meant to attract Lugia.

Now Lugia had not only come, but even brought a little Lugia.

It could be said the mission was completed beyond expectations.

As for... Lugia coming because of Johan rather than the friendly relationship between humans and Pokémon displayed by the competition, that wasn't important.

"Ka-kaah~ Ka-kaah~"

Gengar stepped past Johan and, under Ollivier's bewildered gaze, grabbed his hand.

Hahaha, congratulations all around~

Then it stared expectantly at the plain trophy and the box containing the Z-Crystal.

Johan smiled helplessly.

No choice, Gengar really had put in the effort for this competition.

Then the mayor's secretary, equally bewildered, handed the box and trophy to Gengar.

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar held the trophy in one hand and the prize in the other, raising them overhead in celebration.

Now, I'm also a champion!

Ollivier and his secretary exchanged glances.

Were Teacher Johan's Pokémon all this unique?

Gengar happily held the trophy and directly shoved the box to Johan.

Prize?

I want the trophy!

Opening the box.

Hm?

Seeing what was inside, Johan was stunned.

Because there wasn't just one Electric Z-Crystal inside, but also a grass-green crystal that looked like jade.

A Grass-type Z-Crystal?

Ollivier quickly explained:

"One is the prize, the other is thanks for Teacher Johan and your help to our Fula City."

A thank-you gift.

Hearing this, Johan showed some realization.

Wait.

Taking a thank-you gift meant he couldn't casually claim reimbursement, right?

But thinking again, wasn't one Z-Crystal worth more than reimbursement fees?

"Grass Z." He picked up the Grass-type Z-Crystal from the box, gently rubbing it twice.

"Fula City only had two Z-Crystals in stock. We were worried Teacher Johan couldn't use the Grass-type Z-Crystal, but now that you've caught Snivy... it's perfect timing." Ollivier smiled.

Indeed.

Originally Johan could have sold the extra Z-Crystal for money, but now he couldn't.

With Snivy's competitive personality, if it learned Johan had sold a Z-Crystal matching its type, wouldn't it stomp on his head in the middle of the night?

So...

Future goals: Normal Z, Bug Z, and Psychic Z!

Johan set his targets.

"Thank you."

He didn't pretend to be polite and accepted both Z-Crystals.

Useless items +2

Couldn't muster much joy.

Seeing Johan accept them, Ollivier felt relieved.

Good that he accepted them.

He needed to build a good relationship with Teacher Johan.

Just with his relationship with Lugia and little Lugia, if Fula City invited him to future Wind Festivals, wouldn't Lugia definitely come too?

Ollivier had his own little calculations.

"Mayor Ollivier." After putting away the Z-Crystals, Johan asked: "Will there still be a fireworks show tonight given today's situation?"

Ollivier was stunned.

Then he smiled: "There will be. The spore mist didn't affect the pre-prepared fireworks, and everyone..."

He looked around at everyone's faces showing "post-disaster" smiles, then said seriously: "Everyone also needs a grand celebration to soothe their frightened state."

"That's good." Johan smiled.

He had "lured" Cynthia here with the summer fireworks festival. If it got cancelled... while understandable given circumstances, it would be somewhat imperfect.

"Then Teacher Johan, I'll go handle other matters first."

After saying goodbye, Mayor Ollivier hurried off to deal with other issues.

One spore mist had nearly paralyzed all of Fula City, with countless matters requiring the mayor's attention.

Moreover, the power plant had only been restored to basic function by Johan and needed professional inspection, or who knew when it might catch fire again.

"Fula City is quite wealthy." Looking at Ollivier's departing car, Johan smacked his lips.

Taking out two Z-Crystals just like that.

"Got your prize?"

Seeing Johan walking over with a smile, Cynthia asked with a laugh.

"There's a share for you too."

"Mine?" Cynthia looked surprised.

Then Johan briefly explained.

That Grass-type Z-Crystal as a "thank-you gift" was actually from Ollivier representing Fula City to both him and Cynthia. Keeping it all would be inappropriate.

Moreover, Cynthia also had Roserade, a Grass-type Pokémon that could use it.

"Keep it yourself." But Cynthia directly refused.

"Eh?"

"I'm not used to Z-Moves."

Everyone had their own choices for Pokémon enhancement methods.

Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, Terastallization, etc.

Most people, due to ability, funding, preference and other factors, typically chose only one.

Johan opened his mouth, feeling somewhat regretful.

Too bad... couldn't see Cynthia dance.

Also couldn't "smoothly" share the Grass Z, and if Cynthia had taken it then given him money, that would be wonderful.

"One is enough for me." Saying this, Cynthia rolled up her sleeve, revealing the snow-white wrist with a Z-Ring and the Dragon Z on it.

Tsk.

Another reversal.

Pokémon enhancement methods were diverse, and some naturally conflicted.

For example, Mega Evolution definitely couldn't be used with Dynamax, and Z-Moves couldn't be used with Dynamax or Terastallization, since Dynamax moves were all Max Moves, and Terastallization moves got Tera boosts.

But whether Mega Evolution and Z-Moves could be used together... Johan had never tried.

"Alright then." Johan "reluctantly" put away the Grass Z again.

Cynthia blinked. "Aren't you going to show some appreciation?"

"Appreciation?"

She held up one finger with some playfulness: "One ice cream!"

Then very seriously added:

"Extra large!"

Looking at her serious yet cute expression, Johan couldn't help but laugh.

He sighed lightly.

"Sigh—"

"What?"

One ice cream and you're sighing...

Johan looked up at a forty-five degree angle, quite "melancholy":

"Changed, everything's changed."

"What changed?"

"Rich lady doesn't send money anymore, started deducting from me instead..."

Cynthia was stunned, meeting Johan's teasing gaze, then immediately raised her fist.

"Looking for trouble!"

"Garruu—!!"

Garchomp was delighted.

Let go, let me do it!

Night fell completely.

On the beach of the Wind Festival venue island.

The gentle sea breeze blew past, carrying the fresh scent of seawater mixed with some moisture and seaweed smell, creating rippling waves.

"Today... doesn't seem suitable for fireworks?"

Cynthia sat on the beach hugging her knees, looking at the black velvet-like clouds in the sky, speaking softly.

Many people on the beach shared similar thoughts.

No matter how you looked at it... it seemed like rain was coming.

Even the moon was gray and hazy.

Fula City's day had really been troubled from start to finish. When the moon first rose, it had been fine.

"No." Johan stood up. "Today, even if Kyogre came, it couldn't make it rain on me!"

Saying this, he called out:

"Lugia!"

"Bwooo—"

Above, Lugia, who was taking a post-dinner stroll with its child, heard Johan's call.

"Please, make the weather clear."

Don't want to see rain?

Simple.

What humans couldn't do, let legendary Pokémon handle!

"Bwooo~"

Lugia nodded.

Legend said Lugia could make a city rain for forty straight days with just a light flap of its wings.

Although later, due to Kyogre's appearance, its "Sea God" legend became a joke, as the "Ocean Current God," it could still easily control weather.

"Bwooo bwooo~~"

Little Lugia seemed more excited, flapping its wings and following its mother, vigorously flapping its wings. Then the clouds in the sky... drifted away a tiny bit.

"Bwooo!"

Little Lugia puffed out its cheeks.

Lugia gently patted its head, as if saying watch and learn.

Whoosh—

As Lugia's wings flapped, the clouds in the sky visibly retreated, and crystalline moonlight poured down like a waterfall again.

"Look."

Johan pointed at the round moon in the sky.

Cynthia faced the wind, tying back her golden hair and smiling:

"Johan, having legendary Pokémon exert themselves like this..."

"It's fine, we're all friends. No need for politeness." Johan waved his hand, sitting beside her.

Friends.

Not many people could be friends with legendary Pokémon, right?

"At worst, I'll treat them to dinner sometime!"

Nothing couldn't be solved with one meal, if not, then two!

Bang!!

Instantly, a brilliant firework burst in the night sky, dyeing it in rainbow colors.

Johan took out two pre-prepared sparklers from his pocket like presenting treasure, smiling:

"Fireworks festival, of course we have to set off our own too."

Sizzle sizzle sizzle—

Starlight reflected in Cynthia's eyes.

She watched this scene, slowly leaning on Johan's shoulder, quietly saying nothing.

As if in this moment, she just wanted to silently appreciate the fireworks, or perhaps just feel Johan's warmth.

"Ka-kaah~"

Dragonite, Urshifu, Gengar, Ceruledge, Ninetales, Regieleki, Tinkaton, Larvitar, Victini, Rotom, and Zygarde core sat in a row from big to small, watching the fireworks in the sky.

Gengar remembered the last time watching fireworks, there had only been it, Johan, and little Vulpix then.

"Oowoo."

Ninetales rested its head, smiling.

In just one short year, everyone... had grown so much.

Dragonite and Urshifu didn't have such complex thoughts, just thinking... so pretty, no wonder so many people liked watching fireworks.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar pointed at a firework that had just burst in the sky.

Doesn't that look like me!

[That's clearly Kommo-o.] Zygarde core said.

"Yoji."

Really? Clearly as handsome as me...

Zygarde core rolled its eyes.

Sure enough, trainers and Pokémon became alike after being together long - Larvitar was just as narcissistic as that human!

Zygarde core held its head high, imagining its complete form.

[Nothing's as handsome as my complete recovery form.]

It felt quite smug.

"Cha!"

Hey! It's a big bird!

Talonflame's firework excited Tinkaton.

"Garruu."

Coach Bear looked at Ceruledge.

Want to compete who can sit longer?

Ceruledge tilted its head, looking at Coach Bear like looking at an idiot.

"Goka?"

What's there to compete about?

Did training meditation make you stupid, Coach Bear?

Among martial artists, one emphasized movement and stillness - controlling movement with stillness, defeating effort with ease, overcoming hardness with softness to achieve victory through minimal effort.

Current Coach Bear had switched from non-stop punching to "sitting meditation" training mode.

"Garruu." Urshifu picked its ear.

You competing or not?

"Goka?"

What's the stakes?

"Garruu." Urshifu grinned.

If you win, I'll call you impressive!

"Goka!"

Let's compete!

For males, no one could escape the phrase "call you impressive" - it was the "biggest" bet.

Male Pokémon were the same.

Getting the answer, Urshifu grinned.

Heh.

"Garruu zzZ"

It held its head high and fell asleep.

Ceruledge: "???"

Buzz—

A Poké Ball on Johan's waist opened by itself. Snivy, having slept enough, stretched and lazily looked at the two figures nestled together, curled its lip, then walked toward Gengar and the others.

"Yoji!"

Larvitar squeezed next to Tinkaton, then patted the ground, indicating for Snivy to sit over.

By size, it should sit between Larvitar and Rotom.

But after scanning around, Snivy's eyes lit up.

Using vines to wrap around Dragonite's antennae, it climbed onto the biggest Dragonite's head, standing proudly.

"Sni!"

Your queen has returned!

All Pokémon: "???"

Under a tree by the beach, Zeraora crossed its arms, watching this scene, but somehow couldn't maintain its serious expression.

"Zeraaa."

Perhaps humans really were different from each other.

And perhaps the past was truly past...

"Zeraaa!"

Zeraora regained its composure and silently transformed into blue lightning, disappearing.

"Zeraora? Zeraora?"

Risa turned around to find Zeraora gone and couldn't help showing disappointment.

But she quickly brightened up.

Because she found only a fruit core remained from the delivered fruits.

After delivering food to Zeraora so many times, this was the first time it had eaten.

Beside the core was what looked like an aged, oddly-shaped whistle-like instrument with a strand of golden fur floating on it.

Risa hurried forward, carefully holding the instrument in her palm.

She understood.

Zeraora meant that when she needed it, she could blow this whistle and Zeraora would appear.

"Zeraora..." Risa whispered softly: "I just hope you... live a little happier."

On the rooftop, Zeraora watched this scene, its eyes flickering.

The gentle sea breeze blew, the sound of waves lapping the beach was covered by fireworks. Johan and Cynthia sat quietly, watching the sparklers in their hands burn out, but the flowing light in their eyes didn't disappear.

"Cynthia." Johan spoke softly.

Cynthia's eyes shimmered, her flushed face seeming to make everything else pale. Before Johan could finish, she lifted her head slightly.

One touch, one peck.

Johan froze in place, feeling the slight moisture on his cheek, with a... dreamlike, floating feeling throughout his body.

"I like you." Cynthia's voice, soft as a mosquito, gently sounded in his ear.

Johan, coming to his senses, grabbed her hand.

No good, about to float away.

Two days later, evening.

"Going back to Sinnoh tomorrow?"

Hearing this news suddenly, Johan felt quite surprised.

Cynthia tied up her hair, somewhat helpless and reluctant, but still said:

"I've already taken four days off, tomorrow makes five."

Already five days?

Johan felt somewhat dazed.

First time feeling time pass so quickly.

He subconsciously said: "If not... let Lucian work two more days overtime..."

Cynthia covered her mouth and laughed.

"It's not because of that."

"Then it's..."

She gradually became serious and solemn, looking at Johan quite earnestly:

"I'm preparing to challenge the Champion's Road!"

Champion's Road?!

Johan looked shocked.

Cynthia... was about to become Champion?

But thinking about it.

Made sense.

From after the "Youth World Championship" until now, Cynthia had been training hard.

Lucian had already become Elite Four, so Cynthia... it was indeed time.

As for whether she could succeed...

Of course she could!

Sinnoh region was the first to implement "youth transformation." Cynthia was the most outstanding among Sinnoh's youth, and even if she hadn't reached her peak, it was enough.

If Lance's Kanto Champion's Road was hell difficulty, then Sinnoh's Champion's Road... could only be considered upper-medium difficulty.

Mainly...

Lance had someone in Kanto who countered him perfectly.

While Cynthia in Sinnoh... looking at Lucian, Flint, and Aaron, they were all little brothers and allies.

However, Cynthia still took it extremely seriously, which was appropriate.

Upper-medium difficulty didn't mean it wasn't difficult, just relatively speaking.

After all, it was still the "Champion's Road"!

"Tell me when you're ready, I'll come watch." Johan said.

"You better come!"

Cynthia wrinkled her nose, raising her fist "threateningly" and shaking it twice.

"Door guardian" Garchomp showed its sharp scythe, looking fierce.

In-laws... truly terrifying.

Back in his room.

"Ka-ka-kaah?"

Gengar, lying by the window, met Johan's gaze.

"Yoji! Yoji!"

Below, Larvitar was calling out.

Snap—snap—

Two vines grabbed onto the windowsill, then Snivy quickly climbed up, standing on the windowsill and meeting Johan's gaze.

"Sni! (▼皿▼)"

Snivy not only wasn't afraid, but looked fierce.

These past two days.

Since Snivy joined the team, it went out "leveling" with Gengar and Larvitar every day.

According to Snivy, it had an excellent "leveling spot" here.

Look.

Just returned from "leveling" again.

Facing the "fierce" Snivy, Johan didn't indulge it, showing Gengar's signature evil grin. Under Snivy's "frightened" gaze, he picked it up.

Then held it in his arms for a thorough "rubbing."

"Sni-sni. (≧皿≦)"

Snivy went limp in Johan's arms, losing the ability to struggle.

Hmph.

Still couldn't handle you, little tsundere?

Johan was becoming more experienced with this little one.

"Rest well these two days. We're also going back to Hoenn soon. Then everyone will hold a welcoming ceremony for you."

"Sni~"

There were still many little ones at home who didn't know about Snivy's existence.

Anyway, they'd toured Kalos enough, time to return to Hoenn and reorganize.

Moreover, King AZ was still waiting for his Floette.

Soon.

After some commotion, the room gradually quieted down.

Johan also slowly entered dreamland. In his dream, he dreamed that Deoxys drove a spaceship and took Rayquaza away.

Then Groudon below sighed in relief: "Good thing I can't fly."

Kyogre mocked face-to-face: "That green caterpillar is nothing special."

Hoenn region.

Devon Corporation headquarters building.

"President!"

The president's secretary hurriedly ran into the president's office, seeing the old president and young master Steven.

"What's wrong? All flustered." The old man looked gentle, asking.

"The batch of ore that Young Master Steven brought back..." The secretary caught his breath, then continued: "It's reacting with a giant stone at the mining site!"

The old man's gaze sharpened.

"The batch from Petalburg City?"

"Yes."

"What happened?" Steven looked at the old man's serious expression, somewhat puzzled.

Stone reacting with stone was rare but not unprecedented. Why was father so serious?

"Let me go see."

Steven straightened his clothes and stood up.

"No."

But this time, the old man stopped him.

He waved at the secretary.

After the secretary left, facing Steven's confused gaze, the old man took a deep breath. After considering his words for a long time, his voice became somewhat hoarse:

"Steven, I've never told you, but our Devon's 'Infinity Energy' is actually..."

After hearing the old man's account, Steven also put away his relaxed expression.

Infinity Energy!

Also called "Life Energy"!

The key to Mega Stone creation.

Could Hoenn region also have such energy carriers?

Then...

With such a massive carrier as a giant stone appearing, would it cause some changes?

The old man smiled bitterly.

"But hopefully... I'm just being overly worried and cautious."

----------

Powerstones?

# 652: Testing Snivy's Abilities!

"Not coming with us?"

At the seaside of Fula City.

Cynthia had taken an early flight to Sinnoh this morning, not wanting to burden Garchomp again.

After wandering around Fula City for half a day, Johan decided it was time to leave. Everywhere held memories of him and Cynthia, making it too easy to get sentimental.

However, Johan didn't choose to fly, but opted to take a ship with the little ones.

There wasn't much else to it.

Mainly, Snivy had never been on a ship before.

It had spent most of its life after birth in Fula City, either at Fula City's Day Care or challenging opponents in the mountain forests outside Fula City. As for the ocean...

Although Fula City was coastal, Snivy had at most just watched ships sailing on the sea, never actually setting foot on the ocean.

So.

To satisfy the little one's curiosity about the ocean, Johan chose to travel by ship.

Quite coincidentally.

At this time, Fula City's port had docked a large but fast-sailing ship called the Seagallop, departing from the Kalos region to Hoenn, Kanto, and Johto.

Of course, mainly because Fula City's Wind Festival had brought many tourists from these regions, and now that the festival was over, they naturally needed to be taken back.

Facing Johan's question, the Zygarde core said:

[My duty is to maintain balance in the Kalos region.]

These past days following Johan, the Zygarde core had observed humans up close and gained more understanding of them.

It felt it needed to have a good talk with its "partner."

But most importantly, it had lost contact with its "partner" for some time and didn't know what had happened to it, so it was preparing to search for it.

"Too bad." Johan sighed lightly.

He really felt it was a shame.

Zygarde - what a great mecha, but it seemed he wouldn't get to pilot it.

After all, besides Zygarde, the two biggest guys in the Kalos region were Xerneas, who was already asleep, and Yveltal, who had run off somewhere unknown. Obviously they couldn't fight.

"Well then, goodbye."

Johan exhaled and smiled, speaking to the little creature on his shoulder.

Pop.

The Zygarde core jumped onto the nearby railing.

It had no hands, but Johan knew it was waving goodbye.

[Wait.]

Just as Johan was about to leave, the Zygarde core suddenly called out to him.

"What?" Johan asked with a smile. "Changed your mind?"

[No.]

The Zygarde core rolled its eyes irritably, then after brief hesitation and consideration, said:

[I feel... the energy in the Kalos region is somewhat active. Be careful.]

Energy in the Kalos region was active?

Johan was stunned.

Wasn't he just about to leave Kalos?

However, he didn't say much, just nodded: "I understand."

It seemed leaving quickly was the right choice...

"Well then, goodbye, Zygarde. If anything happens... call me."

Although the Zygarde core had no hands or phone, that didn't mean it couldn't make calls.

Anyway, Johan had already given it his phone number.

[I understand.]

Just like that, under the Zygarde core's watch, Johan boarded the returning Seagallop.

On the Seagallop's deck.

"Sni."

Snivy gripped the railing with both hands, watching Fula City grow more distant, its eyes inevitably showing some reluctance and faint nostalgia.

Although this place hadn't left it with many good memories, this was after all where it was born and had lived until now. Every corner of Fula City held shadows of its past efforts.

Having to leave suddenly, it inevitably felt reluctant and melancholy.

Standing beside it, leaning against the railing and letting the sea breeze blow through his hair, Johan could sense the little one's feelings. His face held a gentle smile.

"Leaving isn't necessarily a bad thing, is it?"

"Sni?"

Snivy tried to suppress the "weak" thoughts in its eyes and turned to look at Johan.

"Without leaving, how can there be return, how can there be reunion?"

"Leaving is for better encounters."

"Sni."

Snivy lowered its head, pondering Johan's words, its heavy heart gradually becoming lighter.

A hand rested on its head, and that gentle voice came again.

"Whenever you miss this place, we can come back anytime."

Snivy stared blankly at Johan's eyes...

After a while.

It suddenly snapped back to itself, showing a fierce expression.

"Sni-sni! (▼皿▼)"

Who-who would feel sad over something like this!

While saying this, it didn't brush away Johan's hand.

"Want to go see the outside world together?" Johan asked with a smile.

"Sni!"

This time Snivy didn't object, but nodded vigorously and clenched its fists.

This queen is setting out!

"Sni."

After the Seagallop had sailed for some time, in the third-floor room, Snivy lay against the window, looking at the torrential rain outside, then turned to look at Johan, who was sitting on the sofa reading.

This is what you call the outside world?

Not long after leaving port, it had suddenly started pouring rain. All the tourists were either hiding in their rooms or huddled in the ship's lounge area.

"It's raining, can't help it."

Johan was flipping through "The Essence of Earth."

Although he had read this book by Giovanni back and forth no less than twenty times, each reading brought some new insights.

This made him constantly marvel - truly worthy of Giovanni.

Even as a "villain," in certain aspects, he was still respectfully called a "master."

When it came to Pokémon training, Giovanni indeed had great insights.

Previously, when Johan read this book, it was to train Larvitar, Dragonite, Urshifu and the others, but this time, while reading, he found Giovanni's insights on training Grass-type Pokémon.

As the possessor of "Viridian Power" and one blessed by Viridian Forest, although Giovanni was called "Giovanni of the Earth," his relationship with forests and Grass-types was actually inseparable.

Therefore, in his "The Essence of Earth," he mentioned his understanding of Grass-type Pokémon to some extent.

For example, one passage—

Grass-type Pokémon certainly have plant attributes, but no matter what plant, fundamentally they all depend on the earth, need to draw nutrients from soil, so when dealing with Grass-type Pokémon, one cannot simply view them as having only a single attribute, even if they are pure Grass-types.

Grass and Ground types are inseparably connected.

This made Johan think of Larvitar and Snivy.

Could these two little ones cooperate perfectly?

"Boss Giovanni's book is still interesting..."

In Pokémon Adventures, after Green became Champion for a few minutes then lost to Red, he returned to Viridian City as Gym Leader, thus obtaining Giovanni's "The Essence of Earth" manual.

Afterward, he completely retrained his team from scratch, and in just one year, raised an entire team of new Pokémon to Champion-level strength - quite terrifying.

While this was partly due to Green's own ability as a "Trainer," he himself said "The Essence of Earth" was greatly inspiring to him.

"Sni!"

Seeing Johan completely absorbed in his book, Snivy puffed out its cheeks.

"Yoji~"

Larvitar walked over, reaching out to pat Snivy's shoulder while saying.

It's fine, it's fine, just some rain, I'm not even scared~

But Larvitar's hand... hit nothing.

"Sni!"

Snivy turned sideways, cleverly avoiding Larvitar's hand.

"Yoji?"

Seeing this, Larvitar immediately became interested. It thought Snivy was playing hide-and-seek with it, immediately grinned and pounced forward.

As the "second generation" leader, am I afraid of this?

Who knew, Snivy just tilted its head slightly, glanced at Larvitar sideways, then turned sideways again, once more avoiding Larvitar.

This time, Larvitar's playfulness really kicked in.

Before long, the room was filled with the two little ones' figures everywhere.

On Dragonite's head, under Ninetales' tails, in Gengar's mouth...

"Yoji-yoji."

Larvitar was panting heavily, looking at Snivy with somewhat disbelieving eyes.

While Snivy was also panting, its chest rising and falling dramatically, but it still maintained its "proud" appearance.

Couldn't catch it.

Larvitar actually couldn't catch Snivy.

Johan, who had been reading earlier, couldn't help but put down his book and look over due to the commotion the two little ones were making.

Seeing them both panting heavily, he laughed.

Larvitar was currently stronger than Snivy, and by quite a lot - this was undeniable.

Even though Snivy had a type advantage.

But...

Larvitar's weakest point was undoubtedly its speed.

If Larvitar competed in defense or strength, two Snivys wouldn't be enough.

While Snivy's greatest advantage was undoubtedly its speed.

What allowed it to face Froslass, another Pokémon with decent speed, without being easily defeated was precisely Snivy's agile movements and extremely quick reaction ability.

You had to know, that Froslass had the "Queenly Majesty" ability, meaning all "priority moves" like Fake Out and Quick Attack couldn't work in front of it.

This itself required Froslass to have extremely fast speed and reaction ability, but Snivy... seemed to have even more advantage in this area than Froslass?

After laughing, Johan was somewhat surprised.

Then he gave Gengar a look.

Gengar immediately understood.

"Ka-kaah~ kaah kaah kaah~~"

Hehehe, let me test you~

Having Gengar probe Snivy's abilities.

Although Johan knew Snivy wasn't weak, he honestly wasn't entirely clear about its current upper limits, having just caught it.

Gengar's form flashed, becoming a black mist, then...

Snivy was lifted by the scruff of its neck.

"Sni!! (#`皿)"

Snivy in mid-air looked fierce, baring its teeth and continuously kicking its feet.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar leaned close to Snivy.

That's it?

Johan: "..."

He rubbed his forehead.

Too hasty.

He'd also taken it for granted, having Gengar test Snivy's abilities.

Snivy was indeed a speed-focused Pokémon, but Gengar was even more so.

With Gengar's strength... this was a wasted test.

But no problem, Johan gave Ninetales a look. Ninetales was more understanding than Gengar.

"Oowoo~"

Sure enough, getting Johan's signal, Ninetales smiled gently, showing its sisterly gentleness, extending one tail from behind toward Snivy's head.

"Sni!"

Having just been caught by Gengar, how could Snivy be caught so easily again?

It immediately used all its strength to flee around the room.

However.

No matter how hard it tried, it ultimately couldn't escape Ninetales' tail.

Finally.

The soft, crystalline tail touched Snivy's cheek, gently stroking it.

Feeling Ninetales' gentleness and goodwill, Snivy, for the first time, didn't bare its teeth, but instead showed a somewhat embarrassed shy expression.

"Sni-sni."

Well.

Another one "conquered" by Ninetales.

However, having Ninetales act allowed Johan to sense Snivy's speed and agility.

This was definitely the confidence that allowed Snivy to battle Froslass.

Looking at Snivy, who resumed its "proud" appearance with head held high after Ninetales withdrew its tail, Johan rubbed his chin.

"Feel like... Froslass's 'Queenly Majesty' ability was majesty for nothing. Our Snivy is more like the real deal..."

Regarding why Snivy and Froslass fought... Johan had already understood.

The reason was very simple.

Purely because Snivy couldn't stand Froslass's proud attitude, though Froslass also couldn't stand this little one.

To put it more simply - among a group of Pokémon, there couldn't be two queens.

Bang!!

The massive Seagallop suddenly lurched, and all passengers on board could feel the significant shaking.

But soon the ship's announcement sounded.

"Sorry passengers, due to the effects of heavy rain and waves, some seaweed from other waters has been swept into the shipping lane. We are currently handling this emergency. We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused."

The announcement repeated three times, immediately calming the passengers.

Speaking of which.

With a large cruise ship like the Seagallop, ordinary Pokémon couldn't cause trouble even if they wanted to.

Moreover, on a cruise ship of this scale, there were definitely powerful trainers among the crew.

"Ka-kaah!"

A soaking wet Gengar suddenly floated in from outside the ship, shaking off water like a little dog, then excitedly pointing at the sea outside and shouting.

Obviously.

Gengar had wandered outside again at some point.

And the reason it was so excited was because...

There are dolphins, I saw dolphins!

Dolphins?

"Yoji!"

Larvitar rolled up from the ground with a grunt, excitedly calling to Johan.

Let's go see, let's go see!

Snivy looked somewhat puzzled at Larvitar, who was no longer panting heavily.

It had clearly been just as tired as itself, yet recovered so quickly?

And thick-skinned too...

Actually, Snivy never underestimated Larvitar. Having personally witnessed Larvitar battle, how could Snivy look down on it?

It was just...

Except for speed, Snivy was completely outmatched in defense, attack, recovery, and multiple other aspects!

"Let's go." Johan put on his coat and patted Snivy's head. "Let's go see the dolphins."

"Sni! (#`皿)"

It burrowed into Johan's clothes.

"Excuse me, sir... Teacher Johan?"

A sailor guarding the deck was about to stop them, as it was quite dangerous to go outside with the large rain and waves, but recognizing Teacher Johan, he immediately let them pass.

"What's the situation?" Johan didn't immediately go out, but asked first.

The sailor smiled bitterly and said: "Just like the announcement said, seaweed from other waters got swept into the shipping lane, then accidentally got caught in the propeller..."

After pausing, he lowered his voice and whispered:

"Actually, the bigger problem is that there's a Dragalge and four Skrelp living in that seaweed patch."

I see...

No wonder.

So it was Dragalge and Skrelp's seaweed, otherwise ordinary seaweed probably couldn't get caught in the propeller.

Johan nodded and asked: "Need help?"

"If it's Teacher Johan..."

The sailor quickly took out his radio to ask the first mate, then got a very clear and urgent answer.

"Quickly go to— (crossed out) please get Teacher Johan!"

Seems like quite a problem.

Johan said nothing more and walked out of the cabin.

Crash—

Heavy rain mixed with sea waves, the entire field of vision was gray and hazy, even the ocean seemed to turn black.

Wave crests continuously crashed against the cabin, blooming into white spray and washing over the bare deck.

Fortunately, the Seagallop had deep draft, so they couldn't feel much swaying.

"Let's go."

Walking to the deck's edge, amid Snivy's screams, Johan jumped vertically toward the churning seawater.

Splash—!!

"Sni-sni...?"

Snivy, covering its eyes, slowly released its hands and opened them. The expected feeling of water rushing and crashing didn't occur, and only then did it realize... all the seawater was blocked outside them, as if forming a bubble.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales beside Johan had a slight glow in its azure eyes, smiling gently at Snivy.

"Sni. (((//Д//)))"

Jumping down from Johan's embrace, Snivy felt like it was stepping on a soft water bed - soft and cool, yet without any moisture.

So amazing...

"Yoji? (●●)"

Larvitar seemed much more comfortable than Snivy. Its face was pressed tightly against the water bubble, staring at a Tentacruel that had just swum by. That face separated by water... immediately scared the Tentacruel so much that the gems on its head seemed to turn white, and it sprayed black ink before hurrying away.

Scared a jellyfish to death!

Snivy also curiously looked into the ocean, then saw...

"Ka-~ gurgle gurgle~ kaah~ gurgle gurgle~~"

A huge Gengar "transformed" into Magikarp form, swimming past them.

"Sni-sni?"

Snivy was so scared that the leaves on its body stood up.

"Garruu zzZ"

Then there was Coach Bear snoring, with standard swimming form, covering good distance with each stroke while pushing the water bubble forward, but was it really okay that it was sleeping with eyes closed?

However...

This was the ocean?

Setting aside Gengar and Urshifu, Snivy's eyes sparkled as it looked at the underwater world, which was much more magnificent than it had imagined.

Gengar led the way in front.

The dolphins it had seen were in the same direction as where the propeller was tangled with seaweed.

Then...

Soon Johan and the others saw a large patch of brownish-yellow seaweed floating in the ocean, with part of it already caught in the propeller and a larger portion floating in the sea.

Outside the seaweed, they could see the Seagallop's sailors and their Pokémon.

And...

A Dragalge with its seaweed-like tentacles spread out, looking fierce, with four Skrelp hiding in the seaweed behind it.

And the dolphins Gengar mentioned were also here.

"Finizen?"

A obviously smaller Finizen was also caught in the seaweed, while two larger ones, seemingly its parents, were outside looking anxious.

"What a complex situation..." Johan clicked his tongue twice.

Finizen were Pokémon first discovered in Paldea region waters, so they were also first registered in the Paldea region Pokédex.

"Finizen, Water-type Dolphin Pokémon. Very gentle by nature, skilled at using ultrasonic waves to sense direction and creatures' emotions, Rotom!"

Besides finding them quite cute, Johan's impression of Finizen was mainly of their evolution, Palafin.

Especially "Hero Form" Palafin.

"Zero Form" Palafin only had a base stat total of 457 points, but "Hero Form" Palafin... had a base stat total of 650!

It could be said to be second only to Slaking among ordinary Pokémon, and its appearance was also... ahem.

But Finizen were still very cute.

Additionally.

As Johan knew, there was a certain food chain relationship between Finizen and Dragalge/Skrelp.

Finizen were very fast, faster than most Dragalge could swim, so Dragalge would often hide in seaweed, waiting for Finizen to come foraging, then use poisonous attacks to paralyze them.

Now all of this had collided.

The Dragalge and Skrelp, the sailors and propeller, the Finizen and young Finizen - three parties were completely at an impasse.

No wonder the first mate had a headache.

As a renowned Pokémon psychologist, when the first mate heard Johan was willing to help, he immediately requested assistance.

Without Teacher Johan, he had no choice but to use force, driving away the Dragalge and Finizen, then untangling the seaweed from the propeller.

Buzz—

Johan didn't speak. Underwater communication was troublesome, so he directly used aura power, sensing the Dragalge's anxiety, the Finizen parents' worry, and the nervousness and fear of the Skrelp and young Finizen.

Soothing.

This wasn't very difficult for Johan now.

Especially after his aura power had been enhanced by Arceus.

"Gengar, Coach Bear."

Johan closed his eyes and spoke softly.

"Ka-~ gurgle gurgle~ kaah~ gurgle gurgle~ cough cough cough~"

"Garruu zzZ"

Gengar helped rescue the four young Skrelp, Urshifu helped rescue the young Finizen. Seeing this, Snivy extended its vines to help sort through the tangled seaweed more quickly, successfully rescuing all the little ones.

The sailors immediately breathed a sigh of relief and quickly dealt with the seaweed tangled in the propeller.

Smooth.

And satisfying to all parties.

"Sni."

Snivy, lying on the water bubble, witnessed the entire process and couldn't help but turn back to look at Johan standing behind it with a smile.

Recalling the spore mist incident in Fula City a few days ago...

"Sni."

Snivy's face also unconsciously showed a smile.

On the Seagallop's deck.

"Ka-kaah~~"

In the heavy rain, Gengar waved at the Dragalge and Skrelp, holding some poisonous seaweed in its other hand as snacks.

The taste was pretty good - crunchy with a seafood flavor.

"Woo woo woo~~"

On the other side, the Finizen family also swayed their bodies at Johan and the others, expressing gratitude.

Splash—

A Finizen suddenly surrounded itself with water and rushed toward the deck.

Aqua Jet!

"Sni!"

Standing on the railing, Snivy almost instinctively dodged the charging Finizen with an extremely agile and graceful movement.

Hm?

Seeing this scene, Johan raised an eyebrow.

Although Finizen was being grateful without any attack intent, Aqua Jet was still a priority move, and Snivy's reaction speed...

"Could it be... besides the 'Contrary' ability, it also has a hidden 'Queenly Majesty' ability?"

Johan grimaced.

This Pokémon was unreasonable.

Is it mine?

Then never mind.

Finizen left a light blue scale shimmering with faint light, then swished its tail and returned to the water.

Soon it was tumbling on the sea surface before disappearing.

"Sni?"

Snivy picked up the strange scale, examined it carefully, and finding nothing special, handed it to Johan.

"I... I can't tell what it is either."

Johan was helpless.

Since Finizen were Dolphin Pokémon without scales, otherwise that would be the obvious guess.

But now this clearly couldn't be a Finizen scale...

"Whatever, it's a thank-you gift anyway."

Setting that aside, today's testing of Snivy was very successful!

He already had a general direction for how to train it.

----------

# 653: Teacher Johan's Reputation is Really Great

Hoenn region, one of Devon Corporation's mining sites.

Hazy mist shrouded the surroundings, making visibility very low, with only faint lights visible in the distance.

This place seemed to be located deep in some mountains, perpetually covered by white mist.

Carrying a white briefcase, Steven arrived here by helicopter.

Two Aron were visible pushing rocks slowly - this was their dinner.

And upon seeing humans, the two little ones didn't seem afraid at all, continuing their work.

At this time, what was originally just the central area of the mining site had been cordoned off with warning tape, with tents set up and numerous staff members in researcher uniforms busily working.

Steven walked straight in, with workers immediately opening the cordon for him.

Arriving at the center of the mining site, after excavation and polishing by Devon Corporation staff, a strange ancient altar that had been buried was now presented before Steven.

On that altar were two broken pillars and some strange patterns.

"The giant stone... became an altar?" Seeing this appearance, Steven was somewhat surprised.

A nearby worker said helplessly:

"Originally this giant stone was extremely hard. Considering it might affect the structure and stability of the entire mining site, we didn't touch it. But after the batch of energy ore you brought arrived at the mining site, the giant stone developed numerous cracks on its own..."

Finally, with careful handling by the workers, they managed to extract this altar.

"Energy ore?"

Wasn't what he brought from Petalburg City just ordinary ore?

However, Steven didn't dwell too much on this question.

"Where is it?"

"On top, we didn't move it."

The worker led Steven to the top of the altar. Stepping on the strange patterns, Steven felt something unusual in his heart.

Soon reaching the top of the altar, beside the two ancient but still very solid stone pillars, Steven saw what he called the "thing."

A... broken and ancient wooden tablet.

Opening his briefcase, this wooden tablet fit perfectly inside.

"Do you know what's written on it?" Steven asked.

"We're still waiting for the company's archaeology team to decipher it," the worker answered honestly.

"Too slow." Steven frowned slightly.

The worker was also helpless about this: "This is an ancient but uncommon script, seemingly used by some ancient Hoenn period tribe, so..."

"It's fine." Steven waved his hand, his voice gentle, indicating he wasn't blaming anyone.

He took out his phone: "I'll find a professional to help take a look."

Saying this, he directly took a photo of the wooden tablet and sent it to the "Teacher Johan's Little Classroom" group chat.

[Stone-digging Steven]: (wooden tablet.jpg)

The group quickly became active.

[Still-working-overtime Lucian]: Wow! Such ancient and rare writing.

As someone who had read through the Canalave Library extensively, Lucian was also surprised by the rarity of the ancient script on the wooden tablet.

[My-name-is-Flint]: Hey Lucian, aren't you working overtime?! @Still-working-overtime Lucian

[Still-working-overtime Lucian]: Who are you? @My-name-is-Flint

[Stone-digging Steven]: Everyone, does anyone recognize this script? Online and waiting, quite urgent.

[Dragon-tamer Lance]: It is very ancient, I don't really understand this kind of thing.

[Princess Caitlin]: For this kind of thing, you should ask my family's Cynthia. @Very-busy Cynthia

[Stab-you-to-death]: You could also ask Teacher Johan. @Teacher Johan

[Dragon-tamer Lance]: Who are you? @Stab-you-to-death

[Stab-you-to-death]: Come to Seven Island, I'll stab you to death!

[Dragon-tamer Lance]: Running away, running away.

Looking at the messages jumping through the group, Steven couldn't control the upward curve of his mouth, but his expression also showed helplessness as he covered his forehead.

The worker nearby was very curious seeing the young master's expression of both amusement and melancholy.

Could this be a Champion and Elite Four group?

[Stone-digging Steven]: @Teacher Johan, @Very-busy Cynthia

However, neither responded.

[Still-working-overtime Lucian]: Big sis just returned from Kalos two days ago, probably already on Mt. Coronet now, where the signal isn't great.

Kalos?

Cynthia went to the Kalos region to find Teacher Johan?

Steven knew about Johan's summer vacation in Kalos.

[Stone-digging Steven]: What about Teacher? @Teacher Johan

[My-name-is-Flint]: Generally speaking, when Teacher Johan doesn't appear, there are two reasons.

Hm?

Two reasons?

[My-name-is-Flint]: First, he probably didn't see the message, or like big sis, has poor signal.

[My-name-is-Flint]: The second reason would be troublesome...

[Stone-digging Steven]: Accept the challenge once.

Holding his phone, Flint grinned widely and quickly typed.

[My-name-is-Flint]: The second reason is that this thing involves something too big, and Teacher Johan needs to digest it.

Something too big?

Steven frowned tightly, looking at the wooden tablet in his briefcase, his heart inevitably feeling heavy.

[My-name-is-Flint]: But with Teacher Johan's personality, no matter how big the matter, it's not a problem. Steven, just do your best, leave the rest to Teacher Johan.

[Still-working-overtime Lucian]: Flint, you can actually say something so reasonable?

[My-name-is-Flint]: Of course! (Proud Infernape.jpg) Wait! Didn't you say you didn't know me?

Watching the group become lively again, Steven smiled and put away his phone.

He had to admit that what Flint said was indeed very reasonable.

Suddenly, his psychological pressure decreased considerably.

When the sky falls, there are tall people to hold it up. The feeling of having a reliable teacher behind you... was really good.

Once his mood relaxed, he actually gained some "insight."

In the group.

[Sootopolis Wallace]: I... might know something.

"When the sky falls, there are tall people to hold it up, don't be nervous."

The storm had continued for two days, and today's rain was particularly heavy, with strong sea winds and large waves. Even with the Seagallop's displacement, there was inevitable swaying.

This made Snivy somewhat nervous.

Although Johan was also curious why the Seagallop chose to sail during such weather conditions, with continuous storms and lightning all the way, it seemed particularly impressive.

But the Seagallop was indeed stable. Even with waves crashing one after another outside, the Seagallop only swayed slightly.

The signal was just consistently poor, making it impossible to go on deck to sunbathe or fish.

But it wasn't a big deal.

At most... let "Kyogre" be arrogant for a few more days. If it had the ability to storm the entire sea route from Kalos to Hoenn, then "Kyogre" would be impressive.

"Sni-sni!"

I-I'm not nervous at all!

Snivy stubbornly declared.

"Look at Larvitar."

"Yoji~burp~Yoji?"

Larvitar, sitting in the room leisurely munching on diamonds and even swaying happily with the ship's motion, looked up with crystalline particles still at the corners of its mouth, lightly burping with a confused expression.

Johan smiled: "The little one who should be most afraid of water is completely carefree."

"Sni! (#`皿)"

Snivy called out to Larvitar.

It's fine, keep eating!

"Yoji~"

Oh~

Larvitar buried its head and continued eating.

If you're not serious about eating, there's something wrong with your thinking.

Full?

Burping didn't mean it was full.

"Sni! (▼皿▼)"

Snivy directly climbed onto Johan's head and started stepping on it.

I told you not to say that, I'm not afraid! Not afraid at all! Not nervous either!

While calling out, its movements were actually quite gentle, even giving a massage-like feeling.

Johan smiled.

This little one was typically sharp-tongued but soft-hearted, acting tougher than anyone else but actually...

Johan half-leaned back on the sofa, letting Snivy "vent," just feeling comfortable enough to close his eyes.

Unlike Gengar - when Gengar wanted you to close your eyes, you really shouldn't expect to open them fully again.

"Speaking of which."

Johan put his hands behind his head.

"Larvitar plus Snivy feels like another excuse to dominate the Baby Cup?"

The "Master Trainer" certification was just harder to obtain.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar floated in from the balcony glass, soaking wet, then floated beside Ceruledge, extending both hands like warming by a fire. Soon its body was dry.

On the balcony.

Urshifu also climbed up, shaking its body vigorously to shake off all the water droplets, but its fur became droopy as a result.

This was perhaps why Rapid Strike and Single Strike Forms had different fur styles.

However, Urshifu was holding something in its hands.

Several lively jumping sea fish.

Pushing the door open, it handed the fish to Rotom, then also ran to Ceruledge's side to warm up like Gengar.

Ceruledge was already used to this.

These two days, Gengar, Urshifu, and Dragonite would team up and go out for strolls, wreaking havoc on the sea floor Pokémon, cough, no, engaging in friendly exchanges with the sea floor Pokémon.

"Oven form, Rotom!"

Rotom transformed into Heat Rotom, putting the already-processed fish into the oven to roast directly.

Daily variety meals were also inevitable.

They even varied the flavors.

Not only had they eaten grilled fish, but also grilled octopus, grilled conch, grilled lobster, etc.

Johan suspected that if he let them eat freely, they could probably destroy an entire marine ecosystem, so he limited them to eating just a little each day.

This also added some novelty to the boring, tedious sea voyage under the storm.

Watching the little ones gather around Rotom's oven with eager expressions, Johan stretched his body and sank deeply into the sofa.

Although such days were a bit boring.

He had to admit that compared to various magnificent major events, he still preferred this kind of lazy, leisurely life.

"Sure enough."

Johan yawned.

"I'm still a homebody at heart."

World peace would be great~

So...

Cynthia was about to become Champion, so Steven probably wouldn't be far behind either.

Similar to Cynthia, Steven's strength might still be far from its peak, but... considering the Hoenn League's staff shortage, no, it should be said the shortage of capable staff... it was probably soon.

At that time.

As the Champion's boyfriend and another Champion's teacher...

Highlighting status and comfort~

Hoenn region.

"Draconid script?"

Steven looked at Wallace sitting across from him, somewhat understanding yet somewhat puzzled.

Wallace was a descendant of the ancient Sootopolis people, who were as renowned as the Draconids, and in ancient times, the Draconids and Sootopolis people had some connections.

Therefore, Wallace barely knew something about this wooden tablet's origin.

So...

Wallace was brought over by Steven.

"Can you decipher this script?" Steven couldn't help but ask.

Wallace rubbed his temples.

"It's a bit difficult."

After all, he was from the Sootopolis people, and moreover a descendant. Just knowing this much was already quite knowledgeable.

Wallace leaned down, staring at the wooden tablet, saying intermittently:

"I can only decipher part of it. Giant stone... path... door, key light? No, glowing stone?"

"No, no."

Wallace shook his head and sat back in his chair.

"Too ancient, and this wooden tablet seems incomplete to begin with. I can only try to decipher it based on Sootopolis people's ancient script."

After all, Wallace wasn't studying archaeology.

"Door? Path? Glowing stone?"

Steven frowned tightly.

These contents were fragmented, just a few nouns. Who could tell what was what?

"Wait."

Steven suddenly seemed to think of something and ran out of the tent.

Wallace didn't understand what was wrong with him but followed anyway.

Soon.

The two arrived at the previous altar again. Steven stood in front of the two massive and broken stone pillars, saying:

"Wallace, look, do these pillars plus the altar... look like a door?"

Hearing this, Wallace was stunned, then shrugged helplessly:

"Steven, if you're going to stretch it like that, there are many doors."

Steven rubbed his nose, knowing he was being a bit far-fetched.

"Door, path..."

These two words were too broad.

Only the word "stone" had "glowing" as a descriptor, making it relatively easier to find.

"Glowing stone..." Steven murmured.

Wallace looked around and couldn't help but gently touch the stone pillar.

The rough texture showed ancient traces.

The patterns on it...

Wallace's gaze followed the patterns until it swept past the stone on his wrist bracelet that emitted faint rainbow light...

!!!

Wallace suddenly turned to look at Steven.

At the same time, Steven also looked at him with some excitement.

The two almost spoke in unison:

"Mega Stone!"

There were many glowing stones, and Mega Stones were the first thing both thought of simultaneously.

"Speaking of which, there are some groove marks here." Steven said.

"Same here." Wallace touched the other stone pillar, feeling the traces within.

The two exchanged glances again.

Try it?

Try it!

Anyway, they were just guessing, and there was a high probability they were wrong.

So.

Steven and Wallace both took out their respective Mega Stones and placed them in the grooves.

Buzz—

Almost instantly.

Their Mega Stones burst with brilliant rainbow light, and this light quickly spread along the patterns on the stone pillars and altar, finally forming a path leading to the mountain peak shrouded in clouds and mist.

The Devon Corporation employees below saw this scene and all ran out, looking shocked.

Actually, Steven and Wallace weren't much better.

They looked in amazement at the stairway that appeared before them.

"Door?" Wallace said softly.

"Path?" Steven also said.

It seemed like everything suddenly matched up?

The two climbed the steps.

Soon they arrived at another altar on the mountaintop, larger and relatively more complete. The rainbow light spreading from the lower altar converged at the center of this larger altar.

Click—

With a mechanical sound, a crack opened in the center of the altar.

Then.

A stone also emitting rainbow light, no, it should be said emitting extremely dazzling rainbow light with iridescent radiance, slowly rose from within.

"This is..."

Seeing this stone he had never seen before, Steven's heart shook violently.

"A Mega Stone?" Wallace was also full of disbelief, murmuring.

Such a large Mega Stone?

This was something neither had imagined.

However.

Before the two could recover from their shock.

Roar!!

A dull thunder-like explosion suddenly erupted from the sky, and a huge cyan dragon shadow appeared in the thick, dense clouds.

Steven and Wallace almost simultaneously felt an extremely strong sense of danger. Both stepped back several steps and grabbed their Poké Balls.

When the green figure in the clouds quickly approached and completely appeared in their sight, their pupils contracted to pinhole size!

A green giant dragon soaring through the sky, with heart-palpitating powerful pressure and crimson eyes full of contempt...

The legendary Sky Dragon, Rayquaza!!

"Roar!!"

A roar faintly carrying anger, like thunder exploding in their ears, made them tense up sharply. The strong airflow made their clothes flutter and their hair fly wildly.

"Rayquaza..." Steven said in a slightly hoarse voice.

Wallace swallowed.

Who was he? Where was he? What was he here to do?

Right.

He had clearly just come to help Steven decipher a wooden tablet. How did he end up seeing the legendary Rayquaza?

Although this wasn't their first time seeing Rayquaza - when Rayquaza battled the extraterrestrial visitor Deoxys at Mossdeep City, they had seen it from afar.

But distant observation was completely different from the almost close-up feeling now.

But soon.

Steven and Wallace quickly calmed down.

Even if it was Rayquaza, they also...

"Roar!!"

Rayquaza roared again, quickly circling in the air, then diving straight toward the huge rainbow stone in the center of the altar.

Then.

Steven and Wallace witnessed the most shocking thing of their lives.

Buzz—

They saw.

Rayquaza's body burst with the familiar light of Mega Evolution. Under the rainbow light mixed with evolutionary light, the huge rainbow stone disappeared into thin air. Above Rayquaza's head, the symbol of Mega Evolution appeared and quickly dissipated.

"Mega Evolution?" Wallace opened his mouth, not knowing what to say for a moment.

The legendary divine beast, Sky Dragon Rayquaza, actually... Mega Evolved?

"Roar—!!"

The rainbow light faded, and Rayquaza reappeared in their sight, its appearance greatly changed.

"Mega Rayquaza..."

[You... are not the inheritors!]

Mega Rayquaza's aggressive gaze swept over Steven and Wallace.

Inheritors?

Steven and Wallace exchanged glances.

As a descendant of the Sootopolis people, Wallace seemed to understand something...

"The Draconid legend?"

"Legend?"

Wallace's mouth drooped as he spoke quickly:

"Legend says that a thousand years ago, a huge meteorite was about to impact the Hoenn continent. The Draconids of that time prayed to a rainbow meteorite for Rayquaza's help, and Rayquaza responded to this wish, ultimately resolving the crisis."

"Meteorite? Wish?"

"The legend has a second half. It's said that a thousand years later, another huge meteorite will appear. At that time, the inheritor will again find Rayquaza and try to gain Rayquaza's recognition, finally... resolving the crisis together."

As a descendant of the Sootopolis people, Wallace was not only the Sootopolis Gym Leader but also the guardian of the Sky Pillar.

The Sky Pillar was said to be where inheritors tried to gain Rayquaza's trial.

However, after so many years, inheritance would inevitably have gaps. Wallace hadn't previously connected this matter with Steven's wooden tablet.

Now he understood.

This stone that allowed Rayquaza to Mega Evolve was exactly the stone worshipped by the Draconids a thousand years ago, their only means of contacting Rayquaza!

Steven focused more on the content of Wallace's words.

Another huge meteorite?

Now that Rayquaza appeared, didn't that mean...

[Considering your relationship with him, I won't make things difficult for you.]

Rayquaza coldly glanced at them, said no more, flicked its tail and shot toward the clouds. The Mega Evolution characteristics on its body also quickly faded, returning to its original appearance.

But.

Along with Rayquaza's departure, the huge rainbow stone from before also disappeared.

Watching Rayquaza leave, Steven and Wallace both breathed a sigh of relief.

Although they weren't afraid of challenges, it was better not to have such challenges if possible.

As for who the "him" Rayquaza mentioned was...

"Teacher Johan's reputation is really great." Wallace clicked his tongue in amazement.

Steven nodded in deep agreement, showing some pride.

My teacher's reputation is indeed great.

But soon.

Both realized the seriousness of this incident.

The key point wasn't Rayquaza's appearance or Rayquaza's Mega Evolution, but the Draconid prophecy.

The words "a thousand years later" were too vague - who knew which year it was.

But Rayquaza's appearance and their discovery of this huge rainbow stone seemed to confirm something.

Moreover...

"I feel this rainbow stone's appearance won't be this 'simple.'"

A stone that could make even Rayquaza Mega Evolve would surely bring something.

This made Steven and Wallace feel heavy-hearted.

If they hadn't curiously tried to open this path, this door, and release this rainbow stone, maybe nothing would have happened.

If it really was as they thought, accompanied by a series of troubles or even disasters...

"I'll go inquire about the situation at Mossdeep Space Center." Steven said.

"I'll return to Sootopolis City and go through the Sootopolis people's ancient texts again to see if I can get more information." Wallace said.

At this moment.

Johan was still leisurely on his way back.
