# 666: Gengar's New "Little Brother," Hoopa (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Thank you very much, Ramos."

Having obtained a large pile of books about agriculture, farming, and such from Ramos, Johan was quite satisfied.

"Haha, very few young people like these things nowadays. You're one, Yarrow from Galar is another—both good kids."

Ramos stroked his white beard, looking very pleased.

He usually enjoyed drinking tea, tending his fields, and reading books, and Johan was surprisingly similar to him in certain aspects.

After staying in Coumarine City for two days, Johan finally got what he wanted.

At the same time, AZ had successfully completed modifying that aircraft. Now "Chesnaught" was helping him carry those books onto the aircraft.

"But that Snivy of yours..."

As they chatted, Ramos inevitably brought up Johan's Snivy.

"Sni—"

Seeming to hear Ramos's voice, Snivy, who was photosynthesizing, glanced at him sideways.

"Cough cough." Ramos coughed lightly. "I really can't understand it."

As a trainer specializing in Grass-type Pokémon for decades, this was the first time he'd seen a Pokémon like Johan's Snivy.

"Uh..."

Johan rubbed his nose and gave a dry laugh.

"However, this thing can be given to you as a gift."

Just when Johan thought Ramos was going to pull out a Badge, Ramos produced a TM and some "Grass Seeds."

"This is..."

"Grass Knot, it's the move this old man is most skilled with. These 'Grass Seeds' can assist in learning this move." Ramos said cheerfully.

"This is really... thank you so much."

Johan didn't refuse.

While Grass Knot might not be particularly useful in games, in the Pokémon world, when used well, it could have miraculous effects.

Moreover...

Johan also wanted to use this TM to verify certain things about Snivy.

After bidding farewell to Ramos.

Johan brought his little ones, along with the exhausted Flint, aboard this aircraft that originated from Pokémon thieves and benefited from King AZ's modifications.

It had to be said...

"Getting things for free just feels great."

This aircraft wasn't large and naturally couldn't compare to the luxurious private jets of Steven's family.

But this aircraft was originally the father-daughter thieves' vehicle, so the space was very ample for Johan alone, and even summoning all the little ones left them with some room to move around.

Of course, most importantly, this aircraft had high-tech functions like autopilot and invisibility, and its flight speed wasn't slow either.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar lay at the cockpit door, looking eager to try operating it.

"Is this really for me? Roto?"

Rotom was no less excited than Gengar.

Flying a plane—has Rotom finally reached the level where it can fly planes?

Such achievement! (T▽T)

"Rotom!" Johan called with a smile after boarding the aircraft.

"Here, Roto!"

"Activate aircraft mode!"

"Super transformation! Roto!"

The Pokédex fell into Gengar's hands as Rotom transformed into a golden electric current and drilled into the aircraft's control system.

"Regieleki." Johan threw another Poké Ball.

"Regi—"

As Regieleki entered the turbine, the aircraft's speed immediately increased.

While Rotom's own electricity could operate this aircraft, wasn't Regieleki a natural "engine"? It had to be put to good use.

Flint, who had finally caught his breath, looked on with envy, taking out his phone to snap a few photos of the aircraft and posting them to their group chat.

Between the lines was thick envy—no, jealousy!

[Elite Four Flint]: (Picture.jpg) Tsk tsk, look at Teacher Johan's new ride, pure electric power, built-in intelligent autopilot and invisibility functions, top speed of...

[Still Working Overtime Lucian]: I, Lucian, am officially envious!

[Dragon Tamer Lance]: +1

[Taking Ads]: +1

After that, the group was filled with "+1"s.

As they say...

It's not that we fear our brothers living poorly, but that our brothers drive Land Rovers.

"Speak up."

After arranging everything, Johan sat before Flint and smiled. "Where to? I'll give you a ride."

As the saying goes, when good fortune comes, spirits soar.

The flying equipment he'd been longing for had finally arrived, and the power source was almost free—this was exactly the kind of aircraft Johan was most satisfied with.

Flint pursed his lips.

Look how smug you're getting.

Isn't it just showing off that you have an exhibition match with appearance fees?

But free rides were free rides.

"Dahara City."

Johan nodded. "Rotom, destination: Dahara City..."

Hm?

Having just said the city's name, Johan couldn't help but freeze.

Wait!

"Where?"

He turned back, looking at Flint with disbelief.

But Flint was currently watching a Mandibuzz passing by the window and hadn't noticed Johan's expression, just shrugging casually. "Dahara City."

Previously Johan had asked him, but he hadn't remembered. Now with time approaching, he'd deliberately checked his mission records and finally recalled.

He also explained:

"They say Dahara City is holding some... Desert Tower Festival, and invited quite a few famous trainers to attend."

Johan: "..."

Dahara City...

Johan had a deep impression of this city, for no other reason... because the Hoopa he'd been constantly thinking about, the one that "crushed Giratina," lived in Dahara City!

And in the movie "Hoopa and the Clash of Ages," it had exaggeratedly summoned six legendary Pokémon!

Including Groudon, Kyogre, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, and Kyurem!

Plus Hoopa itself—seven legendary Pokémon total!

And Rayquaza's most famous legendary battle, that one-against-seven fight, also originated from this.

Of course, there was also Groudon's "famous battle"—everyone else was flying, but not me.

This battle between legendary Pokémon could be called the ultimate in the Pokémon world!

Honestly.

Johan immediately wanted to throw Flint out and then turn around to leave the Kalos region.

But seeing his "confused" expression, Johan twitched his mouth corner, took a deep breath, and suppressed this impulse.

If he'd known Flint's destination was Dahara City, he never would have come to Kalos with him.

But now...

Buzz—

Just as Johan was about to say something, he suddenly felt something unusual about the "Millennium Wrist" in his inner pocket.

This made Johan's thoughts stir slightly.

When he'd first obtained the Millennium Wrist from Arceus, it had vaguely pointed toward the Kalos region.

Johan had originally thought Arceus wanted him to help retrieve the Fairy Plate from Xerneas, but later learned the Fairy Plate had actually been borrowed by the Guardian deities of the Alola region.

At that time he'd wondered whether Arceus didn't know the Fairy Plate's whereabouts.

But now it seemed...

Could it be that Arceus's "Millennium Wrist" had been pointing toward Dahara City, or rather the Valley of Creation, from the beginning?

Regarding Hoopa, Johan naturally had some wariness, after all, when fully unleashed, its abilities were too exaggerated.

Especially with the "shadow" that loved causing trouble controlling Hoopa's fully unleashed power.

But...

Johan was somewhat interested in the Prison Bottle.

As everyone knows.

In Michina, Arceus had fused five plates—Ground, Water, Grass, Dragon, and Electric—into the "Life Jewel" and lent it to Damos, allowing him to use the Life Jewel's power to develop Michina.

And in Dahara City, Arceus had similarly left the power of three plates—Earth, Water, and Fire—to create the "Prison Bottle" that sealed Hoopa's "shadow" power.

The Earth Plate...

Tyranitar had eaten its plate fragment in one bite, and now could only "make do" with Red Orb fragments.

And honestly speaking...

"Even if I really had to face fully unleashed Hoopa in all-out war... I wouldn't be afraid, right?" Johan gently rubbed his chin.

In his previous life, there were two theories about the Pokémon Hoopa summoned.

One said the legendary Pokémon summoned by unleashed Hoopa actually came from different timelines and universes than his own.

The other said the legendary Pokémon summoned by unleashed Hoopa were from the same timeline, though the black Rayquaza was hard to explain.

But regardless of which...

"Groudon, Kyogre, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Kyurem..."

Johan silently counted on his fingers.

"Still remaining: Mewtwo, Rayquaza, the black and white dragons, Regigigas, Lugia, Darkrai, two Deoxys..."

"Moreover, Rayquaza pressing down Groudon and Kyogre has no pressure..."

What's more.

With Johan's current strength, when Gengar, Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite, and others went all out, temporarily holding off one legendary Pokémon shouldn't be a problem.

After calculating, Johan discovered.

His side...

Actually had a numerical advantage!

"Unknowingly... my network in the Pokémon world has become this exaggerated?"

He couldn't help feeling somewhat proud.

"In the future, calling myself a 'human Hoopa' shouldn't get any objections, right?"

Of course.

Everyone being willing to help was them giving him face, but he couldn't take this assistance for granted—this was still different from his own Pokémon.

For example.

Last time when he called the black and white dragons and Darkrai for help, afterward... Darkrai had "sneakily" moved away a cart of energy cubes, leaving him both crying and laughing.

So when asking everyone for help, a big feast was unavoidable.

With legendary Pokémon appetites...

Tsk.

This fighting was purely about his wallet!

When battles could be avoided, naturally it was better not to fight, otherwise his already insufficient wallet might easily become completely flat.

"But this way Giratina might be found..."

Putting away his complex thoughts.

"Looking at it this way... Dahara City doesn't need to be so feared. Just Hoopa..."

Looking at Flint again.

"Teacher Johan, what were you... counting on your fingers?" Flint, who had turned around, asked curiously.

Johan rolled his eyes and said casually:

"I was counting how many debts you owe me now."

Flint's eyes widened as he shrank back, thinking of Johan's earlier posture where two hands weren't enough. "Are, are there that many?"

"Heh." Johan chuckled. "This is just the beginning."

Including this trip to send Flint.

While he might not necessarily encounter the Hoopa incident, but... whether he encountered it or not, this "adventure's" bill would definitely be charged to Flint.

Seeing this, Flint lowered his voice and asked cautiously:

"Is it more than 100,000 Pokédollars?"

100,000?

Pokédollars?

Heh heh.

Kalos region, Dahara City.

A very developed city located in the desert.

In Dahara City's central area, high-rises stood like forests, comparable even to Kanaz City in the Hoenn region.

And in the outer areas, there were relatively lower but extremely solid square-shaped white stone houses that better suited the desert characteristics.

While Dahara City was said to be in the desert, looking from afar one could see this city's water resources weren't scarce—large and small rivers flowed throughout the city, and outside the town was a large azure freshwater lake.

It was said.

Over a hundred years ago, Dahara City was actually a very barren and resource-poor small town.

But the appearance of one Pokémon brought enormous wealth to this small town, and the town rapidly developed under this wealth.

But as the saying goes, "when basic needs are met, desires arise." As the town developed, inevitably some troublemakers appeared who questioned that Pokémon which had brought great wealth to Dahara City, asking whether it could win if it battled other Pokémon.

And it was precisely this questioning that opened the town's "Pandora's box."

That Pokémon which had brought great wealth to the then-Dahara town was naturally the fully unleashed Hoopa with freely controlled abilities!

It started with ordinary Pokémon, then pseudo-legendary Pokémon, all easily defeating them while earning cheers and praise from Dahara town residents.

Gradually, Hoopa was no longer satisfied with "bullying" ordinary Pokémon, until one day, it summoned legendary Pokémon!

Regigigas, who dragged continents!

Zekrom, representing ideals!

Reshiram, representing truth!

Fighting one against three and achieving victory!

But this also brought great destruction to Dahara town at the time.

It was then that Ghris, serving as Arceus's messenger at the time, sealed Hoopa's powerful force, turning the mighty Hoopa Unbound into Hoopa Confined, bringing peace to Dahara town.

But...

"Is this really just Hoopa's problem?"

Looking at this prosperous city and signaling Rotom to descend, Johan asked himself this question.

If not for troublemakers questioning who was stronger...

If not for people cheering after Hoopa defeated ordinary Pokémon, then repeatedly egging it on...

Would Hoopa, who was originally just enthusiastic about eating and incidentally brought enormous wealth, really have become the "Unbound" one?

To some extent, it was actually those people's "desires" that created Hoopa Unbound.

A certain amount of desire might bring creation, but excessive desire definitely brings destruction!

"So... you can't blame Hoopa entirely..."

In some remote and dim valley, sealed and shielded by mysterious power, a strangely shaped "bottle" seemed to sense something, and even in its seal, it couldn't help but shake slightly twice.

The aircraft landed in the backyard clearing of Dahara City's Pokémon Center.

Walking down from the aircraft to the Pokémon Center entrance.

"Whew—"

Flint stretched greatly. "Finally arrived."

He placed his hand above his eyes, looking at the prosperous city before him with amazement:

"Really quite exaggeratedly prosperous..."

For a city located in the desert, Dahara City was indeed exaggeratedly prosperous.

"Any city in a movie is prosperously magnificent..." Johan muttered quietly.

"What?" Flint didn't hear what he said clearly.

"Nothing." Johan shook his head. "Where are the people picking you up?"

Flint took out his phone.

"Should be... coming soon."

"Stand here and don't move. I'll go ask Nurse Joy about the situation." Johan said, waving his hand as he walked into the Pokémon Center.

Gengar floated out from his shadow, planning to see if there were any "local bosses" on Dahara City's streets.

"I always feel Teacher Johan's earlier words had other meanings..." Flint muttered.

Just as he finished speaking.

A strange golden ring suddenly appeared before him, its center briefly blurred before being covered by peculiar energy.

"Hm?" Flint blinked at this suddenly appearing golden ring, looking completely confused.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar also curiously floated to this golden ring, instinctively sensing spatial fluctuations from it.

Space?

Regarding spatial power, Gengar was somewhat familiar with it, but felt this spatial power was rather strange.

It seemed very different from the spatial power of Palkia, the God of Space.

"Hehe, scared you, didn't I?"

From the other side of the golden ring came playful laughter.

"What sound?"

Flint looked amazed, circling around the golden ring.

But no matter how he looked, besides the opaque center, this thing didn't seem particularly special...

"Ka-kaah~ (￣~￣)"

Gengar pulled out a handful of popcorn, eating while studying the source of this spatial power.

Seeing that popcorn, Johan couldn't help but mourn for the Sunflora on Ramos's farm for three seconds.

He'd watched Gengar, but apparently... hadn't watched it completely.

"Hey!"

Possibly smelling the aroma, suddenly a small gray hand reached out from the golden ring, grabbing several pieces of popcorn from Gengar's hand with lightning speed.

A question mark appeared above Gengar's head.

"Ka-kaah?"

It looked at its empty hand, then at the golden circle, scratched its butt, and instinctively sniffed its finger.

What the heck?

Someone dared steal my popcorn?

The next second.

"So spicy! So spicy!"

From the other side of the golden ring came another voice.

Indeed!

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar rolled up its non-existent sleeves, then grabbed the golden ring with both hands and, under Flint and Johan's gaze, dove headfirst... through it!

"Eh?!!!"

Watching Gengar disappear, Flint's eyes widened.

Johan, who had just finished asking about the situation and walked out of the Pokémon Center, saw this scene and unconsciously pressed his forehead.

Then his expression became very strange.

He'd said they might not encounter it...

But they'd run into Hoopa's signature "dimensional hole" right away.

Flint really was toxic.

"Te-Teacher Johan, your Gengar went through and disappeared." Flint pointed at the golden ring.

"I know."

Stepping forward, he also grabbed the golden ring with both hands, then under Flint's astonished gaze... also went through.

What was coming would come eventually...

Moreover, this was just Hoopa Confined—as long as the "shadow" wasn't unleashed, there was no problem.

Flint stood before the golden ring, completely bewildered.

After brief hesitation.

Gritting his teeth, he also climbed through.

"This is Hoopa's!"

"Ka-kaah!"

As soon as Johan passed through the golden ring, he saw...

Gengar was fighting with a small, gray and pink creature with golden curved horns on its head for popcorn.

Undoubtedly, this little Pokémon was the legendary mythical Pokémon, Hoopa!

More precisely, Hoopa in its Confined form.

"Confined" referred to the punishment of Hoopa.

But their fighting posture...

Gengar gripped Hoopa's hands that were clutching popcorn with both hands, then planted both feet on either side of Hoopa's horn-like spikes, pulling back desperately, but only managed to stretch Hoopa's arms away.

Because Hoopa's arms weren't actually connected to its body—both ends had golden protrusions connected by magic power, so no matter how hard Gengar pulled, it didn't have much effect.

And Hoopa...

Its eyes were currently bloodshot, originally dark green eyes filled with red veins, lips red and slightly swollen, saliva uncontrollably dripping from the corners of its mouth.

Obviously it had been affected by Gengar's spicy popcorn.

But even though it was very spicy, Hoopa had no intention of returning the popcorn to Gengar.

"What Hoopa takes belongs to Hoopa!"

Hoopa gritted its teeth, just refusing to let go.

Gengar's face showed a fierce grin.

It had been a while since encountering such a "stubborn" guy—then don't blame me...

Bang—

Flint fell from a nearby golden ring, also seeing this scene.

"What kind of Pokémon is this?"

He obviously didn't recognize Hoopa.

"And... where is this?"

Looking around, he found they seemed to... have arrived at a manor's poolside?

"Hoopa is angry!"

Being "stepped on" by Gengar, Hoopa waved its other hand lightly, psychic energy flickering in its eyes as the golden ring hanging from its horn floated out, then rapidly enlarged, appearing above Gengar's head.

The next second.

Hoopa showed a mischievous smile. "Let you know Hoopa's power!"

Waving its hand in a circle.

As the golden ring trembled with a "buzz," afterward...

Splash splash splash—

A large amount of water flew out from the ring, pouring toward Gengar's head.

Hoopa looked very proud of this.

But the next moment, its expression froze.

Gengar also reached out, lightly drawing above its own head, opening a space crack like a pocket, and the water Hoopa summoned was seamlessly caught by Gengar's spatial rift.

"Wh-what?"

Hoopa murmured, even forgetting it was fighting Gengar for popcorn.

"Ka-kaah! (￣▽￣)"

Gengar grabbed the popcorn and put on sunglasses.

Hmph!

My popcorn...

"How, how did you do that?"

Hoopa was still amazed by Gengar's earlier operation.

But before Gengar could answer.

"Hoopa!"

A shout came from not far away.

A girl wearing classical clothing with a familiar golden pendant on her chest came running over quickly.

"Hey!"

Seeing the girl, Hoopa almost instinctively jolted, flying behind Johan like a streak of smoke, peeking at the girl from his shoulder.

"Vi?"

Who knew.

On the shoulder where Hoopa perched, there was also an invisible Victini, which revealed itself and showed its little fangs, greeting Hoopa friendly.

"Wh-what..."

Hoopa was obviously startled again by the suddenly appearing Victini.

"Hoopa!"

The girl finally ran to Johan and the others, first angrily shouting once, then when looking at Johan and Flint, she froze.

Handsome features, black short hair, signature monocle...

"You, you are..."

Flint grinned, just raising his hand to greet.

"Teacher Johan?!"

The girl exclaimed.

Flint: "..."

Johan smiled slightly. "Hello."

The girl's cheeks reddened slightly as she hurriedly introduced herself:

"I, I'm Meray, I'm, I'm this child's good friend!"

Speaking, she quickly pulled little Hoopa from behind Johan, then pressed Hoopa's head as both she and it bowed ninety degrees. "Sorry!"

"Hoopa must have caused you trouble. I apologize to Teacher Johan on its behalf."

Flint pointed at himself, opening and closing his mouth.

"Hoopa..."

Johan indicated Meray didn't need to worry too much—after all, they hadn't suffered any losses.

But obviously.

This wasn't Hoopa's first time playing pranks.

This point... was somewhat similar to their Gengar.

"..."

Hoopa hung its hands dejectedly.

Then a handful of popcorn was offered to it.

"?"

Hoopa looked up in surprise.

Gengar with sunglasses raised an eyebrow at it.

"Ka-kaah~ (▼O▼)/"

You must understand—what I give you is yours, what I don't give you can't take.

"!"

Hoopa nodded vigorously, happily taking the popcorn and stuffing it in its mouth.

However, it clearly forgot one thing...

"So spicy!"

Splash splash splash—

Gengar opened its spatial pocket, and the water Hoopa had summoned earlier poured back on Hoopa, soaking it thoroughly but also relieving the spiciness.

"Ka-kaah! (■_■)"

Don't thank me!

"..."

Meray looked amazed—this was the first time she'd seen Hoopa suffer at another Pokémon's hands.

Is this the legendary Teacher Johan's Pokémon?

But Hoopa quickly recovered its energy, carefully approaching the "boss-like" Gengar.

Before long...

As the "local boss," Hoopa became Gengar's little brother.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved its hand grandly, displaying "dominance."

Tonight! Tonight I'll take you to do something big!

"Great!"

"Cough, Gengar." Johan's eye twitched as he glanced at his ghost.

He felt...

Gengar plus Hoopa would cause big problems.

With Gengar's "cunning" plus Hoopa's abilities, if no one stopped them, they might turn the Pokémon world upside down.

Gengar would probably gain the strongest "enhancement" in history!

"Te-Teacher Johan, I heard... you're Arceus's messenger?" Meray gathered courage to ask.

As Hoopa's "guardian," the great-granddaughter of Ghris who had sealed Hoopa's power, both Meray and her brother Barza were descendants of Arceus's messenger, just...

They hadn't gained Arceus's recognition and didn't possess their great-grandfather's ability to suppress Hoopa.

"Uh... half of one, I guess." Johan said.

"Ha-half?"

Other recognitions from Arceus, like Damos and Ghris, were all valued by Arceus, while he...

Could he say he'd beaten up Arceus and only then received the so-called "Arceus messenger" title?

Hearing "half," Meray didn't know how to continue what she'd planned to say.

"Um..."

Flint raised his hand.

"Excuse me, where is this?"

He still had a festival to attend.

"Elite Four Flint? When did you arrive?" Meray finally noticed there was another person.

Flint: "..."

Johan patted his shoulder approvingly.

"?"

# 667: "Shadow" Hoopa: Huh? (Two-in-One Chapter)

Kalos region, Dahara City.

Meray's residence.

"Ka-kaah!"

"Amazing!"

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar put its hands on its hips, showing a proud expression.

Johan just smiled and didn't say much more.

"Then let the great Djinn Hoopa show you Hoopa's talent!"

Speaking.

"Hoopa is amazing~!"

The next moment.

"Ka-kaah~"

"Ka-kaah!"

True Transforming Gengar!

Even.

Gengar was greatly shocked by this.

And Johan...

"..."

The scene that happened to Ash and Pikachu had actually occurred to him and his Gengar.

More importantly.

"Ka-kaah!" (Why are you stepping on my foot!)

"Ka-kaah~" (Don't push me~)

"Ka-kaah?" (What did you drag me here for?)

"Ka-kaah~" (Want to hold a concert together~~)

Johan held his forehead.

"Ka-kaah~ (｀▽*)"

You found me so quickly~

Gengar directly gave Johan's cheek a lick.

"So amazing..." Hoopa was amazed by Johan's speed in finding Gengar.

Any trainer who had built deep bonds with their Pokémon would be able to find their own among a hundred similar Pokémon.

Even someone like Flint wouldn't find it difficult.

"Hoopa!"

Hearing Meray's voice, Hoopa immediately shrank its neck.

Its expression was exactly the same as when Gengar got caught making trouble by Johan.

"Hoopa, quickly send everyone back!" Meray put one hand on her hip and covered her forehead with the other, quite troubled.

"Okay, Hoopa knows..."

Hoopa was still very obedient to Meray, just...

Summoning spirits was easy, sending them back was hard.

Especially when summoning a bunch of ghosts—a bunch of cunning Gengar.

Hoopa opened dimensional portals again, but only three or five Gengar went back, including two that were actually Ditto transformed into Gengar.

And Johan's Gengar, looking at the chaotic scene in the room, suddenly reacted.

"Ka-kaah!"

It pounded its fist into its palm, showing sudden understanding.

Right! Isn't this my, no, isn't this His Majesty's "Ghost Legion"?!

It had also studied with Elite Four Agatha's Gengar for a while.

Now it was good.

Little Hoopa had given it, no, given His Majesty an "army"!

Thinking carefully.

Moreover, its Ghost-type energy condensation speed would definitely be faster, and when using "Ghost Aura," everyone could get huge bonuses...

Slurp—

Thinking about it, Gengar drooled.

So.

Gengar immediately floated to the ceiling, shouting at the chaotic hundred-plus Gengar below.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar! Your emperor has returned! (chest vibration)

"Ka-kaah?" (Emperor? What's that, can it be eaten?)

"Ka-kaah?" (That's not right, why can you float?)

"Ka-kaah!" (Right! This must be a fake Gengar! It infiltrated the people!)

"Ka-kaah!" (Brothers, get it!)

"..."

Just like how each of Pikachu's "Pika" had different meanings based on pronunciation and pauses, each "Ka-kaah" from the Gengar also had different meanings.

Johan's scalp was tingling from listening.

"Ka-kaah..."

Damn it!

Seeing such an insubordinate appearance, Gengar was immediately furious.

"Gengar!" Johan couldn't watch anymore and immediately spread his aura.

Buzz—

Invisible energy with emotion-soothing effects immediately made the chaotic room quiet, and pairs of crimson eyes all looked at Johan.

Truly worthy of being an Arceus messenger like great-grandfather, no, in terms of calming Pokémon emotions, Teacher Johan might be even better...

No joke.

But the problem was...

Even if these Gengar ate much less than his own, but...

"Ka-kaah..."

Hearing this, Gengar drooped its ears and scratched its butt.

It felt... the imposing scenes of "Bewitching Ghost" strutting through the streets, "Purple Armor Throughout the City" all shattered like bubbles.

His Majesty failed before even starting!

But Gengar still listened to Johan's words.

So.

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar patted its chubby cheeks and immediately recovered its spirits, grinning.

Fine! Let me show you all His Majesty's, no, my strength one last time!

Buzz—

With Gengar at the center, surging black mist immediately spread outward. The rich Ghost-type energy immediately made all the Gengar present show shocked expressions.

Ghost Aura!

"Gengar." Johan took out several boxes of energy cubes. "Consider these parting gifts. Sorry to trouble them."

So.

Thus.

After sending away the Gengar, Meray breathed a long sigh of relief, while Hoopa quietly floated to Johan's side, its little nose twitching.

Could Hoopa summon Jirachi?

"Teacher Johan..." Meray helplessly apologized again for Hoopa's mischief.

Seal?

"Seal abnormalities?" Meray looked worried.

So Meray's idea was to wait a couple more years until little Hoopa matured more under her guidance, then try!

"But what if the seal really has problems..." Meray said quietly.

Then she looked at Johan and asked: "Teacher Johan, although this is presumptuous, but... could you go with my brother to check the seal?"

If it were Teacher Johan, even if the seal loosened, he could easily suppress it... Meray thought.

In her eyes, Teacher Johan, like her great-grandfather, was "Arceus's messenger," so suppressing seals should be easy.

After all, her great-grandfather alone had sealed and suppressed Hoopa, and Teacher Johan was not only "Arceus's messenger" but also a powerful trainer comparable to Champions.

Speaking, Meray bowed ninety degrees with an extremely sincere attitude.

After being stunned, Barza also reacted.

Right.

Teacher Johan was here!

If the seal was just abnormal due to wild Pokémon accidentally entering, that was fine, but if the seal was really loosening... Teacher Johan might even be able to reinforce it.

Seal?

Me?

Johan really wanted to say, what do I know about seals?

But considering...

No matter what, going to see for himself would be most prudent.

Actually, even if Meray hadn't said it, Johan wanted to go confirm the situation.

So after brief contemplation, he nodded:

"Alright."

Meray and Barza were overjoyed and thanked him repeatedly.

"I'll go prepare right away!" Barza said and quickly left.

Little Hoopa, lying behind Meray, looked at Johan with blinking eyes, not knowing what it was thinking.

At the same time.

Flint also finished meeting with the mayor and walked in.

"Teacher Johan."

Coming to Johan's side, Flint lightly nudged him with his elbow, quietly asking:

"Dahara City's mayor asked me to sound you out—want to make an appearance together? Have an exhibition match? After all, we're already here, and the appearance fee... would probably be substantial."

Appearance fee?

Hearing this, Johan's eyes brightened slightly.

But looking at the siblings before him.

He still didn't know what the seal situation was.

So he could only shake his head: "Forget it, I have other important matters to handle..."

Compared to making money.

Confirming Hoopa's situation was indeed more important.

Moreover...

Hmph.

Was Teacher Johan someone you could choose not to invite and then invite whenever you wanted?

He was famously petty.

Kalos region, among the continuous mountains and valleys, a lush valley came into view.

"Teacher Johan, ahead is the Valley of Creation, where Meray and I grew up."

Kneeling on Braviary's back, Barza pointed at the distant valley with some pride.

The Valley of Creation was said to be the original place where Arceus created the world, so everyone there worshipped the Creator God Arceus.

At the same time, because locals all strived to harmonize with nature, people from the Valley of Creation all possessed some special abilities to varying degrees, like Meray and Barza, and their powerful great-grandfather.

Moreover, people from the Valley of Creation all wore "Millennium Wrists" similar to Johan's—these were tokens representing Arceus.

The only difference was that Johan's Millennium Wrist was gifted by Arceus and possessed special abilities.

While the "Millennium Wrists" worn by people from the Valley of Creation, including Meray and Barza, were actually just accessories and sculptures.

"Valley of Creation, Hoopa likes it!"

In Meray's arms on another Braviary, little Hoopa flew out and immediately expressed its approval.

Johan, lying on Dragonite's back, just nodded silently.

Originally he'd wanted to take the aircraft, but... while the Valley of Creation in the valley had flat ground for landing, the seal location's environment wasn't so accommodating, so he simply didn't take the aircraft.

"The seal location we're going to is in an even deeper valley." Barza said.

According to their grandfather Ghris, if the "Shadow" was released before little Hoopa could master its power, little Hoopa's consciousness would be devoured, equivalent to "disappearing."

Johan couldn't help but sigh.

"Isn't this just split personality?"

Hoopa's consciousness was split into little Hoopa and Unbound Hoopa "Shadow"—two completely independent self-consciousnesses, each believing itself to be the main consciousness, a textbook case of split personality.

The only difference was that other people's split personalities had extra personalities sleeping inside their bodies, while Hoopa's "Shadow" personality was stripped away and sealed by Ghris.

And regarding split personality, mental disorders... hadn't this hit right in Johan's wheelhouse?

This made Johan feel much more relaxed.

Fighting legendary Pokémon was very stressful.

But facing his own "patients"—that was his specialty.

"Hoopa, scared..."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar flew out from Johan's shadow, floating beside Hoopa and smiling as it patted its head, then pointed at itself and grinned.

Don't worry, with me and Johan here, you'll definitely be fine!

But for safety considerations.

The Braviary carrying Meray and little Hoopa still descended toward the Valley of Creation.

The seal inspection would be left to Barza and Johan.

Flying directly over the Valley of Creation, after flying through the complex, craggy valleys for some time, Barza's Braviary slowly flew toward a valley perpetually shrouded in shadows.

"This is it."

Barza jumped down from Braviary, coming to a pitch-black cave entrance.

Then he threw out a Poké Ball.

"Solrock."

In flashing red light, Barza's other Pokémon was summoned.

"Flash."

Buzz—

Light emanated from Solrock, illuminating the dim cave.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar curiously peered inside.

Where's the seal?

"Please follow me."

Barza led the way deep underground, and after walking for some time, they reached the deepest part of the cave where there was no more path ahead.

"Ka-kaah?"

Dead end—did you get the wrong place?

Barza didn't keep them in suspense, smiling slightly as he pointed to a corner with a seemingly special stone.

Solrock's light created some ripples in what appeared to be empty space, faintly forming refraction.

A barrier!

Gengar understood.

Barza closed his eyes, raised one hand, and solemnly chanted:

"Time, sky, all things in the universe, convey my words, break the ancient connection! Break!"

Buzz—

The Millennium Wrist hanging on Barza's chest released weak light, and the transparent barrier rippled again with greater movement.

Dimly, the scene hidden behind the barrier finally slowly revealed its outline.

Hm?

While Barza chanted the incantation to break the barrier, Johan pulled out the slightly warm Millennium Wrist from his inner pocket.

Apart from origin and material, the biggest difference between Johan's Millennium Wrist gifted by Arceus and Barza's chest Millennium Wrist was...

Barza's Millennium Wrist was pure gold, almost identical in outer outline to Johan's, but it lacked four mysterious little green gems at the four corners that Johan's had.

"So the real target that guided me to the Kalos region is right before my eyes..."

Johan murmured as he looked up.

Prison Bottle!

After the barrier retreated, bound by mysterious ropes was the "Prison Bottle" that sealed Hoopa's power!

Possibly due to the passage of time, the "Prison Bottle" already showed obvious rust or weathering.

Without Arceus's power and Ghris's power, how could Hoopa be sealed?

Looking at the "Prison Bottle," Barza frowned slightly, examining it while saying:

"I don't see any signs of the seal loosening, but this 'Prison Bottle' seems... to have aged quite a bit more."

"The ropes are intact, the bottle body is intact, and the power is also..."

"Barza!"

Suddenly.

Johan's voice exploded like thunder beside Barza's ear.

He jolted, looking back at Johan with some confusion.

But he saw Johan's serious expression, pointing at his feet.

Barza looked down in bewilderment and was also startled.

Though clearly standing below the platform, clearly still three or four steps away from the stone platform where the "Prison Bottle" was located, he had somehow already walked onto the steps, only one step away from the "Prison Bottle"!

When?

Barza hadn't realized he was gradually approaching the "Prison Bottle," even extending his hand to try touching it!

If not for Teacher Johan's shout stopping him, probably...

Coming to his senses, Barza quickly stepped back, saying gravely:

"Great-grandfather said Hoopa's 'Shadow' power comes from people's desires."

"From people's sloth of wanting something for nothing, envy of others' possessions and abilities, craving for delicious food, rage when things don't go their way, greed for power and wealth, pride from distorted self-perception..."

Hearing this, Johan was stunned.

You're talking about the Seven Deadly Sins here?

But fundamentally, Hoopa's "Shadow" power indeed came from endless desires.

"So..."

Johan, holding the real Millennium Wrist, wasn't affected by the "Prison Bottle" at all.

"Even sealed, the 'Shadow' power in the 'Prison Bottle' hasn't weakened but might have grown stronger?"

Barza shook his head. "Don't know if it's because the 'Shadow' is getting stronger or because the 'Prison Bottle' is deteriorating..."

This was why he and other "inheritors" in the Valley of Creation periodically came to check the seal.

Before Barza finished speaking, Johan suddenly shouted again:

"Gengar!"

He saw.

A wickedly grinning Gengar had already sneakily approached behind the "Prison Bottle," and an invisible, twisted force was isolating and interfering with Johan and Barza's vision.

"Ka-kaah~ (▼益▼)"

Gengar's eyes glowed red.

From the bottle opening of the "Prison Bottle" that resembled eyes, strange, twisted, evil red light also emanated.

"Oh no!" Barza was shocked, realizing the "Shadow" in the "Prison Bottle" was trying to influence Gengar to break free from the seal.

He immediately raised one hand while gripping the Millennium Wrist on his chest.

But Johan stopped him.

"Teacher Johan?"

Johan watched this scene with interest, asking: "Among the 'Seven Deadly Sins' you mentioned, are there sins called 'playfulness' and 'mischief'?"

"Huh?"

Barza was stumped by his question, thinking briefly before instinctively saying:

"No, no..."

Johan shrugged. "Then that's it."

Suddenly.

A cunning gleam flashed in the wickedly grinning Gengar's eyes.

"Ka-kaah!"

Hey! Give it here!

As soon as the words fell, Gengar reached out and grabbed, and the strange power spreading out trying to influence it transformed into a mass of red-black energy, condensing in Gengar's palm.

What's this thing?

Gengar stared at it for a while.

Opened its mouth.

Tossed it in.

Shadow Hoopa: ???

# 668: Team Rocket's New Business and the Meaning of "Punishment" (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved at the "Prison Bottle" again.

Come on, give me a little more~

Hoopa Unbound: "..."

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar looked up and down at the "Prison Bottle" that showed no further reaction, scratching its head.

That's it?

Hoopa Unbound: "..."

Barza stared blankly at this scene, feeling that... some things had exceeded his understanding.

He himself had been deeply affected by Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" power and nearly made a grave mistake. He had also witnessed with his own eyes the strange power of Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" trying to corrupt Teacher Johan's Gengar, but the result...

Gengar had eaten Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" power?

Was this thing... edible?

Gengar seemed unsatisfied and reached out to gently tap on the "Prison Bottle."

Tap tap—

"Ka-kaah?"

Hey hey~ Anyone home? Anyone home? Ghost paying a visit~

However, the "Prison Bottle" acted as if nothing was sealed inside, showing no movement at all, making Barza's heart race.

Johan couldn't watch anymore and quickly spoke up: "Gengar, that's enough."

If this continued, what if they accidentally broke the "Prison Bottle"?

With the "Prison Bottle" containing it, the Hoopa Unbound "Shadow" inside was being so "well-behaved." If it actually escaped...

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar put its hands on its hips, frustrated but helpless, and floated back to Johan's side.

"Barza, is everything alright?" Johan asked.

"Should, should be fine now." Barza looked at the "well-behaved" "Prison Bottle" and swallowed before saying.

Although the "Prison Bottle" looked somewhat old and decayed, because of Gengar and Teacher Johan's presence, it seemed much more subdued than during his previous visits.

With his heart greatly at ease, Barza breathed a long sigh of relief and once again used the special power of the Valley of Creation people.

"Time, sky..."

He restored the previously disappeared barrier, and in the dark cave, the "Prison Bottle's" trace disappeared once again.

"Good thing nothing unexpected happened." Johan also felt slightly relieved.

He had previously speculated whether there might be various accidents like the "Prison Bottle" suddenly breaking, Barza being influenced by the "Prison Bottle" on the spot, or Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" forcibly breaking free.

Now it seemed he had completely overthought it.

"It's not like I really cause problems everywhere I go..." Johan felt he could remove the title of "Pokémon world's Grim Reaper."

"Let's go back, Teacher Johan." Barza said.

The two returned along the original path.

However, during the return journey, Barza's expression remained serious, making Johan somewhat curiously ask:

"Is something troubling you, Barza?"

Kneeling on Braviary's back, Barza smiled somewhat embarrassedly when he heard this:

"Although the seal still holds, great-grandfather's 'Prison Bottle' probably can't contain the 'Shadow' much longer."

"Hm?"

Barza explained:

"Hoopa Unbound's 'Shadow' power comes from humanity's endless desires. Over a hundred years... human population growth has far exceeded great-grandfather's expectations, so..."

"So the 'Shadow's' power is much stronger than a hundred years ago? Perhaps after some more time, it could forcibly break free from the 'Prison Bottle's' constraints?" Johan finished.

Barza nodded.

"Additionally, as Teacher Johan saw, the 'Prison Bottle' has severely decayed after a hundred years of 'Shadow' erosion. No one knows how much longer it can hold."

Until Ash arrives?

"Actually, when my great-grandfather sealed Hoopa's power a hundred years ago, it was with the intention of having Hoopa understand the meaning of 'punishment,' and he was prepared to return its power to it. But..."

Obviously, little Hoopa still hadn't fully understood the meaning of "punishment."

Then Barza revealed his thoughts.

"I want to create a new 'Prison Bottle' to reinforce the 'Shadow's' seal. When Hoopa feels ready, we'll return its power to it."

Johan supported Barza's idea.

Reinforcing the seal couldn't be better.

"If you need me for anything, you can find me anytime." Johan said.

Hearing this, Barza was overjoyed—this was exactly what he'd been waiting for Teacher Johan to say.

From what had happened at the seal location, it wasn't hard to see that he alone, even with his sister Meray, probably couldn't withstand the "Shadow" power's erosion. But if Teacher Johan and his Pokémon were there...

Barza glanced at the leisurely Gengar and nodded: "Thank you."

At the same time.

Kalos region, in a secret underground base, Team Flare researchers in orange suits and orange sunglasses bustled about.

"Lord Xerosic."

"Executive Xerosic."

"..."

A corpulent Team Flare executive quickly walked through the corridor, with Team Flare members bowing respectfully wherever he passed.

This was precisely Xerosic, one of Team Flare's five highest executives, and also the only male among the five researchers who originally followed Team Flare leader Lysandre.

He hurried to the deepest part of the base, to the office of Team Flare leader and Lysandre Labs representative Lysandre.

The spacious office was filled with various research devices and equipment.

Behind the desk was an entire wall of floor-to-ceiling windows.

Beyond the windows was a massive device that looked quite ancient yet filled with metallic atmosphere, with many Team Flare researchers busy working there.

Lysandre sat in his chair, silently watching everything while gently stroking the Pyroar lying beside him.

"Representative." Xerosic called respectfully.

Hearing this, Lysandre turned around.

"We've detected extremely strong 'desire' fluctuations!" Xerosic said, suppressing his inner excitement.

"Oh?"

Lysandre took the report Xerosic handed over, and after briefly scanning it, raised an eyebrow, looking very surprised.

Once upon a time, he too had lofty ideals and a kind heart. Lysandre Labs was dedicated to helping those poor and struggling ordinary people.

But his selfless giving didn't earn much gratitude. Instead, because of his constant giving, those who received his help became full of desires, considering help as their due, even actively demanding so-called "assistance."

Additionally, as resources became abundant and life gradually prosperous, he witnessed more disputes and fighting, seeing humanity's limitless desires.

Time and again...

The helplessness and confusion in Lysandre's heart accumulated, ultimately creating today's Team Flare and today's Team Flare leader Lysandre.

So regarding "human desires," Lysandre Labs hadn't been without research initially, but this thing from humanity's deepest inner depths really couldn't be erased through technology alone.

This was why Lysandre conceived the idea of reducing life's quantity to preserve this beautiful world.

"Where?" Lysandre put down the document and asked.

"In the great desert, should be outside Dahara City, a place called... Valley of Creation." Xerosic said.

Tap, tap, tap—

Lysandre's fingers lightly tapped the desktop.

Meanwhile, Xerosic continued: "According to my investigation and understanding, it might be related to a powerful legendary Pokémon called 'Hoopa.'"

Then Xerosic briefly recounted the legends about Dahara City and information he'd obtained through special channels.

Team Flare's five top researchers, the five highest executives, each had different areas of responsibility.

What Xerosic was responsible for was investigating, understanding, and searching for those powerful, legendary Pokémon.

For example, the little-known "God of Order" Zygarde, the volcanic beast Heatran, and... Hoopa the Djinn!

"Hoopa..." Lysandre's eyes flashed with light.

There was actually a powerful Pokémon that used human desires as its power base?

As the head of a massive evil organization, Lysandre was quite decisive. After learning about Hoopa from Xerosic, he immediately made a decision.

"Since humans are driven by desires, let them taste what it's like when desires backfire!"

"Yes!"

Valley of Creation.

"Can't catch Hoopa~"

Little Hoopa dodged left and right in the air, looking smugly pleased as it made faces.

"Sni~"

Snivy disdainfully pursed its lips. A vine shot out from its body and, with lightning speed, wrapped around little Hoopa before it could react.

Suddenly bound by the vine, little Hoopa looked confused.

But it quickly reacted and called out:

"You're cheating! That doesn't count!"

The vine retracted.

Snivy crossed its arms behind its back, walking on the field ridge with one vine holding a Grass Knot TM for browsing while another vine waved in the air, teasing little Hoopa.

"Can't catch, can't catch Hoopa~"

Little Hoopa acted as if its wounds had healed and it had forgotten the pain, still showing off in the air. Snivy was unusually patient, occasionally catching it once but mostly just playing with Hoopa.

"That's how things are."

Barza briefly told Meray about what had happened at the seal location, leaving Meray stunned.

She couldn't help but look at Teacher Johan, who was making a phone call nearby, feeling much more confident.

"So I plan to create a new 'Prison Bottle.'" Barza said.

"But brother, do you know how?" Meray asked.

Barza smiled. "Great-grandfather's books must have records about this. I'll stay in the Valley of Creation for a few days, and once I find the method, I'll return to Dahara City to try making it at the Desert Tower."

Both Barza and Meray were learning from what their great-grandfather had left behind. Barza remembered seeing records about this before—he should be able to find them if he looked.

"While Teacher Johan is still here." He added.

Thinking of Teacher Johan's presence, Meray nodded in support.

On the other side.

"The signal isn't very good..." Johan said somewhat helplessly.

"Devon is already working on it, but it seems... much more difficult than imagined." Cynthia's voice came through the phone.

"No, it's not just your signal problem, but also mine."

Johan looked around.

The Valley of Creation still maintained a farming-like lifestyle, and being in a valley basin, signals weren't easy to transmit. Plus, being in the desert...

"Mm..."

After chatting for a while, they ended the call.

Johan learned some news from Cynthia.

Originally, Dahara City had invited Elite Four Bertha from the Sinnoh region, because as a Ground-type Elite Four member, Bertha had once visited Dahara City for research. But she'd been busy recently, so she passed this "task" to Flint.

"That dog still bragged to me." Johan gritted his teeth—so he'd also "picked up" work.

Far away in Dahara City, Flint, who was selecting outfits under the mayor's arrangement, sneezed.

But after "cursing" Flint, Johan dialed a number he hadn't called in a long time.

"It's me."

Soon, that familiar, magnetically steady voice came through the phone.

Team Rocket leader, Boss Giovanni!

Since helping Giovanni find his son Silver, Johan hadn't called him much. Not that he didn't want to maintain the relationship, but... cough cough, he should let the father and son think about how to maintain their relationship.

However, Team Rocket really had nothing to say about wages. As a "consultant," Johan's salary arrived on time every month.

And benefits weren't lacking either—his salary had even increased considerably.

In the entire Pokémon world, few organizations could surpass Team Rocket in benefits.

"Boss Giovanni, there's a new 'job'—are you interested?"

"Let's hear it." Giovanni said with interest.

"Infrastructure."

Hearing this, Giovanni frowned and paused his hand stroking Persian.

Honestly, infrastructure wasn't very profitable. Of course, if you wanted to make money, there were ways...

But for current Team Rocket, profitability was secondary—how to transform was key.

However, to do infrastructure, you first needed strong enough connections within the League, and second, you needed qualifications to compete with others.

Having strong enough connections within the League... that was manageable. Giovanni had ways, especially in the Kanto region.

As for qualifications to compete with others...

Obviously, neither Team Rocket nor Silph Co. could possibly compare to Devon, which started with construction.

Devon was the true "construction madman."

Almost every region and corner of the Pokémon world had Devon Corporation's buildings and construction teams.

Calling them unrivaled in the entire Pokémon world wouldn't be excessive.

However, Giovanni didn't raise objections but prepared to hear what Johan would say next—he didn't think Johan was unaware of these things.

And Johan quickly revealed his true thoughts.

"Infrastructure projects in dangerous areas, and not just infrastructure."

"Hm?"

Giovanni paused. "Dangerous areas?"

"Right, like... Mt. Coronet, Mt. Chimney, Dahara City's great desert, Unova's desert, Crown Tundra, and such..."

These areas belonged to relatively dangerous regions.

Of course, there were still many trainers who brought their Pokémon into them for adventures, but because infrastructure was poor, sometimes when signals were bad, it was difficult to get timely rescue.

While Devon's construction teams were spread throughout the Pokémon world, those were construction teams that didn't have much combat power themselves. Team Rocket was different—you could call any random member a combatant.

These areas were difficult to develop not because various construction teams lacked technical skills, but more because when facing dangerous, fierce wild Pokémon, they couldn't truly begin construction.

Team Rocket's strength could perfectly fill this gap.

This way.

Team Rocket members would have work, preventing them from thinking about destructive mischief, while also satisfying some people's "needs" for battle.

More importantly.

This kind of infrastructure development, building closer relationships with the League, was much more thorough than transforming into some entertainment company.

After hearing Johan's explanation, Boss Giovanni would be lying if he said he wasn't tempted.

Others might worry about danger and trouble, but Team Rocket feared this so-called danger least.

Most League trainers weren't suited to wild environments, but Team Rocket was perfectly suited.

But Giovanni still couldn't help laughing and scolding:

"You brat, I see you suggested this because you couldn't get through to your girlfriend on the phone, right?"

Being seen through by Boss Giovanni immediately, Johan's expression became awkward, but he still said:

"Inspiration comes from life."

If Team Rocket could really transform, it would be good for both the League and Team Rocket.

Johan was happy to promote this.

Giovanni's hand returned to Persian's back.

"However, cough cough, your suggestion this time does have some constructive value."

"Right?" Johan smiled. "Maybe I could even help Boss Giovanni cooperate more deeply with Devon."

Team Rocket providing combat protection, Devon providing technical construction support.

Win-win.

Deep in Johan's heart, his "infrastructure heart" was already stirring.

With his relationships with Steven, old man Joseph, and his connections in Hoenn and Sinnoh, he didn't dare say much else, but the Hoenn League and Sinnoh League would give him face.

Even.

Building good relationships with Rayquaza in advance and having Team Rocket and Devon jointly launch satellites to build more stable networks wasn't impossible.

"Cough cough, where are you now?" Giovanni coughed twice and asked.

"Me? Valley of Creation in the Kalos region." Johan said directly, then frowned. "Boss Giovanni, you..."

"It's nothing, old problem acting up again recently."

Giovanni said dismissively, immediately making the decision:

"Valley of Creation, right? I know that place. I'll head over now."

"You're coming over?"

"Such an important transformation 'project,' cough cough, as a partner and investor, I should take a look at the site, right?" Giovanni smiled.

"Of course."

The call ended.

Johan held his phone, pursing his lips.

Giovanni's old problem...

If he remembered correctly, in the Special manga, Giovanni had an incurable disease that could only be cured by finding Celebi.

To some extent.

Giovanni giving up Team Rocket had Silver's reasons, Red and the League's reasons, and also this disease's reasons.

"Haven't seen Celebi in a long time..."

"Sni~"

Snivy dropped a "Grass Seed" and called out softly.

The "Grass Seed" visibly sprouted and grew rapidly into a massive vine that spiraled upward.

"So, so amazing..."

Little Hoopa, who had been watching the seed, was almost hit by the rapidly growing vine. After dodging in time and looking at the vine thicker than itself, its mouth fell open.

Regarding Hoopa's amazement, Snivy wasn't impressed—it felt there was no need to use "Grass Seeds" to perform Grass Knot.

Such a simple move—if you couldn't learn it after seeing it once, there was no point learning moves at all.

It stared at the bare field ridge nearby and slightly channeled its ability.

In the blink of an eye, a much smaller vine quickly grew out.

"This won't work~" Little Hoopa shook its head.

This time, Snivy nodded in agreement.

This indeed wouldn't work—too simple.

But if combined with Leech Seed...

Snivy, showing thoughtful expression, sent out a tiny seed from its body that landed on nearby Tyranitar. Vines quickly sprouted and soon covered Tyranitar's entire body.

"Bangi?"

Tyranitar looked up blankly from its pile of meteorites, glanced at the vines on its body, then at Snivy and little Hoopa in the distance, scratched its head, and continued eating.

"Sni!"

Seeing that the Grass-weak Tyranitar didn't even bother pulling them off, Snivy immediately felt... indeed, it still needed practice.

But Grass Knot and Leech Seed could indeed be combined.

Grass Knot could restrain opponents while Leech Seed could absorb energy for self-recovery. Combined, they could make Leech Seed's binding stronger and allow better use of Grass Knot.

What if... Grassy Terrain and Grass Knot were combined?

Even combining all three moves?

A vine rolled up an energy cube and tossed it into its mouth as it continued studying the TM, learning Ramos's understanding and experience with Grass Knot.

In the distance, witnessing the entire process, Johan's mouth twitched.

He somewhat understood why Snivy, despite being a Grass-type that could photosynthesize, still had such high food demands.

This brain...

Wouldn't energy consumption be massive?

Johan felt somewhat unreal.

Shaking his head.

"Illusion, definitely an illusion from being around Tyranitar too long, creating the false impression that Snivy is overly smart..."

"Hoopa~"

Little Hoopa felt it couldn't understand Snivy and turned to fly toward Tyranitar.

"Is it tasty~"

"Bangi?"

Want some?

Tyranitar grabbed a coal-ball-like meteorite, offering it to little Hoopa.

Little Hoopa looked at the "coal ball" and shook its head repeatedly. "Hoopa won't eat it, but Hoopa can make lots of these 'coal balls'!"

Coal ball?

Tyranitar looked at the meteorite in its hand.

This was a coal ball?

But before it could speak, Hoopa used its power. Golden rings flew out, opening dimensional portals.

Crash—

Large amounts of coal poured out from the dimensional portals.

"Bangi?"

Coal?

How could this compare to its meteorites...

"Hoopa!"

At this time, Meray, who had finished talking with brother Barza, turned around and saw this scene, immediately putting her hands on her hips and calling out angrily.

"!"

Startled by Meray's shout, Hoopa jolted.

"Hoopa." Johan, picking up a piece of coal from the ground, also called out.

Seeing Johan's action, Hoopa raised its head proudly and immediately said cheerfully:

"Hoopa is amazing, right? Hoopa is the most amazing!"

"It really is coal..." Johan shook his head.

Not like Tyranitar disliking coal compared to meteorites, but feeling...

With such power, no wonder it would become arrogant, proud, and do whatever it wanted.

Want to eat something? Use power to open dimensional portals to get it. Want to use something? Also use dimensional portals to get it. Even want an opponent? Also get one through dimensional portals.

Who would still work hard?

Who would still want to strive?

With such abilities, Johan was amazed Hoopa had taken so long to become arrogant.

If he had such abilities... hmph, he'd rebel in minutes and crown himself king.

Though very envious, cough, Johan still said "reluctantly":

"Hoopa, you want to gain 'achievement' from Tyranitar, right?"

"Achievement? Hoopa?" Little Hoopa looked confused.

Getting things easily was fine once or twice, but doing it too often would inevitably become boring and meaningless.

Ask anyone—if someone could casually pick up a hundred million, who would care about its meaning? It would just be a long string of numbers.

Therefore, Hoopa needed to gain so-called "achievement" through others' amazement, praise, and shock.

This was what Hoopa Unbound had initially done.

Later, under human instigation, it gained another kind of "achievement" from battling Pokémon.

Over time, it gradually lost itself.

"Do you know what this is?" Johan took a meteorite from Tyranitar's "food bowl" and asked.

"Hoopa knows, it's a coal ball!"

"No, this is a meteorite."

"Meteorite?" Hoopa paused but quickly said: "Hoopa will make meteorites appear! Hoopa is the most amazing!"

But Johan ignored it and asked:

"Do you know how we got these meteorites?"

Perhaps because Johan's voice was too magnetic, or perhaps because Johan's aura was quietly soothing Hoopa's emotions, it couldn't help asking:

"How did you get them?"

Johan smiled slightly. "We rode Rayquaza to space, facing a meteorite that could destroy the entire Pokémon world, and pierced it with one strike! Then..."

He then recounted bit by bit how they had obtained the meteorites.

Hoopa listened fascinated, even clinging to Johan and asking "then what, then what?"

Nearby, Meray watched the person and Pokémon huddled together, and for some reason, she once again saw her great-grandfather's shadow in Teacher Johan.

No, great-grandfather perhaps didn't have as good a relationship with Hoopa as Teacher Johan, nor could he explain things so thoroughly.

Meray had already heard Johan's meaning from his words.

He wanted to tell Hoopa that what truly made one proud wasn't how much you obtained or how valuable those things were, but the process of obtaining them.

What Hoopa lacked was precisely this process.

"Like the donuts you love eating—do you know how they're made?" Johan's topic shifted again.

"How are they made~"

Hoopa scratched its head but quickly brightened: "Hoopa can make them appear directly, Hoopa is amazing!"

Meray became agitated and was about to speak when she heard Johan's warm voice again.

"What if you couldn't use your golden rings to make them appear?"

"Hoopa, Hoopa, Hoopa doesn't know..." Little Hoopa hung its head.

"I'll teach you?" Johan smiled.

"If it's Hoopa, you'd definitely learn immediately, right? Then you could make donuts for Meray and Barza yourself."

Hearing this, Hoopa's eyes lit up.

"Good! Hoopa wants to learn!"

"Very good, this kind of Hoopa is the most amazing." Johan patted little Hoopa's head. "Then let's start with buying wheat."

"Buying wheat?" Hoopa paused.

Let's do it.

Then Johan took Hoopa to find an old farmer in the Valley of Creation full of farmland, wanting to buy some ripe wheat to grind flour.

But Hoopa had no money, and Johan obviously didn't want to pay.

So Johan proposed exchanging help with farm work for wheat.

Sweat.

Shedding sweat, tilling farmland, Hoopa worked with Johan using large and small hoes made by Tinkaton, helping the old man till fields until evening in exchange for some plump wheat.

"So tired, Hoopa..." Little Hoopa wiped its forehead, complaining of tiredness.

You're a Pokémon and I'm not even tired but you're complaining—Johan felt he had the constitution of a "natural workhorse saint."

But he still said: "Look at this golden wheat that Hoopa earned with its own hands."

"Right..." Hoopa imitated Johan, reaching into the bag to grab a handful, its eyes glowing slightly.

Next.

Grinding, kneading, fermenting...

"Little Jo became a big cat~"

During the process, little Hoopa mischievously smeared Johan's face and giggled.

Johan naturally didn't spoil it, slapping its face in return. "Haha—Old Hoopa!"

"Mean Little Jo~"

After playing around, they got to the actual making process.

Little Hoopa was obviously a first-timer—besides the shape, almost everything was wrong, but...

At this stage, little Hoopa had begun anticipating the results, staring at the working oven Rotom with sparkling eyes.

"Ding! Task complete, Roto!"

When oven Rotom opened and steaming white fragrant steam poured out, little Hoopa took a deep breath intoxicatedly, eyes twinkling:

"Smells so good~"

A whole tray of donuts emerged, decorated with cream, berries, chocolate...

Gulp—

Little Hoopa swallowed and, not caring about the heat, grabbed one to stuff in its mouth, but before biting, it stopped.

It hurried to Meray's side, saying proudly:

"Meray, try it quickly! Hoopa made donuts, Hoopa is amazing!"

Meray looked complex, watching proud little Hoopa with shifting eyes. She took it without minding the heat, bit down, and praised without reservation:

"Mm! Hoopa is amazing! Hoopa's donuts are the best I've ever eaten! Hoopa is so amazing..."

Tired after working all day, Hoopa felt as if its whole body was filled with inexhaustible strength upon hearing these words. With its little head held high, it distributed them to Barza, Gengar, Tyranitar, Snivy, and all the other Pokémon.

The little ones were very supportive, praising little Hoopa after receiving theirs, making the little thing's tail nearly reach the sky.

But after distributing them all, only one donut remained. Little Hoopa looked at Johan, then without hesitation broke it in half for him.

"Here, Little Jo, let's eat together~"

Little Hoopa felt for the first time an achievement completely different from using golden ring dimensional portals—this feeling of being tired yet warm all over was truly intoxicating.

"Thank you." Johan smiled and took it, biting down. "Mm, really delicious! Hoopa could be a pastry chef at my café~"

"Hehe~"

Little Hoopa also bit down, its face glowing with happiness and satisfaction.

"This is the best donut Hoopa has ever eaten!"

Honestly.

These hastily made donuts tasted average.

But their added value made them the world's only donuts, which to Hoopa were naturally the most delicious.

"Hoopa will make donuts for everyone every day!" Little Hoopa declared earnestly.

Watching laughing Hoopa with Teacher Johan, Meray, and all the Pokémon, Barza also smiled.

"Perhaps this is what great-grandfather meant by the meaning of 'punishment.'"

Making Hoopa understand things don't come easily, making it understand the importance of "process"...

This was probably why Hoopa's golden rings could obtain anything but it couldn't pass through them itself.

Destinations were important, but the scenery and experiences along the way were what made destinations more meaningful and memorable...

Barza felt sincere admiration.

Was this the ability of "Arceus's messenger," "mind master" Teacher Johan?

Everything he did seemed ordinary, but each had tremendous impact on Hoopa.

At this moment, he felt... perhaps Hoopa really had the possibility of completely mastering Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" power.

Indeed.

After sharing donuts, when Hoopa played with Johan and his Pokémon again, although it would instinctively think of using golden rings, current Hoopa would hesitate and think when using its golden ring abilities.

Completely changing Hoopa's thoughts and habits couldn't be done in one attempt.

But making it hesitate and think was a very good beginning.

Night fell.

Valley of Creation, Meray and the others' home.

Little Hoopa lay on Dragonite's belly sleeping soundly, murmuring:

"So Hoopa can become even more amazing~zzZ"
