# 669: Giovanni's Showdown and Hoopa Unbound's Return!

"Vii~ (≧▽≦)"

"Fun~! So fun~!"

"So, so high, Roto~"

Victini, Rotom, and Hoopa—these three little ones were bouncing up and down in the fields, rising and falling like they were being tossed like balls.

And that was indeed the case.

Ninetales lay lazily and comfortably on the soft grass, its three fluffy and agile tails rising and falling. Sometimes it would catch the falling Victini and toss it high, sometimes catch the falling Hoopa and throw it up high, and Rotom too, all playing with great enjoyment.

It had quite the rhythm of a circus clown juggling balls.

"Vii~"

Victini was thrown into mid-air, its entire body flipping upside down as it waved to Snivy sitting on the field ridge.

Come play together~

"Sni! (#皿)"

Snivy put its hands on its hips, baring its teeth.

Who wants to play with you all? So childish!

But watching their happy appearance, its eyes still couldn't help but show some... curiosity.

Ninetales smiled gently.

"Oowoo~"

Whoosh—

A snow-white, soft tail suddenly wrapped around gently.

While picking up Snivy, it also threw it high just like the other three little ones.

Feeling the sensation of weightlessness, experiencing that strange spinning feeling, Snivy's mouth corners unconsciously lifted, wanting to suppress it but unable to, its cheeks slightly flushed as it snorted softly.

"Sni!"

Well, I'll reluctantly play with you all for a bit!

So the four little ones took turns dancing through the air in the Valley of Creation's fields.

"Bangi..."

Nearby Tyranitar watched this scene with longing eyes, not hiding its desire at all as it looked toward Ninetales.

Noticing Tyranitar's gaze, Ninetales' smile stiffened slightly.

It extended a tail, pressed it against Tyranitar's head, making it turn to look at Johan instead of itself.

"Bangi..."

Tyranitar scratched its head.

Could Johan give it a toss too?

Its eyes showed expectation.

But Johan at this moment wasn't paying attention to Tyranitar's gaze at all, or even if he noticed... he'd probably pretend not to see.

Just kidding.

When it was Larvitar, there was still some possibility, but now with Tyranitar, even Ash couldn't toss it high, let alone that his own Tyranitar weighed at least twice as much as a normal Tyranitar.

During the Larvitar period, Johan could still toss it around no problem, but after evolving into Tyranitar... at most he could help support it, that was the limit.

Moreover, Johan currently had a more important matter.

"I didn't expect Boss Giovanni would actually come."

Looking at this middle-aged man wearing a crisp black suit with his hair combed meticulously, Johan couldn't help but be surprised.

Although Giovanni had said he'd come two days ago, he hadn't expected him to arrive so quickly.

"Cough cough."

Giovanni coughed twice with a normal expression, then smiled:

"Didn't you say it was a 'big project'? It's only natural that I come see if it's truly feasible."

Johan shrugged:

"I assume you've seen about enough?"

Flying here from above, he'd probably already gotten a general look at the environment around the Valley of Creation and even around Dahara City.

Hearing this, Giovanni said seriously:

"Indeed."

Giovanni, who held the title "Giovanni of the Earth," might not dare claim other things, but regarding earth and land, his understanding and knowledge could definitely rank in the top three in the Pokémon world!

What appeared to others as desert and wasteland wasn't without construction possibilities to Giovanni.

The "dangerous infrastructure" project indeed had certain feasibility.

However...

"My people will continue surveying here to get final data and provide a relatively feasible plan."

Team Rocket's main business definitely wasn't infrastructure, but if you asked what Team Rocket could do... that was quite a lot.

Not to boast about anything else.

Give the trio enough funding support—believe it or not, the three of them could cover Dahara City with infrastructure?

Already starting to plan solutions?

Watching Giovanni's confident expression, as if he'd already decided on this area, Johan was secretly amazed.

But it had to be said, Team Rocket's way of doing things... was just this swift and decisive.

"Cough cough..."

Giovanni couldn't help coughing again.

Seeing this, Johan frowned: "Boss Giovanni, you..."

"I'm fine." Giovanni adjusted his tie, his manner still calm and confident.

Johan once again thought of Giovanni's illness in the Special manga and couldn't help saying:

"Actually, I'm not only proficient in Pokémon psychology, but also know a bit about medicine..."

Giovanni looked at him with some surprise.

You seem to know a bit about everything?

But Giovanni smiled and shook his head: "No need. I'm very clear about my own condition. You're not the only one with special abilities."

As one favored by Viridian Forest, possessing the Power of Viridian, Giovanni was very clear about his current situation.

"So that rumor is true." Johan realized.

But Giovanni suddenly changed the subject:

"I've met that child."

Child?

Silver?

Then what?

Before Johan could ask, Giovanni continued:

"That child has very deep prejudices against fire—against me now."

Johan still didn't speak.

But Giovanni stared into his eyes and said gravely:

"Johan, I want to ask you for something."

Hearing this, Johan's expression changed slightly.

"Originally, I wanted to pass some of my 'things' to him, but... cough cough, I'll be direct—you know I'm Team Rocket's leader, right?"

Johan: "!!!"

Boss, your speaking rhythm is wrong!

What about our tacit understanding?

What about our unspoken agreement?

Why are you laying all your cards on the table directly?

And also...

What's with this posture of yours preparing for death and entrusting your heir?

Seeing surprise but not shock appear on Johan's face, Giovanni smiled slightly.

As expected.

The feeling of laying cards on the table was really nice...

Silence.

The two fell into a long period of silence.

After a while, Giovanni was the first to break the calm: "When did you know?"

Johan said quietly: "Very early..."

"How early?"

"When you added me the second time."

"That early?"

Giovanni was surprised.

Because his first friend request to Johan... hadn't been approved; only the second one went through.

That meant from that time, Johan already knew he was Team Rocket's leader?

Johan spread his hands: "Mewtwo's situation made me guess from the beginning that it belonged to artificial Pokémon, and at that time, those who could artificially create Pokémon..."

"I see." Giovanni nodded.

After pausing, he said again: "You don't seem... afraid?"

Johan rolled his eyes irritably: "Not afraid? I was scared to death at first."

"Then how..."

"But after contact, I found it wasn't beyond salvation. Within Team Rocket, there are also some innocent and lovely people. Moreover, if we could..."

Giovanni interrupted: "So you've been suggesting and even guiding me to reform Team Rocket? And provided quite a few plans and support for this."

"Boss Giovanni, can we go back to our previous way of communicating?" Johan rubbed his temples.

His head hurt.

Hearing the words "Boss," Giovanni laughed heartily.

Johan had indeed known very early that he was Team Rocket's leader, but unlike other League trainers who would either call for his capture or avoid him like the plague, Johan had even tried to make contact and provide guidance. This made Giovanni recognize how Johan differed from ordinary League trainers.

Johan: Right, definitely not for the so-called salary.

Giovanni said directly: "I originally planned to have Silver inherit Team Rocket, but he seems not only uninterested but quite disgusted with Team Rocket."

This was inevitable.

As Brother Dehua said, if I had a choice, I'd want to be a good person.

Of course, Giovanni had long anticipated this situation, which was why he was committed to transforming Team Rocket, but...

He quickly composed himself and said:

"From today forward, you're granted the highest authority in Team Rocket aside from myself, including but not limited to command, appointment, and personnel authority over everyone except certain top executives."

"Wait..."

As soon as Giovanni said this, Johan's eyes widened as he tried to speak, but Giovanni interrupted him again.

"You don't need to show yourself for anything. You can continue maintaining your 'Teacher Johan' identity. You can complete most commands through Matori."

Coughing again, he continued solemnly:

"Team Rocket's transformation must continue. Any opposing opinions and voices, whether from you or me, can be dealt with directly!"

"If Silver is willing to take over, you can give it to him. If Silver is unwilling..."

Speaking to this point, Giovanni stopped talking, just looking seriously at Johan.

And Johan was somewhat stunned at this moment.

Earlier it just felt like entrusting an heir, but now... you're really entrusting an heir!

Even talking about whether Silver is willing or not... why don't you just add "if he's unwilling, you take it yourself"?

Johan wanted to say something more, but Giovanni put away his previous attitude and returned to his incredibly confident appearance.

"Let's go. Since it's infrastructure, shouldn't we meet Dahara City's mayor?"

Seal Location.

A group of Team Flare members wearing orange suits and orange sunglasses arrived here in special helicopters.

"It should be here."

Team Flare Executive Xerosic held a small laptop computer in one hand and carried a black box in the other.

Soon.

In flashing red light, several Sandslash appeared on the rugged rocky cliffs.

The next moment, stones and debris began flying.

However, the seal location wasn't so easy to find. Even with a relatively accurate position, the mountain walls were full of complex passages everywhere.

But Team Flare possessed the world's most advanced imaging technology. Combined with this technology, images of this area inside and out were quickly displayed.

But still...

Nothing.

"Lord Xerosic, this area has unknown energy fluctuations!"

Technology could sometimes work wonders.

"Can't get close."

"This should be the seal." Xerosic said definitively, waving his hand: "Violent dismantling!"

"Yes!"

Boom!!

Deep, muffled sounds immediately came from the deep cave, and ripples appeared on the transparent seal barrier.

"Indeed a seal." Xerosic adjusted his sunglasses: "Continue the assault!"

Boom! Boom! Boom—

It had to be said, the seal left by Barza's great-grandfather was indeed very powerful—no wonder it could seal Hoopa. Team Flare attacked for quite a while but couldn't forcibly break the barrier.

But the violent shaking, especially the destruction of the surrounding environment, eventually caused some loosening in the seal behind the barrier.

At this time.

"Lord Xerosic! Someone is approaching us!" A subordinate immediately reported.

"Who? Just take them down." Xerosic waved dismissively.

"Can't, can't take them down..."

"Can't take them down?" Xerosic raised an eyebrow.

The Team Flare member was sweating profusely: "The opponents... are extremely skilled in unrestricted outdoor combat, and their fighting strength... is very strong!"

Xerosic frowned.

Were they guardians of the seal? Or...

He had come in a hurry this time and hadn't brought many people, considering his own safety.

Xerosic looked deeply at the cave behind him, then said quite decisively:

"Retreat!"

Since they couldn't break it in a short time, then whether it was seal guardians or others... they couldn't break it either.

Temporarily retreat!

"They ran really fast!"

With Team Flare's retreat, several Team Rocket elite combat personnel appeared here with their respective Pokémon, cursing.

They were "inspection personnel" who had come with Giovanni, surveying the valley's conditions. Hearing the commotion here, they rushed over.

"Those guys were Team Flare, right?"

"Who cares? They don't know who we are anyway."

"But... what were they messing around with here?"

"Captain Ken?"

Several team members suddenly noticed that their captain was now standing before a broken rock wall.

Crack—

An extremely subtle sound came from within the rock wall.

The next moment.

A strangely shaped bottle appeared before them. If Johan were here, he'd definitely recognize it as the Prison Bottle!

Moreover, on the bottle's body was an extremely fine crack, as if it had been chipped by some debris.

Snap!

The Team Rocket captain named "Ken" suddenly reached out and grabbed the "Prison Bottle." A strange red light emerged from the bottle, quickly converging and disappearing on his body.

At this moment.

This "Captain Ken" suddenly had a thought.

I want to go to Dahara City, I want to find Boss Giovanni, I want to find that damned Gengar!

"The seal was broken from the inside?"

Team Flare and Xerosic detected abnormal "desire" fluctuations and returned.

Xerosic looked toward Dahara City, his expression changing.

"Lord Xerosic..."

Whoosh—

Xerosic exhaled lightly and said gravely: "First collect the remaining 'desires' here. These things can help us control Z2. Then..."

He needed to immediately tell Representative Lysandre about this and have the representative make a decision!

"Achoo—"

Gengar sneezed uncontrollably. It rubbed its nose, looking confused.

A cold?

It had just taken little Hoopa around the Valley of Creation's forests last night. Although the mountain valley was cool at night, it shouldn't be...

For safety.

Gengar took out its set of small teapot and Revival Herb tea, leisurely brewing tea in the tea room.

"Ka-kaah!"

Oh right!

A light bulb appeared above Gengar's head.

It raised its hand, and a spatial rift suddenly appeared beside it. When it reached in, half of it disappeared.

Since "eating" that thing that floated out of the bottle, although it couldn't say it was completely digested, Gengar could clearly feel its spatial abilities seemed to have become stronger.

But honestly...

That thing tasted really bad. Not only was it unpalatable, but hard to digest too. If not for Gengar's strong stomach, other Pokémon would probably get diarrhea from eating it.

"Ka-kaah..."

Better eat more good stuff to suppress it!

Gengar searched for a while and finally brightened up, pulling out half a "Dark Stone" from the rift, crushing it and sprinkling it into the Revival Herb tea, then sipping it contentedly.

Whoosh—

"Ka-kaah~ (￣▽￣)"

So comfortable~

Suddenly.

Gengar seemed to sense something. Its two ears immediately perked up as it sat up, its eyes flashing with seriousness. Then, not caring about the heat, it drained the tea in one gulp and quickly flew toward Johan's direction.

At the same time.

"Haha, then it's happily decided!" Dahara City's mayor, a chubby middle-aged man, seemed to be in quite a good mood.

Because he had just finalized a comprehensive cooperation project with Teacher Johan and Mr. Giovanni.

It seemed Dahara City could become even more prosperous under his "leadership"!

"Ho-Hoopa!"

Little Hoopa, who was playing with Victini nearby, suddenly jolted as if sensing something extremely terrifying.

Hm?

Johan and Giovanni almost simultaneously shifted their gazes from the mayor, looking toward the sky.

Clear blue sky, bright sun, cloudless for miles, a black shadow with Crobat's help was rapidly approaching them from far away.

"Ken?" Giovanni was somewhat surprised.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar suddenly appeared in front of Johan.

"Is it that?" Johan's heart jumped as he asked.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar nodded.

Johan's expression immediately became extremely serious.

Although he didn't know what had happened to the previously intact seal, but now...

"Hoopa, come here quickly!" Johan shouted.

"Coming!"

Frightened Hoopa heard Johan's voice and immediately felt reassured, quickly coming to Johan's side with Victini.

Thud—

Team Rocket elite squad captain Ken landed on the clearing.

Before Giovanni could speak, Johan acted decisively.

"Gengar, Dark Void!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar licked its tongue and grinned wickedly as it quickly condensed a black hole, enveloping Ken.

Bang—

Ken fell to the ground with almost no resistance.

But...

The "Prison Bottle" he had been holding was now floating in mid-air, wrapped in black-red mist.

"Teacher Johan, it's the 'Prison Bottle'!" Meray, who had been playing with Hoopa, cried out upon seeing the "Prison Bottle."

"Prison Bottle?" Giovanni looked confused.

"I can see..." Johan rubbed his forehead.

What was meant to come would come eventually?

Had something completely beyond his expectations happened in between?

Boom!!

A mass of black-red mist filled with thick evil aura suddenly surged out as the "Prison Bottle" shook.

That bone-chilling negative energy almost instantly filled the entire clearing.

"Hoopa—has returned!!"

A fierce roar filled with anger echoed across the clearing.

"Hoopa, Hoopa doesn't want to disappear..."

Little Hoopa looked terrified, curled up behind Johan.

However, what surprised little Hoopa was... the "Shadow" didn't rush toward it first, but instead...

"Hey! You there, Gengar, come and die!!"

Valley of Creation cliffs.

Xerosic's eyes behind his sunglasses flickered slightly.

Dahara City, Desert Tower, top floor sealed room.

"Solrock, Flash!"

Buzz—

Gentle light illuminated the entire room.

In the room's center was a mound-like area with a pillar in the middle, surrounded by three triangularly arranged stone slabs with golden rings embedded on top, their centers aimed at the central pillar.

"This is it." Barza said, placing materials obtained from the Valley of Creation elder on the central pillar.

"Then we need Pokémon power to activate the three source powers of Earth, Fire, and Water." Meray said.

The three stone slabs arranged triangularly around the pillar showed earth yellow, fire red, and azure blue colors respectively.

However, these slabs weren't the pure plates from Arceus's body.

In other words...

These three slabs had Arceus's plate power fused within them.

"Teacher Johan, please." Barza said.

"Coach Urshifu, Ceruledge, Tyranitar, feel the source power."

"Garruu! zzZ"

The three Pokémon stood behind the three slabs respectively.

"Bangi..."

Tyranitar looked at the earth-yellow slab representing "Earth" before it, sensing the familiar Earth Plate power within, and couldn't help drooling.

"Tyranitar, restraint." Johan coughed.

"Bangi!"

Tyranitar immediately showed seriousness.

"About ready." Johan waved his hand:

"Channel your power into them and activate the source power!"

Urshifu's water, Ceruledge's flames, Tyranitar's earth...

Buzz—

When their power flowed into the slabs, the strange patterns on the slabs suddenly lit up, forming three beams shooting toward the central pillar.

At the same time.

Barza and Meray exchanged glances and immediately ran to the pillar, extending their hands.

"Time, sky..."

The creation of a new "Prison Bottle"... began!

But soon, sweating Barza stammered: "Te-Teacher Johan, could you have your Pokémon restrain themselves a bit? The firepower is too intense."

"Uh..."

Johan rubbed his nose.

Too intense?

"Everyone, don't be too forceful..."

"Goka!"

Hearing this, Ceruledge sheathed one blade and stood sideways with one hand, looking incredibly cool.

At the same time.

As the new "Prison Bottle's" creation began, Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" seemed to sense the threat. The "Prison Bottle" in Johan's hands immediately shook violently.

His expression changed slightly.

"The 'Shadow' sensed it. I'll leave this to you."

He hadn't expected the "Shadow" to start impacting the "Prison Bottle" again so quickly. It must be deeply wary of the soon-to-be-born new "Prison Bottle."

"Please, Teacher Johan!" Barza shouted.

"Teacher Johan, please take care of Hoopa." Meray looked worried.

Johan smiled slightly, turned around and grabbed a golden ring that appeared beside him. Before entering, he said:

"Don't worry. Today we might not even need that new 'Prison Bottle.'"

Then, under their confused gazes, he disappeared from atop Desert Tower.

Crack!

The moment he stepped out of the golden ring, a huge crack immediately appeared on the "Prison Bottle" in his hands, and surging black-red mist poured out in a more turbulent manner than before.

Johan immediately released his grip.

"Hoopa—is truly free this time!!"

Crack crack crack—

Spider web-like cracks appeared on the bottle's body.

In the black-red mist, crimson eyes immediately locked onto little Hoopa.

But at this moment, little Hoopa somehow found courage and put its hands on its hips, shouting:

"Hoopa isn't afraid of you! Hoopa isn't afraid at all!"

"You can disappear!" Hoopa Unbound roared.

Little Hoopa indeed showed its true colors, shrinking behind Johan again, but it still called out:

"Hmph! Hoopa has helpers!"

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar somehow appeared before Hoopa Unbound.

"It's you again!"

However.

The next second.

"Ka-kaah~"

"Ka-kaah?"

"Ka-kaah!"

One Gengar after another appeared here, appearing before Hoopa Unbound.

"So, so many?" Hoopa Unbound was stunned.

Johan's Gengar grinned wickedly and slowly raised its hands from bottom to top, Ghost Aura immediately spreading.

It pointed at Hoopa Unbound and beckoned with its finger.

"Ka-kaah!"

Come! This time I'm fighting you one-on-one! A fair fight where nobody can cheat!

While speaking, those various Gengar entered its released "Ghost Aura."

Ghost Legion, activate!

Gen·Ghost King·gar!

Dynamax?

No.

Gen·Primal Reversion·gar?

Shadow Ball!

Hey!

What Unbound—nothing special.

"More summoning!"

Giratina not being completely influenced was unexpected, resulting in Dialga and Palkia's strength being difficult to fully display.

And Groudon was actually being held back by that middle-aged man...

Hoopa Unbound needed more, stronger power!

Buzz—

From its feet, waist, and even the horns on its head, five more golden rings flew out!

Seeing this scene, Johan finally couldn't help but curse.

"What the hell are you summoning?!"

Cheating, huh?

In the movie it could clearly only do six, and now you're adding five more dimensional portals—you want to summon eleven?!

Including Hoopa Unbound itself, that would be twelve!

Tsk.

Johan suddenly stopped and looked back at little Hoopa.

"We're calling for backup too!"

"But, but Hoopa, Hoopa can only summon three..." Little Hoopa also realized the gap between itself and the "Shadow."

"No problem! You summon the strongest one you can reach, and leave the other two slots to me!" Johan said gravely.

Black Rayquaza one against seven—the remaining five... Giratina could be turned, canceling out one. Giovanni handles one. If Mewtwo could handle two, they'd even have an extra slot!

Little Hoopa looked somewhat fearfully at the massive "Shadow" in the sky, then at Johan.

Honestly, it was a bit scared because it hadn't expected the "Shadow's" power to be so exaggerated.

Back when... when it wasn't sealed, its power wasn't exaggerated to this extent, was it?

However, Johan's confident expression quickly calmed little Hoopa's wavering heart as it heard Johan say calmly and confidently:

"Don't worry, the advantage is mine!"

# 672: VS Hoopa Unbound! Talk to Me in 22 Days (Two-in-One Chapter)

Dahara City had completely descended into chaos. Under Hoopa Unbound's reckless rampage, various legendary Pokémon that only existed in legends appeared frequently, bringing a terrifying "feast" to the people currently in Dahara City.

Hoopa Unbound had already summoned six powerful legendary Pokémon, but due to some unexpected developments, the appearance of these legendary Pokémon hadn't achieved its ideal goals, so...

It once again released five massive golden rings, attempting to continue summoning!

"This is a real 'big-ass wizard,'" Johan complained internally.

However, he really couldn't let Hoopa Unbound continue summoning like this, otherwise... even Johan couldn't handle it.

"Hoopa!" Johan shouted.

"Coming!" Little Hoopa flew out from behind him, rotating its arms as three golden rings similar to Hoopa Unbound's flew from its body.

Possibly influenced by Johan and Gengar's earlier direct confrontation with Hoopa Unbound, or perhaps it had understood something itself, it wasn't as frightened as before.

"Lolo! Hoopa is also very amazing! Watch Hoopa catch—"

And Hoopa Unbound obviously sensed little Hoopa's power, immediately locating Johan and the others again based on the energy fluctuations.

"This is Hoopa's power, you're not allowed to use it!"

A massive fist struck down fiercely from above.

Little Hoopa tensed its face, looking nervous, but didn't stop its actions.

Little Johan and Gengar, plus that handsome but physically troubled uncle, that red-haired explosive guy, and Barza, Meray—so many people, so many Pokémon, were all fighting for its sake.

Hoopa absolutely couldn't retreat at this moment, and absolutely wouldn't retreat!

"Hoopa isn't afraid! Lolo!"

Little Hoopa shouted at Hoopa Unbound, and a power stronger than before surged from its body.

"Ka-kaah!"

Facing Hoopa Unbound's striking fist, Gengar flew out without hesitation, shouting loudly.

"Look, there's a UFO!"

UFO?

Hoopa Unbound instinctively paused—how could there be a UFO? Had it summoned a UFO?

But it quickly realized that Gengar was tricking it!

"Lolo!"

Hoopa Unbound became furious, its fist striking down again.

But then it heard little Hoopa shout: "Lolo! Watch how amazing Hoopa is! Lo!"

Buzz—

From little Hoopa's golden ring, a massive dragon-like Pokémon with black and gold patterns, resembling both snake and dragon, flew out.

Terrifying golden particles gathered in its mouth, and blazing hot dragon breath surged out, directly blasting Hoopa Unbound away.

"Roar—!!"

With a long cry, this gigantic dragon completely flew out from the golden ring!

"Rayquaza?" Flint's eyes widened. "Black, black-colored?"

"Bwooo?"

Kyogre couldn't help but look over as well.

Rayquaza?

No, this wasn't the Rayquaza it was familiar with. It wasn't just about the black appearance—more importantly...

So strong! The overwhelming powerful aura made Kyogre instinctively feel somewhat intimidated.

The same was true for Groudon, who was clashing with Giovanni.

"Roar?"

Groudon's expression froze slightly. The appearance of the black Rayquaza made it instinctively shrink its neck, and some unpleasant images surfaced in its mind.

"Hmph!" Giovanni's gaze was sharp. "Do you think you know who you're fighting?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a bright white arc of light streaked past his raised hand at extreme speed, and the sharp spear-like stinger struck solidly against Groudon's chest.

Although Groudon's massive size gave it tremendous intimidation and its thick armor granted it extremely strong defense, when facing this Beedrill with such incredible speed and exaggerated piercing power... it actually had trouble handling its opponent for a moment.

Bang!!

The massive form staggered back several steps.

A sandstorm suddenly rose.

In the rolling yellow sand, behind Giovanni, the silhouettes of several Pokémon appeared faintly, filled with threatening presence.

Sandstorm?

Seeing this sandstorm, Groudon's expression briefly became dazed, and some thoughts appeared in its heart that had been influenced by Hoopa Unbound, causing its fury driven by "desire" to briefly halt.

It seemed like there had been a similar sandstorm recently...

Sensing Groudon's sluggish movements, Giovanni's eyes narrowed as surging "Viridian Power" burst from his body.

"Groudon, the ancient Earth God of the super-ancient era..."

On the other side.

"Hoopa! Rayquaza!" Hoopa Unbound flipped up from the ruins, looking at the black Rayquaza with some wariness in its eyes.

This guy... was very strong!

Johan also looked at this massive dragon hovering in mid-air, surrounded by what seemed like ozone creating white mist out of thin air.

It really did summon it out...

However, this was obviously not the Rayquaza he was familiar with.

While Hoopa Unbound, Johan, little Hoopa, and Flint were all watching the black Rayquaza, it calmly swept its gaze over the fierce Hoopa Unbound before turning its attention to little Hoopa and Johan.

[You summoned me?]

After saying this, it scanned the area and spoke flatly.

[I see, this is another world.]

This was the current difference between little Hoopa and Hoopa Unbound.

Hoopa Unbound could use its powerful negative "desire power" to influence or even control the legendary Pokémon it summoned, but little Hoopa...

Only handled the summoning, which didn't mean those summoned would definitely be friendly or help.

At this moment, Johan stepped forward, pointing at the distant Hoopa Unbound that was just getting up, and said directly:

"Rayquaza, that guy says it's the strongest."

[Oh?]

The black Rayquaza, which had seemed lazy before, appeared to gain some interest upon hearing this, looking toward Hoopa Unbound.

Being stared at by the black Rayquaza like this, Hoopa Unbound instinctively showed a Slowpoke-like expression of confusion, then... fury once again occupied its rationality. Thinking of the pain from the black Rayquaza's earlier dragon breath, it immediately shouted:

"Hoopa is the strongest! The most powerful!"

[Interesting...]

The black Rayquaza half-closed its eyes, its body trembling slightly, causing all the surrounding white clouds and ozone to disperse. Its body rose slightly, looking down at Hoopa Unbound with eyes full of assessment.

"Lolo!"

Hoopa Unbound felt threatened and immediately activated its power.

"Roar—!!"

A azure beam carrying temporal power shot over, which the black Rayquaza dodged with a side movement, leaving a building behind it instantly turned to dust, suspended motionlessly in mid-air.

Another pale pink slash tore through space, coming straight ahead.

The black Rayquaza immediately raised its claws, gathering dragon breath energy into a massive dragon claw strike.

Bang!!

Both Spacial Rend and the dragon claw disappeared simultaneously.

Next.

An extremely cold beam accompanied by ice crystals and snowflakes materializing from nothing, along with surging frost, came from behind the black Rayquaza.

Sensing the threat, the black Rayquaza's expression became slightly serious. It turned and breathed out blazing flames, meeting the frost in mid-air. The violent collision raised large amounts of mist.

This wasn't all.

From the black Rayquaza's right side, in Dahara City's wide river, six beams converged into one, unleashing without reservation on the black Rayquaza's flank.

Boom!!!

Origin Pulse!

But when the smoke cleared, the black Rayquaza's form showed little change, only some scratches on its jet-black scales.

Looking closely.

It was Kyogre with half its head submerged in the lake.

[Very good!]

The black Rayquaza suddenly grinned, nodding slightly with approval.

Its gaze swept over, speaking methodically:

[One, two, three, four, five.]

Excluding the struggling Giratina and Groudon being held up by Giovanni, all the legendary Pokémon summoned by Hoopa Unbound had attacked the black Rayquaza.

"Hmph!" Hoopa Unbound proudly raised its head. "Now watch the strongest Hoopa! Lo! Lo!"

Buzz—

Hoopa Unbound didn't attack itself, but the five golden rings it had released earlier finally showed reaction, seeming to have found worthy "helpers" from the vast other worlds.

Pitch-black color surged within the golden rings, with overwhelming death aura rushing forth. Even before seeing its form, a crimson Death Wing ray shot out.

Death Wing!

Yveltal!

"Screech!!"

With a long cry, those massive black-red wings appeared from the golden ring!

"Roar!"

The black Rayquaza gathered surging dragon breath energy, transforming it into a wave impact.

Boom!!

Death Wing and Dragon Pulse annihilated everything in mid-air.

"Lo!"

Another sound.

Dense earth-yellow energy wrapped in Dragon-type energy and pale white emerged from another golden ring.

When the creature inside gradually revealed its form, Johan's eye began twitching uncontrollably.

"No way..."

Johan quickly looked at the black Rayquaza, saying:

"Want to stop this?"

But the black Rayquaza stared intently at the golden ring emitting white-green light, its voice becoming somewhat heavy for the first time, yet also eager to try.

[No need, let it summon!]

As soon as it finished speaking.

Emerald light waves in a "Z" pattern surged toward the black Rayquaza, causing its expression to become serious and focused for the first time. Its body suddenly straightened, wrapped in dense green energy, becoming like a straight arrow, meeting this ray head-on.

Dragon Ascent!

And that "Z"-shaped light wave of the same emerald color—if Johan wasn't mistaken—should be...

Core Enforcer!

Therefore, the Pokémon behind that golden ring was about to emerge—

The God of Order, Zygarde!

More precisely...

A shiny, white Zygarde!

Walking out from the golden ring.

However, what made Johan breathe a slight sigh of relief was that what emerged wasn't the Complete Forme God of Order white Zygarde, but the 50% Forme "Z-God" Zygarde.

Boom!!

The collision of Dragon Ascent and Core Enforcer once again created terrifying ripples in the air, with even the dark clouds in the night sky seeming to completely dissipate at this moment, creating a vacuum zone in the sky!

[Pity.]

The black Rayquaza stopped its movement, looking at the white "Z-God" Zygarde, its voice filled with deep regret.

It had thought the Complete Forme white God of Order would appear.

Too bad it was only the 50% form.

But this way...

Dialga, Palkia, Kyurem, Kyogre, Hoopa Unbound, Yveltal, "Z-God" Zygarde—that was seven again.

[Any more?]

The black Rayquaza's interest and battle desire seemed to have been ignited, even looking toward Hoopa Unbound to ask.

Johan's mouth twitched.

Great, this guy was addicted.

Facing the black Rayquaza's provocation, Hoopa Unbound's answer was only one word.

[Lo!]

The third golden ring of the second round—another extremely powerful dark energy accompanied by hurricane aura.

This time it didn't attack directly, but that figure seemed to carry malevolent aura no less than Hoopa Unbound's, actively flying out from the golden ring!

Black feathers, crimson eyes.

"Lu, Lugia?" Flint felt he was becoming numb, but still said awkwardly: "And it's black again..."

That's right.

The third one to appear was actually a black Lugia!

Obviously not the one Johan knew, which had been affected by "Dark Balls" and dark energy, but a true Shadow Lugia from another world!

At the same time.

Appearing almost simultaneously with Shadow Lugia was a deep purple Pokémon shaped like a bat. Its appearance made the already bright moonlight under the dark night become as bright as daylight.

Wings embedded with golden moon arcs, dark red eyes, a head like the vast starry sky...

All of these revealed this Pokémon's identity...

"What legendary Pokémon is this?" Flint murmured.

Johan pressed his temples, slowly saying: "The Beast that Calls the Moon... the Moon God, Lunala!"

What appeared, hanging high before the moon, was none other than the legendary being from the Alola region, the legendary Pokémon corresponding to Solgaleo that Johan had encountered in space.

Lunala!

"Eh?" Flint looked at Johan, his expression not as serious as Johan's, just asking: "Can Teacher Johan still handle this?"

Johan's face twitched.

Can I handle it?

I can't handle it—do you want to try?

While complaining internally, Johan's thoughts raced, calculating the black Rayquaza's battle power, when suddenly his heart contracted and he looked up sharply.

Looking at the last of the five golden rings Hoopa Unbound had released in the second round—that figure whose form hadn't yet been revealed but whose sacred, brilliant light was already shining forth.

That light seemed to be the embodiment of its greatness, the source of its power!

No, no, no!

This one absolutely couldn't be allowed to be summoned by Hoopa Unbound!

Damn it, wasn't Hoopa Unbound afraid of being devoured by what it summoned?

It didn't dare summon Rayquaza, didn't dare summon Complete Forme Zygarde, but you dare summon this guy?

Seeing that sacred light, the black Rayquaza's expression, which had been somewhat disappointed by the 50% Forme Zygarde, became excited again.

A truly interesting opponent was coming...

The Light God, Necrozma?

"You're breaking everything in desperation, but I still have to clean up the mess!" Johan glared fiercely at Hoopa Unbound, then immediately looked at little Hoopa.

"Hoopa!"

"Hoopa found it!" Little Hoopa had been summoning Pokémon according to Johan's instructions, and now... finally found one!

Boom!!

Familiar yet powerful psychic power surged from little Hoopa's golden ring.

A small, cat-like Pokémon with a pure white body immediately flew out, also attracting the black Rayquaza's attention.

[Another interesting one.]

That figure flew out of the golden ring and immediately landed in front of Johan, while nodding slightly to Gengar nearby.

Mewtwo!

Mewtwo, which had been silent for so long, might still not have finished its business, but... at Johan's call, it still came.

Looking at the powerful legendary Pokémon around, Mewtwo... briefly fell into some confusion.

But it quickly collected itself and said to Johan:

"Seems like this trouble isn't small..."

Johan was also somewhat helpless, saying: "Otherwise I wouldn't disturb you when you haven't finished your business."

Last time during the Groudon and Kyogre incident, he hadn't called Mewtwo, but this time...

He had no choice but to need Mewtwo's help.

Mewtwo nodded, turning its head to look at the brilliantly shining final golden ring, while telepathically saying:

"No matter when or where, no matter what I'm busy with, as long as you need me, I'll come at the fastest speed."

Hearing this, Johan smiled.

Then he became serious again:

"Don't let that thing inside come out, Mewtwo!"

Today's situation here was chaotic enough—it absolutely couldn't be allowed to become more chaotic, otherwise...

Even if the new "Prison Bottle" was completed and Hoopa Unbound was sealed again, the trouble probably wouldn't improve much.

Hoopa Unbound could summon recklessly, but Johan couldn't avoid cleaning up after it.

"Understood!" Mewtwo's eyes glowed with psychic power. After responding to Johan, its form suddenly flashed and disappeared.

When it reappeared.

It was right in front of Hoopa Unbound!

Teleport!

Hoopa Unbound was suddenly startled, not expecting Mewtwo to appear before it so quickly.

But as a Dark-type Pokémon, it had no reason to fear a pure Psychic-type Pokémon...

"Hoopa is the strongest..."

Bang!!

Before its boasting ended, Mewtwo made only a slight gesture with its hand, and Hoopa Unbound's massive body was sent flying, crashing to the ground and rolling several times.

"It hurts!!"

Hoopa Unbound's forehead veins bulged as it lay on the ground, instinctively crying out in pain while clutching its chest, looking severely injured.

Mewtwo looked down at the fallen Hoopa Unbound from above with disdainful eyes.

Who said Psychic-types couldn't hurt Dark-types?

Strongest?

Claiming to be "strongest" in front of me—ridiculous!

Mewtwo's outstretched hand slowly clenched, and powerful psychic force from all directions began stripping away at the fallen Hoopa Unbound like silk threads.

Psycho Break!

Mental and psychic attacks that delivered physical damage.

And physical defense was undoubtedly one of Hoopa Unbound's greatest weaknesses.

The intense pain and constantly constricting psychic force finally left Hoopa Unbound without energy to control that final golden ring.

The brilliant light gradually dimmed, the golden ring slowly shrank, the dimensional portal gradually closed, and that final terrifying being ultimately didn't appear!

But Johan inexplicably shivered.

He felt like the gaze from behind the dimensional portal had lingered on him for a moment at the end.

[Pity, yet not pity.]

The black Rayquaza finally spoke again.

The awaited Light God Necrozma ultimately didn't appear—that was the pity.

As for not being a pity, that was naturally because it saw Mewtwo.

"Rayquaza, rather than fighting Mewtwo!" Johan obviously saw the black Rayquaza's thoughts and suggested: "How about sweeping these guys instead?"

[These guys?]

The black Rayquaza's gaze swept over.

Dialga, Palkia, Kyurem, Kyogre, Hoopa Unbound, Yveltal, "Z-God" Zygarde, Shadow Lugia, Lunala...

Nine!

The black Rayquaza grinned, nodding slightly.

[This is indeed quite interesting.]

1V9?

Now this was challenging!

"Here we go, Hoopa, lo!"

At this moment, little Hoopa's final one was also finally caught, shouting with delight.

A dark shadow appeared.

A familiar figure appeared behind the golden ring, and even before passing through, its voice came with some helplessness.

"Who are we fighting this time? Never mind!"

Darkrai was speechless. Every time it appeared, it had to fight one or two legendary Pokémon, to the point where it was getting used to it.

But this time.

It had just emerged halfway from the golden ring, its gaze just sweeping the entire field, when it discovered...

Damn, so many legendary Pokémon?!

And they were all looking at it!

Actually, the legendary Pokémon present couldn't be blamed.

After all, although little Hoopa could only summon three beings, the first to appear—the black Rayquaza—had tremendous presence.

The second to appear—Mewtwo—while not seeming as imposing as the black Rayquaza, was definitely not to be underestimated, as could be seen from the black Rayquaza's attitude toward it.

So this third one was naturally anticipated, feared, and viewed with curiosity.

However, the third one to emerge from the golden ring was Darkrai, and it had immediately retreated upon seeing the situation.

Johan's forehead showed black lines.

"Darkrai..."

"Don't talk yet, let me process this!"

Darkrai's voice came, and after a pause, it tentatively asked: "So... today I have to single-handedly fight ten—I didn't count clearly, anyway single-handedly fight over ten legendary Pokémon?"

Johan: "..."

Darkrai thought all the ones outside were enemies.

No wonder.

After all, all the legendary Pokémon were looking at it, which was indeed intimidating.

Even Arceus...

Would probably tremble.

But before Johan could speak, Darkrai continued on its own: "I don't care, let's agree first—afterward I want to 'sleep' in Alamos Town, plus three truckloads of energy cubes, bury them underground in Alamos Town!"

Johan was stunned, then couldn't help but laugh, but warmth rose in his heart.

Dakley, you guy...

"Stop fooling around. Some are enemies, some are allies," Johan said.

"You should have said so earlier!"

Darkrai immediately came to Johan's side, facing those Dialga, Palkia, Kyurem types. "I wasn't looking carefully before, but hey, they're all familiar faces."

"They're all enemies too."

Darkrai: "..."

So which ones are friends?

Johan shook his head, looking at the eager black Rayquaza.

"Rayquaza."

Hearing the call, the black Rayquaza also looked at Johan with interest, showing some realization.

[I see... you're the human that this world's Rayquaza values.]

As fellow Rayquaza, it could see this point—it wasn't difficult.

Johan gripped the Key Stone.

"Then I suppose I can offer you some assistance."

The black Rayquaza's eyes focused, then it smiled.

[Do you know the cost?]

"The cost of commanding legendary Pokémon? Of course," Johan's expression didn't change.

Norman commanded Rayquaza and died as a result.

Steven controlled the three Regis for twenty-two days and ultimately collapsed from exhaustion.

Commanding legendary Pokémon, except for those with absolute friendship like the black and white dragons or Mewtwo, was a tremendous burden for anyone.

But Johan had experience.

Moreover...

Some situations didn't allow him to retreat, some things didn't allow him to refuse, and some resolutions had long been silently accepted in his heart.

Seeming to sense Johan's determination, the black Rayquaza stared at him for a while before...

[Then I'll allow you one chance to be reckless.]

Speaking, under Flint's incredulous gaze, the black Rayquaza flew down from above, and Johan, with help from Gengar and Darkrai, steadily landed on the black Rayquaza's head, gripping the two horns on its head.

Instantly.

Johan felt the aura in his body become active and rapidly drain.

But this wasn't enough.

Having the black Rayquaza single-handedly fight so many legendary Pokémon—this state alone wasn't enough!

So...

"Come on!" Johan took a deep breath, the Key Stone in his hand blazing with light as Gengar transformed into black smoke, enveloping Johan.

"Dragon Ascent!"

"Roar—!!"

At this moment, the black Rayquaza and Johan's hearts connected through contact, through aura connection, through the mysterious relationship between Johan and Rayquaza, establishing a link!

Buzz—

Mega Evolution light suddenly burst forth, golden particles like scattered starlight connecting into golden lines around the black Rayquaza.

Under the azure glow, the black Rayquaza rapidly completed its Mega Evolution!

Dragon roars shook the heavens, echoing through the universe!

"Roar!"

"Bwooo!"

Influenced by the black Rayquaza's aura, Groudon and Kyogre also entered Primal Reversion!

"Now this looks proper!" Giovanni laughed heartily, letting sweat drip from his forehead, veins bulging as he spread his arms, releasing his Viridian Power without reservation.

Flint gritted his teeth, extending both hands as he summoned all six Pokémon simultaneously.

"No matter what, if we can hold out for one minute, that's profit!"

Then he led Infernape and his team of Pokémon in an almost self-burning intense state, crossing obstacles to charge toward Palkia.

Shouting, "Palkia, here I come!"

Back in Alamos Town, he had almost no power to fight back against the space-time dragons.

Now he had grown to become a Sinnoh Elite Four member!

As an Elite Four member, even if not in his own region, he should fulfill the responsibilities of an Elite Four member!

"Ohhhhh!!!!"

Flint was running, his fluffy red afro seeming to burn like flames as he ran.

And following beside him, then surpassing him, was Infernape, whose head flame was truly burning, reaching nearly ten meters high like wildfire!

"Before I stop breathing, your only opponent is me!"

When an emotional trainer, and an Elite Four-level trainer at that, completely burned himself, that explosive power... even Palkia couldn't help but take notice.

"Long time no see..."

Mewtwo looked at Johan riding Mega Rayquaza and shook its head, sighing.

Long time no see, and he'd become this "impulsive."

Mewtwo looked down at its hands, holding two glowing Mega Stones that looked similar yet had subtle differences.

This was one of the results of its recent busy work.

Forget it.

It had wanted to show off.

But given Johan's physical condition... it wasn't appropriate to overly exhaust his stamina.

Let's see if this black Rayquaza could handle the situation. If not, it would switch to full power!

With this thought.

Mewtwo flashed and appeared beside Mega Rayquaza, flying alongside it.

After all, in the movie, the black Rayquaza's 1V7 was impressive.

But you couldn't completely ignore the role of the red and blue planes.

Meanwhile, Darkrai, at Johan's instruction, went to Giratina's side.

"Old friend, calm down..."

Giratina was already a Pokémon filled with negative emotions. Not being completely influenced by Hoopa Unbound was already unexpected.

But as Hoopa Unbound's recovery time lengthened, that "desire" power grew stronger, and Giratina could only endure while barely restraining Kyurem.

It wasn't that it didn't want to restrain Dialga and Palkia, but they knew each other too well. Under Hoopa Unbound's guidance, those two deliberately avoided it.

The Time Dragon and Space Dragon—temporal and spatial powers colliding together could achieve maximum effect.

Conversely.

Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre were suited to fight on different battlefields!

And the reason Darkrai came over...

Apart from little Hoopa's three golden ring dimensional portal abilities, Giratina's Distortion World was key to Johan continuing to call for help!

He needed to consider not only solving Hoopa Unbound's problem but also the issues these remaining legendary Pokémon would leave after Hoopa Unbound was sealed again.

More allies were always better!

Therefore, at Johan's instruction, Darkrai came to replace Giratina in dealing with Kyurem, while Giratina focused on resisting Hoopa Unbound's rolling "desire" erosion, trying to recover use of the Distortion World as soon as possible.

Thus.

Above prosperous Dahara City's sky, before the towering Desert Tower, along the banks of Dahara City's largest and most turbulent river.

On one side: Mega black Rayquaza, Johan, Mewtwo.

On the other side: Hoopa Unbound, Dialga, Primal Kyogre, "Z-God" Zygarde, Yveltal, Shadow Lugia, Lunala!

"Damn it..." Hoopa Unbound glared at Johan through gritted teeth.

If not for this human today...

Everything would have ended long ago!

But now...

Hoopa Unbound took a deep breath, looking at the "helpers" beside it, confidence surging again.

However, looking at the opposing side with only two legendary Pokémon, it couldn't help feeling wary.

So for the first time today, Hoopa Unbound used what it considered its best tone:

"Hoopa only wants freedom. Only wants it to disappear. After doing these things, Hoopa can leave..."

It pointed at little Hoopa behind Johan, who was no longer so afraid.

Standing atop Mega black Rayquaza, flanked by Gengar and Mewtwo, Johan's expression was stern as he gripped Rayquaza's horns, chuckling coldly:

"Talk to me about this in 22 days!"

# 673: VS Hoopa Unbound! Hoopa: Can't You Play Fair? (Two-in-One Chapter)

22 days?

In 22 days, Hoopa's "Shadow" would have been scattered to dust!

With negotiations failed, the only option left was fighting, which actually better suited Hoopa Unbound's inner thoughts.

Although the two opponents—Mega black Rayquaza and Mewtwo—made it somewhat wary, but...

"Hoopa has the advantage!" Hoopa Unbound shouted.

[Here we go!]

Even the Mega evolved black Rayquaza felt somewhat nervous when facing the current opposing "lineup," though more than anything it felt excited and exhilarated.

It had been a long time since such a high-intensity battle!

"Roar—!!"

Mega black Rayquaza roared excitedly.

On the other hand, Mewtwo appeared very calm at this moment. It silently stayed by Johan's side—protecting Johan's safety was its primary objective right now. As for those seven opponents...

If the black Rayquaza could handle them, then great. If not... it would take over!

At worst, it could still bring Johan away safely.

"Hoopa is the strongest!!"

Dark shadows surged from Hoopa Unbound's chest, its pupils filled with surging desire, and golden rings lit up one after another, instantly opening dimensional portals between it and Johan.

This was obviously Hoopa Unbound's signature move—Hyperspace Fury!

Moreover.

Compared to before, as Hoopa Unbound's awakening process continued, the power of its moves felt much stronger than earlier.

"Rayquaza, Dragon Ascent!!"

Johan commanded loudly, feeling his stamina and aura power rapidly draining at an alarming rate after entering battle mode.

Even with little Victini on his shoulder, tightly gripping his clothes and providing energy support, the recovery speed couldn't keep up with the consumption.

No wonder there were cases of people dying from exhaustion while commanding and controlling legendary Pokémon...

The more powerful the legendary Pokémon, the less intimate the relationship, the greater this seemingly inevitable consumption became.

However...

It was still enough to hold on!

"Roar!!"

Mega black Rayquaza raised its head and roared, its body dancing through the air. The golden particle threads moved with its body's motion, skillfully avoiding this attack under Hoopa Unbound's multiple fists.

"Your combat skills are lacking."

Johan's "taunting" words once again firmly drew Hoopa Unbound's hatred, and just as it prepared to attack again, a psychic energy blast struck hard against its head.

Bang!!

It was Mewtwo's Psycho Break!

Hoopa Unbound felt like its head had been hit with a hammer, crashing heavily to the ground.

In terms of combat ability and battle experience, Hoopa Unbound wasn't even on the same level as Johan.

If they continued fighting this way, Johan could completely overwhelm Hoopa Unbound with Mega black Rayquaza and Mewtwo.

But obviously.

This attack, while briefly stunning Hoopa Unbound, also completely unleashed its restraints.

"Destroy everything!" The risen Hoopa Unbound flew into a rage.

Rumble—

In an instant, the earth shook and mountains trembled as waves of terrifying energy rapidly gathered on those legendary Pokémon influenced by Hoopa Unbound.

The diamond on Dialga's chest burst with brilliant color, azure photons gathering in its mouth along with temporal energy.

Behind Primal Kyogre, six energy orbs fired Origin Pulse simultaneously. "Z-God" Zygarde's green and white patches flickered like electronics, and the emerald Core Enforcer quickly formed.

"Screech!!" In a long cry, the death god Yveltal spread its massive wings, revealing the crimson "Y" symbol on its chest as red rays carried dense death energy!

Shadow Lugia and Lunala weren't to be outdone either.

One whipped up a hurricane wrapped in dark energy forming a cyclone attack.

The other soared into the sky, hanging before the full moon with wings spread as if completely covering and replacing the moon, gathering shadow power and shooting out ghostly light waves filled with spectral energy—Moongeist Beam!

"Hoopa!"

Finally, Hoopa Unbound wasn't to be outdone either, gathering its six arms at its chest and surging with the most evil Dark Pulse!

For a moment.

Facing Johan's group, it was like seeing a rainbow of lights—seven terrifying energies that made one shudder.

Getting hit by this would be getting off light if they only turned to ash!

Johan gripped Rayquaza's horns tightly and said resolutely:

"Rayquaza, Hurricane! Victini, Helping Hand!"

"Vii~!"

Victini's little face tensed up, the V on its head blazing with fire like wearing a "crown" of victory, pouring golden energy into the black-gold Mega Rayquaza.

"Roar—!!"

Mega black Rayquaza reared up, opened its mouth wide, and unleashed a terrifyingly violent hurricane that seemed capable of completely sweeping the entire city, meeting the seven incoming move impacts head-on!

"Mewtwo, Psychic!"

Buzz—

Mewtwo floating in mid-air had psychic light blazing in its eyes as an invisible force immediately enhanced the black Rayquaza's hurricane, making the already surging storm even more massive!

Rumble—

The hurricane surged, sweeping time, water, order, death, darkness, moon, desire and all other forces into it.

In an instant.

Energy clashed with energy, rules with rules, creating the most direct violent conflict.

Boom!!!

A terrifying explosion erupted, but the impact from the explosion didn't spread because this level of energy collision... directly caused space-time collapse in the area around the explosion center!

A massive black hole, like something that devoured everything, swallowed all the energy completely.

This wasn't simple temporal and spatial annihilation—even Dialga, the God of Time, couldn't help but narrow its eyes when seeing that collapsed space-time.

Even it couldn't say for certain whether it could escape if accidentally drawn into the center of such a collision.

This space-time collapse and world distortion left a black hole hanging in mid-air, echoing with the moon, persisting for a long time.

"Roar..."

Mega black Rayquaza took a deep breath, its expression becoming more exhilarated.

It blocked them!

One move against seven moves!

Although Victini's help and Mewtwo's Psychic were equally important, it was still the main force!

Even though it blocked them by causing space-time collapse, it still blocked them!

Blocked was blocked.

Honestly, even Hoopa Unbound was stunned that such a coordinated attack was blocked.

This didn't break through the opponent's defense?

At the same time.

The massive disturbance in Dahara City finally began to gradually calm down, with large numbers of Dahara City residents successfully evacuated to shelters.

Thanks to Johan's group predicting early that Hoopa Unbound would break free from the "Prison Bottle's" restraints again and inevitably attack little Hoopa and Desert Tower.

So they had contacted the mayor early for evacuation.

Although Dahara City had no gym, Officer Jenny and Nurse Joy were still there.

With Officer Jenny and Nurse Joy's help, the large city had already been evacuated by about seventy to eighty percent. When they were holding back Hoopa Unbound earlier, the remaining people had finally all been evacuated to safety.

Originally, Dahara City's mayor had hoped Johan's group could move the battlefield outside Dahara City, but Desert Tower was key to creating the new "Prison Bottle," and Hoopa Unbound would inevitably return.

Rather than trying to lure it away, it was better to prepare for evacuation early.

And now, with everyone evacuated, Dahara City's residents and some bold Dahara City news workers finally had the opportunity and time to watch this century-defining collision.

When everyone saw the "lineup" on both sides of Dahara City's largest river, not one person's jaw didn't drop.

What kind of divine lineup was this?

Legendary Pokémon!

All legendary Pokémon!

Even Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre, who had recently caused havoc in Hoenn, had appeared, with the black Mega Rayquaza particularly eye-catching.

Especially that earlier "collision of the century" had shocked everyone.

"It's! It's Teacher Johan? On that black Rayquaza's head—it's Teacher Johan!"

With safety secured, someone finally noticed the person standing on the black Rayquaza's head.

After all, not everyone was like the mayor, knowing Johan had come to Dahara City, but seeing Johan's appearance, everyone felt slightly relieved.

Teacher Johan was famously the "Legendary Pokémon Man," not only establishing friendly relationships with numerous legendary Pokémon but also calming multiple legendary Pokémon rampages.

But...

No matter how much they trusted Teacher Johan, when seeing Hoopa Unbound's lineup, no one could truly be completely at ease.

Too overwhelming!

At the same time, countless trainers from around the world flooded into the few livestreams brave enough to broadcast, watching those legendary Pokémon present with shocked pupils and gaping mouths unable to speak.

Among them were naturally Johan's friends.

For example, Cynthia training at the peak of Mt. Coronet.

She had received a call from Johan earlier, informing her that something big might happen soon, but Johan had confidently stated he could handle it.

After all, things were somewhat sudden, and Cynthia was too far away—without spatial power, she couldn't possibly make it in time.

Looking at the slightly blurry but still shocking livestream on her phone, Cynthia's beautiful face was particularly grave.

Garchomp beside her, also watching the livestream, looked extremely agitated, as if thinking why didn't I make it there...

"Garchomp!" Cynthia decisively put away her phone.

"Garrr?"

Facing Garchomp's confused gaze, Cynthia said with extreme determination:

"I'm going there!"

Last time, she had said she wanted to face things together with Johan, at least not let Johan bear everything alone.

Now such a big event had come—was she supposed to just watch from Mt. Coronet?

"Ga, Garrr?" Garchomp was stunned, asking in confusion.

How, how to get there?

Fly there?

By the time they reached Dahara City, Johan would probably be scattered to dust.

Cynthia bent down, looking toward the base of Mt. Coronet, speaking only three words.

"Solaceon Ruins, Unown, Spear Key!"

With the Unown's abilities and the special nature of the "Spear Key," she could definitely reach the battlefield in a short time.

As for what if the Unown didn't want to help...

"Garrr!"

Garchomp grinned ferociously.

Then it would make them more "cooperative"!

Under the night sky, Garchomp raced downward at extreme speed, with Cynthia half-kneeling on its back, absolutely determined at this moment.

"Wait for me!"

"Isn't it finished yet?"

Johan, riding on the black Rayquaza's head, looked back at the still-standing Desert Tower.

Around Desert Tower, everything was already ruins, making the towering Desert Tower even more prominent.

Johan rubbed his temples, trying to make them throb less violently.

Commanding the black Rayquaza in battle consumed tremendous stamina and mental energy. If not for his powerful aura abilities, he would have already collapsed.

After all, he was facing so many powerful legendary Pokémon.

Even with Mega black Rayquaza's strength plus Mewtwo's psychic power, defense alone was exhausting enough, let alone counterattacking—the difficulty and cost were too high.

However, while Johan and the black Rayquaza faced great pressure, Hoopa Unbound on the opposite side felt no less pressure.

Thump thump!

His heart again responded with violent tremors.

From Desert Tower's direction, that sense of dread grew ever stronger.

"Hoopa won't lose!"

Hoopa Unbound floated above the ruins, immediately commanding all legendary Pokémon to ignore Mega black Rayquaza and Mewtwo, directly attacking Desert Tower.

Moreover.

Buzz buzz buzz—

Golden rings opened dimensional portals, hovering before each legendary Pokémon.

On the other side, with Desert Tower as center, six golden rings also surrounded it!

Hoopa Unbound's signature Hyperspace Fury!

But this was Hyperspace Fury combined with six legendary Pokémon, not Hoopa Unbound's individual fists—the power far exceeded the earlier seven great Pokémon moves combined.

In an instant.

Blue, red, purple, black lights suddenly flashed, with overwhelming pressure making everyone hold their breath and pupils shake violently.

No matter Hoopa Unbound's battle experience and command ability, now it was forcibly bypassing Johan, Rayquaza and Mewtwo to directly attack Desert Tower, effectively achieving "attacking what must be saved"!

"Roar—!"

Mega black Rayquaza looked deeply at the opposing legendary Pokémon, immediately turning toward Desert Tower.

Mewtwo followed closely beside, ready to take over from the black Rayquaza and shoulder the main defensive responsibility.

But just then.

"Roar!!!"

A roar full of dominance accompanied by cracking earth and surging magma came roaring.

The next second.

Boom!!!

A massive rock spear wrapped in blazing magma rose like a sword from the ground, accompanied by violent earth tremors...

It struck Primal Kyogre's belly!

Precipice Blades!

"Bwooo!!"

The sudden attack, that all-too-familiar attack, forcibly interrupted Primal Kyogre's charging Origin Pulse!

It stared with shocked eyes at its old rival in disbelief.

If Primal Kyogre could speak human language right now, it would definitely say ^%$#^#@

Damn it.

You're picking a fight at this moment, lying dog?

Primal Kyogre immediately abandoned the golden ring before it, looking toward the distant Primal Groudon standing in the street.

There.

That crimson-gold giant wrapped in magma was provocatively beckoning to Primal Kyogre, roaring.

"Roar—!!"

So what if you can fly?! Tell me if you're so great!!

What's happening?

Not just Hoopa Unbound—even Johan looked toward Primal Groudon's direction in surprise. Didn't Boss Giovanni say...

Suddenly.

Johan's pupils contracted sharply.

Focusing his vision.

He saw on that Primal Groudon's head, wreathed in magma and scorching air, a sweating middle-aged man barely standing, swaying unsteadily.

Boss Giovanni!

On his chest, burn marks were particularly prominent.

The green Viridian Power wasn't being used to heal his injuries, but to sever the connection between Primal Groudon and Hoopa Unbound, forcibly establishing a connection between himself and Primal Groudon!

Without relying on the Red Orb!

The super-ancient "Earth God" Primal Groudon had briefly become a Pokémon under "Giovanni of the Earth's" command!

"Don't... forget about us!"

Giovanni's face was pale, coughing violently as he spoke, seeming at his limit, but his aura reached an unprecedented peak.

Burned out!

The sudden change altered the situation.

The original 2V7 became 3V7!

However.

This was only part of the change...

"Roar!!"

Another familiar roar—from behind Dialga, which was releasing Roar of Time, a black line suddenly appeared.

The next moment.

The line expanded, and a black-gray-gold three-colored dragon with devil-like black bone wings burst out!

Shadow Sneak!

Upon appearing, it directly pressed down on Dialga's head, forcing the Time Dragon that was gathering temporal power directly to the ground, grinding it dozens of meters across the concrete pavement!

The newcomer was none other than the Master of Antimatter, Lord of the Distortion World, the Renegade Dragon, Giratina!

And Giratina didn't appear alone.

On its back, a heroic-looking girl with flowing coat and golden hair had absolutely determined eyes.

Cynthia!

If Giovanni's appearance was unexpected but reasonable to Johan, then Cynthia's appearance... was completely unexpected.

How did she get here?

This involved Cynthia seeing the livestream and immediately rushing to Solaceon Ruins with Garchomp to find the Unown.

This time the Unown were "reasonable"—although they didn't help her immediately reach Dahara City, they helped her "contact" Giratina.

At that time, the struggling Giratina immediately recognized this girlfriend of Johan's, gritting its teeth to pull her over, while Cynthia without hesitation took over Giratina's command and helped it bear Hoopa Unbound's "desire" erosion.

But... Hoopa Unbound's "desire power" was as fragile as paper before the absolutely determined Cynthia, and Giratina finally broke free from its greatest restraint, returning to battle!

"You..." Johan opened his mouth.

"This time, I won't let you face it alone." Cynthia's voice was slightly low but unquestionable.

Obviously, just as Johan commanding the black Rayquaza required bearing pressure, Cynthia commanding Giratina... also had to bear even greater pressure.

"Roar—"

For the first time, Giratina looked at Johan with envious, almost jealous eyes.

Its mind recalled the scene when Cynthia appeared and they communicated.

"Giratina!" The small human stood before it, calling its name.

Before Giratina could respond, Cynthia said very seriously: "Lend me your power, I'll bear everything for you!"

"Roar—" (Not to look down on you, Johan's girlfriend, but you can't handle it!!)

Giratina's face was full of menace.

"No." Cynthia raised her hand, walking toward Giratina, saying word by word: "I can."

When Cynthia's palm touched Giratina, it immediately felt its whole body relax—those "desire power" shackles seemed to completely disappear in an instant.

But only it understood how difficult that power was to deal with. A mere human, with a human body, could actually...

"Roar?" (How did you do it? You're just a human...)

After Cynthia climbed onto its back, her answer was just one word.

"Him."

Back to the present, Giratina looked at Dialga again, beckoning menacingly.

"Come on!"

Dialga staggered up, looking at Giratina warily, then scanning the opposing lineup... its heart shook greatly.

The situation had changed again!

4 against 7!

However.

With Giratina's recovery, Darkrai no longer needed to entangle Kyurem for its sake and returned to Johan's side.

But similarly, Kyurem also returned to Hoopa Unbound's formation.

5 against 8!

Even Hoopa Unbound felt somewhat amazed.

Why did a mere human on the opposite side... have so many helpers?

Was he really human?

Hoopa Unbound quickly turned to look at Palkia.

At this moment, Palkia's power, or rather every bit of power, was crucial...

But the majestic Space God was being held up by a human who didn't even have Flying-type Pokémon?

Really?

Palkia looked at Flint in the ruins, bruised and battered, helping up Infernape while grinning and shouting at Palkia:

"Continue! We can fight like this all day!"

"Roar..."

Palkia looked at the human and his Pokémon who kept getting knocked down and standing up again, feeling their unwavering fighting spirit and passion from start to finish.

Even Palkia had to admit it had changed its view of this human and these Pokémon.

Of course.

If Palkia wanted to completely defeat Flint, it could do so, but the situation over there...

Joining that chaotic situation was too risky.

Palkia shook its head slightly, roaring at Flint.

"Roar!" (Come on, let's fight another three hundred rounds!)

"Hey!" Blood trickled from between Flint's teeth.

All this happened in just an instant.

Giovanni commanding Primal Groudon interrupted Primal Kyogre's Origin Pulse, Cynthia suddenly arrived commanding Giratina to pin Dialga to the ground...

But the attacks from "Z-God" Zygarde, Yveltal, Shadow Lugia, Lunala and Hoopa Unbound didn't stop!

"Giratina!" Cynthia called out.

Buzz—

A spatial rift to the Distortion World suddenly opened, and Zygarde's Core Enforcer passing through the dimensional portal was banished by Giratina to the ruined world, adding another patch of ruins to the already destroyed world.

"Rayquaza, Dragon Pulse!"

"Roar!!"

Surging Dragon-type energy poured from Mega black Rayquaza's mouth, purple-blue Dragon energy immediately forming a roaring dragon, tearing at Yveltal's Death Wing and colliding with Shadow Lugia's cyclone attack!

"Mewtwo, Psycho Break!"

Buzz—

Psychic power burst forth, mental force forming countless silk-like threads, cutting through Lunala's light beam.

Darkrai arrogantly called out, opening a massive black hole to swallow Hoopa Unbound's Dark Pulse.

Others couldn't hear what Darkrai was shouting, but Johan heard clearly.

"One truck! Two trucks! Three trucks! Ohhhh—!! Weaklings, bring more!" Making his face twitch.

However.

Mega black Rayquaza and Mewtwo's pressure suddenly decreased dramatically.

What remained was just holding out until the "Prison Bottle" was completed?

In fact, it wasn't that simple.

Because Hoopa Unbound had "evolved" again—it suddenly realized...

Humans! Had become the key to the current situation!

First Johan, then the middle-aged man, the suddenly appearing heroic woman, even the beaten-up explosive-haired guy...

Without these humans...

"It should have ended long ago!! Hoopa!!"

Hoopa Unbound shouted, using Hyperspace Fury again. Golden rings appeared before numerous legendary Pokémon, but no longer focused on Desert Tower or little Hoopa, but on these humans who had turned the tide!

"This guy..."

Johan's expression immediately changed, quickly shouting: "Mewtwo! Darkrai!"

These two had closer relationships with him, so they understood his meaning.

Mewtwo disappeared wrapped in psychic power.

When it reappeared, it was behind Giovanni.

Giovanni didn't waste words. He understood Johan's meaning and knew his own body's condition, sighing: "I leave it to him..."

Speaking, his body fell backward like a broken kite.

As he fell, Giovanni felt some regret.

If... if his physical condition were at its peak...

Mewtwo wrapped Giovanni in psychic power, enveloping him.

Its expression showed emotion.

Honestly.

This was the first time Mewtwo had seen Giovanni in this state, and couldn't help but recall when it first met Giovanni, what he had said.

"Want to change the world? We can cooperate!"

Now, in another way, they had achieved cooperation.

After catching Giovanni, it instantly disappeared from atop Primal Groudon, avoiding Hoopa Unbound's Hyperspace Fury.

Naturally, Johan took over Primal Groudon's "command."

At the same time.

Darkrai sank into shadows.

Then emerged from Cynthia's shadow on Giratina's back, saying:

"Time to take cover."

Cynthia bit her lip, still absolutely determined, shaking her head: "No need."

Looking at her eyes, Darkrai thought of when it first arrived in Alamos Town, the look in Alicia's eyes when she protected it.

No, even more determined than Alicia!

What admirable will—is this the power of love?

But with danger present, Darkrai still said as Johan had taught it:

"He needs Giratina's power."

Cynthia looked at Johan, seeing him also looking at her, nodding slightly.

"I see..."

Her heart relaxed, and Cynthia swayed slightly. The burden of commanding Giratina aside, just helping it resist Hoopa Unbound's "desire power" erosion brought her tremendous pressure.

But fortunately...

She had helped Johan through the most difficult moment. Now she just needed to transfer Giratina's control.

Darkrai immediately caught Cynthia, shadows enveloping her, taking her away from Hyperspace Fury's range.

"Damn..."

Sweat poured from Johan's forehead—adding Primal Groudon and Giratina had dramatically increased his pressure.

"But far from enough..."

"Giratina!" Johan shouted.

"Roar?" Giratina looked at him.

"Call for help!"

Hey!

Giratina grinned.

Opening spatial rifts, passing through the Distortion World, one black and one white figure flew out!

White Dragon Reshiram, Black Dragon Zekrom!

For Johan, these were among the legendary Pokémon with relatively little pressure to command!

Finally arriving on the battlefield at this moment!

"Roar—!!"

"Roar!!!"

Little Hoopa saw the black and white dragons, eyes widening.

"Little Johan is amazing! Really amazing! Can actually call for help! Hoopa catches, Little Johan calls!"

Seeing this scene, Hoopa Unbound finally couldn't help but scratch its head.

Damn, am I Hoopa Unbound, or is the opponent Hoopa?

Could it be that besides Unbound and Confined forms, Hoopa had a human form?

Giratina's recovery completely eliminated Johan's side's numerical disadvantage.

Hoopa Unbound's side: Dialga, Primal Kyogre, "Z-God" Zygarde, Yveltal, Shadow Lugia, Kyurem, Lunala and Hoopa Unbound—eight total!

Johan's side: black Rayquaza, Mewtwo, Giratina, Primal Groudon, Darkrai, Reshiram, Zekrom and Johan—actually achieving numerical parity!

But parity?

Johan indicated that remained to be seen!

He pulled out a metal pendant from his inner pocket!

DNA Splicers!

Seeing this thing, Kyurem's heart jumped.

"Reshiram, Zekrom!"

Both dragons looked at him.

"Fuse! Whoever gets control wins!"

[I'll go.]

Reshiram flapped its snow-white wings, basking in the light of the [DNA Splicers], lunging toward Kyurem.

Though the True Person's current state was poor, his will had far exceeded when they first met!

Such strong True Will made power continuously surge within Reshiram.

The stronger the True Person, the stronger the True Dragon!

It once feared Kyurem, but now...

It was time for it to take control!

It couldn't say for how long, but at least... until this battle ended, control of the body would definitely be its!

[Pity.]

Zekrom pursed its lips, regretting that its reaction wasn't as fast as its brother's, otherwise the Ideal Person's current vision was equally intense!

Reshiram and Kyurem were about to fuse!

Johan shouted again:

"If you don't come out, I won't handle your business afterward!"

A stream of light flew over.

Transforming into a green-black hunting dog.

Zygarde!

The "hound" showed humanized helplessness.

[It's not that I was watching—I really have my reasons.]

It had its reasons and difficulties.

"Help me temporarily handle it. After this ends, I'll help you deal with your partner," Johan interrupted.

[It's a deal!]

Zygarde didn't doubt Johan's words at all.

Immediately lunging toward the alternate-colored "Z-God" Zygarde, countless green lights gathered from all directions.

[Greetings from another world, partner. Let me introduce myself...]

Two Zygarde, one white and one green, actually... began fusing too?!

Hoopa Unbound witnessed this scene, dumbfounded.

You can defect like this too?

Can't you play fair?

Believe it or not, I'll pull out a[Fusion Removal]!

Rumble—

Suddenly.

From Desert Tower's direction came extremely violent tremors and roars, as if the sky itself was shaking.

Hoopa Unbound's expression froze.

Johan's smile grew wider.

The new "Prison Bottle" was complete!
