# 674: VS Hoopa Unbound! Zygarde: So Close, Just So Close...

Kyurem was forcibly fused by Reshiram using Johan's DNA Splicers, transforming into the legendary White Kyurem!

However, while the two sides fought for control of the body, they were forced to leave the battlefield.

Similarly, this world's Zygarde core "Little Soft" and the white "Z-God" Zygarde summoned by Hoopa Unbound also left the core combat zone and entered the desert after cell fusion to compete for bodily control.

At this point.

Johan's side briefly gained a numerical advantage.

But.

At this moment, Flint had finally reached his limit. Fighting Palkia alone as a mere mortal, although there was some holding back involved, it could still be called legendary—his stubborn will to delay for so long had earned Palkia's recognition.

[You explosive-haired guy...]

Palkia used spatial power to place the unconscious Flint and his Pokémon in a relatively safe location.

But it hadn't escaped Hoopa Unbound's influence, only regaining some rationality during the battle with Flint. Its return once again balanced the numerical scale.

It was precisely at this moment.

Inside Desert Tower, Barza and Meray, with the help of source powers and Johan's Pokémon, finally completed the new "Prison Bottle"!

This became the signal that pushed this battle to its climactic peak!

Sensing this, Hoopa Unbound went completely berserk, freely adding various negative emotions and desires to the legendary Pokémon it had summoned, causing some previously wavering legendary Pokémon to completely unleash themselves under negative influence.

"Hoopa won't disappear!" Hoopa Unbound again activated golden rings, swinging and throwing punches, its target clearly aimed directly at the black Rayquaza!

Signature move, Hyperspace Fury!

But the black Rayquaza had already become familiar with its attack patterns and methods, dodging this attack with an agile turn.

However, the following "Death Wing" caught the black Rayquaza somewhat off-guard, forcing it to use Extreme Speed to try evading.

Under Hoopa Unbound's influence, Yveltal's initial attack target wasn't the black Rayquaza, but Johan on its head.

Seeing Death Wing about to sweep over him, Johan, who had already witnessed this move's terrible power, decisively let go and fell from the black Rayquaza.

Wind roared in his ears.

Falling amid the clash of numerous legendary Pokémon—one careless moment meant being shattered to pieces.

Fortunately.

Johan still had Gengar, little Hoopa and the others by his side.

"Lo! Lolo!"

Little Hoopa reacted much faster, immediately using golden rings to appear below Johan. After passing through, he landed directly on the ground.

"Were you scared, Little Johan?" Little Hoopa floated up from his shoulder, grinning as it withdrew the golden ring while playfully asking.

Johan shook his head, taking a deep breath before exhaling long.

In the air, Mega black Rayquaza released its Mega Evolution state, and Johan's pressure decreased considerably.

After he steadied himself, the black Rayquaza broke through layers of obstacles and came before him again, showing some inquiry in its eyes.

Johan waved his hand, somewhat wearily saying: "I'm fine, but now even without me, dealing with them shouldn't be a problem."

Hearing this, the black Rayquaza nodded, showing some regret in its expression.

What a pity—the Mega state was really great, but it seemed Johan wasn't planning to support another Mega Evolution.

All because of that damn Yveltal!

"Rayquaza, I'll leave it to you." Johan gasped twice before continuing.

The black Rayquaza understood his meaning, nodding and immediately transforming into a straight arrow, soaring into the sky again with layers of sonic boom sounds around it.

"Roar!!!"

Yveltal, come and die!!

Even without Mega Evolution, the black Rayquaza's strength was above Yveltal's. Carrying fury, it headbutted Yveltal toward the sky, continuously ascending!

"Screech!!"

Yveltal's cries of pain grew more distant.

"Bwooo..."

Primal Kyogre's gaze followed Yveltal and the black Rayquaza upward, showing a look of watching a good show.

Back in the day, only it and Groudon had received such treatment.

Suddenly, the river beneath Primal Kyogre trembled, and Precipice Blades rose from the ground again.

"Roar!!"

Who the hell are you looking at? Your opponent is me!

Possibly influenced by Giovanni, Primal Groudon now had a more domineering air.

But as old rivals, this was the second time Primal Kyogre failed to react to Primal Groudon's sudden attack. Did it still want to sneak attack?

"Bwooo!!" (Lying dog!)

Primal Kyogre violently slapped the water and flew up, dodging Precipice Blades while spitting out a water cannon, met by Primal Groudon's Fire Blast!

As two old rivals, it was quite difficult for them to quickly determine a winner in a short time.

Also as old rivals, Dialga was more miserable, facing Giratina alone with almost only defensive power and no chance to fight back, being ground into the earth by Giratina.

However, the attacks of these two great legendary Pokémon were truly rule-based moves of extreme power—wherever they passed, whether tall buildings or low houses, all vanished into nothingness.

Highlighting one point: Giratina, you might as well not fight Dialga.

Compared to these rather noisy ones, the duel between Mewtwo and Shadow Lugia was obviously much quieter.

This Shadow Lugia summoned by Hoopa Unbound wasn't the traditional Ocean Current God, but its mastery of wind power was much stronger than the Lugia Johan knew.

In the complex city full of buildings, it engaged in tense and exciting "speed and passion" with Mewtwo, while Mewtwo maintained a certain initiative throughout.

Similarly "quiet" were Lunala and Zekrom.

Saying they weren't "loud" didn't mean the collisions they caused were small, but rather both legendary Pokémon had flown into mid-air.

Lunala, with the moon's power and its own mastery of shadow power, had the advantage in the moonlit sky as its home field.

What a coincidence.

Zekrom was black enough.

So in their collision, one could only see scattered aftershocks and hear huge sounds, but it was hard to see these two figures.

Of course.

Speaking of truly quiet, that had to be Palkia and Darkrai.

On the pitch-black city streets, Darkrai stood on an electric pole, its single pale blue eye staring intently at the huge guy before it.

During the Alamos Town incident, it had already fought Palkia, and had cooperated when facing Arceus. If not knowing everything about each other, they at least knew quite a lot, so it was still very wary of Palkia's abilities.

"If the enemy doesn't move, I don't move." Darkrai just stared at Palkia, letting cloud-like black mist drift in the wind.

The Palkia facing it also understood this seemingly clever but inwardly reckless Darkrai.

This guy, when reckless, truly feared nothing—it even dared to fight Arceus.

The key point was.

Clearly just a mythical Pokémon, just a Nightmare God, but no matter who it fought, it could surprisingly go fifty-fifty!

Palkia seriously suspected this Darkrai had a hidden authority called "Legendary Pokémon Quality Inspector"—only Pokémon that could go fifty-fifty with it could be called legendary Pokémon.

So...

"If the enemy doesn't move, I don't move." Palkia was inwardly vigilant.

The fight had completely broken out.

At this moment, Johan was physically and mentally exhausted, just waiting for Barza and the others to bring the new "Prison Bottle" to seal Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" again, then the remaining legendary Pokémon would be easier to handle...

With this thought, Johan suddenly felt a chill behind him, spontaneously developing an idea.

Where was Hoopa Unbound?

Buzz—

A huge golden ring appeared above his head out of nowhere, with night's gloom enveloping him even more.

Looking up sharply.

He saw a massive fist crashing down.

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar quickly floated out, rushing toward that falling fist.

Bang!!!

Shockwaves scattered!

Gengar honestly caught that fist bigger than itself!

"Hoopa is the strongest!"

At the corner of towering buildings, Hoopa Unbound quietly appeared, grinning maliciously as it stared at Johan, its sinister aura making him shudder.

"Hoopa is the best at catching!"

This human before it was the real source causing the situation to become like this. As fellow "catchers," now was their moment of confrontation!

Huff, inhale, huff—

Johan's chest was like a bellows, but after just one glance at Hoopa Unbound, he turned to look behind him.

In his aura.

Barza and Meray, along with his own Urshifu, Ceruledge, and Tyranitar, had arrived nearby.

In Barza's hand, he gripped a brand new "Prison Bottle" tightly!

"Hoopa!" Barza held the "Prison Bottle," shouting at Hoopa Unbound.

"No!"

Also seeing the "Prison Bottle," Hoopa Unbound cried out in terror, trying to retreat.

Buzz—

The "Millennium Wrist" on Barza's chest suddenly blazed with golden light as he opened the bottle stopper, his face full of justice.

"Time, sky..."

The "Prison Bottle" suddenly burst with extremely strong suction, and Hoopa Unbound's turning motion was directly frozen!

The next second.

Hoopa Unbound's massive body immediately transformed into black-red mist with a "bang" and was absorbed back into the "Prison Bottle."

"Success!" Meray said joyfully.

Seeing this, Johan swayed slightly and was about to sit down on the ground.

"Garruu!"

"Goka!"

Urshifu and Ceruledge flashed to his sides, supporting him left and right.

"It's over..."

Thud thud thud thud—

Suddenly.

The sound of violent bottle shaking entered his ears.

"I, I..." Barza's forehead veins bulged as he gripped the "Prison Bottle," his face fierce, the "Prison Bottle" in his hands shaking violently.

The bottle shot out!

Johan's heart pounded wildly as he immediately reached for the flying "Prison Bottle."

Boom!!

The moment he touched the "Prison Bottle," a chaotic, violent energy filled with various negative emotions crazily poured into his mind.

In an instant, half-kneeling on the ground, his eyes turned blood-red.

"Hoopa won't disappear!!" Johan spoke in Hoopa Unbound's voice.

"Ka-kaah?"

"Bangi?"

His Pokémon immediately surrounded him.

"Little Johan?" Little Hoopa also quickly came over.

But before the little ones could touch him, Johan gripped the "Prison Bottle" with one hand while raising the other to block his Pokémon and little Hoopa from approaching.

"Ka-kaah!!" Gengar seemed to understand Johan's condition and immediately called out to the "Prison Bottle."

Come at me! I'll fight you for three hundred rounds!

"Hmph..."

Johan grunted, and the "Millennium Wrist" in his inner pocket released gentle energy, reducing the negative energy from Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow" that Johan was bearing.

He suddenly grinned with a fierce expression, saying hoarsely:

"You want to come out?"

"Hoopa! Lo..."

"Shut up!"

At this moment, Johan was like he had split personality disorder, playing two roles by himself, arguing with himself.

"Little Johan..." Little Hoopa was somewhat afraid now.

But Johan squeezed out a gentle smile, indicating it was fine.

Then he said to the Hoopa Unbound inside himself: "Fine, since you want to come out..."

"Then come out!"

Pop!

The new "Prison Bottle's" stopper was pulled out by Johan.

"Teacher Johan?" Seeing this scene, Meray cried out.

"Hahaha!! Hoopa is back!!"

As the "Prison Bottle's" stopper was removed, black-red mist surged out once again, and Hoopa Unbound returned to freedom again, quickly condensing its previous form.

Seeing this scene, Meray was about to ask when Barza stretched out his hand to stop her, shaking his head and saying:

"Trust Teacher Johan."

Although he didn't know whether Teacher Johan doing this was his own will or because he was influenced by the "Shadow."

But look at the outside situation.

Teacher Johan had even handled such huge trouble with legendary Pokémon flying everywhere—besides trusting, what else could they do?

"Little Johan!"

As soon as the Hoopa Unbound "Shadow" disappeared from Johan, little Hoopa immediately rushed over.

"I'm fine." Johan shook his head, indicating his Pokémon didn't need to worry either.

They all looked at the once-again condensed Hoopa Unbound.

"Hoopa." Johan placed his hand on little Hoopa's head, saying softly.

"Mm?"

"Want to recover your true power?"

"True power..." Little Hoopa was stunned.

Images floated in its mind of itself once commanding wind and rain, omnipotent and so powerful.

But quickly, its mind also showed the years in the Valley of Creation, in Dahara City living with Barza and Meray, the process of meeting Johan and Gengar and the others.

Its eyes quickly became determined.

"If recovering power means losing Little Johan and everyone, then Hoopa doesn't want power!"

Behind it, Barza and Meray were moved.

You know, during these years living together, what little Hoopa talked about most was how amazing it used to be, how powerful its strength was, and that it must recover its power and such.

But at this moment, little Hoopa said it didn't want power?

Johan was also stunned for a moment, then smiled even more brilliantly as he vigorously rubbed the little one's head.

"If it's power given by others, of course you can't control it, but if it's power you earn yourself—that's yours!"

"Power... earned myself?" Little Hoopa tilted its head.

"Just like..." Johan paused briefly, then said: "Just like when we made donuts together, the donuts you make yourself taste the best."

Little Hoopa's eyes lit up.

"Hoopa wants it!"

Johan said: "Good, and I also need Hoopa's power to help."

"Help!" Little Hoopa nodded repeatedly. "Hoopa wants to help! Hoopa can help Little Johan!"

"Good child."

Johan stood up again, looking at the restored Hoopa Unbound. Beside him, Gengar, Urshifu, Ceruledge, and Tyranitar all looked over with serious expressions.

He gripped the "Prison Bottle" and exhaled deeply.

Through the earlier contact, he understood.

This thing was just like a Poké Ball. With Hoopa Unbound currently at full strength, plus absorbing massive negative energy during its time out, it could no longer be sealed using just the "Prison Bottle."

How do you normally catch Pokémon?

Of course, defeat them, then throw the ball when the opponent loses fighting ability or becomes weak.

So...

The current situation was the same.

"Let's work together and beat it down!"

"Beat it down!" Little Hoopa clenched its fists, fighting spirit high!

Hoopa Unbound laughed loudly, "Hahaha—without those legendary Pokémon helping, just you all?"

"Hoopa is the strongest!"

Dark Pulse surged forth.

Johan forced himself to concentrate, supporting his weary body to directly face Hoopa Unbound's attacking Dark Pulse.

Boom!!

Shockwaves scattered, a black suit fluttering in the wind, falling into the confused Meray's hands.

In the white smoke, Johan stood calmly and composed, his expression unchanged as he slowly rolled up his shirt sleeves.

Before him, a snow-white Ninetales and a gleaming metal hammer together blocked this Dark Pulse impact!

"Hmph!"

Hoopa Unbound's eyes were fierce as golden rings floated.

It could naturally sense that Johan's current condition wasn't good—in fact, it was very bad, so... strike while he's down!

Six golden rings appeared around Johan, all fists striking out!

Hyperspace Fury!

Buzz buzz buzz—

"Bangi!!"

Tyranitar roared.

Don't ignore us!!

Tyranitar, which hadn't fought Hoopa Unbound before, showed no fear, firmly gripping the ground with both feet and charging toward one of the fists.

At the same time.

Ninetales, Dragonite, Tinkaton, Urshifu, and Ceruledge also used their respective methods to counter each fist.

Freezing World!

Crack crack crack—

The fist was covered in frost.

Outrage, activate!

Bang!!

Red-eyed Dragonite firmly caught the fist with both hands, its feet unmoved, small wings vibrating rapidly.

Gigaton Hammer!

Boom!!

The incredibly heavy hammer pressed against the fist's surface—for a moment it was impossible to tell whether Tinkaton's strength was too great or the hammer too heavy.

But the Fairy energy full of life force wrapping around it made the fist emit "sizzling" burning sounds.

In fist fights, Coach Urshifu had never lost!

Wicked Blow!

The massive fist and tiny fist were evenly matched at this moment?

Fists were like this, let alone blades?

Crossed sword blades accompanied by ghostly blue flames, causing damage while continuously absorbing power—under this ebb and flow, it actually blocked it!

Six fists, six Pokémon!

"Hoopa! Let's see how you block this!"

But above Johan's head, another golden ring appeared as Hoopa Unbound's head emerged, forcefully using Psybeam on Johan!

"Lo! Lo!"

At this time, little Hoopa also moved. Facing the fierce Hoopa Unbound, facing this existence it feared most in its heart, it acted without a moment's hesitation!

Little Hoopa's golden ring appeared above Johan's head, teleporting Hoopa Unbound's Psybeam elsewhere.

Seeing this scene, Hoopa Unbound roared angrily.

"You disappear quickly!"

"Hoopa won't disappear! Hoopa won't disappear! The one who should disappear is you!!" Little Hoopa fearlessly responded.

It was also at this moment that Johan finished rolling up his sleeves while completely withdrawing what little aura power remained.

"About time..." he said flatly.

About time?

About time for what?

"Garchomp, Mega Evolution!" A delicate shout came.

"Garrr!!"

An extremely fierce Garchomp completed Mega Evolution in mid-air, wearing a dragon's armor, charging toward Hoopa Unbound's body location.

Cynthia!

"Hoopa! Lolo!"

If it was energy attacks, Hoopa Unbound could transfer them through dimensional portals, but this kind of pure physical impact...

Hoopa Unbound quickly gathered its psychic power to resist Mega Garchomp's terrifying charge.

Boom!!

"That's it? That's your trump card? One Garchomp?"

Hoopa Unbound's head above Johan scoffed disdainfully.

But Johan slowly looked up, the Key Stone in his hand brilliantly shining.

"This? This is just the prelude."

Johan's expression suddenly became solemn, his stern voice emerging from the dazzling rainbow light of the Key Stone.

"Gengar, Mega Evolution!"

"Ka-kaah!!"

Surging white light interwoven with black mist enveloped Gengar.

As the evolution light faded, Mega Gengar with spikes covering its back and hands made its second appearance today!

Gengar?

Hoopa Unbound's heart jumped.

It had almost forgotten about this guy earlier—when it attacked, it didn't appear to help this human defend, so it wanted to...

But Hoopa Unbound quickly scoffed disdainfully again, "Even adding this Gengar won't change anything."

It had fought Gengar before—even Mega evolved, wasn't it easy to handle?

However, out of wariness, Hoopa Unbound prepared to withdraw.

But the next second.

Its expression changed.

It saw.

Its six arms were actually being held in reverse by Johan's Pokémon!

Even.

Little Hoopa had flown before its head, gritting its teeth as it grabbed its head.

"You..."

"Trying to catch you was really difficult." Johan's pale face showed a smile, wanting you to take one attack was even more difficult.

With its ability to open dimensional portals, plus its increasingly powerful strength...

"What exactly are you trying to do?"

"What am I doing?"

Johan's smile widened, "Either you kill me now, or I kill you!"

The next second, Johan's expression suddenly became fierce as he shouted:

"Gengar! Terastalization!"

A black ball filled with strange power was thrown by Johan into little Hoopa's golden ring, precisely landing on Mega Gengar's head.

Crack—crack crack crack—

Brilliant crystalline crystal completely enveloped Mega Gengar, shattering completely in an instant, and Mega Gengar's appearance seemed to become a crystal sculpture.

"Not enough! Not enough!"

Johan flipped his wrist.

In his hand was a Z-Crystal filled with Ghost-type energy!

Seeing that Z-Crystal, Hoopa Unbound's eyes shook like an earthquake as it shouted:

"You're crazy? Can your body handle this?"

"Hey!" Johan remained unmoved, just taking a deep breath, letting air rush into his lungs to stimulate his spirit, "I said, either you kill me now, or..."

Buzz—

The Z-Crystal released incredibly ghostly energy, madly pouring into Gengar's body.

"Ka-kaah!!"

At this moment, Gengar's power seemed to break through some kind of shackle—even its body color seemed to become slightly whiter.

You know.

The "Gengar Legion" that little Hoopa had summoned hadn't left yet!

Hoopa Unbound struggled frantically, its dimensional portals shaking wildly, but it couldn't break free from the Pokémon's restraints in a short time.

"Lolo!!"

Little Hoopa gritted its teeth, hugging Hoopa Unbound's massive head.

Johan felt his body seemed instantly drained.

Honestly, today was truly exhausting.

First Gengar's Mega Evolution, then the black Rayquaza's Mega Evolution, then commanding numerous legendary Pokémon in battle, resisting Hoopa Unbound's negative emotion erosion, and now... Gengar's Mega Evolution, Terastalization, and Z-move all at once!

Johan even doubted whether he could survive afterward.

Although he was unwilling to admit it, when he grabbed the "Prison Bottle" earlier, he had been more or less influenced by Hoopa Unbound's negative emotions.

Otherwise, he probably wouldn't "dare" to confront it this way.

But.

Whether he could survive or not, he had to kill this Hoopa Unbound now!

"Gengar!!"

Johan's voice was hoarse, but his tone was extremely firm.

"Million Gengar, Explosion!!"

"Ka-kaah!! (◣_◢)"

Gengar leaped up, the black shadow behind it like a curtain, infinitely expanding and stretching, with numerous differently shaped Gengar appearing within.

At this moment, they seemed to reach some kind of agreement—one Gengar shadow after another merged into Johan's Gengar, finally becoming an incredibly massive black hole!

Everything around seemed to be sucked in and swept up by the black hole's gravity.

Especially the emotional power that Hoopa Unbound possessed, with the portion Gengar had absorbed earlier as a guide, was drawn into the void.

"Ka-kaah!!"

With Gengar's roar.

The incredibly massive black hole struck squarely on the inescapable Hoopa Unbound.

"No—"

Boom!!!

Crack crack crack—

Everything around vanished and was annihilated in countless shattering sounds.

Just like Giratina's antimatter power, the most direct erasure!

"No!!!" Hoopa Unbound, bearing the center of this power, naturally... felt its threat most acutely.

Was this... really power that an ordinary Pokémon could possess?

This was its final thought?

No!

Hoopa Unbound stared deadly at Johan—it was this human, this human!

Always humans, why always humans, why forever humans!!!

Damn!

Damn!

Damn!

"Don't think you'll have it easy either!"

Bang bang bang!!

Hoopa Unbound's body shattered, and those six gripped arms naturally all broke apart, but before its body completely collapsed, its head broke free from little Hoopa's laughable restraint with one final golden ring, enveloping Johan.

Boom—

"Time, sky..." Barza reacted faster, grabbing the "Prison Bottle" with one hand while chanting the incantation, once again absorbing Hoopa Unbound.

He had to admit, this time the resistance was... countless times weaker.

Just like catching Pokémon—first exhaust their stamina or apply a debuff.

But he still looked worriedly toward the ruins.

Under the golden ring, the collapsed Johan showed a weak smile to the approaching Gengar.

"It's really good having you all with me..."

"Johan!!" The arriving Cynthia widened her disbelieving eyes.

Clatter.

A monocle fell among the ruins.

In an instant.

All the Pokémon froze.

"Oowoo, Oowoo?"

"Ban, Bangi?"

"Cha..."

"Vii..."

The Pokémon looked at that empty place, the remaining monocle, all showing bewildered expressions, unable to even feel panic.

Johan had disappeared?

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar, having shed all its power, crashed into the center, grabbing the monocle from the ground.

Its eyes were vacant.

It couldn't sense Johan's presence anymore...

The legendary Pokémon in battle nearby, those closest to Johan—Mewtwo, Zekrom, Darkrai and others—all immediately abandoned their opponents and came.

"Little Johan..." Little Hoopa was also vacant, murmuring.

Its mind showed the scene from a few days ago when they made donuts together, when Johan encouraged and recognized it.

"Little Johan!"

Little Hoopa suddenly gritted its teeth, lunging at Barza and snatching the "Prison Bottle" from his hands!

"Power! Power! Power! Give Hoopa back its power! Give me back my power!!"

With a somewhat crying voice, it frantically absorbed power from the "Prison Bottle."

But this time, it wasn't for showing off, not for boasting, not to prove its strength, but to find a way to save Johan!

The meaning of "punishment" was nothing more than this.

Patter—

A crystal drop quietly fell.

Touching the glasses, it shattered into petals.

Gengar held the glasses, biting its lip as it suddenly looked up.

Eyes blood-red!

"Ka-kaah!"

Everyone lift your heads!

Not far away.

"Little Soft," who was fusing with the white "Z-God" Zygarde, noticed this scene as dangerous signals wildly jumped in its heart.

[We're screwed!]

The one person who absolutely shouldn't disappear, how could...

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar looked fiercely at Mewtwo.

Rayquaza, hold that so-called "death god"!

Then looking at the silent Zekrom and equally fierce Darkrai.

"Ka-kaah!"

Ultimate weapon, it's in Geosenge Town—I want to see it now!

Finally looking at Old Johan's family of partners, they had also put away all sadness, their eyes as determined as Gengar's.

"Ka-kaah!"

Go dig out that damn deer still sleeping in the forest!

Then!

Ho-Oh! That guy who can revive life—I want to see it too!

At this moment, Gengar seemed to inherit Johan's "wisdom," acting as the "big brother" and frantically issuing "orders."

And those blood-red fierce eyes showed not one objection from anyone.

"Ka-kaah!!!!"

Time God, Space God, plus Celebi, Mew—I want them all! All of them appear here immediately! Right now! This instant!!!!

"I'll take down Dialga!"

Cynthia wiped her face, biting her hair tie to put up her hair.

Those eyes made no one dare to look directly.

All the Pokémon, even the legendary Pokémon hearing this, turned to take action.

Just then.

A weak voice sounded.

"Cough cough..."

Time seemed to freeze at this moment.

Everyone, every Pokémon, after being rigid for two or three seconds, all looked toward the source of the voice.

There.

Little Hoopa, rubbing its nose with tears in its eyes.

Before a golden ring, Johan lay weakly on the ground in tattered shirt.

Gengar's eyes immediately cleared, flying to Johan's side.

Although little Hoopa had brought him back from the "banished dimension," Johan felt his body gradually losing sensation.

And Gengar and the others could see more clearly—Johan's body, starting from his palms, seemed to be gradually becoming transparent.

"Ka-kaah!"

No!

Gengar quickly covered Johan's palms with both hands, seemingly trying to press those scattering particles back.

Cynthia and the other Pokémon, after initial joy, became panicked again.

At this moment, Johan appeared unusually calm.

Now thinking back to the earlier situation, even he had to admit he had indeed been influenced by some of Hoopa Unbound's negative emotions, even through the "Prison Bottle."

After all, these were negative emotions capable of influencing and controlling so many legendary Pokémon.

The crazed Hoopa "Shadow" had brought "madness" to himself as well.

However, through that collision, like a surgical knife, it had precisely separated Hoopa Unbound's power and emotions to a certain degree.

This was also an important reason why little Hoopa could so smoothly reclaim its power.

Speaking of "psychological therapy," it was successful too. Good thing he hadn't gone up unprepared... ow, I miss Cynthia's legs... At this moment, Johan's thoughts were wandering.

Fortunately, he quickly came back to himself.

Showing a weak smile.

His voice hoarse:

"Have Hoopa help find Celebi, call Marshadow back, or... or find Arceus..."

Patter—

Lying on Johan's chest, covering those scattering particles, Gengar looked tragic as another crystal tear fell.

Buzz—

Suddenly.

From the ruins, from Johan's discarded coat, the "Rainbow Wing" floated out.

[Rainbow Wing]: After "eating" free meals for so long...

A shadow suddenly appeared below the "Rainbow Wing," then a small hand reached out to grab the feather. The one emerging was... the "Shadow Guide" Marshadow.

"Marsha?"

Wow, how did it get this bad?

Holding the "Rainbow Wing," Marshadow hurried forward in two steps, pressing the feather against Johan's chest—those scattering light particles visibly slowed.

At the same time.

The "Millennium Wrist" also floated up on its own, emitting sacred light.

Little Hoopa seemed to understand something, or perhaps received guidance, nodding: "Hoopa found it!"

Speaking, it opened a dimensional portal through the golden ring.

"Bii~"

Bang—

"Little Soft" collapsed exhausted, frantically wiping its forehead.

[Close, so close... I almost felt this whole world would have to be 'buried with him'... Was it Hoopa Unbound's final dimensional portal that sent Johan to another world?]

This day, Zygarde recorded an important entry in its "diary"—

Johan, suggest not letting him disappear (crossed out), absolutely cannot let him die (emphasized)!

# 675: I Want to Become Champion (Two-in-One Chapter)

A blank, void space.

Johan sat cross-legged on what could be called the "ground," looking at the sacred alpaca before him—oh, Arceus.

[How did you end up like this...]

A gentle, calm voice tinged with helplessness echoed through this space.

It had only wanted Johan to help reinforce Hoopa Unbound's seal, so how did things end up becoming such a big mess...

Johan squeezed his arm and shrugged:

"Can't help it. As a 'Pokémon psychologist,' I can't stand seeing Pokémon 'having episodes.'"

Arceus's eyes showed a mix of exasperation and amusement.

['Pokémon psychologist'? And then you got influenced by those negative emotions? Making such crazy moves?]

Johan grinned.

"If I didn't experience those emotions myself, how could I perform 'surgery'? I had to ensure Hoopa wouldn't be influenced by those emotions again."

Personally experiencing those emotions...

Arceus looked at the smiling Johan, silent for a long time.

[Weren't you afraid?]

"I was." Johan put away his smile and nodded seriously.

[Then you...]

But he quickly showed an even brighter smile.

"First, I did want to test my and Gengar's limits, but never had the courage to act on it. This time, the hidden 'madness' in my heart was triggered."

"Second, I believe in my little ones, and I believe in the friends I've made. Of course, that includes you too, Arceus."

It was Arceus's "Millennium Wrist" that guided him here. Johan didn't think Arceus would do nothing in the end.

"Can't help it—I have too many friends."

Seeing Johan's somewhat "cheeky" expression, Arceus was both amused and exasperated.

But...

Friends?

Who would have thought that it, Arceus, would have a day when someone considered it a friend?

The feeling wasn't bad at all.

Johan continued: "Third... forget it, the first two reasons are enough."

The third reason was probably that many beings wouldn't dare let you die, right?

Arceus mentally completed Johan's unfinished thought.

It shook its head slightly.

[After this incident is over, go find the 'Fairy Plate.']

"Fairy Plate?" Johan looked like he'd lost the will to live. "I still have to do 'work' for you..."

Arceus said irritably:

[What do you mean 'work for me'? That's for your own benefit.]

"For my own benefit?"

Arceus sighed lightly.

[You really pushed yourself too hard this time. To prevent you from exhausting yourself beyond human form again in the future, find the 'Fairy Plate.']

[Besides Xerneas, it's the most abundant source of 'life energy' in the entire world.]

Actually, Johan had another reason for daring to take such a "risk" that he hadn't mentioned.

When Xerneas had previously infused Ninetales and Tinkaton with "life energy" to teach them abilities, he had also been a beneficiary.

With Xerneas's "life energy" protection, even if the so-called "backup"—like Celebi, the ultimate cameraman—didn't appear, he should have been able to hold on long enough to fully recover.

It's just that he might have suffered for a long time.

But Arceus's words did remind him about the "Fairy Plate" matter.

To be safe, he could indeed "borrow" it for a while.

[You can 'go back' now.]

Johan was stunned.

"So soon?"

[There's still a pile of 'mess' waiting for you to clean up.]

"True..."

A bunch of legendary Pokémon were still gathered in Dahara City.

Speaking, he stood up, patted his clothes, and waved at Arceus.

"Well then, see you next time, Arceus."

In this pure white space, Johan's figure slowly faded away.

Watching his "departure," Arceus gazed for a long time.

Suddenly, it laughed out loud—a rare occurrence.

[This guy...]

Whether he was truly influenced by Hoopa Unbound or was doing this to help little Hoopa regain its power was hard to say...

Looking at everything Johan had done since becoming a trainer, he'd never really hesitated when it came to helping Pokémon.

But as a "Pokémon psychologist," he was indeed one of the few who could help solve Hoopa Unbound's problem. Otherwise, Arceus wouldn't have guided him here.

Arceus's form also slowly faded.

[Friends, huh...]

Golden light sparkled on the river surface.

"Mmm..."

In the ruins, Johan's eyelids trembled as he lay pillowed on Cynthia's lap, slowly opening his eyes.

The moment he regained consciousness, the first thought that flashed through his mind was—

Thighs are still the most comfortable...

"Awake?"

A slightly choked voice reached his ears.

Following the sound, he saw slightly reddened eyes and a delicate face stained with some dust.

Cynthia.

"Ka-kaah?!"

The next second.

A huge, pitch-black head immediately leaned over, staring with red eyes that showed rare sternness and irrepressible joy.

"Gengar." Johan weakly smiled. "Were you just crying..."

"Ka-kaah!"

As punishment for you, behold my Sticky Eighteen Licks!

Seeing Johan about to expose its "embarrassing moment," Gengar immediately stuck out its tongue and gave Johan a direct "face wash" attack.

Good thing he always carried Cheri Berries, otherwise who knows how long recovery would have taken.

Eating the increasingly delicious-tasting berries, Johan suddenly wondered...

After Ash was revived by Ho-Oh, he became a "human Pokémon" and "super rookie." After this experience... would he become a "super Hoenn person"?

"It's fine now."

He gently touched Cynthia's cheek, wiping away some dust, then patted Gengar's head, having a "friendly" moment with his Pokémon.

Then.

He saw Marshadow grinning while holding a dim "Rainbow Wing."

And Celebi flying joyfully in mid-air.

Of course.

There was also the "photographer" in the sky, the legendary Pokémon shining brilliantly in the dawn light—Ho-Oh!

However, Ho-Oh's current "situation" didn't seem very good.

Under the "watchful eyes" of Mewtwo, black Rayquaza, Giratina, White Kyurem, Zekrom, Darkrai... various legendary Pokémon, Ho-Oh's face was stern.

If not for its messenger Marshadow's call, if not for truly sensing the "Rainbow Hero's" aura from the "Rainbow Wing," if not for Hoopa's dimensional portal, if not for...

Would it stick around with these legendary Pokémon?

Ridiculous!

Hmph!

Ho-Oh looked at the human surrounded like a star among people in the center below, feeling helpless.

Clearly, that "Rainbow Wing" wasn't even willingly given—it had just accidentally dropped...

"Marsha!"

The long-unseen Marshadow jumped into Johan's arms, handing him the now-dim gray "Rainbow Wing."

"Long time no see, Marshadow..."

As the "Shadow Guide," both Marshadow and Ho-Oh had very clear perception of the "Rainbow Wing." Marshadow could arrive so quickly thanks to the "shadow world."

Taking the "Rainbow Wing."

The "Rainbow Wing" that had only been gray in Marshadow's hands turned completely dark when it reached Johan's hands, gray to the point of blackness.

[Rainbow Wing]: Ah, burned out. (π-π)

"Tsk..."

That color doesn't look good.

Johan immediately channeled the little bit of aura he'd recovered into it. The dim "Rainbow Wing" immediately regained its rainbow brilliance, even its feathers spreading out distinctly.

[Rainbow Wing]: Ah... energized again!

Seeing this scene, Ho-Oh's entire state deteriorated.

The surrounding legendary Pokémon's gazes toward it suddenly became much more "friendly."

So it's "one of us"—why didn't you say so earlier?

Ho-Oh: "..."

Is this really a "Rainbow Hero"?

If not for so many legendary Pokémon present, Ho-Oh would have lost its temper.

"Bii~~"

Celebi finally came before Johan—it was the biggest contributor to Johan's "resurrection" this time.

"Oh right, Celebi, I have a friend..." Johan thought of the fallen Boss Giovanni.

It had to be said, Boss Giovanni was truly impressive—directly facing Primal Groudon and successfully "conquering" it was one of the key factors in turning the stalemate.

"I'm fine."

With bandages wrapped around his chest and arms, wearing a suit jacket and refusing support from Ken and other Team Rocket elites, Giovanni also appeared in view.

"Bii~~"

Celebi drew a big circle with both hands, indicating it had put in great effort to save him.

Johan smiled: "Thank you, Celebi. I'll treat you to a feast."

"Bii~~"

The little one happily hummed a tune and flew away again.

Giovanni's expression looked somewhat complex.

Honestly.

He had originally been prepared for his "final dance" when facing Primal Groudon.

Having "Viridian Power," he was very clear about his physical condition—his days were numbered due to an illness that even advanced Pokémon technology couldn't cure, a chronic condition from his early struggling days.

For this reason, to help Johan—this person he'd entrusted with Team Rocket and the future—he'd fought desperately to stop Primal Groudon, even overdrawing his "Viridian Power" and body.

In Giovanni's view.

Rather than die searching for a cure with no clues or waste away in a hospital bed, it was better to go out in such a spectacular battle, leaving one more brilliant mark on this world.

He was more content with that.

Who would have thought.

The cure he had no leads on became a "routine" method for Johan.

Life's ups and downs could be so inexplicable sometimes.

However.

Although his old illness was cured, Giovanni had become more open-minded.

So be it.

Life was short—he wanted to try bridging the gap with his son Silver as much as possible and spend quality time with him.

As for Team Rocket... stick to the old plan.

Looking at the rising dawn, like his own portrait, he'd been given another chance at "rebirth."

Giovanni said with some emotion: "The rising dawn..."

Johan: "???"

Boss Giovanni, I feel like you're cursing, and I have evidence.

"Celebi also helped me recover." Cynthia said.

She had helped Giratina resist Hoopa Unbound's negative emotional interference while commanding Giratina in battle—the consumption wasn't small either.

"Good girl." Johan was very pleased.

Just felt like he was forgetting something again.

Hm?

Why "again"?

Forget it.

Deal with immediate matters first.

Johan dragged his weak, exhausted body up with Cynthia's help, reluctantly sitting up from that comfortable position.

"Everyone, thank you so much."

The black Rayquaza nodded at him.

Today, it had not only enjoyed the "fun" of one-against-many but also experienced different Mega Evolution. For this human, it somewhat understood why this world's Rayquaza recognized him.

Unfortunately, it was indeed quite tired today, otherwise it would have wanted to fight Mewtwo. It had a feeling... Mewtwo was far from using its full strength.

But it was enough—today had been satisfying.

"Roar—!!"

With a long cry, the black Rayquaza wrapped in clouds shot straight up into the sky.

"Hoopa, please."

"Leave it to Hoopa! Hoopa is amazing!"

Little Hoopa had completely recovered its former power, but it didn't transform into Hoopa Unbound form, maintaining its small appearance instead.

Having understood the meaning of "punishment," it realized that even its own power shouldn't be overly relied upon.

Some things were better taken step by step.

Buzz—

A golden ring appeared above the black Rayquaza, and its figure disappeared into the dimensional portal.

As the black Rayquaza left, the other legendary Pokémon also began making moves.

"Screech—!!"

Yveltal left immediately after seeing the black Rayquaza go. As a Kalos region legendary Pokémon, it didn't need little Hoopa's power.

Time to run!

It could feel the atmosphere getting a bit wrong.

After losing Hoopa Unbound's influence, not to mention other Pokémon, Dialga and Palkia had directly "switched sides."

Looking at it with those eyes...

As if they wanted to beat it up first to "show loyalty" and avoid being beaten themselves.

Running away now~

Next was Shadow Lugia and the white "Z-God" Zygarde.

They didn't say anything—facing Johan and numerous legendary Pokémon, nothing they said would be appropriate. They "obediently" flew back through the dimensional portal little Hoopa had opened.

After that.

Kyogre.

It flapped its fins, flying into mid-air, then after leaving Dahara City's boundaries, dove headfirst into the vast ocean.

"Bwooo—"

I'll do a diving move, glub glub glub—

Kyogre had similar thoughts to Yveltal.

If it didn't run now, that Groudon guy might team up with other legendary Pokémon to beat it up!

Besides, that Johan... why didn't you say earlier that you had such strong connections?

Hoenn was temporarily off-limits—better go hide somewhere.

I heard the Alola region has few people, little land, minimal development, and a large ocean area. Let's hide in Alola for now.

[We, ahem, we should also leave.]

Dialga and Palkia looked at each other, saying something to Johan.

But they were still quite "sensible," trying their best to restore some of the destroyed Dahara City before drilling into time and space respectively.

Speaking of which.

A Time God that can't reverse time.

A Space God that can't traverse worlds.

Tsk, fake gods!

"DNA Splicers." Johan held up the [DNA Splicers].

Buzz—

White Kyurem reverted to Kyurem and Reshiram.

Reshiram looked quite "nostalgic," seemingly enjoying the recent power gain.

Kyurem looked deeply at Johan, nodded once in acknowledgment, then flew toward the dimensional portal little Hoopa had opened again and also left.

Reshiram and Zekrom chose to stay temporarily.

Feeling the "danger" level had decreased somewhat, Ho-Oh glanced at the "Rainbow Wing" in Johan's hand and flew toward the sky.

"Screech—!!"

This world was indeed full of danger everywhere—better interfere less in the future.

No more distributing feathers either...

Groudon stood alone on the river surface like a mountain. It raised its head, looking at the legendary Pokémon flying away one by one, freezing in place.

Damn it.

Am I the only one who can't fly?!

Legendary Pokémon from other worlds were mostly sent away by Hoopa's dimensional portals, while legendary Pokémon from this world relied on their own abilities, and as a fellow native legendary Pokémon...

Looking toward Hoenn region.

So far...

Buzz—

A golden ring opened a portal before it.

"Roar..."

Groudon scratched its head.

To enter or not to enter?

Enter, and it felt like everyone else was relying on their own abilities—it would be somewhat embarrassing.

Don't enter, and Hoenn region was really damn far...

Groudon struck a thinking pose, couldn't figure it out... so temporarily pretended to be very smart.

"Groudon."

Johan's hoarse voice came.

It looked toward the sound.

"Go back for now. I'll come find you for a chat later."

"Roar."

Getting this "face-saving excuse," Groudon decisively stepped into the golden ring.

A bit tired—better go back and sleep first.

At this point.

The legendary Pokémon that had turned Dahara City into chaos had left about seventy to eighty percent, with Mewtwo, Giratina, Reshiram, Zekrom, Darkrai, Zygarde, Marshadow, and Celebi remaining.

"Bii~~"

After playing with Gengar and Tyranitar for a while, Celebi actively waved at Johan.

"Leaving so soon?" Johan was stunned.

They hadn't seen each other in so long—they hadn't even had a proper sit-down chat.

"Bii~"

Celebi indicated that time was vast, and in this boundless time, there were too many forests waiting for its protection and rescue.

Johan could only express regret.

However, Celebi seemed to be one of the few beings that, like Arceus, could traverse multiple universes. No wonder Giovanni hadn't held much hope for finding Celebi.

"Next time, I'll have little Hoopa invite you, and we'll have a proper gathering." Johan said.

With his current physical condition, he honestly couldn't properly host Celebi.

"Bii~"

Celebi nodded happily, waved at Johan again, then opened a time portal and entered it.

In terms of truly understanding time, Celebi seemed more capable than Dialga. It's just that in any specific universe, Dialga's use of time, especially for destruction, far exceeded Celebi's.

In the time portal Celebi had opened, for an instant, Johan seemed to see many familiar yet strange world fragments.

Recalling being thrown into another world by Hoopa Unbound earlier... Johan shook his head.

"Wait a moment."

After Celebi left, Johan noticed Giratina also preparing to sneak away.

"Roar..."

Hearing Johan's voice, Giratina froze mid-motion, its hands gripping the crack leading to the Distortion World, turning back with an awkward smile.

Seeing Giratina's appearance, Johan couldn't help but laugh.

"You guy... fine, when my body recovers, I'll come to your place for tea."

Giratina nodded, flicked its tail, and disappeared into the crack.

[We're leaving too.]

Reshiram and Zekrom looked at each other, saying to Johan simultaneously.

This was Kalos—as Unova's twin dragons, they shouldn't stay too long either, as it would cause some unnecessary influence.

The nearby Zygarde core in cellular form was watching them.

"Alright." Johan nodded. "Thank you for your hard work."

[Your thoughts become my truth.]

Reshiram showed no dissatisfaction at all.

Zekrom also agreed but added:

[Next time, let me fuse.]

Reshiram couldn't help but glance at it.

Johan indicated, "Actually, I hope there won't be such an opportunity next time."

The twin dragons spread their wings.

"When I finish building my small island in Hoenn, I'll call you for dinner."

At this point.

Only Mewtwo, Darkrai, Marshadow, and the Zygarde core remained in Dahara City.

Whether Mewtwo, Darkrai, or Marshadow, none mastered so-called "rules," so as long as they didn't cause massive destruction, they wouldn't have much invisible impact on the Kalos region.

So the Zygarde core, as the "God of Order," didn't worry about this anymore.

"You all..."

Johan looked at them.

Darkrai directly dove into his shadow, muttering, "If you won't let me eat, you want me to leave? I'll wait until your body recovers!"

That's what it said.

But Johan could feel Darkrai was worried about his body or that something else might happen, preparing to guard him until he fully recovered.

Meeting his gaze, Mewtwo used telepathy to say very simply and directly:

"Waiting for your recovery."

Seemingly having the same idea as Darkrai.

But Mewtwo added a simple supplement.

"Once recovered, experience my power. In the future, don't use that black Rayquaza."

The words carried strong confidence.

It had to be said that without confusion and knowing clearly what it wanted, Mewtwo was truly "complete."

As for its real strength, Johan knew very little after not seeing it for a while.

Looking at it, it seemed confident of fighting even that black Rayquaza from earlier.

This made Johan somewhat apprehensive... Surely Mewtwo hadn't gotten hold of another Mega Stone too?

Marshadow wouldn't leave quickly after being away so long.

As for the Zygarde core.

[When you recover a bit, talk with me about my partner.]

Here.

This "Hoopa Unbound" incident finally came to a complete close.

Actually, not quite.

His little ones still needed proper comforting.

Earlier when he disappeared and nearly died, they were probably scared out of their wits.

"Sni!"

Snivy was crying as it pounded Johan's chest with little fists.

This was the first time Johan had seen this strong, tsundere little one cry.

Earlier, due to the dangerous and tense situation, Snivy had wanted to come out and help but was locked in its Poké Ball and couldn't get out.

Now it was here to "vent."

"I'm fine now..." Johan was quite helpless.

But thinking of a so-called "master" from his previous life who taught that when girls are angry, don't worry about anything else—just hug her tight, and everything will be fine after a while.

So he simply pulled Snivy into his arms, "There, there, it's okay now, it's okay now."

However, Snivy directly extended its vines, pressing against Johan's chest and breaking free from his embrace.

"Sni!"

Running to one side, arms crossed, looking angry.

Johan pursed his lips.

"Sure enough, all 'masters' are liars."

"Sni! (▼皿▼)"

Snivy was furious.

You do this with every Pokémon—how could it work when it's my turn!

Nearby, Ninetales and Tinkaton looked at each other.

"Ha, haha..."

Before laughing twice, Johan clutched his chest and coughed.

"Sni!"

Seeing this, Snivy immediately rushed forward nervously, gently rubbing his chest.

Was it okay? She seemed to have used too much force earlier.

"It's fine, cough cough... I'm fine." Johan said hoarsely, secretly raising an eyebrow at Cynthia nearby.

See? Handled it.

Cynthia laughed out loud.

"Garrr! (Д)σ"

Look at this guy—so many tricks for fooling girls! You better be careful!

Nearby Garchomp pointed at Johan, warning Cynthia.

Finally calming all the little ones, Johan collapsed exhaustedly in his wheelchair.

However.

As their trainer, Johan could clearly feel that the little ones were working even harder.

This incident, although they'd all contributed significantly, especially Gengar who had "operated" together with Johan when facing Hoopa Unbound in the end, but...

They still felt their strength was too weak, the gap with true legendary Pokémon too large.

If they wanted to avoid similar situations in the future, they had to continue strengthening!

Even the usually lazy Ninetales was now patiently training its use of Fairy-type moves.

In Ninetales' view.

If it could manipulate large amounts of life energy like Xerneas, Johan wouldn't have faced that situation at all.

The other little ones also had their own "reference targets" to varying degrees.

With them working so hard, Johan felt bad telling them to take it easy.

After all, this time it was indeed his "madness" first.

Just...

His wallet—Johan was worried again.

Increased training volume, increased training difficulty naturally meant increased consumption, which was definitely a significant test for his wallet.

"I'll take you for a walk." Cynthia, pushing the wheelchair, said.

"Okay."

"Speaking of which..." Johan suddenly thought of something. "Where's Flint?"

Golden sunlight, busy crowds in the ruins, walking along the banks of Dahara City's largest river, feeling the rare cool breeze.

"How's your recovery?" Cynthia gently brushed her hair, asking.

"Not bad."

Johan raised his hand resting on the wheelchair, but couldn't lift it above his head.

This time he'd really overdone it, even more dramatically than Boss Giovanni. Although he had Celebi and Ho-Oh's help, his body still hadn't fully recovered, especially mentally.

"Next time..." Cynthia bit her lip.

She had wanted to tell Johan not to push himself so hard next time, but the words stopped at her lips.

Some things always needed someone to bear them.

When the sky fell, someone tall had to hold it up.

In the entire Pokémon world, besides Johan, how many people could handle and solve this incident?

Even if the entire League mobilized... by the time it ended, the Kalos region would probably be nearly destroyed.

Moreover.

Having resolved to become Champion, Cynthia asked herself—if she encountered such a situation, what would she do? Probably... still charge forward without hesitation.

This was a Champion's resolve!

Seeing Cynthia stop speaking, Johan smiled—he knew what she wanted to say.

"I want... to become Champion!" Johan suddenly said out of nowhere.

"Hm?"

Cynthia was stunned.

"Champion?"

She looked at Johan somewhat bewildered, then reached out to touch his forehead.

"No fever..."

Johan: "..."

Grabbing Cynthia's hand and placing it against his cheek to gently caress, he said:

"After experiencing this incident, I've figured out some things."

"Like what?"

"Like... since someone always has to bear certain responsibilities, since there's always a need for 'tall people' to stand up, why can't that person be me?"

"Hasn't it always been you?"

Johan: "..."

He turned back to look at that flower-like smiling woman, seeing the slight smile in her curved eyes, knowing he'd been "played."

"Mm..." Seeing through Johan's realization, Cynthia pursed her lips, put away her smile, and asked:

"What about Steven?"

The Hoenn League had put their cultivation plans on Steven after hitting walls with Johan several times.

"Simple."

Johan had already thought this through.

"After I do it for a year or so, I can hand it over to him."

Anyway, according to the Hoenn League's intentions, Steven becoming Champion would also take about a year—it was perfect timing for the "transition period."

A pale hand withdrew from Johan's grasp and pressed against his temple, applying slight pressure.

"Champion is something you 'hand over'?"

"You don't understand—this is Hoenn tradition."

"Tradition?"

"Uh..."

Johan realized this "tradition" seemed to start with Steven.

"Ahem, no problem—it's a tradition starting with me." He said seriously.

"Oh..."

Cynthia nodded thoughtfully.

The wheelchair moved slowly as both fell into brief silence, seemingly thinking about their own matters or enjoying this momentary, long-missed tranquility.

After a while.

Cynthia spoke again:

"You're sure it's not because of your little island?"

A year or so would be about enough to finish building that small island.

"Hm? Who told you that? That's slander! Someone's slandering me!" Johan jerked his head up.

"Pfft—"

Cynthia burst out laughing.

While Dahara City gradually returned to calm, the outside world was in chaos because of what happened here, especially online.
