# 676: After the Great Battle (Two-in-One Chapter)

Dahara City gradually returned to normal, while the entire world was thrown into tremendous upheaval.

Following the Hoenn region's ancient twin gods incident with Primal Kyogre and Primal Groudon, the Kalos region had now erupted with such a massive disaster.

If the Hoenn region's ancient twin gods incident was viewed as a "regional" disaster, then what happened in Dahara City was a "world-class" disaster!

The former could perhaps be calmed by combining the power of a region's Champion, Elite Four, and top trainers, though only after paying some heavy costs.

The latter... forget about one region—even combining the entire League's forces would be questionable. Just the number of legendary Pokémon that appeared exceeded the total number of Champions!

The trainers capable of solving such a problem could be counted on one hand.

Of course, it wasn't that the League lacked trainers with extremely impressive strength, or that there weren't those who could face legendary Pokémon directly, but...

Even if they blocked the disaster, how much destruction would it cause?

Compared to Hoenn's ancient twin gods incident, this event erupted too suddenly.

For the ancient twin gods, the Hoenn region had advance warning and deployment, barely minimizing the disaster.

This time, if not for Teacher Johan being there, probably... at least half of the Kalos region would have been destroyed.

Even the Kalos region's local Champion and Elite Four hadn't been able to make it in time.

Teacher Johan had almost single-handedly, through his friendly relationships with numerous legendary Pokémon, calling upon friends, and paying an extremely heavy price, barely managed to resolve this "world-class" disaster.

You have to understand.

That was Teacher Johan!

The famous "Legendary Pokémon Man" had nearly lost his life because of this. If not for being pulled back by numerous legendary Pokémon at the end, he might have really died.

Such battle results could be called tragic.

Of course.

Teacher Johan's feat of riding the black Rayquaza and summoning nearly ten legendary Pokémon to battle Hoopa Unbound and its summoned legendary Pokémon had completely shocked the entire League and swept across the world, leaving no one unawed.

Some even joked—finally seeing Teacher Johan's "strongest lineup," no wonder Champion Alder said that if Teacher Johan used his full power, he'd have almost no chance of winning!

Previously, people had laughed at Champion Alder for being too accommodating and modest—a regional Champion actually saying he had no chance against a trainer was viewed as representing "weakness."

Now these people finally understood.

Champion Alder wasn't being modest at all—he clearly had self-awareness!

Just ask.

With Teacher Johan's "strongest lineup"—Reshiram on the left, Zekrom on the right, Giratina in the center, Mewtwo above, riding Rayquaza below, with Darkrai protecting from behind—who could fight such a formation?

This statement received unanimous approval from the vast majority of people online.

Some even suggested.

The League should establish a position above regional Champions, called "Master," to command all regional Champions.

And for this "Master" position, in this era, Teacher Johan was unquestionably deserving!

However.

While there were many who praised him, quite a few people maintained rationality.

Though Teacher Johan's ability to summon numerous legendary Pokémon demonstrated outstanding capability and powerful strength, anyone with eyes could see that Teacher Johan's relationship with these legendary Pokémon was more friendship-based and hadn't reached the level of capture.

So theoretically speaking, these legendary Pokémon couldn't be considered Teacher Johan's Pokémon.

However.

Besides the clashes between legendary Pokémon, Gengar's "final dance" also provided tremendous shock to everyone.

Mega Evolution! Terastalization! Z-Move!

Three major enhancements used simultaneously—Gengar facing legendary Pokémon as a mortal, confronting Hoopa Unbound as an ordinary Pokémon. That final condensed "power of a hundred ghosts" super-large black sphere still left everyone stunned.

Although using three major enhancements simultaneously caused Teacher Johan to nearly collapse from overdraw, it truly made people understand the upper limit of Gengar's strength as Teacher Johan's ace Pokémon!

That was definitely an existence surpassing Champion aces.

Using this as evidence, saying Teacher Johan could surpass numerous Champions wasn't impossible.

It's just that this ability obviously couldn't be used as a regular method.

Thus.

Online, classifications like peak Champion, strong Champion, standard Champion, weak Champion, and quasi-Champion appeared, attracting many busybodies to make so-called rankings and divisions, which weren't worth discussing.

In any case.

Afterward, whether online, in forums, or in real life, discussions about the Dahara City incident and Teacher Johan almost never stopped.

Especially online.

Those seemingly fragmentary videos and photos, after being pieced together and filled in with speculation, even sorted out the general course of events.

Particularly regarding Hoopa—this being that wasn't a legendary Pokémon but could control and command legendary Pokémon was thoroughly understood.

Combining Pokémon, split personality, violent temperament, filled with negative emotions, and other issues further confirmed Teacher Johan's identity as a "Pokémon psychologist."

Everyone exclaimed—Teacher Johan truly deserved the title "Master of Hearts"!

Discussions about Teacher Johan weren't limited to ordinary residents and trainers—the entire League's upper echelons were also in uproar.

The League headquarters located atop Mt. Silver in the Kanto region even contacted all regions to hold an emergency meeting.

But they got stuck on Teacher Johan's reward.

After all, such a massive incident involving so many legendary Pokémon—not giving a reward after calming the situation would be quite unreasonable.

But what kind of reward could match such great "merit"?

This was a problem.

Additionally.

In this incident, besides Teacher Johan, three other people's contributions and roles couldn't be ignored.

Cynthia, who controlled Giratina and changed the battle situation!

Flint, who faced Palkia directly and held it back desperately!

And...

The Viridian City Gym Leader Giovanni, who faced Primal Groudon directly and ultimately controlled it!

Everyone was surprised by Giovanni's appearance in Dahara City.

Giovanni's identity wasn't really a secret among the League's true upper echelons.

Team Rocket's leader!

The League allowed him to serve as Viridian City's Gym Leader for several reasons.

First, when serving as Gym Leader, Giovanni hadn't done anything excessive or left any evidence.

He had obtained the Gym Leader position through legitimate means—without revealing his Team Rocket leader identity, they naturally couldn't easily criticize him.

Second, Team Rocket was the largest underground force in the Kanto and Johto regions, with roots spread everywhere in complex networks, diverse personnel connections, and most having considerable combat power.

The League could take down Team Rocket, but the cost would be too high.

Most Team Rocket members excelled at actual combat, unrestricted battles, and outdoor fighting. If the League wanted to take them down, the casualties would probably...

Moreover, Giovanni's own strength was also something people feared.

Additionally.

As long as Giovanni was there, Team Rocket's backbone remained, preventing major chaos.

If Giovanni wasn't there, that would be real trouble. Without Giovanni's restraint, who knew what Team Rocket would become.

At the same time.

With Giovanni serving as Gym Leader, he would naturally maintain Viridian City's stability, and the League and Team Rocket had a "communication" bridge.

At least they could talk.

If Giovanni's Gym Leader status was revoked and he hid in some corner, nobody could find him—that would be real trouble.

Elite Four Agatha spending most of her time living in Viridian City also had this consideration.

However, most importantly.

Recently, Team Rocket had been so well-behaved it surprised everyone.

They seemed to be preparing to go dormant, leaving League upper echelons somewhat puzzled.

And this time.

Giovanni had even appeared at the center of the "Dahara City incident," facing Primal Groudon directly. That statement "As long as I still stand on this earth, I will not be defeated" had gained countless fans.

People exclaimed—

Giovanni-san was so cool! Uncle Giovanni was too handsome! I used to wonder why Teacher Johan would throw off his suit at critical moments, until I saw Giovanni-san!

It also made more people aware of Giovanni's strength.

Many even exclaimed that while Kanto's Elite Four were said to be strong, Kanto's Gym Leaders were also terrifyingly strong—at least Champion level, right?

Such a Gym Leader who had almost burned himself out to protect Dahara City—now if you said he was the evil organization Team Rocket's leader, probably not many would believe it.

After all.

His Team Rocket leader identity couldn't be proven with evidence, while his single combat against Primal Groudon was absolutely real.

This made League upper echelons speculate... could Giovanni be trying to... go legitimate?

Otherwise, why fight so desperately?

Moreover, Giovanni's appearance also made people discover that... Teacher Johan apparently had quite a relationship with Giovanni!

Of course, nobody suspected Johan would collude with Giovanni, or rather, with Team Rocket.

After all, Giovanni had only shown his face once in this major incident and gained massive support, while Johan... had played nearly decisive roles in almost every major incident.

Saying such a person colluded with Team Rocket?

Forget about the vast number of trainers not accepting it—even League upper echelons found it laughable.

Moreover, Giovanni's true identity was only known to a few. Even Lance, the new Elite Four active in Kanto and Johto, didn't know. How could Johan possibly know?

He probably just treated him as a Gym Leader.

However, Giovanni's appearance had indeed drawn considerable attention from League upper echelons.

As for Teacher Johan's reward, it remained the biggest discussion focus of this meeting.

Johan, far away in Dahara City, naturally had no idea what was happening within the League. He wasn't even paying much attention to the heated online discussions.

On one hand, his body was still somewhat weak.

On the other hand...

Cynthia, Mewtwo, Marshadow, little Hoopa, his own little ones—which didn't need his company?

Although Dahara City was in the desert, it actually had quite distinctive scenery. With this rare opportunity to rest peacefully, he naturally didn't want to be bothered by various trivial matters.

However, little Hoopa.

With Hoopa Unbound's disappearance, it inevitably became the "culprit" causing this incident.

Although Dialga and Palkia had helped restore some of Dahara City before leaving, the damage caused this time was too great to be easily fully restored.

Thus.

The Valley of Creation, as little Hoopa's "supervisors," proactively proposed taking out some treasures, gold, mining, and other valuables accumulated over generations to compensate for some of Dahara City's losses as much as possible.

Originally, little Hoopa also wanted to use its newly recovered abilities to bear some responsibility, but was immediately vetoed by Johan, Barza, and Meray.

Having finally made little Hoopa understand the meaning of "punishment" and know the joy of obtaining rewards through its own efforts, how could they let it rely on abilities again?

Little Hoopa obediently indicated it wouldn't directly take gold and other valuables from elsewhere or other worlds—it just wanted to help rebuild Dahara City together.

This still pleased Johan and the others.

The similarly injured Giovanni smelled opportunity in this.

He proactively approached Dahara City's mayor, proposing that "Rocket Construction Company" could undertake this reconstruction construction task and was willing to offer an extremely low price.

Giovanni's desperate fight against Primal Groudon was still fresh in memory, plus the price he offered was indeed near cost—how could Dahara City's mayor refuse? He was too happy to agree.

Thus, most of Dahara City's reconstruction and restoration construction projects were handed to "Rocket Construction Company."

This naturally included the infrastructure projects previously discussed.

After settling the project's general details, Dahara City's mayor hurriedly left.

Current Dahara City had too many matters requiring his attention.

The only fortunate thing was that Dahara City's destruction was only at the building level. Dahara City's residents and tourists, having evacuated in time, suffered no casualties.

As the saying goes, where people exist, the place exists. As long as there were no casualties, wealthy Dahara City's urban reconstruction wasn't too difficult.

While Dahara City urgently rebuilt, Johan's group of "patients" had become quite leisurely.

Mewtwo wore a cold expression and a "Gengar apron," standing in the yard... barbecuing.

The grilled meat sizzled with oil on the charcoal fire prepared by Ceruledge, and the aroma immediately spread.

"Ka-kaah?"

Is it burning?

Gengar peeked out from behind it.

Hearing this, Mewtwo was startled, quickly flipping while looking at Gengar with eyes full of "death."

Gengar wasn't afraid of Mewtwo at all, just grinning as it patted its shoulder.

"Ka-kaah~"

Pay attention~

Mewtwo nodded stiffly.

Indeed.

Being human was much harder than being a Pokémon, Mewtwo thought.

It had once pondered whether it was human or Pokémon, but under Johan's guidance, after several "attempts" and "experiences," Mewtwo instantly understood... it was definitely a Pokémon!

On the other side, bandaged Giovanni pushed Johan's wheelchair, walking beside the garden.

"Pokémon, construction, technology?" Johan listened to Giovanni's description, couldn't help turning back to look at him.

Giovanni remained unmoved, just continuing: "These are my planned three main businesses for Team Rocket after transformation. Plus four subsidiary businesses: entertainment, berries, dining, logistics."

Having walked the edge of life and death in this battle, Giovanni had completely come to terms with things.

Since Team Rocket was transforming, might as well use this opportunity to transform completely!

Pokémon breeding—Team Rocket already had its own breeding houses, and Giovanni even had a private breeding house. His Pokémon, except for those like Beedrill that he'd captured from early on, mostly came from there.

Originally Team Rocket actually had "hunting" as a "business," but after Johan and Giovanni's discussions, hunting operations had been withdrawn, allowing Team Rocket's internal breeding house business to develop.

Now transforming breeding as a main business was completely manageable.

As for construction, this was the planned cooperation with Devon—naturally no problem.

And technology...

Team Rocket could create artificial legendary Pokémon like Mewtwo, and technology had always been a project Giovanni valued greatly. Team Rocket had countless research talents, so technology definitely needed no explanation.

As for the four subsidiary businesses: entertainment, berries, dining, logistics.

Entertainment was Team Rocket's first transformation project, also suggested by Johan and initiated by Giovanni, handed to Matori to manage. It was now on track.

Just that the Pokémon world's entertainment industry wasn't very developed, so the market couldn't be called particularly large—sufficient as a subsidiary business.

Berries, like breeding houses, was something Team Rocket already possessed, essentially front-and-back businesses connecting with Pokémon breeding houses.

Regarding dining.

This had originally been bundled with entertainment, later temporarily separated, now being brought up again by Giovanni as an independent project.

As the saying goes, to capture a man you must first capture his stomach—women were similar.

So Giovanni decided to first do internal consumption.

After all, Team Rocket had massive personnel—just internal consumption of everyone's meals could recover considerable funds.

Moreover, it could control Team Rocket internal personnel's "stomachs"—killing multiple birds with one stone.

And logistics...

This was also work Team Rocket already did.

As an underground force occupying two regions, transportation of various materials, supplies, items, etc., inevitably involved logistics business.

Many Team Rocket members' identities were also covered as logistics workers.

Now it was just expanding the logistics business originally covering two regions—the best business for accommodating and covering Team Rocket personnel numbers.

Listening to Giovanni's description, Johan was secretly amazed.

Boss Giovanni, you're aiming to match Galar region's "Rose Corporation."

Rose Corporation covered aviation, railways, energy, technology, internet, construction, living, banking, television, and many other projects, encompassing almost every corner of Galar region.

"I'm calling it—the Rainbow Rocket Plan!"

Johan in the wheelchair raised his eyebrows and his mouth twitched.

"This is the name you suggested when we first met," Giovanni said flatly.

Originally Johan had only suggested the word "Rainbow."

Now...

Three main businesses, four subsidiary businesses... better matched this name.

"When the time comes, find someone to coordinate with Matori."

Stopping, Giovanni gently patted the wheelchair handle, speaking gently to the girl before them:

"I'll leave it to you."

"Mm..."

Turns out Giovanni had pushed Johan to Cynthia.

Watching Giovanni's departing figure, Cynthia frowned slightly but then relaxed.

"This Uncle Giovanni... isn't simple," Cynthia said softly.

Intuition told Cynthia that Giovanni was hiding quite a lot.

"Of course he's not simple," Johan sighed.

"Hm?"

Cynthia blinked at him.

Johan smiled slightly, beckoning for Cynthia to come closer.

So Cynthia slowly leaned down, bringing her ear closer.

But Johan reached out to gently wipe the corner of her mouth, smiling: "Little kitten."

Whoosh—

In an instant, Cynthia's pale cheeks reddened.

She wasn't blushing because Johan wiped her mouth, but because no wonder Uncle Giovanni's gaze had been a bit strange earlier.

Johan laughed heartily—pink Cynthia was really so cute.

At the same time he said: "Anyone who can single-handedly fight Primal Groudon and even control it in reverse—how could they be simple?"

Cynthia gave him a coquettish glare, blaming him for not reminding her earlier.

But she agreed with Johan's words.

"True."

As a Gym Leader, being able to directly confront Primal Groudon, even if only for a while, wasn't something ordinary Gym Leaders could do.

Even Hoenn's Norman or Sinnoh's Volkner couldn't do it.

Watching Giovanni disappear around the corner, Cynthia said thoughtfully:

"But he does seem like a good person."

Good person?

Johan's expression became somewhat strange.

Wonder what Boss Giovanni's reaction would be hearing our little Cynthia evaluate him this way.

Night fell.

The campfire crackled, flames dancing.

"Let me see it."

Johan grabbed the longest spike on Gengar's back, like grabbing its little tuft, not letting it sink back into the shadows.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar laughed awkwardly twice, scratching its head, suddenly pointing at the distant sky.

"Ka-kaah!"

Look, a UFO!

Then it turned to run, but the spike was still firmly held by Johan, its feet sliding on the ground.

Turning back.

It saw Johan's teasing gaze.

Little guy, we've been together so long—don't I know what this purple fatty is thinking?

"Heh, when you wag your tail, I know whether your farts stink."

"Ka-kaah?" Gengar pinched its nose, waving its hands in front of its face with disgust.

You actually pay special attention to that?

Johan's forehead showed black lines. "Don't make me delete all your browsing history."

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar immediately opened its mouth, reaching in to pull out a palm-sized stone emanating seven-colored light.

Seeing this thing, Johan's pupils contracted, then his mouth corners drooped.

"How did you cut this off?"

This stone emanating seven-colored light... was clearly the seven-colored meteorite that caused Rayquaza's Mega Evolution and the Groudon-Kyogre incident in Hoenn!

Although this palm-sized piece was countless times smaller than the original massive seven-colored meteorite.

Back then, in Hoenn, when Kyogre and Groudon met, the seven-colored meteorite was born and condensed. To prevent these two big guys from getting it, Gengar had sent the meteorite to the Distortion World per Johan's instructions.

However.

Seven-colored meteorites were hard to preserve—they would disappear after a certain time, only condensing again when sufficiently strong Mega energy waves appeared.

So at the time, neither Johan, the Hoenn twin gods, nor Rayquaza cared much.

Who knew Gengar had actually cut off a portion and kept it for itself?

"No wonder the Mega Evolution consumption feels heavier each time..." Johan murmured.

"Ka-kaah!" Gengar grinned, showing a proud smile.

"What are you proud of?" Johan tapped its head lightly in exasperation.

Gengar immediately covered its head, pouting.

No logic, totally no logic!

As a Ghost-type Pokémon, how could ordinary human fists hit it?

Even if it was a martial artist, wouldn't it just pass through?

Johan was totally unreasonable!

Without even using force, Gengar was already acting pitiful. Johan rolled his eyes at this purple fatty.

"Marsha~~"

Marshadow approached Johan, sniffing around him curiously.

"What's wrong, Marshadow? The food is with Mewtwo and Rotom." Johan noticed this long-unseen little one, pointing at Mewtwo's barbecue stand and Rotom's oven and refrigerator.

"Burp~" Marshadow belched, patting its belly to indicate it was full.

It approached Johan again, sniffing once more, tilting its head.

"Marsha?"

It felt there was a... familiar yet strange scent on Johan.

Hearing this, Johan understood: "You mean this?"

He pulled out Marshadow's exclusive Z-Crystal from his pocket.

Though it was Marshadow-exclusive, somehow his Gengar could use it too—probably due to shared move origins...

"Marsha!"

Marshadow immediately jumped up, looking excited.

That's it! That's it!

"If there's a chance in the future, I'll let you use it," Johan couldn't help smiling.

Marshadow nodded repeatedly.

"Speaking of which, Marshadow, what have you been doing lately?" Johan asked.

Marshadow rolled its eyes, swaying as if about to collapse from exhaustion. Gengar conveniently floated out from behind to catch it.

Then one Gengar and one Marshadow performed a "don't die, live well" drama, leaving Johan helplessly watching.

"Marsha!"

Getting back to business.

Marshadow quietly indicated...

It was all Ho-Oh's fault for giving out too many feathers, making it constantly run around "guiding" feather holders.

This was very troublesome.

More importantly.

These feathers wouldn't stay with one person.

Like father to son, grandfather to grandson, teacher to student—there were always people hoping to see Ho-Oh, treating them as treasures passed down through generations.

So while Ho-Oh might give out few feathers in one period, at most one or two.

But accumulated over such long periods... it was really tiring.

Johan immediately expressed understanding, then gathered some recovered aura to give Marshadow a full aura massage package.

"Marsha~(3)"

Marshadow immediately collapsed on Johan's lap.

At Mewtwo's barbecue stand.

"More please."

Darkrai emerged from the shadows, tossing several skewers into the trash bag, saying to Mewtwo.

Mewtwo glanced at it, expressionlessly handing over several skewers.

How could these guys eat so much?

Been grilling from morning to evening and still not full?

Darkrai skillfully stripped a skewer, nodding slightly: "Not bad, barbecue skills have clearly improved."

[Are you Johan's Pokémon?]

Mewtwo looked at the skewers in its hands, suddenly asking.

"No," Darkrai said flatly.

[Then why try so hard? I thought you were Johan's Pokémon.]

Mewtwo's voice was somewhat stiff.

But Darkrai didn't mind much.

It looked at Johan massaging Marshadow, feeding Victini small crackers, telling stories to Ninetales, Tinkaton, Dragonite...

Coming back to itself.

It asked back: "Aren't you the same?"

Glancing at Mewtwo.

This guy was like itself—one of only two Pokémon remaining.

Mewtwo fell silent.

"Besides, who says you have to become someone's Pokémon to fight for that person?"

[Hm?]

Darkrai stripped another skewer.

"The word 'friend' is enough."

Friends?

Mewtwo nodded thoughtfully.

Darkrai tossed the skewer, "By the way, more please, extra spicy."

Mewtwo: "..."

Boom!!

Suddenly.

A rumbling sound came from outside the yard—quite loud, but didn't particularly concern Johan, Cynthia, and the Pokémon in the yard.

Soon after.

Bandaged Giovanni walked into the yard looking refreshed.

Behind him.

The already bruised Flint now looked even worse, grimacing as he and Infernape supported each other walking in.

Seeing this scene, Johan's expression was strange.

Flint had grown some backbone.

Actually challenging Boss Giovanni to a duel.

Setting aside strength differences, just... a Fire-type specialist trainer challenging a Ground-type grandmaster...

What was the difference between this and a penguin challenging an Articuno?

Moreover, the opponent was "Giovanni of the Earth."

Johan could only say... admirable courage.

"Hiss—" Flint sat down beside Johan's wheelchair, inhaling while saying:

"Teacher Johan, Uncle Giovanni is really strong."

Of course... Johan thought silently.

Even peak Lance would probably lose more than win against peak Giovanni.

Let alone with your severe type disadvantage.

"Speaking of which," Flint scratched his head, "why do I feel like Teacher Johan, big sis, and Uncle Giovanni all seem to have been treated, but I haven't?"

"Your imagination," Johan stared straight ahead, saying seriously.

"Imagination?"

"Mm."

"Alright..."

At this time, suited Giovanni approached, saying to Flint with satisfaction:

"You're quite good. How about... cough, how about taking a position at my new company?"

"A position?" Flint was stunned.

"Good salary."

Flint's eyes immediately brightened.

Just a position...

"Ahem, Gym Leader Giovanni," Johan coughed lightly, reminding him.

Hearing this, Giovanni came to his senses, pondering briefly before nodding slightly at Johan.

"True, too early. Wait two months."

"Mm." Johan also agreed.

"Huh?"

Flint looked confused, looking at Johan then Giovanni, not understanding.

"Oh right, there's something."

Johan seemed to remember something, suddenly calling:

"Little Soft."

Plop—

A green cell dropped into his palm, raising its upper body.

[I've said many times, I'm not called 'Little Soft.']

"Okay Little Soft, I understand Little Soft, no problem Little Soft."

Zygarde core: "..."

"Seriously, your matter—Gym Leader Giovanni might be able to help."

Hm?

Both Giovanni and the Zygarde core looked at each other in surprise.

Johan whispered to Giovanni:

"Let me introduce my friend, Zygarde—it's a legendary Pokémon, Ground-type..."

Giovanni's gaze showed some change.

----------

Powerstones?

# 677: Strike at the Heart

"Hoopa! Hoopa will miss Little Johan, wuu wuu wuu~"

Little Hoopa looked like it was biting a handkerchief, with tears in its eyes, remarkably similar to when Gengar cried watching TV shows.

"There, there."

Johan gently pulled the little one into his arms, smiling as he said:

"It's not like we'll never see each other again. It's just that Dahara City needs you more right now."

After confirming that no major incidents would occur in Dahara City again, Johan and the others decided to prepare for departure.

Little Hoopa had just absorbed Hoopa Unbound's power and recovered its original abilities, but its condition wasn't very stable yet. It needed to stabilize further in Dahara City and the Valley of Creation.

Of course.

As the "main surgeon" in this incident, Johan still needed to check on little Hoopa's condition periodically to ensure it wouldn't be affected by the "Shadow's" power again.

Besides, Barza and Meray were little Hoopa's "guardians," so their feelings had to be considered too.

"Hoopa will come find Little Johan to play! And everyone else too!"

Little Hoopa floated out of Johan's arms, leaving a wet face print behind, which left Johan quite speechless.

"Ka-kaah~(￣︶￣)σ"

Gengar burst into laughter seeing this, and little Hoopa was also amused by the water mark it left, breaking into a smile through its tears.

Johan shook his head, not particularly bothered, just saying:

"Good, next time bring Barza and Meray along, and I'll treat you all to delicious food."

Little Hoopa's eyes immediately lit up.

Although it hadn't eaten Johan's cooking after the incident, it had tasted it before and knew Johan's culinary skills.

After absorbing the "Shadow" and understanding the meaning of "punishment," little Hoopa finally recovered the ability to freely pass through dimensional portals it created. The world was vast, and it could go anywhere.

Of course, it still needed some so-called "medium" or "coordinates."

"Yes yes yes! Hoopa wants to go! Hoopa wants to go!" Little Hoopa spun in circles in the air, calling out happily.

"But you can't just wander around randomly, okay?" Johan cautioned.

"Got it."

Little Hoopa deflated again.

But it quickly perked up.

"Hoopa will work hard to rely on itself, not on its rings!"

Patting its little head.

The little one had truly grown up after all.

"Maybe I can introduce some new friends to you," Johan smiled.

Hoopa's eyes immediately brightened.

"New friends? Hoopa likes friends!"

Barza and Meray also looked pleased, with Meray picking up little Hoopa. After Barza expressed gratitude once more to Johan and the others for this incident, he also said with emotion:

"When Hoopa fully masters its own power, we'll let it regain its freedom to go out and see the outside world."

Where Hoopa came from was no longer traceable, but from its usual words and habits, it obviously didn't know much about the outside world.

More experiences would surely give little Hoopa more wisdom, and wisdom would help Hoopa better understand its own power.

Although Meray was reluctant, she agreed with her brother's words.

They had made such plans long ago.

The matter came to a complete end.

Johan and the others finally departed on the invisible aircraft.

Although he was also somewhat reluctant to part with little Hoopa, after all, compared to him, little Hoopa's bond with Barza and Meray after nearly twenty years together was deeper.

"Bonds" didn't only exist in battles between trainers and their Pokémon—the little details of daily life were what truly formed the essence of "bonds."

However, Johan also believed.

When he needed Hoopa's power, little Hoopa definitely wouldn't refuse.

This was undoubtedly much more "useful" than Giratina's abilities.

If he encountered major incidents he couldn't solve in the future and needed to call upon friends, little Hoopa would definitely be more convenient than Giratina.

Gengar's "electronic pet" was probably going to be "honorably retired."

Kalos region, Lumiose City.

Inside a coffee shop.

"Team Rocket's business?"

When Johan learned from Boss Giovanni that Team Rocket actually had coffee shops in Lumiose City, he was somewhat taken aback.

"Very surprising?" Giovanni picked up his coffee and took a small sip.

Since Team Rocket began preparing for transformation, Giovanni hadn't just tried opening an entertainment company.

He had contacted and experimented with all kinds of industries.

Otherwise, he wouldn't have finally settled on three main businesses and four subsidiary businesses to determine Team Rocket's overall transformation direction.

However, this coffee shop belonged to a typical "failed startup" project.

After all, coffee shops were everywhere in Lumiose City, even throughout the entire Kalos region. Without some special features, it was hard to keep them running.

And this coffee shop was temporarily serving as Johan and the others' temporary base.

"It's alright."

Johan also took a sip of coffee.

He immediately understood why this coffee shop couldn't stay in business—the coffee brewing could only be called mediocre at best.

"If you're interested, I'll give it to you," Giovanni said casually.

Johan was embarrassed.

Truly worthy of being Boss Giovanni—equally generous with money. In Lumiose City where land was worth its weight in gold, such a large coffee shop was given away just like that.

"Ahem."

Johan wanted to refuse, but felt he couldn't disappoint Boss Giovanni's kind intentions, so he turned to look aside.

Nearby.

The little ones were eating pastries.

These were all brought by Johan from outside, not pastries from this coffee shop.

"Mmm~"

Dragonite sat next to Gengar, gently nudging Gengar's chubby belly with its elbow, calling out softly.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar tilted its head, looking at Dragonite with some confusion.

The seven-colored meteorite?

Dragonite wanted to ask Gengar about the seven-colored meteorite, to borrow it for a look.

Gengar was somewhat puzzled.

Dragonite couldn't Mega Evolve, so what did it want to borrow the seven-colored meteorite for?

After all, which Pokémon could Mega Evolve was mostly public knowledge now, including Gengar and Tyranitar, but seemingly not Dragonite.

Although it thought this, Gengar still took out the seven-colored meteorite fragment emitting rainbow light.

"Mmm."

Dragonite carefully took it, muttering to itself.

Rayquaza relied on this thing to Mega Evolve, so logically I should be able to too.

Besides, where there's a will, there's a way. Even if I can't Mega Evolve, maybe I can still gain something.

This "Hoopa Unbound incident" made all of Johan's Pokémon feel their own strength was insufficient, and Dragonite was naturally among them.

If it could also Mega Evolve, its strength would surely surge dramatically at crucial moments, right?

Watching Dragonite pondering while holding the seven-colored meteorite, Johan's lips curved upward.

In his knowledge, there were only so many Pokémon that could currently Mega Evolve, but Pokémon updates came quickly.

It was said that after "Pokémon Scarlet/Violet," there would be "Pokémon ZA," which might introduce new Pokémon capable of Mega Evolution, perhaps including Dragonite.

Moreover.

Logically speaking, since some Pokémon could Mega Evolve, other Pokémon should be able to as well, right?

It was just that they hadn't been discovered yet.

Johan always looked forward to the infinite possibilities that existed in Pokémon.

For example, Ash and his Greninja clearly had no Mega Evolution form and didn't even have Mega Stones and Key Stones, but Ash and his Greninja could still perform "Bond Evolution" similar to Mega Evolution.

Ding-a-ling—

The wind chime at the coffee shop entrance made a crisp sound as Flint pushed the door open, a hot dog in his mouth.

"Teacher Johan, Gym Leader Giovanni, try this hot dog. It tastes pretty good."

He handed over two small paper packages.

Cynthia had already returned to Sinnoh.

Originally, Cynthia hadn't planned to leave so early. After all, Johan had been so seriously injured. Although he was fine now, she still wanted to stay and take care of him.

However, Johan still sent her back.

After all, Cynthia was preparing to walk the "Champion's path," and every moment was extremely precious to her now. Although he still had to use a wheelchair, didn't he still have Flint?

In the end, Cynthia couldn't persuade Johan and returned to Mt. Coronet in Sinnoh with little Hoopa's help.

Now that Johan and the others came to Lumiose City, it was naturally to help the Zygarde core "Little Soft" find its missing partner.

Sure enough.

The Zygarde core jumped from Johan's shoulder to the table, looking at the bustling streets outside and the crowds coming and going, couldn't help but speak:

[My partner is in such a bustling city?]

Giovanni and Flint couldn't hear its words, so after sitting down, Flint continued:

"Teacher Johan, about that hotel you asked me to inquire about... there isn't one, and I haven't seen the person you mentioned who's over three meters tall either."

"Three meters tall? Must be a descendant of giants, right?"

Flint gestured with an exaggerated range.

Hearing this, Johan nodded and also looked toward the street outside.

So either King AZ hadn't left the forest yet, or... he'd been captured by Team Flare?

The reason Lysandre knew about the "Ultimate Weapon" and how to use it was because his ancestor was King AZ's brother from three thousand years ago!

In other words, King AZ was actually Lysandre's ancestor.

If Lysandre wanted to activate the "Ultimate Weapon" again, then the key in King AZ's hands was essential to him.

It's just that Lysandre probably didn't know that the key to the "Ultimate Weapon" in King AZ's hands was now in his own Gengar's possession.

Ignoring Flint's chatter, Johan looked at Giovanni sitting across from him.

A black suit concealed the bandages on his body, and the wide black hat he wore made it hard to recognize his identity.

Noticing Johan's gaze, Giovanni slightly raised his hand, subconsciously wanting to stroke Persian, then remembered he wasn't at the Team Rocket base and hadn't brought Persian out.

His movement paused briefly, but he still said:

"Just go directly to their door."

His gaze swept through the coffee shop, lingering briefly on Mewtwo, Darkrai, and Gengar.

With such power, he didn't think they needed to fear any Team Flare.

Moreover.

If he were the leader of Team Flare, when Johan appeared in Lumiose City, the other party should already know.

Hearing this, Johan grinned.

Truly worthy of Boss Giovanni.

"Exactly what I was thinking."

Strike at the heart!

With that, he said to Flint: "Let's go, Flint."

"Eh?"

Flint looked bewildered. "Where are we going? Didn't we come to Lumiose City to drink coffee?"

Johan's forehead showed black lines.

Specially traveling to Lumiose City to drink coffee?

Are you usually this idle?

"To Lysandre Labs," Johan said irritably.

"Oh."

Flint stuffed the entire hot dog in his mouth, clapped his hands, walked behind Johan, and pushed the wheelchair out.

Seeing this, the little ones in the coffee shop all voluntarily returned to the Poké Balls at Johan's waist.

Darkrai, along with Gengar and Marshadow, dove into Johan's shadow.

"Don't you all feel cramped?" Darkrai said helplessly.

Mewtwo watched them walk out of the coffee shop, its form flashing as it appeared directly at the top of Lumiose City's Prism Tower, overlooking the entire city.

[Humans...]

Its eyes flickered.

Whether Hoopa, Zygarde, or even itself—all had suffered because of humans.

Hoopa was "incited" by humans, gradually losing itself in various negative emotions, ultimately becoming a product driven by power.

According to Johan, Zygarde's partner was very likely captured by the organization called "Team Flare."

And itself...

"But humans aren't all negative, are they?"

A voice echoed in Mewtwo's mind.

It was Johan's aura.

He had keenly sensed Mewtwo's mental state change.

[Johan...]

Mewtwo came back to itself.

Images of its acquaintance and interactions with Johan floated through its mind, images of Johan getting along with his Pokémon...

It continued overlooking.

On the streets.

A Bug Catcher with a Caterpie on his head, a youngster with a Magikarp in his bucket, a girl with a Nidoran beside her, an elderly man riding a Gogoat, a lady walking a Furfrou...

The Caterpie happily munched on leaves, the Magikarp curiously watched the tall buildings, the Nidoran snuggled against the girl's feet, the Gogoat walked slowly and steadily, the Furfrou reminded the lady to watch her step...

Indeed.

Just as Johan said.

Friendly coexistence between humans and Pokémon was the "baseline," and the "bonds" between humans and Pokémon couldn't be "represented" by a few people.

[When life meets life, something is always born...]Mewtwo murmured the phrase Johan often said.

The originally heavy and depressed feelings in its heart immediately became soothing and light.

It slowly sat on the spire of the Prism Tower, quietly watching this peaceful world beneath the prosperity.

Sensing Mewtwo's mental state change, Johan, sitting in the wheelchair, smiled.

Having seen much and experienced much naturally led to feeling much.

This was part of Mewtwo's process of establishing its "self." Johan couldn't prevent Mewtwo from encountering the "dark" side of the world, but he could guide Mewtwo to view these things positively.

Traveling ten thousand miles didn't mean literally walking ten thousand miles—the people and events encountered during the journey were the best "nourishment" for growth.

Ding-dong—

The glass sliding door of Lysandre Labs slowly opened.

A woman in a white lab coat with orange glasses walked out from the reception desk, smiling:

"Excuse me, how may I help you? Do you have an appointment?"

Johan looked up, smiling: "We're looking for Mr. Lysandre."

Only then did the woman see Johan's appearance clearly. Her eyes widened in surprise:

"T-T-Teacher Johan?"

The Dahara City incident had caused such a commotion, with Johan as the "hero" of the Kalos region, even the entire Pokémon world. The woman naturally couldn't fail to recognize him.

It's just...

Teacher Johan came to find Representative Lysandre?

"Let them in."

At this moment, Lysandre's voice came through the woman's earpiece.

Hearing this, the woman was startled, then immediately said to Johan and the others: "Teacher Johan, and everyone, please come in."

Johan's smile remained unchanged, tilting his head slightly to glance at the camera on the wall, entering the research facility with Flint's help.

Indeed, just as Boss Giovanni had predicted, Lysandre already knew of their arrival.

Directly inviting them in.

This saved a lot of unnecessary trouble.

After Johan's group entered, the main door of Lysandre Labs directly closed and the iron shutter came down.

At the same time.

All the researchers and Team Flare members in Lysandre Labs seemed to receive some information, their faces changing as they sprang into action.

As for Johan and the others, they had an unobstructed path, arriving at the depths of Lysandre Labs.

In the spacious underground laboratory.

Lysandre sat in a chair, legs crossed, gently stroking the Pyroar beside him, wearing a faint smile.

It had to be said.

At this moment, Lysandre really did resemble Boss Giovanni somewhat.

Johan couldn't help but glance at Giovanni, hidden under his trench coat, from the corner of his eye.

"Teacher Johan, you've finally come."

Lysandre stood up.

"Oh?" Johan raised an eyebrow. "Representative Lysandre guessed I would come?"

"After all, you caused such a commotion in Dahara City..."

Lysandre's gaze swept over Johan, Flint, and Giovanni, finally stopping on the Zygarde core "Little Soft" on Johan's knee, his smile deepening.

"So this is Z1."

Johan's expression remained unchanged. "So the other half of Zygarde's core is indeed in Team Flare's hands?"

"Correct."

Lysandre had no intention of hiding anything, lightly snapping his fingers.

Snap!

The ground where he stood immediately opened with a mechanism, and a platform slowly rose. On the platform was a transparent special container, imprisoning green soft cellular matter identical to what was on Johan's knee.

The only difference was.

The Zygarde core on Johan's side was red, while the one in the container was blue.

[Partner!]

Seeing the other Zygarde core, "Little Soft" immediately cried out, jumping to the ground.

[Answer me quickly! I've come to rescue you!]

However, the Zygarde core "Z2" in the special container showed no reaction whatsoever.

[What's wrong with you! Can you hear me?]

"Gengar."

Johan tilted his head slightly, speaking softly to the back.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar immediately floated out, bringing the Zygarde core "Little Soft" back.

"Ka-kaah?"

However.

While stopping "Little Soft's" impulse, Gengar also couldn't help but look at the other Zygarde core "Z2" with some confusion, scratching its head, feeling...

"Ka-kaah~Ka-kaah?"

Putting "Little Soft" back on Johan's lap, Gengar gestured with both hands.

"You sensed it too?" Johan wasn't surprised by Gengar's reaction, nodding. "Then my feeling wasn't wrong."

From the Zygarde core "Z2," both he and Gengar sensed an aura similar to Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow"—an aura condensed from human desires and negative emotional energy!

"It seems... Representative Lysandre also had some 'gains' from Hoopa Unbound," Johan said flatly.

Lysandre spread his hands.

"Exactly! I have to thank you properly for this, Teacher Johan!"

"Without you, I wouldn't have witnessed the terrifying power formed by condensed human desires!"

With that, Lysandre's expression gradually darkened, clenching his fists.

"Having witnessed that power yourself, don't you feel it? What is the source of that power? It's humans!"

"Humans are the culprits making this world worse day by day, more corrupt day by day!"

"Only by destroying humanity can this world become beautiful again!"

After speaking, he looked at Johan with some hope.

He had interacted and communicated with Johan several times before. When he had slightly revealed his thoughts and goals, Johan hadn't objected, which gave Lysandre some hope that Teacher Johan might be his "kindred spirit."

However.

Before Johan could speak, Flint couldn't hold back and said:

"Aren't you human?"

Lysandre was stunned.

Flint continued:

"Are you going to destroy yourself too?"

Lysandre composed his expression, glancing at him coldly. "Only the chosen ones deserve to live."

Flint curled his lip.

"When it comes down to it, you just want to kill others while staying alive yourself, or rather, you want to decide who gets to live, right?"

Flint showed disdain.

"I've seen someone even more extreme than you, wanting to destroy the entire world, including himself. That guy was a madman, and you're not even as good as him."

The "madman" he referred to was naturally Team Galactic's leader Cyrus.

Hearing this, Lysandre's expression darkened, but he took a deep breath, trying to calm his emotions, looking at Johan and saying gravely:

"Teacher Johan, are you willing to participate in my plan as one of the chosen?"

Johan's mouth curved into a grin, asking back:

"And if not?"

Clap clap—

Lysandre clapped his hands.

Hiss—

A nearby wall slowly opened, revealing a secret room.

Inside the secret room were the unconscious and chain-bound King AZ, Eternal Floette, and... Alain?

Beside them stood a group of Team Flare members with hands behind their backs, standing straight.

More importantly.

Although this secret room was revealed, it was separated by a layer of transparent special glass, seemingly the same as the glass container holding Zygarde core "Z2."

"Teacher Johan, I know you have many legendary Pokémon friends..."

Lysandre picked up a special backpack from beside him, strapping it to his shoulder, continuing:

"I just don't know if you care about these non-legendary friends."

# 678: Johan: Flip the Table! (Two-in-One Chapter)

The Dahara City incident had caused such a commotion, with more legendary Pokémon appearing than could be counted on both hands.

No matter how confident Lysandre was in himself, no matter how much he believed in Zygarde's abilities as the "God of Order," he didn't think he could gain much advantage when facing Johan.

However, he wouldn't simply release the Zygarde core "Z2" that he had worked so hard to capture just because Johan had come knocking.

Moreover.

Their previous exchanges had made Lysandre view Johan as a potential target for "conversion."

"After experiencing the Dahara City incident, don't you understand yet, Teacher Johan?!"

Lysandre's voice became high-pitched, passionate, and filled with indignation.

"The power that Hoopa Unbound possessed!"

He swept his hand dramatically, staring intently at Johan.

"Was all granted by humanity's endless desires!"

Humans were weak and useless, yet filled with various complex and ever-changing desires. When these desires gathered together... even so-called legendary Pokémon would be influenced and controlled.

Was it Hoopa Unbound that controlled the legendary Pokémon it summoned?

No!

It was human desires, those intense negative emotions and malice, that influenced and drove the legendary Pokémon.

"And those Pokémon hunters you despise, those Pokémon trafficking organizations you hate—aren't they all driven by desire, longing for money, manifestations of resource plundering?"

"Johan." Lysandre extended his hand toward Johan, speaking earnestly: "Rather than watch an even worse tomorrow than today rise again, why don't we together... make this world once again..."

"Have you seen tomorrow?" Johan suddenly interrupted.

"Hmm?" Lysandre's brow furrowed.

"I'm asking, Representative Lysandre, have you seen tomorrow?" Johan's expression remained unchanged, hands crossed under his chin, asking calmly again.

Lysandre stared at him, pondering briefly before speaking: "A terrible tomorrow is foreseeable."

"Foreseeable?" Johan scoffed. "So you haven't actually seen it yet?"

He continued: "Then what gives you the right to stand here today and deny a tomorrow full of infinite possibilities?"

Johan's gaze swept up and down over Lysandre. "Look at yourself."

"How different are you right now from those despicable, foolish, ungrateful people you speak of?"

"Unsatisfied with everything the world has given you, selfishly believing that only your perception of the world is correct, so you want to destroy the world, annihilate life—have you asked the 'world' for its consent?"

Lysandre's expression darkened.

Then he actually laughed.

"So be it."

"Let's battle!"

At this moment, Lysandre had the air of... card players meeting and deciding to duel first before talking.

Flint's eyes widened slightly. "You want to battle Teacher Johan?"

In Flint's view, Lysandre's strength was definitely not weak, but Teacher Johan's strength...

Even though he was still somewhat weakened now, he definitely wouldn't be inferior to Lysandre.

Lysandre didn't even look at Flint, just staring intently at Johan with burning eyes.

"As long as Teacher Johan defeats me, you can take your friends away."

Johan couldn't quite understand what Lysandre was trying to do, but he looked at the unconscious King AZ, Eternal Floette, and Alain in the secret room, pondered briefly, then nodded.

"Fine."

At the same time, he inconspicuously let his hand droop and lightly waved his fingers behind him.

The little ones in the shadows immediately understood and silently left through the shadows.

Lysandre continued:

"However, I have a requirement. Teacher Johan, you must use your own Pokémon, can only use Mega Evolution, and must use it!"

This made Johan's brow furrow.

He vaguely seemed to guess Lysandre's intention.

However, Lysandre moved quickly, seemingly not wanting to give Johan too much time to think, lightly pressing the button on the high-tech backpack on his back.

The backpack immediately activated, then three mechanical devices resembling electronic bees flew out, connected to the backpack by cables, hovering behind Lysandre.

At the same time, Lysandre lightly pressed his forehead, and orange-colored goggles extended from both sides, covering his eyes.

"All show and no substance," Flint muttered with disdain.

Johan and Giovanni both looked at him with identical expressions, as if looking at an idiot.

Can't you see this?

Those three hovering mechanical bee-like devices were actually another application of holographic imaging technology. They could scan and display the battlefield situation on goggles that only Lysandre could see.

Then through calculation and analysis, they would make the fastest judgment of the situation, allowing for the quickest and most correct commands.

This function could be called "technological aura power" without exaggeration.

Lysandre's own strength wasn't weak—even Diantha wouldn't dare say she could definitely defeat him. Adding this equipment made him nearly Champion-level, right?

"Teacher Johan, with respect to the title 'Teacher,' you go first."

After putting on the goggles and deploying the holographic battle backpack, Lysandre's entire demeanor became sharp, his whole body radiating absolute confidence in himself.

This posture made it seem like he had deployed a "Duel Disk" and was ready to summon cards.

Moreover, Lysandre was confident but still cautious, taking the initiative by letting Johan summon his Pokémon first.

Thud thud thud—

In the spacious arena, bright lights lit up one by one, completely illuminating the surroundings.

The ground beneath their feet also began to move slowly, raising the battle platform.

Johan gently stroked "Little Soft" on his lap to comfort it, then unclipped a Poké Ball from his waist and threw it.

"Go, Tyranitar."

"Bangi!"

Red light flashed.

A "Desert Tyrant" Tyranitar wearing thick dark green armor with a fierce and menacing appearance appeared prominently on the field.

Seeing this Tyranitar, Giovanni standing quietly to the side showed a glimmer in his eyes.

Without a doubt, this was the Tyranitar that had grown from the Pokémon egg he had given Johan, a Pokémon he had carefully selected.

Combined with Johan's training...

Giovanni, who deeply understood the characteristics of Tyranitar, could see Johan's Tyranitar's excellence at a glance.

His eyes under the hat brim inconspicuously swept over the young man in the wheelchair, nodding slightly.

The "Earth's Mysteries" hadn't been given to Johan in vain.

Just this one Tyranitar alone made Giovanni believe Johan was worthy of inheriting his "legacy."

As soon as Tyranitar appeared, the originally clean indoor space was immediately filled with a sandstorm, with yellow sand flying everywhere.

Seeing that Johan had summoned Tyranitar rather than Gengar, Lysandre smiled as if he had anticipated this.

Then he didn't hesitate and threw out his own Poké Ball.

"Go, Gyarados!"

"Roar—!!"

A red Gyarados with magnificent presence appeared upright on the field, letting out an intimidating roar at the fierce Tyranitar.

Intimidate!

Seeing the red Gyarados being so arrogant toward it, Tyranitar fearlessly spread its arms and responded with a fierce roar of its own.

"Bangi—!!"

The originally flying sandstorm instantly became more violent, with distinct sand particles sweeping across the ground and hitting the surrounding metal walls, creating crisp sounds.

Some sand particles even scraped against the walls, producing harsh metallic friction sounds and leaving dense, intricate white scratches.

It was like metal entering a meat grinder with a hard texture.

Intimidate?

Who are you trying to intimidate!

I'm the Desert Tyrant—I don't accept intimidation!

So what if you're a red Gyarados?

It's not like I haven't seen one before!

Get down!

Lysandre's red Gyarados failed to intimidate Tyranitar. Instead, Tyranitar's fierce appearance and the increasingly intense sandstorm made the red Gyarados's breathing falter slightly.

Seeing this, Lysandre frowned slightly.

He thought he had already given Johan enough respect and knew this Tyranitar was one of the Pokémon Johan had trained later, but he hadn't expected that not only did Gyarados's "Intimidate" fail to work, but it could actually intimidate a Gyarados known for being "fierce."

However, Lysandre still showed no hesitation.

He lightly raised his hand and pressed the ring on his left hand.

Instantly.

Seven-colored rainbow light burst forth.

"Be liberated, Gyarados! Mega Evolution!"

"Roar!!"

The Mega Stone on the red Gyarados's chest pendant immediately responded with a roar, forming a "bridge" connecting itself and Lysandre. In the brilliant light, Gyarados's appearance rapidly changed, and its aura climbed swiftly.

When the light of Mega Evolution faded and the symbol of Mega Evolution flashed briefly before Mega red Gyarados, its even more fierce appearance was revealed to everyone!

Mega red Gyarados!

"Roar—!!"

It roared at Tyranitar again, releasing powerful water currents from both sides of its body, dispersing all the sand and dust around it.

Its aura was terrifyingly powerful!

Truly worthy of being Lysandre's ace Pokémon!

It was said.

Mega Gyarados endured tremendous burden during Mega Evolution and would become more violent due to pressure, leaving only the brutal instinct to destroy everything in sight.

The water currents it released from both sides could let Mega Gyarados ride them at speeds even exceeding the speed of sound!

The original Water and Flying-type Gyarados would have its typing change to Water and Dark after Mega Evolution, with its ability becoming "Mold Breaker," which ignored the opponent's abilities.

"Bangi..."

Seeing such a Mega Gyarados, Tyranitar showed no fear at all, instead becoming more excited.

Now this looks proper! This is what it should be like!

Without even looking back, Tyranitar's will was already aligned with Johan's.

Johan glanced at the stern-faced Lysandre and still took out his Key Stone, gently rubbing its smooth surface.

"Need to collect Mega Evolution energy as a means..."

He murmured softly.

His eyes suddenly sharpened. "Then as you wish!"

Buzz—

The Key Stone at the end of his chain also burst with brilliant light at this moment, and the dazzling radiance completely enveloped Tyranitar.

"Bangi!!"

Tyranitar roared toward the sky, releasing powerful energy along with a mighty aura, instantly turning the surrounding sand particles into a sandstorm. The harsh sounds in the room were endless.

At this moment, it was as if a true Desert Tyrant had descended. Everyone felt the moisture in the air rapidly disappearing, unconsciously licking their lips.

The golden bracelet of unknown material on Lysandre's right hand trembled slightly, and his cold pupils under the goggles shook violently.

Such powerful Mega Evolution energy!

As someone who specialized in researching Mega Evolution power, this was the first time Lysandre had witnessed such formidable Mega Evolution energy.

You have to understand.

Many people could use Mega Evolution—as long as they had sufficient strength, possessed Mega Stones and a Key Stone, and the bond between trainer and Pokémon reached a certain level, they could successfully perform it.

The amplification brought by Mega Evolution depended on the Pokémon's own strength and... the bond between Pokémon and trainer.

The deeper the bond, the stronger the power gained after Mega Evolution. This was a force with virtually no upper limit.

With such powerful Mega Evolution energy, one could imagine how much enhancement Tyranitar's strength would receive.

No wonder...

A mere Tyranitar dared to compete with the ancient legendary Pokémon Primal Groudon for weather control.

Both were Mega Evolutions, but the impression given by Johan and Tyranitar was clearly... more imposing than that between Lysandre and the red Gyarados.

"Bangi!!"

A pair of strong dark green hands broke through the light-formed "cocoon," and with a roar, the energy scattered as it stepped forward with full presence!

Mega Tyranitar!

Before others could react, Lysandre was the first to show satisfaction, shouting:

"Excellent!"

Then he launched an attack without hesitation.

Water-type against Rock-type—the type advantage was his!

"Gyarados, Waterfall!" Lysandre swept his hand dramatically.

"Roar—!!"

Instantly, water surged. Even in the vast sandstorm, Mega Gyarados could still release powerful currents, creating waves that crashed toward Mega Tyranitar.

Johan half-closed his eyes, his gaze intense.

"Take it."

Boom!!

The massive water impact struck Mega Tyranitar, instantly soaking its dark green armor. The surrounding sand and dust were also dampened by the water, briefly creating a vacuum zone in the sandstorm.

Hmm?

Lysandre raised an eyebrow.

He hadn't expected Johan to not even have Mega Tyranitar dodge.

Even with complete confidence in Mega Tyranitar's strength, this was still a Water-type move with double damage. Wasn't he afraid of being one-shot?

The next second.

The surging waves gradually subsided, and the crimson Mega Gyarados gradually revealed its form in the water current. Its wet, bright red scales gleamed, but its body was actually trembling slightly!

Not from fear, but because the Mega Gyarados that had charged forward with the Waterfall impact had its fierce maw wide open, yet was firmly grasped and held back by Mega Tyranitar's hands, unable to advance even an inch despite using all its strength!

Mega Tyranitar slowly raised its head, arms bulging with muscle, grinning to show a big smile.

Mega Gyarados's pupils, filled with violent color, suddenly contracted as it felt a terrifyingly powerful force transmitted from Mega Tyranitar.

Boom!!

The massive Mega Gyarados was directly thrown away.

"Bangi!!"

Mega Tyranitar roared again, its aura climbing madly.

"Weakness Policy?" Flint's eyes lit up, seeming to understand why Teacher Johan had let Mega Tyranitar endure this attack.

Tyranitar had too many weaknesses—a full seven!

The "Weakness Policy" item, which raised both Attack and Special Attack by two stages when hit by a super-effective move, was undoubtedly very compatible with it.

As for carrying multiple items in battle...

Coincidentally, the League's current rules hadn't yet classified "Mega Stones" as "held items."

"Tyranitar, Stone Edge!" Johan called out lightly.

"Bangi!!"

Having just thrown Mega Gyarados away, Mega Tyranitar immediately lifted its foot and stomped the ground hard.

Rumble—!!

Instantly, the ground shook as sharp rock pillars rose from the earth one after another.

"Gyarados, Dragon Dance to avoid it!"

Although Lysandre was amazed by Mega Tyranitar's power, he didn't appear panicked. He immediately had Mega Gyarados use Dragon Dance, which could both boost its stats to close the gap with Mega Tyranitar and dodge the attack.

This was Lance's signature tactic, which he hadn't expected to see from Lysandre.

The bulky Mega Gyarados showed remarkable agility at this moment. As soon as it hit the ground, it used its tail to push off and spring up, releasing water from both cheeks to make itself more flexible.

It danced gracefully while building momentum, perfectly avoiding the rising rock spears.

It looked exactly like it had predicted the direction of the rock spear attacks in advance.

This made Flint click his tongue in admiration at Lysandre's skills.

Johan's gaze briefly swept over the three "mechanical bees" behind Lysandre, understanding the situation.

Very naturally.

Lysandre's "Holographic Battle Backpack" was playing a huge role. He could clearly see which areas of the ground were loosening and which corners had rock spears emerging.

Combined with the mental connection between trainer and Pokémon brought by Mega Evolution, he could promptly inform Mega Gyarados of the dodging angles and positions.

At first glance, it was quite impressive.

However...

Since you're dodging like this, I'll make it so you can't dodge!

Johan spoke again.

"Tyranitar, Earthquake!"

Bang!!

Its thick tail slammed hard into the ground, and immediately, with Mega Tyranitar as the center, terrifying ground ripples spread out in waves toward the surroundings.

Mega Gyarados had lost its Flying-type after evolution, so Ground-type moves were no longer ineffective. This full-field attack couldn't be dodged.

Only because Lysandre's arena was built solidly enough—otherwise, with Mega Tyranitar's Earthquake, not only would the entire field collapse, but the whole building would be at risk of collapsing.

Lysandre was obviously prepared and immediately shouted:

"Twister!"

The Dragon Dancing Gyarados immediately changed moves. A howling, spiraling wind suddenly rose, and Mega Gyarados rode this twister to escape the ground's constraints and fly into the air.

It demonstrated the flexible use of moves to perfection.

Seeing this, Johan smiled slightly.

"Stone Edge!"

The Mega Gyarados flying in mid-air surely had no chance to dodge now, right?

Even with the help of the twister and its large fins, how much space could it maneuver in?

Rumble!!

Rock spears pierced out one after another. Lysandre furrowed his brow.

He already felt it.

The initiative in this battle had quietly slipped from his hands into Johan's.

Clearly, at the beginning, he had the advantage of summoning his Pokémon second and attacking first—the initiative should have been his.

When did he lose the initiative?

It was from when Mega Tyranitar took Mega Gyarados's Waterfall head-on.

By taking damage to trigger "Weakness Policy's" massive boost, both Lysandre and Mega Gyarados didn't dare take any of Mega Tyranitar's attacks.

But why... hadn't Mega Gyarados's Waterfall been able to knock out Mega Tyranitar?

It didn't even feel like the damage was very lethal.

This left Lysandre very puzzled.

But now, he obviously didn't have time to think about these things, because Mega Tyranitar's Stone Edge was attacking again!

Buzz—

Instantly, a green barrier appeared around Mega Gyarados.

Protect!

With nowhere to run and nowhere to hide, it could only rely on Protect to turn the situation around.

Crack—

The barrier created by Protect shattered with a sound. Lysandre seized this brief moment and immediately said gravely:

"Gyarados, Aqua Tail!"

"It's over." Giovanni, standing beside Johan, shook his head slightly and announced the result.

Flint blinked.

The sandstorm was too intense, and with the twister added, he couldn't see clearly.

But the next second.

Boom!!

A sudden sound like tearing silk, and the entire ground shook violently. Even though this arena was built extremely solidly, it actually cracked open from the middle at this moment.

The entire building seemed to sway slightly under this huge sound.

Looking closely.

After the rock spears from Stone Edge were blocked by Protect's barrier, Lysandre had again issued an attack command to Mega Gyarados, trying to regain the initiative.

But among those chaotic, interwoven Stone Edge rock spears, a thicker, faster-shooting, more powerful rock spear wrapped in red-hot magma struck the belly of Mega Gyarados, which was preparing to use Aqua Tail, with lightning speed.

Moreover.

After hitting Mega Gyarados, the red-hot rock spear didn't stop its upward momentum, directly pushing Mega Gyarados against the ceiling and embedding it there before finally stopping.

Only at this moment did Johan speak flatly:

"Precipice Blades."

As his words fell.

Boom!!

Amid Mega Gyarados's pained roar.

The tip of the red rock spear exploded violently again.

When the smoke cleared.

Lysandre's Mega Gyarados had already shed its Mega Evolution energy, returning to its original form, but with swirling eyes and completely unable to battle!

Using Earthquake to force Mega Gyarados to take to the air, where the flightless Mega Gyarados lost its leverage point—even with water currents, its agility was definitely inferior to being on the ground.

Then using Stone Edge to compress Mega Gyarados's dodging space while forcing out the life-saving Protect move, simultaneously using the chaotic Stone Edge to block the "Holographic Battle Backpack's" visual blind spots...

Sudden attack, defeating the enemy with one move!

Giovanni glanced at Johan sitting quietly in his wheelchair from the corner of his eye.

Leading Lysandre step by step into the trap Johan had set, Johan's battle skills, his control over combat, and his confidence in his own strength had all reached their peak.

That final "Precipice Blades" move had indeed surprised him.

But the entire process of this battle also made Giovanni recognize Johan's abilities as a trainer once again.

His eyes couldn't help but show a hint of barely contained interest.

If he were to battle Johan...

Lysandre stared blankly at his red Gyarados, which had lost its ability to battle, obviously not having expected this fight to end so quickly.

It could only be said.

Although Lysandre's "Holographic Battle Backpack" was impressive, it still couldn't compare to aura power that ignored all blind spots.

Moreover, Lysandre was too blindly trusting of his technology, of his "Holographic Battle Backpack." Success came from this, and failure also came from this.

"This, this, this move isn't..." The one with the biggest reaction was undoubtedly Flint, pointing at the Precipice Blades flowing with scorching magma, his face full of amazement.

As a participant in the Dahara City chaos, he had naturally witnessed Groudon's Precipice Blades.

What Mega Tyranitar had used, apart from being smaller in size, power, and momentum, was almost identical in every other aspect.

However, after his initial amazement, Flint thought about it and realized this was Teacher Johan's Pokémon, so it made sense.

Teacher Johan's Pokémon—mere Precipice Blades were normal, perfectly normal.

Buzz—

The Mega Evolution energy on Tyranitar also faded. It glanced at the red Gyarados pinned to the ceiling and curled its lip.

"Bangi..."

Nothing special.

After turning around, it clutched its chest with a pained expression.

Lysandre and his red Gyarados still had strength. Don't think Tyranitar blocking the Waterfall was effortless—it was just putting on a brave front.

Look.

As soon as the battle ended, Tyranitar kept rubbing its chest.

But when it walked back to Johan's side and turned around, it immediately resumed its disdainful, arrogant appearance.

Watching this scene, Johan couldn't help but be amused.

It seemed like it had learned this from his own Gengar—in front of outsiders, unless absolutely necessary, never lose face.

"Representative Lysandre, according to our agreement..."

Lysandre took out a Poké Ball to recall his red Gyarados. He had already collected himself from his earlier amazement and regained his composure, praising:

"Teacher Johan truly lives up to being Teacher Johan. No wonder you're called the 'Tactical Master.' I've experienced it firsthand today."

Actually, his Gyarados and Johan's Tyranitar probably weren't too different in level—his Gyarados might even be slightly higher.

But through tactics, moves, Mega Evolution, and multiple other layers, Tyranitar's strength received layer upon layer of enhancement, creating the result of... Gyarados being one-shot by Tyranitar earlier.

Although Lysandre still didn't understand why Johan's Tyranitar could withstand Gyarados's Waterfall.

But it didn't matter anymore.

Snap!

Lysandre lightly snapped his fingers.

The unconscious Alain was thrown out.

Flint immediately threw out a Poké Ball, summoning Rapidash to catch the person.

Looking at King AZ and Eternal Floette still imprisoned, Johan raised an eyebrow.

"What? Does Representative Lysandre think one battle isn't enough and want to continue? Or..."

His body leaned forward slightly, the dangerous glint in his eyes no longer suppressible.

"Does the great representative of Lysandre Labs, the leader of Team Flare, want to go back on his word?"

Giovanni couldn't help but frown.

"No."

Lysandre slowly backed away, walking to the transparent container holding Zygarde core "Z2."

"Teacher Johan, you might not know, but this person is not only your friend but also my ancestor, so... for now, he must continue to be my 'guest' for a while."

Hearing this, Johan scratched his hair and sighed lightly.

"As expected..."

The Team Flare members in the transparent sealed room were suddenly startled.

They saw a ghost face like a pancake pressed against the glass, sticking out its tongue and making scary faces at them.

"I've long heard of Teacher Johan's Gengar. That glass is specially made—even Ghost-type Pokémon can't..."

Lysandre had anticipated this long ago, which was why he dared to insist that Johan must use Mega Evolution. He was certain Johan would have Gengar rescue people.

However.

Boom!!

Before Lysandre's self-satisfied words could finish, a muffled sound came, and a large hole had opened in the transparent special glass.

"Marsha~"

Marshadow blew on its little fist with a disdainful expression.

Much simpler this way—clean and efficient.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar retracted its tongue, and where it had been pressed against the glass, a tongue print had fallen!

Poison-type corrosion!

Gengar wasn't just a Ghost-type Pokémon—its Poison-type abilities were equally strong. Just as it was about to corrode through, Marshadow directly punched it to pieces.

The Team Flare members in the transparent sealed room immediately reacted, wanting to use King AZ and Eternal Floette as hostages, but before they could move, they all obediently collapsed to the ground, falling into deep sleep.

"This is the most efficient way."

Darkrai also appeared, black flowing clouds drifting.

As the dignified Nightmare God, putting a few humans to sleep was easy.

Just like that.

King AZ and Eternal Floette were safe.

"So skilled..." Flint, patting Rapidash, couldn't help but sigh seeing this scene.

Hearing this, Johan's mouth twitched.

Gengar's infiltration, Marshadow's violent demolition, the Nightmare God's silent nightmare casting—it highlighted one thing: no door could stop them, no barrier could block them.

Each was a top-tier "talent," and combined together, they were truly...

"Ahem."

Johan coughed lightly, looking at Lysandre.

This scene somewhat exceeded Lysandre's expectations.

Are you really a "good guy"?

"Lord Lysandre, preparations are complete!"

At the same time.

Xerosic's voice came through Lysandre's earpiece.

Hearing this, Lysandre secretly breathed a sigh of relief and immediately said without hesitation:

"Activate!"

"Yes!"

Buzz—

The container holding Zygarde core "Z2" suddenly burst with an eerie red light, carrying thick malice.

The originally limp "Z2" in the container immediately began trembling violently.

[What's wrong with you?!]

Zygarde core "Little Soft" noticed its partner's change and immediately called out through telepathy.

[Answer me!]

But it received no response.

At the same time.

That malice wrapped in red light was so familiar, so disgusting.

Johan sighed lightly, scratched his head again, looking somewhat troubled and annoyed:

"Why do things just keep coming one after another, never ending..."

He had already fought a shiny "Z-God" Zygarde before—was there another one?

Moreover.

Last time there were so many legendary Pokémon, but this time it was just one Zygarde... no, half a Zygarde.

Was this Lysandre's trump card?

Suddenly.

Johan seemed to think of something, starting to understand.

No!

According to the anime, Lysandre's real trump card was the Giant Rock.

In the games, Lysandre's trump card came from the "Ultimate Weapon," not Zygarde.

The thought flashed through his mind.

Johan immediately stopped hesitating.

His aura spread out.

He found Mewtwo, who was sitting atop the Prism Tower and seemed to have sensed something as well.

"Mewtwo, Geosenge Town."

Then.

He looked at Gengar.

"Gengar, see if you can sense the Giant Rock."

"Ka-kaah?"

Giant Rock?

Didn't that thing disappear after a certain time?

It had worked hard and even borrowed Giratina's "Distortion World" to barely retain a portion.

But since Johan said so...

Lysandre walked to the corner, spread his arms, and smiled at Johan:

"Then, Teacher Johan, let us together... 'celebrate' this final day..."

"Final your sister!"

Johan couldn't hold back, cursing and interrupting, shouting: "Flip the table!"

Just as Boss Giovanni had said.

With the power they currently possessed, they could completely flip the table—there was no need to play by the "rules" Lysandre had set.
