# 679: With This Treatment, Why Didn't You Say So Earlier?! (Two-in-One Chapter)

Rumble—

The container holding Zygarde core "Z2" opened, and countless thread-like green lights converged from all directions.

In just an instant, under the wrapping of green light, Zygarde core "Z2" transformed into its fifty percent form—"Z-God" Zygarde!

However, this "Z-God" Zygarde appeared in crimson red!

Moreover, from this Zygarde's body, Johan could sense negative emotional energy and desire power similar to Hoopa Unbound's "Shadow," as well as abnormal Mega Evolution energy.

In the original work, Lysandre had also captured a Zygarde core and, relying on the power of that mysterious "Giant Rock," used abnormal Mega Evolution energy to forcibly influence and control Zygarde.

This was to demonstrate the "correctness" of representing the "God of Order" executing order and destroying most living beings.

And this current "Z-God" Zygarde had obviously been given an additional layer of power—the power of negative emotions!

This made the Zygarde that had just recovered to fifty percent immediately become extremely violent.

Thick red-black vines surged wildly from underground one after another.

In just moments, the vast Lysandre Labs was entangled and covered by these red-black vines, and these vines were spreading throughout Lumiose City with Lysandre Labs as the center.

[What's wrong with you! Answer me!]

The most anxious about this change was undoubtedly the other Zygarde core "Little Soft."

But no matter how it called out, it obviously wouldn't get any answer.

As Zygarde core "Z2" underwent changes, the room immediately filled with a large number of Team Flare members who had been lying in wait.

Among them were many high-ranking Team Flare executives, such as blue-haired Mable, purple-haired Celosia, and green-haired Bryony.

In an instant, numerous Poké Balls were thrown, and a large number of Pokémon appeared in the room, surrounding Johan's group.

As for Lysandre, he just glanced coldly at Johan before turning and calmly walking out through the large hole opened by Zygarde's vines.

"Gengar!" Johan called out lightly.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar grinned menacingly, and black mist surged from its body as it slowly sank into the gradually spreading shadows at its feet.

As Gengar disappeared, the spreading black mist instantly flowed like "black water" rapidly toward the surroundings.

Wherever it passed, whether Pokémon or humans, almost all rolled their eyes and collapsed unconscious on the ground.

Except for some Team Flare members with decent strength who reacted quickly enough, along with their Pokémon, most ordinary members lost their fighting ability almost immediately.

Lysandre, who had calmly walked out earlier, now had a dark expression as he slowly retreated.

Before him.

Darkrai with flowing black clouds and Marshadow holding a small stick and continuously weighing it in its hand—one with a calm expression and one grinning—gradually forced him back.

No matter what arrangements or plans you have, this "violent demolition" approach was more straightforward than anything.

"Since you want to see your so-called 'beautiful world,' let me give you a 'preview' first."

Johan half-closed his eyes.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar emerged from the shadows, floating before Lysandre with rotating hands as a black hole appeared.

Old Johan family hypnosis!

When the black hole dispersed, the mighty Team Flare leader Lysandre was already unconscious on the ground.

Seeing this scene, the Team Flare members were even more bewildered.

No one had expected things to develop this way. For a moment, everyone didn't know what to do.

This was truly "flipping the table"—ignoring the rampaging Zygarde, disregarding so many Team Flare members present, and directly knocking out Team Flare leader Lysandre?

Actually attacking the trainer directly?

Without even hesitating...

Who exactly were the evil organization members here?

However.

What happened next exceeded everyone's expectations.

Buzz—

Suddenly, a crimson beam shot from a tall building in the distance.

Far away, one could see on that tall building, through an open gap, a precise giant device was mounted, and that red beam originated from it.

Beside that massive precision device stood a chubby Team Flare executive with his hands behind his back—it was Xerosic!

Behind him, numerous Team Flare members bustled about, operating the giant machinery.

"Xerosic, you bastard!"

"Xerosic, how dare you?"

"Damn it!"

Noticing this crimson beam, the remaining Team Flare executives all disregarded the current situation and quickly turned to run out of the research facility.

Johan immediately took out the "Millennium Wrist," injecting aura power. A green gem on it blazed brilliantly, raising a barrier that temporarily blocked the crimson light.

"Get out!" Johan bent down to scoop up Zygarde core "Little Soft" from the ground, urgently telling Flint.

Flint didn't dare hesitate, pushing Johan's wheelchair and running out through the hole in the wall.

Giovanni appeared quite calm, unhurriedly following beside the wheelchair as they ran out of the research facility together, avoiding the red beam's illumination.

Everyone who could move evacuated the research facility at maximum speed.

"Xerosic, you bastard..."

Team Flare executive Mable gritted her teeth looking at Xerosic on the distant building.

You have to know, Representative Lysandre was still inside the research facility!

However, Xerosic appeared very calm, hands behind his back, speaking into his earpiece:

"Representative Lysandre said that for a brilliant tomorrow, all our lives would become insignificant. Representative Lysandre is like this, and we all are too."

The Team Flare top executives led by Mable gritted their teeth but couldn't refute.

Because this was indeed what Lysandre had instructed beforehand.

Xerosic continued:

"Representative Lysandre is only temporarily unconscious..."

Hearing this, Mable and the other two's eyes flickered.

Xerosic calmly declared:

"But now! Team Flare is temporarily under my command!"

"The plan remains unchanged—continue!"

Johan and the others who had also left the research facility looked toward Xerosic on the distant building.

They hadn't calculated that Xerosic would act "regardless of everything" at this timing.

Speaking of which.

Xerosic was actually somewhat similar to Team Galactic's chief scientist Charon—working for Team Flare while harboring his own agenda.

In the games, after the protagonist defeated Lysandre, he agreed to stop the "Ultimate Weapon" plan.

However, Xerosic directly disobeyed Lysandre's orders and still insisted on forced activation.

In the original work, after Lysandre was captured and Team Flare fell, Xerosic still led Team Flare remnants to continue their evil deeds, trying to capture the legendary Pokémon Volcanion to turn the tide.

A typical case of having rebellious intentions.

Actually, there were quite a few such people in the Pokémon world.

Whether Team Flare's Xerosic, Team Galactic's Charon, or Team Plasma's Colress—all were top researchers with their own calculations, and they would all take over remnant forces afterward.

Highlighting one point: unwillingness to be subordinate.

Johan could take down Lysandre in one fell swoop, but he temporarily had no way to deal with Xerosic hiding far away.

Because the previously controllable Zygarde, after being illuminated by that red light, had gone completely berserk.

"The preparations are indeed more thorough than I imagined." Giovanni, pressing down his hat brim, suddenly nodded slightly.

He and Johan had originally thought they could catch Lysandre off guard, but hadn't expected Lysandre's preparations to be truly comprehensive.

Not only himself, but also Team Flare's executives.

Of course, more importantly, Lysandre could even use himself as "bait" to facilitate the plan's smooth execution.

Regarding Boss Giovanni's words, Johan naturally had no response, but just...

Boss Giovanni, what's with that approving expression on your face?

[Wake up!]

Zygarde core "Little Soft" called to its companion and got a response—a crimson energy beam.

Boom!!!

Darkrai flashed into appearance, spreading its arms to create a black hole that blocked the beam's impact.

[In that case...]

Seeing this, Zygarde core "Little Soft" gritted its teeth and immediately leaped up from Johan's lap. Countless green threads converged from all directions, and under the shimmering green light, energy rapidly gathered.

The next second.

The true "Z-God" Zygarde appeared on the street!

Buzz—

The red Zygarde attacked again, while the green Zygarde also fought back with energy without showing weakness.

For a moment.

The two Zygarde clashed on the street as surrounding residents fled for shelter.

Numerous red-black vines spread from underfoot, destroying half of Lumiose City.

Fortunately.

Johan had already contacted top trainers from the Kalos region as an International Police Inspector, including Elite Four members and Gym Leaders.

With the help of Officer Jenny, International Police, and arriving League trainers, they quickly evacuated crowds and captured Team Flare members.

"Teacher Johan."

Flint murmured as he watched the scene before them.

When Johan looked at him, he clicked his tongue: "Do you think... others might consider us 'disaster beasts'?"

Wherever they went, major incidents occurred.

What was the difference between this and being a "Grim Reaper's apprentice"?

Johan immediately gave him an unamused look, saying: "It's exactly because of thoughts like yours that Absol gets treated as a 'disaster beast.'"

With or without them, these incidents would erupt sooner or later.

The difference was that with them here, things could be stopped before completely spiraling out of control.

"Stop daydreaming! I now appoint you as 'International Police Special Officer'—quickly arrest these Team Flare executives!"

Johan kicked the contemplating Flint and gave him a randomly fabricated "title."

"Teacher Johan, you're still in a wheelchair?"

Flint complained while being kicked, taking Poké Balls and walking toward the Team Flare executives who had escaped.

Johan looked at the two clashing Zygarde and said to Giovanni:

"Boss Giovanni, I need to perform 'surgery' now. I'll leave that guy over there to you."

Johan indicated Xerosic on the distant building, who was preparing to release another beam.

Giovanni, hidden under his wide coat, smiled.

"Already starting to give me orders?"

Johan was speechless.

However, Giovanni didn't say more and turned to leave.

Johan exhaled, looking at the two colliding Zygarde. "Little Soft's" telepathy continued but received no response.

More importantly.

Every time "Little Soft" contacted and collided with the red Zygarde, the originally green-black colored Zygarde seemed to be tinged with a hazy blood color.

And its movements became increasingly aggressive, its behavior gradually becoming more violent.

Johan raised an eyebrow.

"It can spread?"

He immediately used aura power: "'Little Soft,' fall back! Leave it to me!"

[I'm not called 'Little Soft'!]

Zygarde nearly roared, but after shouting, it was stunned itself.

Only then did it realize it seemed to be affected by the negative emotional energy from its partner, immediately retreating and looking at Johan with some apology.

However, Johan obviously didn't mind these details and immediately directed Darkrai and Gengar to intercept the red Zygarde.

"Be careful not to make contact, don't get too close!"

Releasing large amounts of aura power, he began "surgical extraction."

Having experience removing negative emotions from Hoopa Unbound, Johan was obviously more skilled when "operating" on the red Zygarde.

But the red Zygarde was affected not only by negative emotions but also abnormal Mega Evolution energy, so...

"Hold it down!"

When Gengar's hands withdrew, grasping a large mass of dark red mist and stuffing it into its mouth, Johan's voice was stern.

Darkrai, Zygarde, Marshadow, and Tyranitar immediately rushed forward.

Doing their best to restrain the red Zygarde's movements.

Johan then closed his eyes.

Aura exists within the heart!

In a trance.

He seemed to arrive in a mysterious space filled with blood-red color, where a emerald Zygarde cell with a blue diamond-shaped core was wrapped and bound by countless crimson threads. Zygarde core "Z2" painfully kept its eyes tightly shut.

Johan stepped forward, "tearing apart" those threads one by one, but found these so-called "threads" were particularly clingy, gradually staining toward his hands.

Fortunately, he had experience, and since this was just aura power anyway, he ignored it and called softly:

"Zygarde, Zygarde..."

Outside.

The continuously devouring and spreading red-black vines representing "order power" suddenly stopped, and the red Zygarde's movements also halted.

The next moment.

Green threads quickly dispersed, Zygarde core "Z2" fell, and "Little Soft" immediately caught it while also returning to cellular core form.

[Partner! Partner?]

Under "Little Soft's" calls, "Z2" slowly opened its eyes, but the first thing it saw wasn't "Little Soft" but Johan sitting in his wheelchair not far away.

[Human!!]

Carrying anger, with some gnashing of teeth.

Zygarde's two cores—one friendly to humans, one repulsed by humans—and "Z2" belonged to the core that repulsed humans.

Moreover, it had always operated according to "order," being the "system" in maintaining order.

Having been captured, tortured, and even forcibly controlled and manipulated by humans this time, its hostility toward humans was more than obvious.

But fortunately, "Little Soft" stopped it in time.

[It was Johan who saved you!]

Regarding this point, "Z2" obviously knew, which was why it only gritted its teeth without showing intent to attack.

[Look at this devastation—it's all caused by humans. We have no need to intervene further. Let's go!]

So "Z2" immediately wanted to pull "Little Soft" away.

This incident was completely caused by humans themselves—it not bringing down calamity was already being "impartial."

[Wait!]

"Little Soft" was about to stop it, but a hand was faster.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar scooped up Zygarde core "Z2," flicking its finger to gently tickle under its chin.

Don't be afraid, don't be afraid, lulu lulu~

"Z2" immediately trembled all over from the tickling, its eyes gradually becoming dominated by whites, and finally... it rolled its eyes, tilted its head, and went limp in Gengar's hand.

"Little Soft" showed a gloating expression on the side.

At this time.

"Johan."

"Diantha?"

Following the voice.

It was indeed the future "movie star" Champion of the Kalos region, currently one of Kalos region's Elite Four—Diantha.

As Lysandre's friend, after receiving Johan's message, she had rushed to Lumiose City immediately.

After all, Lumiose City was different from Dahara City.

Dahara City was remote and required considerable time to reach, while Lumiose City was located in the center of the Kalos region with very developed transportation, making it much faster to arrive.

Diantha looked at the devastation before her with complex emotions, hesitating:

"Lysandre, he..."

Johan jerked his chin toward Lysandre Labs.

At the same time.

"Ka-kaah?"

After handing the two Zygarde cores to Tyranitar and preparing to return to push the wheelchair, Gengar's ears suddenly twitched twice as it looked toward the east of Lumiose City.

Johan's phone also rang.

The call was from Professor Sycamore.

After connecting.

"Johan!" Professor Sycamore spoke quickly: "What you asked me to investigate—extremely strong abnormal Mega Evolution energy fluctuations are located in a warehouse on the east side of Lumiose City!"

Rumble!!

As soon as he finished speaking.

The entire ground of Lumiose City shook, coming from the east side of Lumiose City.

Immediately after, one could see a towering giant rock slowly rising in the distance, gradually changing into the shape of "Z-God" Zygarde.

However, it was much larger and completely made of stone, with particularly striking crimson giant eyes.

More red-black vines appeared at its feet like legs, supporting its movement.

"It was still activated..." Johan rubbed his temples.

From Lysandre anticipating his arrival, using King AZ, Alain and others as leverage to force him into Mega Evolution battles, to the "Z-God" Zygarde being controlled—everything was preparation for this "Giant Rock Zygarde" that now appeared.

Having witnessed Johan commanding so many legendary Pokémon in battle at Dahara City, Lysandre never believed that half a Zygarde alone could take down Johan or achieve his world-destroying goals.

Although Johan had some anticipation of all this, he couldn't prevent it.

Either he ignored the lives of King AZ, Alain and others.

Or he simply didn't interfere.

At most, when Ash began his journey, it would still erupt the same way, and by then Lysandre would undoubtedly be even better prepared, making it more troublesome to handle.

"Johan!"

At this time, Diantha jogged over, shaking her head solemnly under Johan's gaze:

"He's not there."

Not there?

Johan was stunned.

That didn't make sense.

With Gengar's abilities, plus "Old Johan family hypnosis," no matter how much of a card player Lysandre was, he was still just an ordinary human. How could he disappear?

Then he suddenly understood.

It was the beam Xerosic had fired!

So...

Johan looked at the massive towering "Giant Rock Zygarde"—Lysandre should be there.

"What is that..."

Following Johan's gaze, Diantha also noticed the massive "Giant Rock Zygarde," her pupils contracting sharply.

"Big trouble." Johan smiled helplessly.

Then, with Gengar's help, he quickly headed toward the "Giant Rock Zygarde."

"Gengar, slow down!"

Johan gripped the wheelchair handles tightly, urgently calling out.

"Ka-kaah~(￣∇￣)"

But Gengar had already put on sunglasses, assuming a posture of... preparing to race—oh, race wheelchairs.

Darkrai and Marshadow looked at each other and returned to the shadows together.

Tyranitar scratched its head, straightened the two Zygarde cores on its head, then followed with heavy steps.

Diantha followed with confusion, asking while walking quickly:

"Johan, what exactly is that?"

"'Giant Rock'—a monster evolved from abnormal Mega Evolution energy influence, combined with Zygarde's power."

In the original work, this "Giant Rock Zygarde" was no joke. Hoenn Champion Steven plus Kalos Champion Diantha working together, along with numerous Kalos Gym Leaders, plus Ash and Alain as the male leads, barely managed to take it down.

Its strength was much greater than the "Z-God" Zygarde with only half its power.

After all, it was the "Giant Rock" that even Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre fought to obtain, something that could enable Rayquaza's Mega Evolution—the materialization of Mega Evolution power, so naturally it was extraordinarily powerful as a monster.

"'Giant Rock'? How did Lysandre get this thing?"

The Hoenn disaster hadn't been long ago, so Diantha naturally knew about this thing.

But how did it end up in Lysandre's hands?

Johan was also puzzled.

After all, the "Giant Rock" appeared and disappeared unpredictably—no one could control it.

However, he had some guesses.

"Probably... Lysandre attracted it through gathered Mega Evolution energy."

Groudon and Kyogre's Primal Reversion attracted the "Giant Rock"—if Lysandre was intentional, perhaps he could discover this pattern.

Attracting the "Giant Rock" by releasing Mega Evolution energy was also possible.

Or...

The "Giant Rock" and the "Ultimate Weapon" were fundamentally both sources that caused Mega Evolution power to appear. Through some unknown means, Lysandre might have been able to retrieve it.

"So what's it doing now?"

Diantha watched the "Giant Rock Zygarde" heading straight away from Lumiose City toward the east, not understanding why it wasn't causing massive destruction like the earlier red Zygarde.

"If I remember correctly... ahem, if I'm not mistaken, its target is Anistar City."

Johan's body tried to press against the wheelchair back while speaking.

"Anistar City?"

Before Diantha could speak, Professor Sycamore's voice came through the phone that hadn't been hung up.

"Anistar City—its target is the 'Sundial'?!"

Professor Sycamore reacted, exclaiming.

Sundial?

Diantha was stunned.

Johan gripped the handles, saying gravely:

"Anistar City's sundial was originally a meteorite. Although it's not as good as the 'Giant Rock,' it actually contains quite similar components. If the 'Giant Rock Zygarde' gets it..."

Diantha immediately understood, finishing: "Power multiplication!"

"Right!" Johan nodded.

Professor Sycamore also added: "Our collection of 'Mega Stones' scattered around is actually based on the special radiation frequencies possessed by the sundial."

Diantha immediately dared not hesitate further, speaking into her communicator:

"Everyone, stop the 'Giant Rock Zygarde'!"

"Wait!" Johan quickly called out.

Under Diantha's slightly confused gaze, he took the communicator and said:

"This is Johan."

"Let the 'Giant Rock Zygarde' leave Lumiose City, reduce unnecessary destruction! Once it leaves Lumiose City by ten kilometers, immediately begin interception!"

After a brief silence.

The communicator responded.

"Understood! ×n"

As the initiator of this operation, Johan temporarily took over supreme command through Diantha's communicator.

Several helicopters headed toward the "Giant Rock Zygarde's" advancing direction from different angles, preparing to intercept the giant rock ten kilometers outside Lumiose City.

At the same time, a helicopter landed before Johan and the others.

"Johan, Diantha!"

It was Professor Sycamore, standing at the cabin door and quickly waving at them.

The group quickly boarded the helicopter, heading toward the "Giant Rock Zygarde."

Johan, Professor Sycamore, and Diantha watched the map on the helicopter's instrument panel.

Tyranitar sat in the plane, lying against the window, watching the distant figure that had already left Lumiose City and was passing through a forest, about to reach a barren rocky area.

"Bangi..."

Rocks, wonder what they taste like...

On its head.

The two Zygarde cores were also watching this scene.

[Look at what humans have done—this monster is completely created by humans. Humans really are...]

[Partner!]"Little Soft" sternly interrupted. [Don't completely deny all humans based on just one corner you've seen. At least I believe in humans!]

"Z2's" eyes were stern.

[Why do you trust humans so much?]

[Because humans haven't given up on everything!]

"Little Soft's" gaze unconsciously fell on Johan.

[I traveled with Johan for a while and saw many things! Helping each other, working hard, sharing joy, trusting each other, having goals, moving forward. I don't know about others, but if it's Johan... he will definitely change what you've seen!]

Seeming to notice "Little Soft's" gaze, Johan looked up.

Finding both Zygarde cores looking at him, he smiled slightly and waved.

"Z2" remained unmoved, while "Little Soft" directly bounced onto Johan's knee.

"It's fine, small problem." He comforted with aura while taking out an energy cube and stuffing it into "Little Soft's" arms.

Originally.

Zygarde cores didn't need to eat, but they couldn't resist... having followed Johan for a while.

The situation with Old Johan's family Pokémon didn't need explanation—in short, one saying:

If you're not enthusiastic about eating, there's something wrong with your thinking!

"Little Soft" didn't want to have thinking problems, so eating was unavoidable, and once it ate... it became irresistible.

Fortunately, in cellular form, its appetite was almost negligible.

"Want some?"

Johan looked at "Z2" again, producing an energy cube.

"Z2" originally didn't want to respond, but seeing "Little Soft" enjoying it so much, it couldn't help swallowing.

[I...]

Before "Z2" could express its stubbornness, Johan used aura power to gently pull "Z2" over as well.

Then he stuffed an energy cube into it.

"Don't be polite."

Only after finishing did he continue looking at the real-time map with Professor Sycamore and Diantha.

"Preparing to intercept!" Professor Sycamore said gravely.

Their plane was slow, but the Gym Leaders, Elite Four, and International Police who had arrived first had already reached the location and begun intercepting the "Giant Rock Zygarde."

However.

Unsurprisingly, the interception had minimal effect.

After all, even retired Steven using Mega Metagross couldn't cause much damage to the "Giant Rock Zygarde" or significantly impede its progress.

Let alone ordinary Gym Leaders and ordinary Elite Four members.

Watching the images displayed on screen, Diantha and Professor Sycamore's expressions became increasingly grave.

All attacks were blocked by the "Giant Rock Zygarde's" vines.

Worse, if accidentally caught by the vines, strength would rapidly drain away.

Johan picked up the communicator again:

"Everyone, do not use Mega Evolution! The giant rock can absorb Mega Evolution power!"

"Don't try to forcibly block it! Dig trenches, divert water, drop boulders—learn to use nature's power!"

"Gym Leaders, Elite Four, International Police—each form separate teams!"

Successive commands were transmitted.

This time they quickly received responses.

"Yes! ×n"

It had to be said, after changing methods, although they still couldn't completely stop the "Giant Rock Zygarde," they did indeed slow its speed and progress.

[Tasty, right?]"Little Soft" on Johan's knee couldn't help asking.

[...]

"Z2" couldn't help glancing at its partner.

It had every reason to suspect its partner was speaking for humans because it had been "bought off" by humans.

But honestly, the taste was really good.

So humans had such delicious food?

It tucked its body and changed the subject.

[Humans can't stop it.]

"Little Soft": [But they won't give up.]

Speaking, it quickly added:

[When Johan arrives, they'll be able to stop it.]

[You trust him that much?]

[Weren't you also rescued by Johan?]

"Z2" was speechless.

Feeling Johan's aura full of goodwill and friendliness, "Z2" found it couldn't argue.

Humans had evil ones, those filled with desire, those who destroyed balance.

But there seemed to also be those who worked hard to maintain balance, solve problems, and were trustworthy...

If it was this human before it...

"Full?" Seeing the two Zygarde cores stop moving, Johan immediately gave them an aura treatment for "post-meal massage."

Whether they could pilot mecha depended on these two.

After a full aura treatment.

"Little Soft": (๑>ڡ<)☆

"Z2": (๑>︶<)☆

With this treatment, why didn't you say so earlier?!

# 680: Target, the Champion's Path! (Two-in-One Chapter)

The massive Giant Rock Zygarde stood towering, while numerous League trainers commanded their respective Pokémon to respond.

Johan and Diantha arrived a step late, but immediately had a tremendous effect upon taking action.

"Gardevoir, Psychic!"

"Tyranitar, Stone Edge!"

Thud thud thud—

Sharp rock spears rose from the ground, not attacking the "Giant Rock Zygarde" but surrounding it, slightly impeding its advancing steps.

"The center! The place with the most abundant energy is in its central red rock!" Professor Sycamore, holding a laptop, immediately shouted.

"Teacher Johan?" Diantha couldn't help but look at Johan.

"Wait, just wait a moment..."

Buzz—

Just as they were talking, the red stone at the center of the "Giant Rock Zygarde" suddenly burst with extremely dazzling light, followed by a powerful impact rushing toward them.

"Darkrai!"

Black shadows swept by, and Darkrai appeared against the wind, spreading its arms as a massive black hole met that brilliant beam.

Darkrai gritted its teeth.

It hadn't expected that a mere stone could unleash such an impact.

This was no less than Dialga's Roar of Time, right?

"Found it!"

Johan's eyes suddenly lit up.

"Ka-kaah!"

Then.

On the "Giant Rock Zygarde's" body, shadows moved as a Gengar flew out from the shadows, finding Lysandre hidden on the "Giant Rock Zygarde's" body with bloodshot eyes!

"Bastard, let me go!"

After being hit by Xerosic's beam, Lysandre had also been consumed by negative emotions, acting purely on instinct, no longer showing his previous composed appearance.

With Lysandre found by Gengar, the "Giant Rock Zygarde" immediately went berserk, countless black-red tentacles flailing up and down, as if trying to swat Gengar away.

However.

Under Johan's instruction, Gengar was well-prepared. It reached out and drew a line beside it, immediately opening a crack, threw Lysandre inside, then dove in itself.

When they reappeared, they had brought Lysandre to Johan's side.

"Take it off." Johan pointed to the golden device on Lysandre's arm.

"The world needs to be rebuilt..."

Bang!!

Lysandre roared ferociously when suddenly a small stick appeared behind his head, striking the back of his skull with a thud. His eyes rolled back as he fell straight down.

"Marsha~" Marshadow tossed away the stick and clapped its hands.

Diantha & Professor Sycamore: "..."

Gengar couldn't help but glance at it.

This way, Tinkaton's "hammer sleep method" was sometimes more effective than "Hypnosis"...

Gengar wasted no time and immediately removed the golden device from Lysandre's left arm.

"What is this?" Diantha, Professor Sycamore, and others all looked over.

"Controller."

Johan directly put it on his own arm.

Then he discovered...

This thing was quite advanced, bound to its user—others couldn't use it even if they wore it.

"As expected."

Johan shook his head.

"Rotom!"

"Here! Rotom!"

Rotom flew out from the Pokédex in his pocket, and at Johan's indication, dove headfirst into the golden device.

He wondered if Rotom could crack it.

If not, they could only forcibly destroy the "Giant Rock Zygarde."

Not entirely though...

Johan took out his phone and found Giovanni's number.

Dialing.

"It's resolved here." Giovanni's voice came through.

Xerosic, as Team Flare's "second-in-command," continued organizing Team Flare operations after Lysandre disappeared, attempting to overthrow the world again.

So.

Dealing with Team Flare was like dealing with Team Plasma—just taking down the leader Lysandre or Ghetsis wasn't enough.

Moreover.

The rest of Team Flare, it was best not to leave any behind if possible.

"Lend me Porygon2 for a moment." Johan said.

Porygon2 had already been called in by Giovanni from Team Rocket before the three of them—Johan, Giovanni, and Flint—entered Lysandre Labs.

When Johan and Lysandre were having their so-called wager battle, it had already quietly infiltrated Lysandre Labs' systems.

Collecting all the "crimes" committed by Lysandre Labs and Team Flare.

After all, if Lysandre behaved properly, even as an International Police Inspector, Johan couldn't just arbitrarily arrest a research institute representative who paid hefty taxes annually.

Additionally, Porygon2 had also collected massive amounts of secret information about Team Flare members.

Regarding infiltration of the League, if Team Rocket claimed first place, then Team Flare could claim second. Pachira was typical, but definitely not the only one, so this information needed to be collected.

Moreover, Team Flare's secret bases were scattered throughout the Kalos region, with countless executives and elite members of all sizes—most of these needed to be arrested.

In Johan's view, not pulling up weeds by the roots was equivalent to not pulling weeds at all.

And Team Rocket also happened to need a group of people for developing "construction projects" to work the mines.

Of course, the vast majority of Team Flare members would be arrested by the International Police.

Actually.

What Johan and Giovanni cared about most was Lysandre Labs' "holographic imaging technology." With this technology's promotion, it had essentially monitored information about trainers throughout the Kalos region, and even some trainers from other regions.

This included quite a few Pokémon hunters that Johan deeply despised, as well as some forces that cooperated with Team Flare.

To resolve this incident, it wasn't enough to just take down Lysandre.

A massive organization needed to be dismantled.

Either like Team Plasma, with a new "leader" reorganizing it.

Or like Team Magma and Team Aqua, with most high-ranking members wiped out.

Otherwise, it would be like Team Galactic in Sinnoh...

Currently in Sinnoh, Lucian was still troubled by some Team Galactic remnants.

"Sent it to you." Giovanni didn't hesitate either.

When it came to using electronics, Rotom was definitely better.

But for cracking and networking, Rotom couldn't match Porygon2.

The round, dual-colored Pokémon looked cute and innocent, but Porygon2, whom they hadn't seen for a long time, seemed unchanged.

But artificial intelligence could improve, and there was depth hidden in its eyes.

After observing the surroundings, it dove into the device.

Double approach!

Bzzt bzzt bzzt—

Continuous sounds came from Lysandre's device.

Johan looked toward distant Geosenge Town.

He wondered how things were going with Mewtwo.

If he were Lysandre and really wanted to destroy the world, he'd definitely play on two fronts.

On this side, personally controlling the "Giant Rock Zygarde"—as long as it contacted the sundial and gained the sundial's power, it could unleash extremely powerful force.

On the other side at Geosenge Town, sending people to activate the "Ultimate Weapon." Although they might not have the activation key, after researching for so many years, he might already be able to bypass the key for activation, or obtained some crucial parts from King AZ.

Soon, both Porygon2 and Rotom flew out together.

Porygon2 had hacked Team Flare's entire system—a mere identification device naturally couldn't stump it.

As for Rotom.

It half-closed its eyes, scrutinizing the seemingly vacant Porygon2.

Feeling "threatened."

This guy...

Could it be trying to steal my position as "best tool"?

Dangerous! Dangerous!

Seeing this, Johan put on the golden armguard-like device again and immediately felt the connection between himself and the "Giant Rock Zygarde."

Like the mysterious connection between trainer and Pokémon after Mega Evolution.

However.

The current "Giant Rock Zygarde" gave him much more pressure than Mega Evolution.

Moreover, because it incorporated negative emotional power similar to Hoopa Unbound, it began influencing Johan's will in reverse.

Fortunately.

He was already quite familiar with this energy.

Boom!!

The rampaging "Giant Rock Zygarde" suddenly froze, and the surrounding Gym Leaders and League trainers blocking it were all stunned, not understanding what happened.

"Gengar." Johan closed his eyes and said softly: "Help me."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar stuck out its tongue to lick its lips, making hungry "smacking" sounds twice, then quickly floated to Johan's side.

Aura power, surgical extraction to expel negative emotional energy.

As for the Mega Evolution power inherent in the "Giant Rock" itself, Gengar was more familiar with it. After some manipulation, loosening appeared.

Diantha and Professor Sycamore watched them without understanding.

Although they didn't know what Johan was doing, they understood that he had stopped the "Giant Rock Zygarde's" movements.

[See?]Zygarde core "Little Soft" looked at its partner with some smugness, saying.

"Z2" was silent for a moment before slowly speaking.

[I thought he would need to borrow our power to...]

Honestly.

It had originally completely refused to help humans.

But after the simple contact on the plane, plus Johan indeed saving it, it began considering whether to help.

Unexpectedly.

Before it had even decided, the matter was already resolved?

"Z2" looked up at Johan from below.

From this human's perspective alone, humans... were indeed somewhat different from what it had perceived.

[This is Johan!]"Little Soft" had a sense of "pride" as if proving something to its partner.

"What a pity..." Johan, with his eyes closed, clicked his tongue and sighed. "Can't pilot the 'mecha' now."

Mecha?

"Z2" looked at "Little Soft."

[What's a 'mecha'?]

"Little Soft's" expression became somewhat unnatural as it coughed twice and turned its head away.

[If I'm not mistaken... it should refer to us.]

"Z2": "???"

As soon as it finished speaking.

Rumble!!

The "Giant Rock Zygarde" collapsed with a thunderous crash.

Tyranitar acquired provisions!

Large amounts of gray-brown rocks fell to the ground and turned to powder.

Provisions (crossed out).

Scattered points of light gathered into a brilliant "Giant Rock."

This time.

The "Giant Rock" came quickly and disappeared even faster, vanishing like starlight in the blink of an eye.

Only leaving a ground full of craters.

Gengar regretfully opened and closed its mouth.

My meteorite...

"Is it over?" Diantha asked in a daze.

Professor Sycamore stared at the screen, which showed no energy fluctuations whatsoever.

"Should... be, I guess..."

He had expected a major battle to erupt, with Johan summoning numerous legendary Pokémon for a spectacular clash.

Actually, Diantha had the same expectation.

They hadn't expected it to end so quickly and "simply."

However...

Being able to end everything in this relatively "peaceful" manner was a good thing.

At this time.

Elite Four Drasna walked over.

"Looks like it's finished."

Johan opened his eyes, now holding a USB drive. He looked at Diantha, then at Drasna, and handed it to Drasna.

"Elite Four Drasna."

"This is..."

Johan's lips moved, briefly saying a few words.

Hearing this, Drasna's expression immediately became serious as she nodded solemnly:

"I understand."

The Elite Four members, Gym Leaders, and League trainers who had originally relaxed after the incident ended were again summoned by Drasna for urgent arrest operations!

Diantha also heard Johan mention words like "evidence" and "list," looking at her unconscious friend Lysandre with complex emotions.

She had tried.

But she hadn't expected Lysandre to be in so deep.

Thus, this seemingly major incident with significant commotion ended in such a "strange" manner.

Actually, it took much longer than Johan and Giovanni had anticipated.

On one hand.

It was because Lysandre Labs and Team Flare, being a company famous for "technology," had systems that were indeed difficult to infiltrate.

If not for him battling Lysandre and attracting most Team Flare members' attention, Porygon2 wouldn't have been able to infiltrate so easily—it might have been discovered upon entry.

On the other hand.

Lysandre had also made multiple preparations. Whether Xerosic or the "Ultimate Weapon," both were separated and placed outside.

In this situation, even taking down Lysandre with lightning speed would have yielded the same result.

But even so.

Using Team Rocket's "irregular" channels combined with the League's "regular" methods, they managed to dig out this deeply rooted organization from the vast Kalos region, pulling up the radish and bringing out the mud.

As for losses.

When "Z2" became the red Zygarde, it did cause some damage to a small part of Lumiose City, though fortunately there were no casualties.

Pure architectural destruction was easy to repair with the Pokémon world's resources and capabilities.

After the "Giant Rock Zygarde" was destroyed, all vines disappeared, further reducing the difficulty.

The destruction caused by the "Giant Rock Zygarde" was even less significant—the battlefield had been moved outside Lumiose City anyway, so aside from some streets, it caused almost no substantial damage.

Instead, a piece of information that Porygon2 found in Lysandre Labs' data caught his attention.

Aether Foundation!

Actually, this wasn't the first time Johan had seen information about the "Aether Foundation."

He had seen it once in the dismantled Team Plasma's, or rather Colress's notebook data.

He had also seen it once among Hunter J and the ghost pirate Pokémon hunter groups.

Even.

From Giovanni, Johan learned.

Team Rocket, which used to have "Pokémon hunting business," actually had some cooperative relationship with the Aether Foundation.

This made Johan sigh.

"The Aether Foundation's reach is too long. No wonder the 'Rainbow Rocket' incident occurred."

The so-called "Rainbow Rocket" incident was actually related to the "Ultra Wormholes" in the Alola region, involving the "multiverse" setting that existed in the Pokémon world.

Besides Giovanni, the members included Team Magma's Maxie, Team Aqua's Archie, Team Galactic's Cyrus, Team Plasma's Ghetsis, and Team Flare's Lysandre!

The darkness and evil thoughts in these people's hearts resonated with the energy overflowing from Necrozma that could open "Ultra Wormholes," summoning them to the Alola region.

Therefore, these leaders of various evil organizations actually came from worlds where they had realized their ambitions.

Adding the foundation's Faba...

Johan found it hard not to think that the Aether Foundation's close contact with various evil organizations might be preparation for this aspect.

"Forget it."

Johan shook his head, stopping his thoughts.

"Boss Giovanni is on our side now. With these so-called evil organization leaders gathered together without a true 'leader' who can command respect, they'd probably start fighting among themselves first, right?"

Moreover, such "sci-fi" events might not actually occur.

After all, facts proved that the Pokémon world's so-called "multiverse setting" was actually quite disappointing.

As Mewtwo returned from Geosenge Town carrying the last Team Flare executive, red-haired Aliana, this incident was finally completely over.

Kalos region, League headquarters.

A man with crimson long hair like a lion sat dazedly in a room full of surveillance equipment, looking like he had aged ten years, as if he had lost his spirit.

Before him sat a woman in a white dress with exquisitely beautiful features, though her expression was somewhat complex.

Diantha!

As a former good friend, Diantha handed over a cup of coffee.

"Lysandre..."

Since the Lumiose City incident ended, Lysandre had been confined here, unable to leave.

Lysandre was surprisingly compliant, sitting listlessly every day as if he had lost his soul.

Hearing Diantha's voice, Lysandre's turbid, confused eyes finally showed some spark. He slowly raised his head, looking at this familiar yet strange friend, nodded expressionlessly, then took the coffee with both hands and gently sipped.

After a long while.

Lysandre's voice was hoarse: "Bitter."

Diantha was stunned, gently stirring the spoon in her cup. "This is your favorite coffee from before..."

Before...

Lysandre frowned slightly, slowly saying:

"I used to think that first bitter then sweet—bitterness was certainly unpleasant, but the aftertaste was memorable. To enjoy sweetness, bitterness was unavoidable. The more bitter, the stronger the aftertaste."

Diantha understood her friend was using metaphor.

The so-called "bitter" referred to destroying the world, while "sweet" naturally meant his ideal "beautiful new world."

But...

"But I discovered I might have been wrong..."

Hmm?

Diantha looked up, hiding some surprise in her eyes.

Lysandre put down the coffee cup, pressing his fingers against his temples.

"That day, I had a dream... it was a dream Teacher Johan made me have, I suppose. I saw a 'new world' somewhat different from what I had perceived."

He gently rubbed the cup rim, rotating the coffee.

"That 'new world' was empty, desolate, dead..."

Diantha didn't know what Lysandre had "dreamed" or "seen," but looking at her former close friend's current state, she didn't know whether to be happy or sorry for him.

Originally, with Lysandre's abilities, steady development could have easily achieved not just Kalos region Champion, but even Kalos League Chairman.

Diantha actually knew about Lysandre's ideals.

But so what if she knew?

She couldn't possibly join Lysandre in such crazy endeavors.

It could only be said.

If Lysandre awakened now, it wasn't too late.

"Have you thought it through?" Diantha asked carefully.

Lysandre was silent again for a moment.

"No." He gritted his teeth and shook his head. "I still need to wait for a result."

"Result?"

Lysandre tilted his head slightly, his gaze seemingly piercing through thick walls, crossing mountains and rivers to see a certain blurred figure.

"Let 'him' help me verify once more!"

The incident in Lumiose City wasn't small, but it didn't cause much commotion.

After all, the fact that Lysandre Labs, such an iconic research institute in the Kalos region, was actually Team Flare's headquarters wasn't particularly glorious.

So besides arresting Team Flare members, the Kalos League still suppressed the matter.

Moreover, they dispatched professionals to take over Lysandre Labs.

The League also took over the highly functional "holographic imaging" technology, preparing to continue research and expansion.

Of course, these matters weren't much related to Johan anymore.

He was still regretting not being able to pilot the "mecha."

But fortunately, everything ended smoothly.

Giovanni had already returned to Kanto, and King AZ had successfully connected with Team Rocket through Johan's help. The hotel construction matters were handed over to the newly established "Rainbow Rocket Corporation's" "Construction Department."

As for Alain...

The kid had been fooled by Lysandre for a while, but Professor Sycamore had already taken him back.

Fortunately, he had only just been fooled, so correcting him should be relatively simple.

He just didn't know what would happen if he met Ash in the future—whether the "Water Storage Blast" would still appear.

Besides these, Johan had done one "big thing"!

That was "abducting" Zygarde's two cores.

Actually, Johan had invited "Little Soft" to play in Hoenn last time.

But at that time, it was busy searching for its partner, and as the Kalos region's "God of Order," it couldn't casually leave the Kalos region, so they didn't go together.

However, this time.

Using the excuse of letting "Z2" better understand humans and the human world, Johan was much more successful.

Moreover, he clearly stated that whenever they wanted to return, they could do so anytime—he could even have little Hoopa or Giratina help send them back.

As for...

Whether being the "God of Order" in Hoenn would be viewed hostilely by Hoenn's native deities...

Two cells—as long as they didn't excessively use their power, who would care about them?

Besides.

In Hoenn, whether Rayquaza or Groudon, Johan had some face with them. As long as they didn't do anything excessive, like "transforming" on the spot, there wouldn't be big problems.

As for the Kalos region's safety...

Their cells were monitoring at all times anyway. If there was any real emergency, little Hoopa and Giratina could send them back promptly.

Thus.

Harboring curiosity about the human world (food), Zygarde's two cores were temporarily "abducted" by Johan to Hoenn without anyone knowing.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar stood under the sun on the clear island, spreading its arms and excitedly introducing the two Zygarde cores.

This! This is my "kingdom"!

Kingdom?

The Zygarde cores looked at each other.

This barren place?

Besides the relatively soft soil, what else was there?

Unlike their bewilderment, Flint's reaction was much stronger.

"Teacher Johan, your island?!"

Flint stepped on the ground, looking completely shocked.

Both coming from "poor" backgrounds, how was it that he still only had a few coins in his pocket while Teacher Johan already owned an invisible aircraft and now had an island.

"Island Master Johan?"

Johan squinted his eyes, enjoying the comfortable title.

He was just short of making a long "ah" sound like Zhang Wei being called Lawyer Zhang.

Letting wealthy people like Steven, Cynthia, and Lucian know wouldn't give much sense of achievement—only Flint's expression was what Johan "hoped" to see.

Comfortable.

Mind at ease!

"Ahem, Groudon left it behind. I thought it was pretty good, so I applied to keep it." Johan put on an expression of "small matter, no big deal."

He had always considered himself somewhat vain—yes, very thorough self-examination.

"Um..."

Flint carefully approached Johan, lowering his voice:

"Teacher Johan, could you have Groudon make one for me too?"

Johan: "..."

Walking past Flint toward the two bewildered Zygarde cores.

"Look around—is there anything here that needs improvement?"

As the "God of Order," although they couldn't as easily bring life to the entire island like the "God of Life," they who maintained balance were essentially a type of "plant," so they should have many methods.

Hearing Johan's words, both Zygarde cores' expressions stiffened.

Improvement?

This was completely barren!

Rather than improvement, it should be called complete reconstruction.

[Did we get 'tricked'?]"Z2" said quietly.

[Should, probably, possibly, maybe... not? Perhaps just asking us to help 'a little.']

"Little Soft" spoke with extreme uncertainty.

"Z2" looked at the nearby Dugtrio working hard in cultivation, whose form seemed to have become thin.

[Like it?]

Although it was a small island.

But this was originally hardened terrain from solidified magma. Converting it to soil required much more effort than forests.

Dugtrio was famous for helping soften soil, but it was quite exhausted too, right?

"Little Soft's" expression stiffened, momentarily not knowing what to say.

"Z2" seemed to realize:

[Humans are indeed treacherous.]

"Thank you for your hard work."

Johan handed over two boxes of energy cubes.

"Little Soft" immediately chimed in:

[Indeed 'treacherous'!]

"Z2": [Mm!]

Having settled the two Zygarde cores, Johan took out two more Poké Balls.

"Come out, Gogoat!"

Red light flashed.

Two Gogoat appeared on the island.

These were borrowed from Gramps' farm in Kalos.

According to Gramps' experience, for newly cultivated fields, having Gogoat improve the vegetation environment was perfect.

Sure enough.

As soon as the two Gogoat landed, soft grass like down gradually grew under their feet.

Actually, Johan had always been puzzled.

Gogoat could produce "grass" on their own, and one of their food sources was also "grass"—did that count as a "self-sufficient" perpetual motion machine?

Unfortunately, only the Galar region's Grass-type starter, Grookey, Thwackey, and Rillaboom had the "Grassy Surge" ability, or the Alola region's island guardian Tapu Bulu.

Otherwise, Pokémon with the "Grassy Surge" ability on the island might have even better effects than Gogoat.

Johan took out two more boxes of relatively ordinary energy cubes as provisions for the two Gogoat.

Although grass could be "self-sufficient," eating only grass definitely wouldn't provide adequate nutrition, and the grassland seeding effect wouldn't be as good as now.

When sending them back to Gramps later, if they became skin and bones, that... definitely wouldn't be acceptable.

Once the island's vegetation became dense and the ecosystem gradually balanced, he wouldn't need to invest energy cubes anymore and could let the island's creatures achieve true circulation.

Overall.

Dugtrio's cultivation and Gogoat's initial grass laying had given the island's ecological construction a good start.

Then Johan summoned all his little ones to play for a while.

Also checking the island's situation to see if there were any problems.

After all, it was at sea.

There were quite a few wild Pokémon in the ocean, and occasionally some with rather fierce temperaments might attack Dugtrio and Gogoat, which wouldn't be good.

After all, Hoenn's Water-type Pokémon included the infamous Sharpedo and Gyarados.

However, after playing for a while.

Seeing the grass had already covered a small patch of land, Johan received a call from Elite Four Drake.

"You're back in Hoenn?"

"Uh, just returned."

Having caused such a commotion in the Kalos region, it would be abnormal if the Hoenn League didn't contact him upon his return.

"I'm at your shop's entrance." Drake said.

Shop entrance?

So fast?

"Coming."

Johan looked around and sighed lightly.

"Dragonite!"

Since someone was already there, it wouldn't be appropriate to keep them waiting too long.

In terms of flying, Dragonite was undoubtedly much simpler than the invisible aircraft.

This aircraft hadn't been "registered" yet—better not let "Old Reimbursement" see it, or there'd be another bill to pay.

In a couple days, he'd go through Steven's Devon channels to help with registration, then there'd be no problem.

"Mmm~~"

Dragonite took off excitedly.

Recently, it had been working hard on "research," gaining new insights into the "Dragon Ascent scroll" and some understanding of Gengar's small "Giant Rock" fragment. Its speed had improved considerably.

"Slower!"

Maybe... his Dragonite really could circumnavigate the globe in 16 hours in the future.

His Dragonite was about at the level of an ordinary Champion's main Pokémon now. If it went all out... that was hard to say.

Kanaz City.

Johan met Elite Four Drake at the coffee shop entrance—standing with his robe open, looking like he was ready for battle.

Seeing Johan, the first thing he said was...

"When did you start getting mixed up with Giovanni?"

As expected.

The real League higher-ups still knew about Boss Giovanni's background.

With the Hoenn Champion absent, Elite Four Glacia handled Hoenn's internal affairs, while Elite Four Drake represented the Hoenn region in external matters.

Johan didn't answer, but after pondering briefly, said:

"Elite Four Drake, I want to challenge our Hoenn's 'Champion's Path.'"
