# 693: Disasters Are Always One Step Behind Me (Two-in-One Chapter)

Champion's Path.

It would be best to finish the Champion's Path before summer vacation ended. Success or failure aside, a guaranteed Elite Four position should be secured.

Moreover, the island's development would sometimes need the "Champion" status to help with small favors.

But before starting the Champion's Path, Johan also wanted to visit the Alola region first.

At least get the "Fairy Plate" back first, helping Ninetales and Tinkaton get one final power boost.

With this thought, Johan said to Drake:

"Fifteen days."

"Fifteen days? Is that enough?"

Drake thought Johan wanted to use these ten-plus days to adjust his Pokémon to their best condition, which wasn't easy.

Especially under the high-difficulty pressure of facing the "Champion's Path."

"Should be... enough."

Johan thought about it.

The four Island Guardian Pokémon of the Alola region had strange personalities and weren't easy to talk to.

But considering that he had been entrusted by Arceus and instructed by Xerneas to retrieve what should rightfully be returned, the Island Guardians would have to give it back no matter how bad their tempers were, right?

If worse came to worst...

One island per day, just four days.

Time was plenty.

However, besides the "Fairy Plate," Johan was also very interested in the plants of the Alola region.

After all, it was recognized throughout the Pokémon world as the region with the lowest development level and most natural scenery.

Surely there would be many valuable plants worth transplanting that wouldn't cause too much environmental impact or damage?

"Alright then." Drake nodded. "Then we'll also try to perfect the 'Champion's Path' during this time."

Johan showed the expression of a subway grandpa looking at his phone.

Perfect it more?

What, are you trying to kill me in the "Champion's Path"?

Drake didn't explain, just casually picked up another flower cake and stuffed it in his mouth, showing a meaningful smile that made Johan's heart flutter.

"Oh, are those Applin?"

Sharp-eyed Drake noticed several "apples" slowly crawling under a tree and recognized them immediately.

After all, he was a real Dragon-type Elite Four member, unlike Flint who would mistake them for apples.

Since Drake had spotted the Applin, Johan went with the flow:

"Drake, as a Dragon-type Elite Four member, do you have any way to get items like Tart Apples, Sweet Apples, and Syrupy Apples?"

"You want the Applin to evolve?" Drake immediately understood Johan's purpose.

He paused, then showed some confusion.

"However, I understand Tart Apples and Sweet Apples, but what's a Syrupy Apple? An item?"

Hmm?

Hearing this, Johan was stunned.

Seeing Drake's expression didn't seem fake, Johan slowly realized.

Could it be that no one knew yet that Applin could evolve into Dipplin after burrowing into a "Syrupy Apple"?

Johan put his hands on his hips and looked up at a forty-five-degree angle.

So difficult, too difficult!

Others who transmigrated to the Pokémon world either discovered Eevee evolution forms and wrote papers, or discovered Mega Evolution, special evolutions, or Fairy-types, becoming famous through this.

His original goal was also to become a Pokémon Professor, not a trainer.

But unfortunately, whether it was Eevee evolution forms or Fairy-types, they had all been discovered already.

Even Mega Evolution was Professor Sycamore's main research topic, and he had just caught the tail end of the project and got his name on it.

Now, could there finally be a special evolution method for him to "discover"?

Wait.

Then why did the Rotom Pokédex have information about Dipplin?

To be safe, Johan tentatively asked: "Drake, do you know... Dipplin?"

"Dipplin? Of course I know it. Isn't it also one of Applin's evolution forms?"

Johan: "..."

Drake continued on his own: "I heard that the research project on Applin's evolution conditions depending on apple acidity and sweetness was proposed by a teacher at Orange Academy. What was the name... I can't quite remember."

Apple acidity and sweetness?

Johan felt that the new "research topic" and the research funding about to be in his hands were getting further and further away.

"Professor Jacq?" he still asked.

Professor Jacq was a biology teacher at Orange Academy in the Paldea region, also a very famous researcher specializing in Pokémon ecology and Pokémon changes based on environment.

"Oh right, Professor Jacq. He first discovered the effects of Tart Apples and Sweet Apples, then discovered that apples with an acidity-sweetness level between these two types, within an extremely precise threshold..."

"Can make Applin evolve into Dipplin. That's your 'Syrupy Apple,' right?"

Johan sighed lightly and nodded.

Indeed.

For a "fully open" Pokémon world, trying to catch a research topic was really not easy.

However, after learning this was Professor Jacq's research topic at Orange Academy, Johan understood that the person to find wasn't Drake, but his old dean whose connections were jaw-dropping, worthy of being called the "Pokémon social butterfly."

"Johan?"

Kanaz Pokémon Academy, Dean's Office.

The old dean rarely wasn't being pinned against the wall by Pangoro, but his face still showed bruises. Seeing Johan, he showed some surprise.

It's just that his facial expression changes affected his injuries, making him grimace.

Johan was long used to this scene and smiled: "Dean, I'd like to ask for your help."

"Hey." The old dean waved his hand. "When did you become so polite? Whatever this old man can help with, just say it directly."

The old dean had watched Johan's growth.

Back when the academy's teacher evaluation was held, Johan's reward was personally handed out by him.

No one expected that Johan, who had just shown his talent in the teacher evaluation, would become a household name in the blink of an eye.

He had shone brightly in several major incidents, becoming someone everyone pursued.

And Johan's fame undoubtedly made Kanaz Pokémon Academy a hot commodity among Pokémon academies.

Look, summer wasn't even over yet, and their Kanaz Pokémon Academy's admissions office was reportedly packed.

Director Martin had suggested expanding enrollment and opening several more classes more than once.

This was probably the so-called "famous teacher effect."

At the same time, he had heard from some friends within the Hoenn League that Teacher Johan was preparing to challenge the "Champion's Path."

If he really became Champion, this old man would have much more confidence when calling his old friend—Orange Academy's Dean Clavell—next time.

After all, Hassel, one of the Paldea region's Elite Four and a Dragon-type specialist, was an art teacher at Orange Academy.

So regarding Johan's needs, the old dean always maintained... an absolutely supportive attitude.

"I want Tart Apples, Sweet Apples, and Syrupy Apples." Johan wasn't actually being polite.

Then he added:

"The quantity doesn't matter, and it's not urgent either."

Anyway, those Applin were still quite weak, so consider it advance preparation.

"No problem."

The old dean agreed very readily.

He also knew about Professor Jacq's research results at Orange Academy. With his relationship with Orange Academy's Dean Clavell, it shouldn't be difficult.

"Also..."

Johan hesitated before asking: "Dean, does our academy's breeding house have Combee?"

This was something he suddenly thought of.

Their academy had two breeding houses, and "borrowing" some Pokémon didn't necessarily need to go through the League.

"Combee?" The old dean was stunned.

"This... I really don't know. You want Combee? I can help you ask."

"Uh, it's not urgent either."

Combee, like bees, had an extremely strong sense of community.

Especially when there was a Vespiquen, they would serve the Vespiquen as their only object of devotion.

However, Vespiquen needed female Combee to evolve, and investigations found that in Combee colonies, the male-to-female ratio was 7:1, a typical case of "more monks than porridge."

But at the same time, a colony could only have one Vespiquen. Once another Vespiquen appeared, it would either be driven away or...

So the academy either had none, or would raise a large group.

The old dean nodded.

After chatting briefly for two more sentences, Johan took out a box of flower cakes and a box of energy cubes and placed them on the desk.

"Dean, I just made some flower cakes. These are for you, and this box of energy cubes is for Pangoro."

Huff—

Pangoro, who had been standing with arms crossed, snorted two puffs of white air from its nostrils and nodded slightly at Johan.

This was actually his main "mission" for finding the old dean.

During his time at Kanaz Pokémon Academy, he had received considerable care from the old dean.

Moreover, the old dean was also a regular customer at the café. According to Hatenna, the old dean had purchased the highest-level membership card.

So Johan often brought the old dean some food and snacks.

Nothing expensive, it was all about attitude.

Personal relationships involved give and take—the "take" part was very important.

After putting down the items, Johan left.

"This kid..." The old dean couldn't help smiling.

Others would give gifts first then ask for help, but he was good—asking for help first, then "giving gifts."

He opened the lid and casually picked up a piece to put in his mouth, his eyes lighting up slightly.

"Still as skillful as always..."

However, before the old dean could enjoy it for long, he heard "bang bang" sounds from the office.

"Don't grab it! This is mine..."

Bang! Bang—

Night fell.

Inside the café.

"Hatenna~"

Hatenna hummed a little tune, gently waving its hand. Psychic power immediately spread out, kneading the dough in front of it, dividing it into equal small portions, then kneading them into different shapes.

Then Hatenna's brother put these kneaded dough pieces into the Rotom oven, taking out the previously baked bread, immediately filling the air with fragrance.

"Alcremie~"

Alcremie held a small spatula, decorating different breads with fresh cream inside or outside.

This way, a simple cream bread was made.

"Sister's psychic power has improved quite a bit."

Watching the three skilled little ones, Johan noticed the change in Hatenna's psychic power and showed some surprise.

Mewtwo, wearing an apron, didn't use psychic power but just expressionlessly kneaded the dough until smooth, then set it aside sealed to wait for fermentation.

"Hatenna~"

Hatenna smiled shyly, its eyes curving like crescents.

Its gaze looked at Mewtwo, and Johan roughly guessed the reason.

It seemed Mewtwo was quietly "training" Hatenna, helping it improve its strength and abilities.

Being able to get Mewtwo's help was naturally excellent for Hatenna as a Psychic-type Pokémon.

Maybe in this "Champion's Path" challenge, Hatenna could shine brightly.

Beep beep—

His phone suddenly rang.

Johan put down his book and picked it up. The caller ID showed Professor Oak.

"Professor Oak?"

Pressing the answer button, Johan greeted him.

"Hahaha, it's me." As soon as the call connected, Professor Oak's hearty laughter could be heard. "Johan, I heard you're going to Alola?"

"Professor Oak, your information network is really well-informed..."

Johan had only called Professor Kukui during the day saying he was planning to visit the Alola region, and now he was getting a call from Professor Oak at night.

"Well, who told me I have a cousin who's the principal of a Pokémon school in Alola?"

"Principal Samson Oak?"

"Right. He heard you were coming to Alola and wanted to invite you to give a few classes to the school's students, saying the students all admire you greatly."

"Me? Teach? Don't Pokémon schools in the Alola region have summer vacation?" Johan was stunned.

"I'm not too clear on the specifics. You can look into it when you get there."

"Alright, I understand."

This was the second person to invite him to a Pokémon school.

The first was Professor Kukui.

However, he would only stay in the Alola region for a few days at most, so even teaching wouldn't be many classes.

"Oh, there's one more thing." Professor Oak added.

"Hmm?"

"I heard that some... rather strange Pokémon have appeared in the Alola region. They seem to call them 'Ultra Beasts.' If you encounter any, could you help this old man collect some Pokédex data?"

This was probably Professor Oak's main purpose for making this call, right?

Ultra Beasts?

Those were creatures from the alternate dimension Ultra Space, belonging to an alternative type of "Pokémon" that came to the Pokémon world through "Ultra Wormholes." They were very dangerous.

"Uh..."

Johan was thinking about how to avoid these troublesome matters when visiting the Alola region...

"Um, Professor Oak, I have another call coming in. Let me hang up first."

"Then I'll leave it to you, Johan." Professor Oak said hurriedly.

The call ended.

It wasn't that Johan was being deliberate, but another call really had come in. The caller ID showed Matori.

"Teacher Johan, the transportation I arranged for you is ready and docked at Hau'oli City port on Melemele Island." Matori got straight to the point.

Since the Alola region wasn't like other regions that were one continuous landmass...

The Alola region mainly consisted of islands, so if you wanted to travel between islands, you either had to fly or take water routes. Transportation was essential.

Therefore, Johan had asked Matori to help arrange this in advance.

However...

"So fast?" Johan was somewhat surprised.

Hadn't he just called Matori not long ago?

Wait.

Johan seemed to think of something and tentatively asked: "You guys... aren't also in Alola, are you?"

"How did Teacher Johan know? We're currently location scouting in the Alola region. I have to say, the Alola region's scenery is really beautiful, especially the beaches."

Johan: "..."

So the trio was also in the Alola region?

Didn't that mean there was a chance of encountering the "true god" Bewear?

"Alright, I understand."

Hanging up again, Johan sank into the sofa.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales stepped lightly and naturally settled into his arms.

This trip to Alola also included taking Ninetales to see its birthplace. The little one's heart probably wasn't very calm either.

He gently combed through Ninetales' crystalline white fur, softly muttering to himself:

"Why do I feel like something will definitely happen on this trip..."

"No, no, no."

He shook his head decisively.

"As long as I move fast enough, disasters can't catch up to me!"

Sunny skies.

Ocean waves carried white veils, teasing the beach again and again.

The Alola region had a warm climate. The undeveloped islands were extremely rich in resources. Besides four natural islands, there was also an artificial island located at the central junction of the four islands.

Each island in the Alola region had a large stretch of beautiful beach, distinctive island festivals, and legendary guardian deities.

As a paradise for tourism and vacation, it attracted massive numbers of visitors every year. Sunshine, beaches, and bikinis were classics among classics in the Alola region.

In the northwest of the Alola region was "Melemele Island," with the legendary Tapu Koko as its guardian deity.

At the same time, Melemele Island also had the largest and most prosperous city in the Alola region—Hau'oli City.

It was said that because tourists from around the world first arrived at Hau'oli City on Melemele Island, the city gathered everything from around the world, making it the most developed city in the Alola region.

It was mainly divided into commercial, beach, and port districts, making it a distinctive seaside city.

In Hau'oli City's suburbs sat the first Pokémon school in the Alola region, and wild Pokémon with Alola region characteristics could be seen everywhere in the wilderness.

And at this moment in Hau'oli City...

Having just arrived in the Alola region, changed into Alola-style beach clothes, carrying flip-flops, and wearing a sun hat, Johan came to Hau'oli City's famous Malasada chain store at his little ones' repeated requests.

Malasada was a specialty food of the Alola region.

Given his little ones' situation... obviously they couldn't refuse these delicacies.

"Is that enough, Gengar?"

Johan pressed down his sun hat, looking helplessly at Gengar, who was also wearing Alola beach clothes and sweeping through the counter.

The clerk nearby watched this scene with delight, obviously understanding they had encountered a big customer.

It wasn't until the counter was completely empty that Gengar and Marshadow, who had somehow emerged from the shadows, reluctantly stopped.

Johan painfully paid the bill.

"Esteemed customer, given your purchase amount, this is our Malasada chain store membership card. You can enjoy a 97% discount at all chain stores." The clerk handed Johan an exquisite card with a full smile.

97% discount?

Thank you so much, how generous.

But considering that even a mosquito was meat, Johan still accepted the membership card.

Then he went to the Pokémon Center, got the key Matori had stored, and headed straight to Hau'oli City's tourist beach, with the port right next to it.

The sun was blazing, palm trees swayed gently, several Lapras swam leisurely on the sea surface, and white Pelipper circled in the sky.

Several Alolan Exeggutor lined up, swaying their slender necks and walking shakily across the beach. A group of Toucannon circled around them, seemingly looking for bugs that might be hiding on them.

Crabrawler that had originally been hiding from the sun in reef caves by the beach saw this scene and followed along, waving their fists excitedly as they chased behind the Exeggutor, looking like they wanted to knock down the "coconuts."

Under a beach umbrella, beach chairs were laid out, and the little ones sat around together enjoying the Malasada they had just bought.

Johan leaned back in his beach chair, his gaze hidden behind sunglasses scanning across the beach.

Wow, this beach is really white—no, this mood is really good...

"Too bad Cynthia isn't here." Johan clicked his tongue.

This time Flint hadn't followed him. It wasn't that Flint didn't want to, but... as one of Sinnoh region's Elite Four, after slacking off for so long, Lucian really couldn't stand it anymore and dragged him back with one phone call.

Not only was the Hoenn region preparing the "Champion's Path," the Sinnoh region was also preparing it.

"After Cynthia finishes her 'Champion's Path,' I'll bring her to the Alola region for vacation!" Johan eagerly made up his mind.

After preparing for so long, regardless of the results after finishing, they should relax a bit, right?

Reluctantly withdrawing his gaze, he looked at his little ones.

"Are you done eating? After you finish, let's find accommodation first." Johan reminded them.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar pointed to the nearby waves, representing all the little ones in expressing: such a nice place, they wanted to play in the water.

"Our little island is surrounded by ocean, but I don't see you being so enthusiastic..."

Johan couldn't help complaining.

However, considering that although their island was surrounded by ocean, it really didn't have beaches.

After all, it was an island constructed from Groudon's lava, and beaches needed time to accumulate.

Perhaps when they returned this time, they could choose to create an artificial beach?

Then even without coming to the Alola region, they could bring Cynthia to the beach to play...

"Alright then." Thinking this in his heart, Johan agreed verbally.

After all, they had been on a plane for most of the day, and the little ones hadn't trained or been allowed to move freely. If they didn't burn off this excess energy, the wild Pokémon on Melemele Island might suffer tonight.

Although he wanted a quick victory, there was no need to be so hasty.

Getting Johan's permission, the little ones immediately cheered and rushed toward the ocean.

"Just right, I'll also stretch my muscles."

Infected by the little ones' mood, Johan smiled and stood up.

"Slow down, Rotom!"

On the azure sea surface, a small speedboat rode the wind and waves.

Behind it, Johan stood on a wakeboard, gripping the tow rope. With his considerable physical fitness, he rode the waves while calling out to Rotom, who was driving the speedboat.

"Got it, Rotom~"

Hearing this, Rotom sheepishly slowed down the speedboat.

This speedboat was exactly the transportation Matori had prepared for Johan.

"Draaa~~"

Dragonite flapped its small wings, flying close to the sea surface beside them. The airflow stirred up seawater, creating white spray.

Gengar lay with its hands behind its head, wearing sunglasses, floating naturally on the sea surface with a rope tied around its belly. The other end was connected to a piece of driftwood with iced fruit juice, Malasada, and berries placed on it.

When it came to enjoying life, Gengar was the master.

"Bangi~!"

Tyranitar's excited calls came from nearby.

A dark green head could be seen floating on the sea surface, its expression showing unstoppable excitement.

If you didn't look at how its limbs were flailing underwater, you'd think it was a swimming expert!

However, Johan was still somewhat surprised.

You had to hand it to Urshifu being a "bear instructor." Under its continuous guidance for several days, Tyranitar had really learned to swim.

But it looked like mastering the Surf move was still some distance away.

"Be careful not to bump into Lapras!" Johan reminded.

"Bangi!" Tyranitar confidently responded.

Lapras, which were extremely rare in other regions, had almost become overpopulated in the Alola region due to excessive protection.

Many Lapras were cruising around the tourist beach outside Hau'oli City.

This was also why so many Pokémon hunters were enthusiastic about cross-regional Pokémon hunting.

"Let's head back, Rotom."

"Roger, Rotom!"

Returning to shore, Ninetales immediately handed over a chilled fruit juice. One sip instantly dispelled all heat and irritation.

Johan contentedly rubbed the little one's head.

Turning around...

He saw Snivy, Ceruledge, Marshadow, and Tinkaton circling around several green coconuts.

Tinkaton indicated these coconuts were all unripe, as their color was still green.

Snivy argued that it had just seen several Crabrawler knock them down from coconut trees, so they should be ripe.

"Goka~"

Ceruledge drew its blade, accompanied by a ringing sound as it spoke.

Regardless of whether they were ripe or not, roasting them would make them edible.

Swoosh!

A flame rose from its blade, causing Snivy and Tinkaton to change expression.

Roasted coconuts?

This was the first time they'd heard of such a thing. Could coconut water still be drinkable after roasting?

"Marsha!"

In the end, Marshadow was the most straightforward. It produced a wooden stick from somewhere and whacked one of the coconuts. The green coconut immediately cracked open, and sweet juice flowed out.

Seeing this, the little ones all crowded around to taste it.

"Sni!" (I told you they were ripe!)

Snivy put its hands on its hips with a proud expression.

"Cha~" (They really are drinkable. Green coconuts can be drunk too, how strange...)

Tinkaton discovered for the first time that green coconuts could also be consumed.

For a moment, it looked at the coconut trees lining the beach, its eyes gleaming.

Ceruledge felt somewhat regretful.

Too bad, it had wanted to try roasted coconut.

"Your coconuts..."

Johan, who had silently watched the entire process, suddenly spoke.

Swoosh—

The next second.

Four Pokémon made four almost identical and perfectly synchronized movements, hiding the coconuts behind them.

Then they whistled, looked at the sky, and hammered the ground.

Not far away, several Crabrawler waved their blue fists angrily, looking very upset but helpless.

Johan: "..."

"Cough."

Clearing his throat, "I was going to say... if you're not in a hurry, you can drink them later tonight. I'll make some coconut specialty dishes for you."

Hearing this, the four little ones looked over in unison.

Coconuts could be made into dishes?

Johan smiled mysteriously, "Have you ever heard of coconut chicken, coconut rice, coconut pudding, and coconut cake?"

Could there really be such preparations?

Wasn't this just to trick them out of their coconuts?

The little ones looked at each other.

"Too bad there aren't enough. I can probably only make coconut chicken."

Not enough coconuts?

The next moment.

The Crabrawler that had been waving their fists angrily on the beach suddenly froze in place. An inexplicable chill ran up their spines, making them feel an extremely strong "malice."

Then they saw four Pokémon with very "kind" expressions walking toward them with smiling faces.

One swinging a hammer, one dancing with swords, one wielding a stick, one cracking whips...

Aftermath of the tourist beach Pokémon latest incident—

Crabrawler 1: Crab! (Miserable)

Villains! They're all complete villains! Just some energy cubes, and they made us knock down hundreds of coconut trees! My fists are all soft now...

Crabrawler 2: Crab! (Tearful)

It's all their fault! It's all their fault for giving too much! Woo woo woo—

Night, Hau'oli City Pokémon Center.

"Finally finished being busy..."

Nurse Joy sat down in her chair, let out a long sigh, and said to the Pokémon beside her:

"Blissey, Comfey, let's rest for a bit."

As soon as she finished speaking, Nurse Joy's nose twitched slightly, catching a... unique aroma she'd never smelled before. Saliva unconsciously started flowing.

Having been busy for so long, she immediately felt hunger pangs from her stomach.

"Lucky~"

Blissey and Comfey also caught this scent. Comfey immediately drifted toward the aroma, with Blissey close behind.

"Wait for me!"

Following the aroma, they soon arrived at the Pokémon Center's backyard and saw...

"Don't grab it! There are enough coconuts. If there isn't enough, we'll just cook more!" Johan was trying to maintain the fragile "balance" of the picnic table.

Seeming to hear the commotion, he turned around and saw Nurse Joy, Blissey, and Comfey at the entrance.

He immediately smiled and extended an invitation: "Nurse Joy, Blissey, Comfey, would you like some? Pokémon specialty coconut chicken."

Coconut chicken?

Blissey and Comfey immediately moved closer, confirming this was the aroma they had detected earlier.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales obediently brought them utensils.

"Thank, thank you!" Nurse Joy's stomach rumbled slightly, making her face turn red, but she still accepted the utensils.

Teacher Johan was not only handsome and strong, but could even cook... Cynthia was really too fortunate!

"Don't be polite." Johan immediately had his little ones make some room.

"I'll dig in!" Nurse Joy clasped her hands together and called out with flushed cheeks.

Having been busy all afternoon, being able to eat such a bite made her satisfied.

"It was worth staying busy until now..." Nurse Joy muttered quietly.

But it didn't escape Johan's ears.

"Hmm? Were you very busy today?"

"Yes." Nurse Joy nodded, blowing on her small bowl. "I heard that around 4 PM this afternoon, a strange black hole suddenly appeared by the sea, and quite a few trainers' Pokémon were injured."

Hearing this, Johan was stunned.

"Black hole? Pokémon?" he asked tentatively.

"I don't know. Many people said they only saw the black hole, then their Pokémon were mysteriously injured..."

"What about now?"

"I heard the International Police and Officer Jenny intervened, and the black hole seems to have disappeared."

Johan fell silent.

Then he muttered:

"Indeed, as long as I'm fast enough, disasters will always be one step behind me!"

# 694: Alola Pokémon School (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Ka-kaah?"

Black hole?

Gengar bit into a chicken leg and suddenly raised its head.

Black holes, this old man is familiar with them!

Johan pulled the chicken leg from Gengar's mouth and pressed it back into the basin.

"It's not the kind of black hole you understand."

The "black hole" Nurse Joy mentioned referred to Ultra Wormholes, passages connecting the Pokémon world to the Ultra Space.

This mainly related to the Pokémon Sun and Moon storyline, involving the underwhelming multiverse, alternate dimensions, and alien phenomenon settings.

Rather than calling it a Pokémon world story, it was more like borrowing settings from other anime and shows.

"Does Teacher Johan know what that black hole was?" Nurse Joy couldn't help asking.

Even as a Nurse Joy, she knew almost nothing about Ultra Wormholes.

After all, even within the International Police, this was classified intelligence only known to high-level officials.

So Johan smiled and didn't delve too deeply into what the black hole was, instead asking:

"I heard that each island in the Alola region has a guardian deity? When this black hole appeared, did Melemele Island's guardian deity show up?"

"Of course not."

Nurse Joy answered instinctively, then realized her tone seemed wrong and quickly added:

"I mean, although the black hole's appearance injured quite a few trainers' and tourists' Pokémon, fortunately the injuries weren't serious. It was quickly 'controlled' by Officer Jenny and the others who arrived, so the 'guardian deity' didn't need to intervene."

"Melemele Island's guardian deity seems to be Tapu Koko?"

"Yes!" Nurse Joy nodded. "Teacher Johan seems very knowledgeable about Alolan culture too."

"A little, a little. When in Rome, do as the Romans do."

Speaking of which, the four guardian deities of the Alola region actually had complex relationships with Ultra Wormholes, Ultra Space, and Ultra Beasts.

They should be the first four Pokémon born in the Alola region, representing the most ancient traditions and totems.

Through recent researchers' investigations and studies, they discovered that Z-moves originating in the Alola region seemed to have considerable connections to these island guardian deities.

More precisely, it was a special aura covering the Alola region, and this aura... was under the control of the island guardian deities.

The main supporter of this theory was Professor Kukui.

Therefore, many people regarded the island guardian deities as the origin of Z-moves.

However, Johan knew that this special aura covering the four islands actually originated from the first powerful being from another dimension, called the "Blinding One" - Necrozma!

The island guardian deities were merely "natives" who first contacted the "Blinding One" Necrozma and gained certain abilities to manipulate the aura from Necrozma.

The so-called "Z-Crystals," "Z-moves," or "Z-Power" were called "Ultra Power," and this "Ultra Power" actually originated from Necrozma.

This was actually identical to how "Dynamax Power" in the Galar region and "Tera Power" in the Paldea region worked.

The difference was that "Ultra Power" came from Necrozma, "Dynamax Power" came from Eternatus, and "Tera Power" came from the "Crystal Turtle" Terapagos.

If we traced "Ultra Power" to its source, its essence was actually the power source belonging to the "Blinding One" Necrozma - light!

For example, the two most famous deities in the Alola region, Solgaleo the Sun God and Lunala the Moon God, actually carried most of the scattered "light" from Necrozma.

This setting was actually... quite familiar.

Especially in the anime plot, at the final moment, Ash and company gathered all the "light" from the entire Alola region, restoring Necrozma to its full power and sanity, once again becoming the "Blinding One" and dispelling darkness.

Light, cosmic beasts, Ultra Defense Force - if you didn't know better, you'd think you were watching Ultraman.

One could only say.

Even in the Pokémon world, you could always believe in the light.

Actually, Teacher Johan had always been a sincere "believer in light."

There was only one way to help Necrozma - turn Ash into soup!

"But if Teacher Johan had been there at the time, it probably wouldn't have caused such a big impact." Nurse Joy looked worshipful and convinced.

The entire Joy family had been paying close attention to Teacher Johan.

"Haha..." Johan laughed politely twice.

He just wanted to retrieve the "Fairy Plate" right now; other matters could wait.

It wasn't that he couldn't handle them, just that they took too much time. He needed to clear the Champion's Path first, then legitimately "write his own orders and approve his own orders."

Every day the island's development was delayed, his wallet became thinner.

Nurse Joy took a bite of coconut chicken and her eyes immediately lit up.

"This is... coconut water?" She looked surprised.

"Yes."

"Coconut water chicken stew? I never knew there was such a cooking method..." Nurse Joy was greatly shocked.

The Pokémon world's cuisine wasn't actually bad, and the development of culinary arts wasn't low either, but ultimately this was a world centered on Pokémon. Their "development" of food certainly couldn't match that of certain countries.

"Try this too, coconut pudding."

"Delicious!"

"Ka-kaah!!"

My chicken leg!

The next day.

Melemele Island, Hau'oli City.

"The sunshine is bright, Gengar-san!"

Riding a bicycle, he leisurely left the Pokémon Center and exited the city into the suburbs.

The Alola region truly deserved to be the least developed region in the Pokémon world; many natural environments were exceptionally well preserved.

Just after leaving Hau'oli City, he saw many wild Pokémon.

Gumshoos standing with hands behind their backs, looking serious as they kept watch, groups of Cutiefly dancing around flowers, and Rockruff that kept barking at Johan the stranger with adorable voices...

It was truly a vibrant scene.

Kukui Research Lab.

Knock knock—

Wearing green safety goggles, dressed in a white coat that revealed his bronze, muscular skin, Kukui was eating instant noodles when he heard the knock and immediately put down his chopsticks, saying casually:

"Coming!"

Opening the door, Professor Kukui was stunned, then exclaimed with delight:

"Teacher Johan!"

"Professor Kukui, Alola!" Johan appeared at the door with a full smile.

The Alola region was based on Hawaii, and the word "Alola" also referenced the Hawaiian word "Aloha," meaning "hello," "goodbye," "I love you," and also containing meanings of "hope," "love," "peace," "happiness," etc.

"Alola" was the most authentic greeting method in the Alola region, somewhat like "Have you eaten?"

Very versatile.

"Alola!"

Professor Kukui immediately gave Johan a big hug.

The two were old acquaintances, having first met at Kanaz Pokémon Academy, and had maintained contact since. When Johan was preparing to visit the Alola region, Professor Kukui was the first person he contacted.

"What would you like to drink? Coffee? Pineapple juice?"

Kukui stepped aside to let Johan in while offering.

"Pineapple juice."

Pineapple juice was one of the Alola region's specialty drinks, even more famous than coconut water.

"Ka-kaah~!"

Hearing there was something to drink, Gengar immediately emerged from the shadows, raising its hand to indicate it wanted a cup too.

"Great!"

Kukui smiled and poured two cups of juice, placing them on the coffee table.

"Johan, you've been incredibly popular lately, household name doesn't even begin to cover it. The kids at school are constantly clamoring for you to come teach."

Johan didn't stand on ceremony, picking up his cup and taking a sip. The sweet and sour taste with a hint of coolness was quite good.

He said: "Alright, alright, I get it. I'll go, okay?"

"Really?" Professor Kukui looked delighted.

Johan showed helplessness: "One Professor Kukui, one Professor Oak, plus the famous Pokémon regional variants specialist Professor Samson Oak - three Pokémon professors extending invitations. I can't really refuse."

Professor Kukui laughed heartily.

"That's wonderful! I'm sure the children will be absolutely thrilled!"

"Actually, I'm curious why your Pokémon school doesn't have summer vacation?"

Professor Kukui sat on the sofa across from Johan.

"Because our school has flexible class hours. We don't have classes all day - just three to four hours daily. Seven to eight continuous hours of studying would be too stressful, so we chose to extend the semester length."

I see.

"Also, some students need to help their families, so they prefer this teaching method."

It seemed the Alola Pokémon School was quite free, well-suited to Alola region residents, just with fewer holidays.

"What's suitable is best," Johan said.

Anyway, as long as it didn't affect his holidays.

Professor Kukui nodded, unable to help sighing somewhat:

"The Alola region is still too backward."

After traveling abroad and seeing so many regions and leagues, Professor Kukui deeply felt the Alola region's backwardness.

"Johan, I'll be honest with you. I actually want to establish a new Alola League in the Alola region, hoping to drive the Alola region's development."

As a native Alolan with strength, ability, and a sense of responsibility, establishing an Alola League to enable better communication between the Alola region and other regions was his greatest goal or dream.

Just like Leon hoped to promote the Galar region, Professor Kukui also hoped to let more people recognize the Alola region's existence.

"Alola League?"

Johan wasn't surprised by Professor Kukui's ideal and actually quite agreed with Kukui's thinking.

Although there wouldn't be situations like "falling behind means getting beaten," the Alola region's relatively backward system had indeed... become a paradise for many Pokémon hunters.

"I support your idea. Establishing a league and creating new systems can better protect the Alola region while improving Alolan Pokémon trainers' strength."

Moreover, if you really calculated it, the Alola region's top-tier trainers weren't actually weak.

The Island Kahunas of the four islands, while possibly different in some ways, could barely match other regions' Elite Four, especially the Kalos region.

Additionally, Kukui himself wasn't weak.

At his peak, he had challenged the Kanto League, defeating three Elite Four members before losing to peak Lance. Saying he had strength comparable to Champions wasn't wrong.

If he also got help from island guardian Tapu Koko, matching some powerful Champions would be possible.

Add in Kukui's close friend Burnet, young talents Acerola, Kahili, Hau - no matter how you looked at it, they didn't seem much worse than the Kalos League.

Honestly speaking.

Kukui just chose the most difficult Kanto League. If he had chosen the "lazy" Kalos League back then, he might have succeeded.

So Professor Kukui's peak strength, without Tapu Koko, could barely be considered an ordinary Champion, or peak Elite Four - more like something between the two.

But this was already the Alola region's strongest fighting force.

Alolan Pokémon trainers' overall strength was indeed somewhat weaker compared to other regions.

The current Professor Kukui was probably at Elite Four-plus level, still a bit short of his peak.

But don't forget - he wasn't just a trainer, but also a Pokémon professor!

Champion plus professor - currently only Professor Oak was known to have both titles. Even Professor Sycamore fell a bit short, showing how strong Kukui's talent was.

If he had focused solely on being a trainer, perhaps his strength ceiling wouldn't have stopped at ordinary Champion level.

"Really?"

Getting Johan's recognition, Professor Kukui appeared very excited.

"I've already gotten recognition from two Island Kahunas. As long as I get approval from the other two, I plan to challenge the Kanto League to truly understand how big the gap between our Alola and Kanto really is."

Johan felt that Professor Kukui's biggest obstacle in creating the Alola League wouldn't be the Island Kahunas, but the Aether Foundation!

The Aether Foundation was the biggest "leader" in the Alola region, reportedly controlling fifty percent of the entire Alola region's wealth.

Their influence on the entire Alola region was equivalent to Rose's Macro Cosmos Corporation's influence on the Galar region.

Without the Aether Foundation's support, Professor Kukui's Alola League establishment would probably face enormous difficulties.

However, he didn't discourage Kukui, believing Kukui could see this clearly. He just smiled:

"Why not choose the Kalos League?"

Professor Kukui looked confident.

"I heard the Kanto League is the strongest league. Since we're challenging, we should challenge the strongest to truly understand where the gap lies."

The strongest league?

Johan looked thoughtful, saying softly:

"In a while, that might not be certain."

"What?" Professor Kukui didn't catch his words.

"Nothing." Johan smiled and shook his head.

He would be challenging the Hoenn League's Champion's Path soon. If successful, there would also be Steven and Wallace in the future.

If all were at their peak...

That would be at least three Champion-level existences!

With the Kanto League's Champion position still undecided... whether Kanto League or Hoenn League was stronger was hard to say.

Of course.

If Red, Green, and that batch grew up in the future, it would be another situation entirely.

"I want to say..." Johan paused. "Professor Kukui, do you have a way to let me meet Melemele Island's island guardian, Tapu Koko?"

"Tapu Koko? You want to meet it?" Professor Kukui was stunned.

"Yes. I have some matters I'd like to ask Tapu Koko about."

"Hmm..."

Professor Kukui nodded thoughtfully.

"You don't know - although Tapu Koko is a guardian deity, it doesn't appear often. Even people who've seen it can be counted on one hand."

"However..."

After thinking briefly, he said:

"Let me think of a way. It should be possible."

"Then I'll trouble you."

Without Ash present, Professor Kukui was undoubtedly the best choice for meeting the island guardian deities.

Johan really didn't want to use violent methods to "invite" the island guardian deities out, as that approach might not hurt Johan but would damage relationships and harmony.

"Mm."

The two chatted for a while longer.

"By the way Johan, let me take you to the school? Meet everyone first, especially those little ones who've been anticipating you for so long." Kukui suggested.

"Sounds good."

So Johan got in Kukui's jeep and headed to the Pokémon school located in Hau'oli City's suburbs.

Compared to Kanaz Pokémon Academy's towering buildings, compared to Blueberry Academy's advanced technology, compared to Orange Academy's long history, the Alola Pokémon School seemed much more modest.

It had only one teaching building, one teachers' office, one cafeteria, and a playground.

A small river ran through the campus, with quite nice landscaping around it.

When Johan and Professor Kukui arrived, several students were playing with their Pokémon on the playground, filled with sunshine and laughter.

Although the teaching facilities were somewhat simple, you could tell the students were quite happy.

Professor Kukui led Johan to meet the principal while introducing things along the way.

"The school's current enrollment isn't ideal - each grade only has four to six students. After completing basic courses, higher grade students mostly self-study, while the school mainly handles basic content teaching for lower grades."

Four to six students per grade?

"What about teachers?" Johan asked.

"Cough, mainly just Principal Samson Oak and me." Professor Kukui coughed lightly, looking somewhat embarrassed.

Johan didn't think this was anything bad, actually finding it quite admirable:

"The teaching staff is truly outstanding."

This wasn't sarcasm but heartfelt praise.

Although there were only two teachers total...

But look at these two teachers' identities!

One was an authority in Pokémon research, Professor Oak's cousin Samson Oak, a doctor in Pokémon regional variants!

The other was a doctor in Pokémon move studies, also a top trainer currently at Elite Four level with future Champion potential!

Although the numbers were small, the average teaching quality was so exaggerated that no one in the entire Pokémon world could surpass it.

As for student resources...

Just talking about Ash's class...

Including Ash, including Lillie as Professor Kukui's assistant, the other four would all become Trial Captains!

And Trial Captain wasn't necessarily these people's limit.

Alola region Trial Captains, after the Alola League was established, could from some perspectives be equivalent to Gym Leaders from other regions.

Add in Ash becoming Champion, Lillie being the Aether Foundation heiress...

One classroom in a single school would simultaneously contain one Champion, four Gym Leaders or higher, and one young lady controlling half of Alola's wealth.

This wasn't an ordinary Pokémon school but Alola region's elite academy!

A small but elite teaching staff and student body.

If you pushed the timeline forward ten or twenty years, this school would probably become Alola region's "military academy," the most solid foundation for the future Alola League!

This value was almost higher than Kanaz Pokémon Academy.

"Alola~"

"Alola!"

Many greetings along the way.

Entering the campus, Professor Kukui saw a girl in a white dress with golden waterfall-like hair wearing a large white sun hat and immediately waved at her.

She was stunned, then immediately ran over.

Her cheeks were slightly flushed, whether from running or feeling shy seeing the stranger beside Professor Kukui.

"A-Alola..." The girl held her hands together, appearing very shy.

Professor Kukui smiled and introduced:

"This is the assistant I told you about, named Lillie. Lillie, you definitely recognize this person - the famous Teacher Johan."

Under Lillie's large white sun hat, her light blue eyes quickly swept over Johan's face. Unable to suppress her surprise, she then quickly lowered her head shyly:

"Tea-Teacher Johan, I-I'm Lillie."

"Hello, Lillie." Johan smiled and greeted her.

This was a key character in the Pokémon Sun and Moon storyline.

As everyone knew, Serena belonged to Ash, while Lillie belonged to everyone (crossed out).

Cough, Lillie was one of the female leads in the Sun and Moon anime, quite popular herself, and also the character with the most obvious growth and change, loved by many.

The current Lillie, due to a UB incident in her childhood, should still be in the stage of fearing Pokémon, and her relationship with her mother, Aether Foundation President Lusamine, should also be quite tense.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar floated out from Johan's shadow behind him, grinning mischievously as it greeted Lillie too.

!!

Seeing Gengar, Lillie immediately froze, her body trembling slightly, unable to speak.

Johan pressed Gengar's head and pushed it back down, while apologizing:

"Sorry, Gengar means no harm. It's just rather mischievous."

Lillie took quite a while to slowly recover.

Professor Kukui sighed softly, not immediately explaining anything, but instead arranging:

"Lillie, Teacher Johan will be coming to our school to teach for a while. You'll serve as Teacher Johan's assistant then."

Although Lillie was very afraid of Pokémon, she performed excellently as an assistant, thanks to her very good upbringing.

"Really?"

Lillie unconsciously raised her head, surprise bursting from her eyes.

Then realizing she had lost composure, she quickly lowered her head again, saying quietly:

"O-okay, I understand."

"Then Lillie, please take care of me from now on." Johan smiled.

Having an additional assistant, especially the Aether Foundation heiress, would undoubtedly make many things much simpler.

"Y-yes!"

"Right, is everyone here? Have Lana, Mallow and the others come out. The Teacher Johan they've been thinking about has finally arrived."

"Everyone... doesn't have class this morning..." Lillie quietly explained, then immediately said: "I'll go call them right away!"

With that, she immediately ran off to call her friends.

"Let's go Johan. Since they're temporarily not here, let's go see Principal Samson Oak first."

The two came to the principal's office.

Opening the door...

They saw an elderly man in a flower shirt lying on his desk sleeping and snoring, with a snot bubble growing and shrinking.

Professor Kukui helplessly approached and gently popped the snot bubble.

Samson Oak immediately bounced up from his chair.

"Haha! I'm Samson Oak, Samson hugged by Komala!"

While speaking, this Professor Oak Alola Form immediately transformed to look like Komala, actually quite resembling it.

Johan: "..."

Kukui: "..."

Instead, seeing this, Gengar immediately popped out again, rubbing its own head before also transforming to look like Komala.

"Ka-kaah~"

Samson Oak was immediately "shocked," feeling he had met a worthy opponent, about to cos again when Professor Kukui quickly stopped him.

"Principal, Teacher Johan is here."

This "man with a thousand Pokémon faces" Samson Oak finally noticed Johan's presence.

"Teacher Johan finally came? Wonderful!"

Originally Samson Oak wanted to continue "performing" his cosplay abilities, but fortunately Professor Kukui was there, quickly completing simple introductions and setting up future teaching arrangements.

After all, there weren't many classes or students anyway - the arrangement emphasized being casual and free-spirited.

As long as Johan had time, as long as it was daytime, classes could start anytime!

However, Gengar was both somewhat wary of and curious about this "Alola Form Professor Oak" Samson Oak's cosplay abilities. When leaving, it couldn't help looking back at Principal Samson Oak several times.

Alola Pokémon School, on-campus Tauros ranch.

A dark-skinned boy in red shorts was slowly descending on a majestic Charizard.

After taking bundles of hay from Charizard's back, he used a pitchfork to deliver the hay into the ranch while banging on the fence.

"Feeding time! Feeding time!"

"Moo~Moo~"

Hearing the commotion, the Tauros immediately crowded over.

"Don't push! Don't push! One at a time, everyone gets to eat!" the boy called out.

"Kiawe!"

At this time, Lillie wearing a sun hat came running over.

"Lillie?" Kiawe cast a questioning look.

Lillie panted lightly: "Tea-Teacher Johan came, Professor Kukui wants us to gather on the playground."

"Teacher Johan?"

Kiawe was stunned, then his eyes seemed to burst with flames: "That Teacher Johan who punched legendary Pokémon, kicked mythical Pokémon, and shattered the space-time dragons with one punch?"

"Eh? Eh... I think so..."

Kiawe immediately dropped his pitchfork and climbed onto Charizard's back.

"Charizard, let's go! We're going to challenge Teacher Johan!"

Lillie called from below:

"Before gathering, let's call Sophocles first."

"Got it!"

Kiawe's voice came from far away.

By the school's seaside fishing area.

Blue-haired Lana sat quietly on the rocks, focusing intently on the calm sea surface.

"Today the wind is calm and waves are still. Let's not fish for Kyogre today - target is Lugia!" Lana murmured quietly but with extreme determination.

"Lana! Lana!"

Lillie stood on shore, hands on her knees, calling:

"Tea-Teacher Johan came to school, Professor Kukui wants us to gather on the playground!"

"Teacher Johan?"

Hearing Lillie's words, Lana was stunned, then immediately stood up, not even bothering to reel in the Horsea already hooked, immediately getting up and grabbing her water bucket.

Teacher Johan had defeated Kyogre and ridden Lugia!

She definitely had to ask Teacher Johan how he "conquered" these Pokémon.

Lillie hurriedly said:

"We-we should go to the cafeteria first and call Mallow too."

"Right, Mallow!"

Usually known for her calmness, Lana now showed some excitement too.

On the Pokémon school playground.

Johan and Professor Kukui had already arrived first.

Professor Kukui in thought suddenly said:

"I've got it!"

"What?"

"I know how to let you meet Tapu Koko!"

Hmm?

"Tapu Koko is full of curiosity, especially about battles and Pokémon it hasn't seen much. The more powerful the collision, the more likely it is to attract Tapu Koko." Professor Kukui said.

Battle?

Johan rubbed his chin, somewhat understanding.

Professor Kukui wanted to battle him?

If it was to smoothly meet Tapu Koko, that wasn't impossible.

Noticing Johan's gaze, Professor Kukui understood he had misunderstood and immediately smiled:

"Not with me."

"At least, not with me for now."

He certainly wanted to battle Johan too, but for the current him, establishing the Alola League was most important.

For this, he could suppress his battle desires.

"Then..."

"With my master, Melemele Island's Island Kahuna, Hala!"

Island Kahuna?

Professor Kukui explained:

"Johan, you don't know - island guardian deities and Island Kahunas have closer relationships, and Island Kahunas can get more attention from guardian deities, so if you battle an Island Kahuna..."

It would definitely be more likely to attract Tapu Koko than battling others.

Johan mentally completed Professor Kukui's explanation, fully understanding his meaning.

"Would Kahuna Hala agree?"

"He will!"

Professor Kukui appeared very certain about this: "Master always maintains a twenty-year-old heart when it comes to Pokémon battles!"

This had to mention that the Island Kahunas of Alola region's various islands actually shared many personality similarities with their island guardian deities.

Although Hala was older, he always maintained passion for battles and curiosity about many new things. He was also the first Island Kahuna to support Professor Kukui in creating the Alola League.

After brief consideration, Johan nodded, accepting Professor Kukui's suggestion.

As long as he could meet Tapu Koko, the other three island guardian deities would be easier to handle.
