# 695: You Said One Step Behind, But It Came Right to My Face? (Two-in-One Chapter)

On the playground of Alola Pokémon School.

Lillie, Kiawe, Sophocles, Lana, and Mallow—five students stood in a row.

"Let's start with simple self-introductions," Professor Kukui said.

Among the five, Lana and Mallow already knew Johan. They had met him at the fishing contest in Canalave City in the Sinnoh region and had exchanged contact information.

Energetic girl Mallow was about to introduce herself first when dark-skinned Kiawe rushed to the front, clenching his fists with flames seemingly burning in his expression.

"Teacher Johan! I'm Kiawe from Akala Island, and I want to battle you!"

Kiawe's gaze burned intensely, showing no trace of fear.

Sophocles and Mallow behind him immediately covered their foreheads.

"This guy, here he goes again..."

Johan looked at Kiawe with interest.

First he saw the Alola form of Professor Oak, now he was seeing the Alola form of Flint?

The Alola region truly was a magical place.

"Sure." Johan nodded.

"Eh?" ×4

The other four exclaimed in surprise in unison.

Even Professor Kukui looked at Johan with some surprise.

Johan smiled: "How should I put it... As a teacher, well, it's been a long time since a student challenged me."

He beckoned to Kiawe.

"Come on."

With his current strength, let alone teaching an ordinary trainer, even Gym Leaders could be taught.

On a whim, having a battle was no problem.

Kiawe didn't notice Professor Kukui's strange expression and immediately took out a Poké Ball, throwing it with full momentum.

"I'm counting on you, Turtonator!"

Turtonator, the Blast Turtle Pokémon, Fire and Dragon-type. It looked like a turtle, but the shell on its back and the plates on its head were both star-shaped, red and yellow, as if burning.

A Fire and Dragon-type Pokémon...

Johan's finger slid across the Poké Balls at his waist, finally grasping Snivy's Poké Ball.

That would be it. His other Pokémon seemed... a bit too much of a bully.

"Go, Snivy!"

"Sni~!"

Compared to the large and heavy Turtonator with its appearance of blazing flames, Snivy's entrance... seemed somewhat "weak."

"A Grass-type Snivy!" Mallow's eyes lit up.

"It's the starter Pokémon from the Unova region, the initial form of Serperior..." Professor Kukui "thoughtfully" provided simple introductions for Kiawe and the others, though his expression became even stranger.

There were rumors online that Teacher Johan deliberately kept an initial-form Pokémon specifically for baby cup matches.

Now it seemed...

Snivy? Grass-type?

Kiawe looked at Johan with some surprise.

He didn't understand why Teacher Johan would summon such a "weak" Pokémon, and a Grass-type at that. Was he... going easy?

This immediately made Kiawe feel dissatisfied, feeling he was being underestimated.

"Sni!"

Snivy crossed its arms, turned sideways and glanced at Kiawe and Turtonator with disdain, its face full of arrogance, as if it looked down on Kiawe and Turtonator. This made Kiawe even angrier.

Damn it!

Being looked down upon right from the start?

"Turtonator, Flamethrower!" Kiawe felt the anger in his heart about to become real.

Looking down on him and Turtonator, they had to make Teacher Johan pay the price for underestimating them—

Whoosh—

The next second.

Countless leaves swept in with a tornado, and Turtonator's Flamethrower was instantly swallowed by the hurricane and leaves.

Only then did Johan's calm voice reach them.

"Leaf Storm."

Boom!!

Leaves blocked out the sky, hurricanes howled endlessly. Kiawe and Turtonator seemed to be in a green ocean.

Those seemingly delicate leaves could leave marks on Turtonator's shell with just a casual slash.

Kiawe: "..."

The leaves scattered.

Kiawe's Turtonator was already lying on the ground with swirling eyes.

"O-one move KO? Grass-type beating Fire-type?" Sophocles cried out.

"Kiawe's Turtonator has 4× resistance to Grass-type moves, right?" Mallow shrank her neck and said quietly.

"Sni~"

Snivy curled its lip, flicked its tail twice lightly, and glanced sideways with disdain.

That's it?

Making such a loud noise, I thought it would be impressive.

Kiawe: "..."

"Don't be discouraged." Johan patted Kiawe's shoulder, smiling: "After all, I'm uh, I'm also your teacher."

He had originally wanted to say he was Champion-level, but considering he didn't actually have the Champion title yet, the teacher identity was more reliable.

Smack—

Lana nearby hit her palm with her fist, suddenly understanding:

"Kiawe, Teacher Johan treated you like a baby."

Kiawe: "..."

"Cough cough." Johan choked on air, quickly saying: "It's okay. I did this to make you understand that Pokémon battles aren't just about attacking. Sometimes defense is more important than offense."

It was just that Turtonator had too many openings earlier. Otherwise... even if Snivy combined Leaf Storm with Twister, it wouldn't have KO'd it so easily.

"Defense?" Kiawe repeated in a daze.

A fist gently tapped his chest.

"Cheer up, Kiawe."

Kiawe looked up to meet Johan's encouraging gaze. After being stunned, fire lit up in his eyes again.

Teacher Johan was instructing him! Helping him find his shortcomings! This was the way to become stronger.

"Yes! I will, Teacher Johan!" Kiawe clenched his fists and called out energetically.

Johan secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Just now, he had really treated Kiawe like the Alola form of Flint, losing control of his strength. Fortunately, Kiawe really had some of Flint's never-give-up spirit.

So...

It was all Flint's fault!

Right, another mark against him.

Little Sophocles shrank his neck.

Worthy of someone who could beat his cousin Molayne in competition. His strength was truly terrifyingly powerful. Just an unevolved starter Pokémon, even with 4× resistance, could KO Kiawe's Turtonator.

Noticing Professor Kukui's gaze fall on him, Sophocles immediately stepped forward:

"I'm Sophocles, um, I like computers and electronic devices. This is my partner Togedemaru—a great buddy!"

Speaking, Sophocles held up the electric mouse Togedemaru with both hands, regaining some composure.

Johan nodded, his voice gentle: "I know you. Your cousin Molayne and I are good friends."

Hearing this, Sophocles immediately relaxed, subtly patting his chest.

Good, another "acquaintance." No problem then.

"Teacher Johan, I'm Mallow." Mallow still had her energetic appearance, smiling brightly: "My dream is to inherit the family restaurant and make food that makes everyone happy!"

"Then we should definitely discuss that together when we get a chance." Johan smiled.

Another somewhat absurd existence. If nothing unexpected happened, Mallow would adopt a Shaymin that Giratina was obsessed with.

"I..."

When it was Lana's turn, although she was the most familiar with Johan among them, she still couldn't help being shy and timid.

"My dream is to catch Kyogre!"

Lana mustered her courage, shouting out her dream in front of so many people for the first time.

Everyone was stunned.

That was Kyogre!

The legendary super-ancient beast, representative of the ocean.

But when everyone thought Lana was joking, Johan quite seriously confirmed:

"You can do it. If it's you, you definitely can."

Lana's face immediately turned red.

Getting Teacher Johan's recognition made the nervousness in her heart dissipate somewhat while also making her more confident.

Johan felt that Groudon lost arguments with Kyogre every time because Groudon's inability to fly was always exploited and attacked by Kyogre.

He believed Groudon would be happy to give Kyogre an indelible stain, like... being caught by a little girl with a fishing rod.

At least that would make them even.

Mm.

Johan nodded secretly.

Indeed, after meeting Zygarde, he increasingly understood the "way of balance."

Lillie didn't need much introduction afterward, having been introduced before.

Actually, Lana and Mallow didn't need it either, but Mallow was lively, while Lana wanted to take this opportunity to express her dream.

"Alright."

After introductions, Professor Kukui clapped his hands to get everyone's attention, then said:

"You all get acquainted with Teacher Johan first. Remember to come to Iki Town tonight for the festival."

"Okay!" ×5

"Festival?" Johan was stunned, looking questioningly at Professor Kukui.

He scratched his head, smiling embarrassedly: "I forgot to tell you. Today is actually our Melemele Island's 'Full Moon Festival,' to thank the 'Moon God' for watching over the Alola region."

The so-called "Full Moon Festival" was actually an ancient ritual in the Alola region to summon the "Moon God" Lunala.

Lunala's title "Emissary of the Moon" actually came from this.

However, as time passed and history changed, Lunala was never seen again, but this ritual was preserved, becoming today's "Full Moon Festival."

After listening to Professor Kukui's simple explanation, Johan showed a thoughtful expression.

"For the festival celebration, battles will naturally follow, and that guy really likes excitement." Professor Kukui added.

"Battles?"

The five little ones looked confused.

Professor Kukui didn't explain much, just saying:

"I'll go make arrangements now."

With that, he quickly ran off.

Melemele Island.

Azure seawater lapped the shore, palm trees rustled.

"I say... is it really okay to go this way?"

James stopped at the forest edge, looking at the dense, deep forest ahead that seemed like a gaping maw, swallowing before asking.

"We finally rushed over after quickly finishing location scouting. This time we must make good money at the 'Full Moon Festival'!"

Jessie looked full of energy.

"No, what I mean is..."

James pointed to the sign in front of the forest that read—Beware, Bewear Habitat!

Meowth held some unknown navigation device: "This is the shortest route to Iki Town. If we don't go this way, we definitely can't make the festival, meow~"

"Sona~nsu~! ∠(°ゝ°)"

"Wobbuffet isn't afraid, so what are you afraid of? It's just bears. How evil can they be compared to us? We're the evil Team Rocket!" Jessie took the lead, swaggering toward the forest path.

James shrank his neck.

Despite his heart full of worry, he couldn't resist Jessie's "tyranny" and could only quickly follow.

"The boss wants Team Rocket to expand new business. If we can earn enough funds to open a shop in the Alola region..."

"Promotion! Salary increase!"

"What a great feeling~!"

"Sona~nsu~!"

Melemele Island, Iki Town.

A town located in the center of Melemele Island with a long history.

Although Hau'oli City was the most developed and prosperous city on the island, when it came to festivals, pilgrimages, and other ancient customs, Iki Town was Melemele Island's first choice.

Crackle—

Orange sparks danced in the bonfire, the dim yellow glow dispelling darkness and reflecting with the bright moon in the night sky.

Thump thump! Thump thump thump—

Two Alolan Marowak waved bone clubs burning with blue flames, beating drums with rhythmic beats that made people want to dance.

Abundant fruits were piled on the festival stage in the town center. Melemele Island residents held hands, singing and dancing, celebrating the "full moon's" arrival and worshipping the great "Moon God."

Of course.

Since it was modern times, besides the festival stage, the entire town square was filled with various stalls—goldfish scooping, ice cream, cotton candy, etc.

Wasn't this exactly what his Pokémon loved most?

"Don't cause trouble."

Johan instructed Gengar and the others not to mess around, not imposing too many restrictions.

He spread his aura across the entire festival stage.

Tapu Koko was interested in festivals; perhaps he could find it now.

But obviously Johan was overthinking. His aura didn't detect Tapu Koko's presence.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' tail curled, passing him an ice cream.

"Thanks." Johan smiled and petted it twice.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales' other tail also passed ice cream to the very restrained Lillie behind them.

The festival was full of Pokémon everywhere. For someone like Lillie who feared Pokémon to appear here already took all her courage.

Suddenly seeing Ninetales offering ice cream and its extended tail, Lillie froze in place again.

Johan patted Ninetales and took the ice cream before personally handing it to Lillie.

Ninetales looked at Lillie with some confusion, seeming to realize she was afraid of it, so it obediently walked away.

Only after Ninetales had moved a good distance away did Lillie slowly relax, accepting Johan's ice cream and saying quietly:

"Th-thank you."

"Don't mention it." Johan smiled gently.

Lillie silently licked her ice cream, suddenly saying: "Teacher Johan, am I useless?"

"How so?" Johan also bit his ice cream, thinking... this taste was quite different from what Team Rocket trio made.

"I-I'm afraid of Pokémon." Lillie's head drooped.

Actually, Johan had a very straightforward and simple way to help "cure" Lillie's condition.

That was through hypnosis, forcibly making Lillie forget that traumatic experience.

But this method had implications of controlling others, violating Johan's principles.

Human growth came from overcoming difficulties, not erasing them. Otherwise, even if they got through this time, there would definitely be next times. Johan couldn't always stay by Lillie's side.

"Many people like Pokémon, and many people don't. Since you're afraid of Pokémon, just avoid contact." Johan said gently.

Hearing this, Lillie was stunned, staring blankly at Johan.

"What?" Johan smiled.

Lillie shook her head.

"Nothing, it's just... Teacher Johan, you're the first person to tell me this. Others... all think I can try to make contact and overcome my fear..."

"What do you think?" Johan asked.

"I..."

Before Lillie could say much, Johan walked while giving the "answer":

"I imagine you actually like Pokémon quite a bit. Otherwise you wouldn't become Professor Kukui's assistant or get perfect scores in basic Pokémon knowledge."

Lillie fell silent.

Honestly, she was confused too.

As Johan said, if she didn't like Pokémon, she could completely avoid anything related to Pokémon, let alone become Professor Kukui's assistant and work hard studying Pokémon knowledge.

But... she just couldn't overcome that instinctive fear when Pokémon approached.

Lillie's condition was actually post-traumatic stress response.

If she had received family support and comfort immediately after the incident, it might not have become so severe.

But Faba's concealment and her mother Lusamine's indifference gradually amplified this trauma until it became uncontrollable.

Johan spoke again.

"Actually, I can help you. But first you need to clarify whether you like Pokémon but instinctively fear them, or if you dislike Pokémon from inside out."

Lillie stopped walking.

Standing in place, her face full of struggle.

Her gaze swept across the festival venue, seeing the cute Togedemaru, gentle Ninetales, happily galloping Tauros, serious-faced Gumshoos...

Suddenly raising her head, face flushed, looking directly into Johan's eyes, she said very seriously:

"Teacher Johan, I like Pokémon! Very much!"

She had almost no hesitation before reaching a very accurate and firm answer.

She wanted to ride Pokémon and gallop, she wanted to hug cute Pokémon intimately, she wanted to share her joys and sorrows with Pokémon...

She envied others, truly envied them.

So she knew what she wanted.

Johan smiled.

"Let's go, the festival battle is starting."

On the festival stage, trainers had already begun battling.

Every festival must have battles—this wasn't just in the Alola region but throughout the entire Pokémon world.

Coming to the festival stage side.

Two young trainers were battling on stage.

"Not bad." After watching for a few seconds, Johan nodded approvingly.

"That's Hau, Master Hala's grandson." Professor Kukui smiled as he introduced.

Hau?

Johan understood.

This was the person who replaced Professor Kukui as the second Champion of the Alola League in the Ultra Sun/Moon games.

Although it was the Alola region, being able to serve as Champion undoubtedly marked him as extremely talented.

Soon, Hau had won the battle.

Professor Kukui looked at Johan: "Teacher Johan, are you ready?"

Johan looked up, meeting Island Kahuna Hala's gaze across from him, smiling slightly:

"Of course."

Professor Kukui grinned and strode onto the stage.

"Everyone!"

His voice attracted everyone's attention.

"Next, let's welcome our Melemele Island's Island Kahuna, Kahuna Hala!"

Roar!!

The audience immediately erupted in enthusiastic cheers.

Island Kahuna was an island's representative, a powerful existence protecting the entire island. Their popularity was obvious.

"Kahuna Hala is actually taking the stage at this festival?"

"Worth it! This time was worth attending—we get to see Kahuna Hala in action! Just don't know who can be Kahuna Hala's opponent..."

"Could it be Ilima? I heard he recently returned to Alola."

"Ilima? That's not impossible, just don't know how long Ilima can last against Kahuna Hala..."

Ilima was also a famous genius on Melemele Island. As the first graduate of the Pokémon School, after traveling and challenging abroad, he had gained considerable fame and strength.

Professor Kukui soon announced the "answer."

"Next, let's welcome, from the Hoenn region... Teacher Johan!"

The townspeople were stunned, then began discussing quietly, while Johan's five students immediately cheered.

"Teacher Johan?!" Hau opened his mouth wide, elbowing the boy with a book beside him.

"Ilima, is that the Teacher Johan you mentioned? The one who crushed legendary Pokémon?"

Ilima, who had recently returned to Melemele Island, nodded seriously.

"That's right!"

He had once fought Johan before.

He just didn't know how big the gap between him and Teacher Johan had become after all this time.

Hau clicked his tongue: "We're in trouble. Grandpa's going to suffer."

Ilima looked at his good friend.

Was that any way to talk about your grandfather?

Hala and Ilima somewhat knew Johan, but most townspeople knew little about this "Teacher Johan."

Information in the Alola region was still too delayed.

Johan and Kahuna Hala stood on opposite sides of the arena, smiling and nodding respectfully at each other.

"Hahaha, Teacher Johan, I never expected to battle you, a fighting master. This old man is full of energy!" Hala laughed heartily, his eyes squinting into slits.

"Kahuna Hala, it's also my honor to battle an Island Kahuna." Johan bowed slightly, showing respect for the older generation trainer.

"I heard you want to meet Tapu Koko?"

"Yes."

Hala's smile grew broader: "That guy is indeed easily attracted by intense battles."

Johan chuckled: "We might not even need a battle."

"Hm?" Hala was stunned.

In Johan's spreading aura, he had already faintly sensed a mysterious power moving at extreme speed that even aura couldn't easily capture.

Who else could it be but Tapu Koko?

"In that case, let's celebrate the 'full moon'!"

Hala shouted loudly while throwing his Poké Ball.

"Show your power, Crabominable!"

Johan's Luxury Ball was thrown at the same time.

"Your turn, Urshifu!"

Two red lights immediately flashed.

Appearing before Hala was a Pokémon covered in white fur that looked like a crab, waving giant pincers—Crabominable!

This was Crabrawler's evolution. It was said that Crabrawler aimed to reach the summit but mistakenly climbed a snowy mountain. To fight the mountain's cold, it grew thick white fur.

Bang bang—

Two strong, powerful giant pincers collided, producing dull sounds.

"Garruu zzZ"

Urshifu closed its eyes, its snot bubble growing and shrinking, but its movements weren't slow at all. It immediately took a fighting stance upon entering.

Only those proficient in martial arts could see that although Urshifu appeared to be sleeping, its current posture had almost no openings!

When Urshifu appeared, the townspeople fell silent again.

What Pokémon was this?

How did it seem to still be sleeping?

Fortunately Professor Kukui was present to give simple introductions about Urshifu to the townspeople.

"A legendary Pokémon?!"

The entire venue was in uproar.

Actually a legendary Pokémon from the distant Galar region.

This made many townspeople who had no impression of Teacher Johan unconsciously give him a "powerful" label, making them more excited about this festival battle.

Since they wanted to use battles and curiosity to attract Tapu Koko, the rarer the Pokémon, the better the effect.

Moreover, Hala was a famous fighting master specializing in Fighting-type Pokémon. No Pokémon was more suitable than Bear Sensei.

"Crabominable, be careful—the opponent is strong!" Old man Hala grinned, his fighting spirit high while reminding his Pokémon.

Bang bang!!

Crabominable waved its fists, showing its determination to climb Mount Lanakila.

The battle officially began in their mutual understanding!

"Crabominable, Close Combat!" Hala shouted loudly, his palms like overwhelming mountains, launching the first attack with full momentum.

Crabominable's fists immediately flashed with bright white light, charging straight at Urshifu with unstoppable force, its fists seeming to split mountains and crack stones!

"Urshifu, Detect!" Johan also commanded calmly.

"Garruu zzZ"

Facing the charging Crabominable, Urshifu didn't retreat at all. Although it seemed to be sleeping, its aura had already spread, making Crabominable's attacks completely visible under its aura.

Bang!

Deflecting upward, knee blocking, side-stepping, advancing and pressuring...

A series of dazzling postures and reactions actually managed to block and dodge all of Crabominable's storm-like Close Combat.

The townspeople's eyes couldn't keep up, only hearing "bang bang" sounds without knowing if anything hit.

"Exquisite fighting technique!" Hala couldn't help praising, but his commands didn't stop.

"Stomp!"

With Close Combat completely blocked by Urshifu, Stomp's power would be doubled!

It seemed like being at a disadvantage with Close Combat blocked, but the follow-up Stomp put Urshifu in further passivity.

No escape possible.

Then no need to escape!

"Close Combat!" Johan said in a deep voice.

Counter-attack!!

"Haha! Well done!" Hala was delighted. It had been long since he encountered an opponent who made his blood boil like this.

Boom!!!

In an instant.

The festival stage exploded, accompanied by violent ground trembling and countless scattered rocks.

This time it really wasn't us who broke the venue... Johan thought fleetingly. Urshifu took Stomp directly while its fist also landed on Crabominable.

Bang!!

Just one punch made Crabominable feel incredibly intense pain and strong impact.

Yet this was only the first punch of Close Combat!

This full Close Combat combo—Crabominable definitely couldn't withstand it!

Both Johan and Hala understood this clearly.

But since he chose to trade blows, he was naturally prepared.

"Crabominable, show our full power!"

Hala's laughter became more hearty. He spread his stance, his squinting eyes suddenly opened, extending his palms, gripping, closing, punching—all in one fluid motion.

The Z-Ring on his wrist immediately burst with golden light, instantly enveloping him.

Whoosh!!

The entire venue immediately erupted in intense cheers.

It was the Island Kahuna's Z-move!

They didn't know how long it had been since they witnessed an Island Kahuna fighting at full strength.

The golden aura enveloping Hala rushed into Crabominable's body, immediately bringing out more of Crabominable's power.

Fierce light surged around its fists!

Hala roared: "All-Out Pummeling!!"

In an instant.

Urshifu's descending fist was blocked by the surging aura, and Crabominable's pincers deflected its punch.

Having a Z-Ring versus not having one, dance moves versus no dance moves—Z-moves felt quite different when performed...

Johan's eyes sharpened as he called: "Urshifu!"

Pop—!

The snot bubble burst, and Urshifu's closed eyes suddenly opened, an equally unstoppable momentum surging wildly.

"Garruu!!"

The fist deflected by the pincers immediately flowed like continuous water—cutting water with a blade only makes it flow more!

But besides the endless flow of water, it added the momentum of unstoppable force.

"A combination of Rapid Strike Style and Single Strike Style secrets!" Hala's eyes flashed brightly. Only as a martial artist could he understand the difficulty of combining these two styles.

No, besides Hala, there was another person who could see clearly—Professor Kukui.

"Secret Art: Rapid Strike Single Strike Style?"

He clicked his tongue in amazement while sighing: "Teacher Johan could almost start his own school, right?"

"Crabominable, show your spirit!" Hala clenched his fists.

"Defeat it, Urshifu!" Johan's emotions were also stirred.

Boom!!

Fists met, and the ground immediately exploded under both Pokémon's feet. Auras surged wildly, seemingly forming two opposing currents.

Actually evenly matched?!

However.

This move was Crabominable's all, but for Urshifu, this punch was just the beginning.

The next second.

Bullet-like fists fell like a storm, and Urshifu's aura continuously surged.

Bang!!!

The final punch struck.

Crabominable flew backward, crashing heavily into the ground and losing consciousness!

This scene was too shocking—everyone opened their mouths, unable to make a sound.

"Ha-Kahuna Hala lost?"

"Those terrifying fists..."

Hala, after a brief moment of surprise, laughed heartily again:

"Hahaha—amazing, truly amazing! The combination of Rapid Strike and Single Strike styles is astounding. This old man lost!"

He very frankly accepted defeat.

"Garruu!!" Urshifu spread its arms wide, roaring and shocking the entire venue.

Such a battle should be able to—

Hm?

Johan's expression changed slightly.

Under his aura, he sensed an abnormal spatial fluctuation. Following the disturbance, he immediately looked in that direction.

He saw a twisted black hole slowly appearing.

Johan: "..."

He didn't wait for Tapu Koko but got an Ultra Wormhole instead?

What happened to disasters always being one step behind me?

It came right to my face?

# 696: Question: How Much Budget Does It Take to Raise a Mosquito? (Two-in-One Chapter)

"What is that?"

Seeing the black hole that suddenly appeared in the sky above Iki Town, the townspeople couldn't help but stare in confusion after the exhilarating battle.

What was that?

A black hole?

For most residents of the Alola region, they knew nothing about Ultra Wormholes or Ultra Beasts.

But obviously Johan, Professor Kukui, and Hala were among the rare few who knew.

"How is it so frequent now?" Professor Kukui frowned.

His good friend Dr. Burnet, the famous Dream Research professor, was currently researching Ultra Wormholes as her main topic.

An Ultra Wormhole had just appeared at Hau'oli City's tourist beach yesterday. Theoretically, they shouldn't be this frequent...

"Hau, take everyone and evacuate first." Hala waved his large hand, speaking in a deep voice.

As Island Kahuna, protecting Melemele Island's residents was his duty.

"Ah? Oh..." Hau was stunned at first but still chose to follow Hala's instructions, working with Ilima to direct the festival attendees to evacuate.

"Lillie? Lillie, we should retreat! Lillie?" Kiawe and the others were preparing to retreat when they discovered Lillie standing frozen in place with a terrified expression.

Bzzt—

Suddenly.

A faint arc of light flashed beneath the bright moon.

Just as Johan was about to speak, his aura captured this strange electrical fluctuation.

All three looked up at the night sky simultaneously. A black and yellow striped Pokémon with armored hands, sporting something like a mohawk hairstyle and looking somewhat like a rooster, hovered beneath the moon, illuminated by brilliant starlight.

"Island Guardian?!" Hala exclaimed in surprise.

Professor Kukui also showed surprise.

Johan squinted slightly.

Finally, he had seen it—Melemele Island's Island Guardian, Tapu Koko!

Tapu Koko glanced at the three of them, then directed its gaze toward the black hole in the sky.

There wasn't much time for Johan to be stunned. The originally pitch-black hole suddenly burst with brilliant light, as if something was about to emerge from within.

The next moment.

An extremely thick red arm seemed to shatter glass as it suddenly thrust out from the Ultra Wormhole with a "bang."

"Here it comes!" Professor Kukui said in a low voice.

Immediately after, a humanoid giant red mosquito-like creature squeezed out of the Ultra Wormhole. It had exaggerated, terrifying muscle bulk filled with what seemed like crimson liquid, a horrifying thin spike extending from its mouth, and translucent short wings that vibrated as it crashed heavily into the town.

Bang—

Seeing the creature that emerged, Johan couldn't help frowning.

He had thought it might be the relatively easier-to-handle Nihilego, but it turned out to be one of the stronger Ultra Beasts—Buzzwole!

Although Ultra Beasts were just ordinary creatures like Pokémon in their own world, with considerable numbers...

It was certain that Ultra Beasts capable of passing through Ultra Wormholes and resisting spatial compression to reach the Pokémon world were absolutely powerful existences even in their original world.

Just from their anime performances, Ultra Beasts like Guzzlord, Buzzwole, Pheromosa, and Kartana probably all had strength comparable to Champion-level main Pokémon.

"Buzz! (‵‵)"

Buzzwole slowly rose from the rubble, immediately striking a pose showcasing its muscles, as if showing off or announcing its arrival.

Just from its current pose, plus its appearance, if you didn't know better, you'd think it was a muscle-doubled version of a masked wrestler.

While everyone was wary of this suddenly appeared unknown creature, Buzzwole's gaze also surveyed the entire area.

When it saw Urshifu standing beside Johan, its eyes immediately burst with terrifying light, and its entire state became extremely excited.

"Buzz!!"

Without hesitation, its four seemingly small legs bent, then shot out like a cannonball.

"Watch out!" Hala immediately shouted.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu immediately embraced Johan and jumped back in evasion.

Boom!!

Buzzwole's fist crashed down heavily. The ground shook violently, countless rocks flew, and a crater formed instantly.

Full of power!

"Such tremendous strength." Even Hala, an Island Kahuna specializing in Fighting-type Pokémon, couldn't help exclaiming after seeing Buzzwole's speed and displayed power.

Buzzwole missed with one strike and tried to find Urshifu again. Scanning around, it spotted two Machamp responsible for festival construction nearby. Noticing their muscle definition, its eyes lit up again.

Its orange transparent wings flapped as it rushed toward the Machamp at extreme speed, then...

The two Machamp were lifted up like toys by Buzzwole.

"Buzz~(д.)"

Buzzwole immediately felt bored and dropped the frightened Machamp on the ground.

It was hard to imagine that Machamp, already known for their strength, could be toyed with so easily by Buzzwole even if they weren't good at battling.

"Professor Kukui, Teacher Johan!" Mallow's voice suddenly called out.

The group of five was desperately trying to take Lillie away, but she was trembling all over with a dark expression, completely unable to move herself.

"What's wrong with Lillie?" Professor Kukui, who was evacuating people, was the first to run over.

"Let me down, Urshifu." Johan landed, glanced at the lost and terrified Lillie, then said to Professor Kukui: "Professor Kukui, I'll leave them to you. Please take them away first."

"But..."

Professor Kukui looked at Buzzwole, who was flexing its muscles in dissatisfaction. Considering his current identity was just a Pokémon professor rather than the Royal Masked Man, and thinking of Teacher Johan's strength...

After looking deeply at Johan, "Alright!"

He immediately carried Lillie and led the other four away from town.

"Urshifu." Johan half-closed his eyes, calling softly.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu's expression was stern as it took a Single Strike stance, looking at Buzzwole, which was also directing its gaze back.

As fellow Fighting-type Pokémon, Urshifu could sense Buzzwole's exaggerated strength and the greater threat it posed compared to Hala's Crabominable.

But it showed no intention of retreating or fear. Airflow surged beneath its feet, and its fur naturally rose.

Hala, who was protecting the evacuating crowd, couldn't help looking back.

As Island Kahuna, he first had to ensure the safety of the island's residents.

"Buzz! (˙o˙)"

Seeing Urshifu's stance, Buzzwole became excited, striking one muscle-showing pose after another, as if showing off.

Buzzwole, the Swollen Pokémon, Bug and Fighting-type, had tremendous strength and could absorb energy to combine with its bodily fluids, making its muscles more swollen while its strength soared.

Though dangerous, it wasn't a "disaster" like Guzzlord, provided its need to find strong Pokémon for competition was satisfied.

"Rotom, record well."

"Understood, Rotom!"

Rotom Pokédex had already emerged and activated its recording and analysis functions, collecting information about this never-before-seen creature for the database.

This was what Professor Oak had requested.

"Bulk Up!" Johan glanced at Tapu Koko hovering above and calmly commanded.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu gave a low shout, its muscle definition becoming more pronounced as its aura climbed.

"Buzz!"

Sensing the greater threat from Urshifu's rising momentum, Buzzwole immediately exerted force with its four legs, charging straight at Urshifu.

Dark red Fighting-type energy gathered around Buzzwole's clenched fist.

"Block it!"

Bang!!

Urshifu crossed its arms, taking Buzzwole's punch.

As the fist landed, Buzzwole's momentum and fighting spirit surged another level.

Power-Up Punch!

However, after blocking this move, Urshifu gained the benefits from Bulk Up.

"Urshifu, Wicked Blow!" Johan swept his hand.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu's eyes flashed with cold light. Taking advantage of Buzzwole being in front of it, it pulled back its fist like a drawn bow, then struck with devastating force.

Dark Evil-type energy intertwined with Fighting-type power, smashing toward Buzzwole's face.

But the next second.

Bang!!

Buzzwole actually mimicked Urshifu, crossing its arms in front to block Urshifu's devastating punch.

Terrifying force transmitted through both arms to their entire bodies, and the ground beneath both combatants immediately cracked.

"Buzz!" Sensing Urshifu's power, Buzzwole could no longer suppress its excitement, showing a happy, delighted smile.

Then its expression suddenly changed.

Flipping its hands, it actually grabbed Urshifu's arms firmly.

Terrifying power erupted from Buzzwole as powerful Fighting-type energy surged.

Grabbing Urshifu's arms, it suddenly turned with its back to Urshifu, its powerful muscles tensing as it exerted force.

Seismic Toss!

Urshifu's feet left the ground as its entire body flew into the air, tracing a beautiful arc.

Johan shouted: "Counter!"

Crash—!!

Urshifu was slammed hard into the ground, its back making solid contact. Intense pain followed as the already collapsed ground cracked further with a wailing sound.

But before Buzzwole could celebrate, just as it prepared to release Urshifu's arms, it felt itself being counter-restrained by steel-like arms.

"Buzz?"

Buzzwole was startled.

But the next moment, its body also rose under tremendous force, similarly tracing an arc in the air before crashing heavily to the ground.

Boom!!

The entire town's ground shook violently.

Iki Town residents still evacuating were shocked by this scene.

In the forest.

Rumble, rumble rumble—

"Wow, is this Melemele Island's festival? Such commotion—there must be so many customers!" Jessie pushed through branches, feeling the ground tremor and imagining crowds of people.

Those weren't people!

Those were clearly moving Pokédollars, moving funds!

"Hurry up, hurry up, meow!" Meowth rolled up his sleeves. "If we're late, all the customers will be taken, meow!"

"Sona~nsu~! ∠(°ゝ°)"

"Wait, wait! Is this really commotion caused by crowds?" James, being relatively rational, raised his doubts.

However, in a three-against-one situation, he had no chance to voice his concerns. Jessie, Meowth, and Wobbuffet had already charged ahead. James had no choice but to follow.

But...

When they finally pushed through the forest leaves, they saw...

Buzzwole giving Urshifu a powerful overhead throw, followed immediately by Urshifu's Counter giving Buzzwole an even more powerful overhead throw.

The trio's faces immediately turned pale.

Gulp gulp they swallowed.

"I-I think... maybe we should come back next time, next time to earn funds?" James stammered.

Was this the "primitive tribe" festival of the Alola region?

Too extreme!

"A-agreed, meow!"

But...

Just as the trio turned around, they bumped into something fluffy and dark.

Not painful, but rather bouncy.

"What the hell?!" Jessie immediately shouted irritably.

Then the trio slowly raised their heads.

They saw a... pink, fluffy, doll-like bear head.

It was clearly the Bewear that Johan had been "thinking about"!

Bewear looked at the commotion in town, especially the colliding Urshifu and Buzzwole, then looked at the trio before it, nodding expressionlessly.

"Bewear~"

Then it grabbed Jessie and Wobbuffet with one arm, James and Meowth with the other.

"Wh-what's happening?" James looked confused.

"It-it seems to be saying there's danger, meow!" Meowth translated.

"Sona~nsu~!"

The next moment, Bewear ignored the trio's resistance and turned... whoosh—

Its entire body seemed to fly away, disappearing from Iki Town's edge instantly.

The trio, who had been resisting and cursing a second ago, suddenly felt like their bodies were running ahead while their souls chased behind, completely losing the ability to resist.

"Help us!" ×3

"Sona~~~nsu~!!"

Hmm?

Johan inconspicuously glanced toward the forest, frowning slightly.

He seemed to have heard very familiar voices just now?

But since Urshifu and Buzzwole had both stood up, he couldn't spare attention for other matters and refocused.

"Garruu!!"

Urshifu wiped its cheek, staring intently at Buzzwole.

"Buzz!!"

Buzzwole seemed to feel no pain, bouncing up from the ground after the fall, looking at Urshifu with increasingly passionate eyes.

The bear and mosquito suddenly had a feeling of mutual recognition.

Eyes meeting.

Urshifu and Buzzwole almost simultaneously flashed forward, colliding again in an instant.

Fist against fist, knee against knee, power against power.

Close Combat VS Close Combat!

Throughout, Tapu Koko hovered in the air without moving.

As Island Guardian, Tapu Koko was actually quite like a curious child, full of curiosity about people and other Pokémon.

However, after seeing the Ultra Wormhole, it had immediately appeared.

But when it discovered that Buzzwole actually had no great destructive desires and was purely seeking strong opponents, and after finding Urshifu, it became interested in watching.

It loved watching decisive battles and felt that since these two were fighting so enthusiastically, it wouldn't be appropriate to interfere.

But it was also concerned that Buzzwole might later cause destruction while continuing to seek strong opponents, so it hadn't left.

Boom!!!

In town center, Urshifu and Buzzwole stood back-to-back.

Their arms hooked together like claws, solidly locked in mutual force, neither able to overcome the other.

"Garruu!"

"Buzz!"

Both were breathing heavily but sensed no hostility from each other.

Bang!!

Another collision.

Both flew backward simultaneously, sliding along the ground before stopping.

"Garruu!"

"Buzz!"

"Urshifu!" Johan called out heavily, scanning the surroundings—already a complete mess.

If this continued, while Iki Town residents faced no danger, this town might be gone.

He couldn't possibly... have to pay for it himself, right?

With this thought.

Time to decide the outcome!

"Garruu~"

Urshifu understood Johan's meaning. Taking a deep breath, its Single Strike stance gradually changed, its fur floating as it combined Single Strike and Rapid Strike stances into a starting position.

Seeing this, Buzzwole got excited.

"Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!"

With each shout, its pose changed.

It thought Urshifu was "communicating" with it.

This was a unique communication method of Ultra Beasts like Buzzwole.

Grumble—

However.

Just as Johan and Urshifu prepared to attack, thunder-like rumbling came from Buzzwole's muscled stomach.

"Buzz..."

Buzzwole touched its stomach.

Hungry.

Its eyes scanned around, seemingly searching for food.

"Ga-Garruu?"

Urshifu paused, looking at Johan.

Still... fighting?

Johan was also stunned, watching Buzzwole's aimless behavior and gently rubbing his forehead.

Muscles for brains—that described Buzzwole perfectly.

However, Buzzwole's feeding method was quite different from other Pokémon.

As a "mosquito," Buzzwole fed through its thin, sharp proboscis, drawing not blood but energy from other Pokémon.

In the anime.

A Snorlax was almost completely drained by Buzzwole.

This might be one of the few destructive behaviors Buzzwole could cause.

Soon.

Buzzwole's gaze turned to the evacuating townspeople's accompanying Pokémon, especially several robust-looking Tauros.

Bzzt—

Tapu Koko, which had been inactive, now sensed destructive intent from Buzzwole and made some movement, electricity arcing around its body.

"Tapu Koko, wait!"

Johan quickly called out, then summoned: "Ninetales!"

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales exhaled white mist.

Thud!!

A solid ice wall immediately fell in front of Buzzwole.

Seeing this, Tapu Koko looked puzzled.

[That won't stop it.]

Its voice echoed in Johan's mind with a somewhat childish tone.

Although the ice wall looked solid, given Buzzwole's demonstrated strength, it could shatter it with any casual punch.

But soon.

Tapu Koko was dumbfounded.

After the ice wall fell in front of Buzzwole, blocking its view of the town's Pokémon, the smooth ice surface also reflected Buzzwole's appearance.

"Buzz!" (How can there be such a perfect body!)

Facing the mirror-like ice wall, Buzzwole began posing, showing off its physique.

Flexing while admiring itself.

It even became somewhat narcissistic and cheerful.

"Hehehe~Buzz! Buzz! Buzz~(‵‵)"

Forgetting both its hunger and opponent Urshifu, it kept admiring itself against the ice wall, exactly like... some guys looking in mirrors after showering.

Tapu Koko: ???

Urshifu: ???

"The best way to stop Buzzwole is actually to give it a mirror." Johan looked at the finally-moving Tapu Koko and smiled.

Tapu Koko stiffly turned its head, watching Buzzwole still posing and styling against the ice wall with "Buzz! Buzz!" sounds, more question marks appearing above its head.

[Then why didn't you use this method from the start?]

"Cough." Johan turned away somewhat embarrassedly. "I said I just remembered—do you believe it?"

Tapu Koko: ...

Actually, it was mainly to fulfill his promise to Professor Oak to help collect Ultra Beast information and data.

Of course, if Buzzwole didn't get a good fight first, it would at most pose against the ice wall briefly before being distracted by Urshifu again.

But if it fought Urshifu first, it could be controlled by the ice wall for a long time.

"Tapu Koko." Seeing that communication was possible, Johan stated his main purpose for coming to the Alola region.

"I'm here to retrieve the 'Fairy Plate.'"

Hearing this, Tapu Koko's eyes half-closed.

[What qualifies you?] Tapu Koko asked bluntly.

Johan took out a pile of items from his inner pocket: Rainbow Wing, Silver Wing, DNA Splicers, inheritance scrolls, Arceus Ring...

Tapu Koko: ...

Looking at the pile of items in Johan's hands, it was momentarily speechless again, thinking this human's backing was really solid!

"Oh, found it."

Johan held up the Arceus Ring.

"I represent Arceus to retrieve the 'Fairy Plate.'"

Tapu Koko stared at the Arceus Ring for a while, confirming it was indeed Arceus's token, that the person before it... was Arceus's messenger.

The "Fairy Plate" originally belonged to Arceus anyway, only falling into Xerneas's hands before being borrowed by them.

Tapu Koko fell silent for a while.

After staring at Johan for some time, it spoke again.

[The plate isn't in my possession.]

Johan wasn't surprised.

After all, there were four Island Guardians in the Alola region.

"Whose hands is it in? Could you help introduce me?" Johan asked.

Tapu Koko glanced at Johan sideways, about to say "why should I," but caught sight of those items in Johan's hands—each representing a "background"—and rarely swallowed its words.

[Deal with this guy first.]

Tapu Koko said somewhat irritably.

[By the way, let me warn you—this Ultra Wormhole is very unstable. Only because this guy's body is tough enough did it manage to squeeze through, but sending it back through this passage probably won't work.]

Ultra Wormholes in the Alola region were currently very unstable, being in their initial state.

Later, when human research into Ultra Wormholes became more advanced, with Cosmog's help, they could open relatively stable passages themselves.

But now.

The reason humans and Alola's Island Guardians found Ultra Beasts troublesome wasn't just that they were hard to deal with, but also difficult to send back.

Hearing this, Johan looked up at the Ultra Wormhole in the sky.

Indeed, as Tapu Koko said, the Ultra Wormhole was very unstable, fluctuating in size and clearly ready to disappear at any moment.

This made Johan's expression grow serious.

That was troublesome.

He couldn't keep Buzzwole posing against the ice wall forever, right?

Though narcissism had no upper limit, its hunger did have limits.

When Buzzwole got truly unbearably hungry, it would eventually break free from the ice wall's "hard control."

Grumble—

Sure enough, Buzzwole's stomach rumbled again, deeper than before. Buzzwole covered its stomach again, looking about to starve.

Johan sighed softly and walked over.

"Buzzwole!"

He attracted Buzzwole's attention.

"Buzz?"

Buzzwole instinctively turned its head, scanning around and scratching its head.

Who's calling me?

Johan's forehead showed black lines as he said irritably: "Here!"

Buzzwole looked down and finally saw Johan nearby.

But seeing Johan's "thin" appearance, it showed disdain.

Weakling.

Johan: "..."

"Buzz~"

Buzzwole extended one hand toward Johan, making a flicking gesture as if to flick away a fly.

Johan irritably swatted Buzzwole's hand away.

"Stop fooling around. I'll get you some food."

"Buzz?"

Buzzwole seemed not to understand Johan's aura-transmitted meaning, staring blankly at its swatted hand, eyes gradually brightening.

This weakling—no, this human seemed not as weak as imagined?

"Buzz!"

Buzzwole called out again, swinging its fist at Johan.

This action naturally didn't escape Johan's aura perception.

However, he sensed no hostility or malice from Buzzwole, rather a mood of interest.

So Johan... raised his hand and solidly blocked Buzzwole's punch.

Whoosh—

The ground beneath his feet trembled slightly, wind stirred behind him along with some dust.

Johan and Buzzwole simultaneously thought: As expected.

Johan: As expected, Buzzwole was relatively friendly as long as he showed no hostility.

Buzzwole: As expected, this human wasn't weak. Though I only used less than thirty percent strength, he blocked it effortlessly...

This scene, witnessed by Hala and Kukui who were calming townspeople, appeared completely different.

Buzzwole's punch—that earth-shaking punch from before—was easily blocked by Teacher Johan with just a raised hand?

Both being martial arts experts, they clearly understood what kind of power that represented.

They couldn't help exchanging glances, almost speaking in unison:

"Monster..."

Johan didn't notice their reaction, instead taking out some energy cubes.

"Try these, see if they suit your taste. If not, I'll get you something else."

"Buzz!"

Buzzwole seemed to acknowledge Johan's "strength," tentatively accepting the energy cubes and placing them near its proboscis.

Slurp—

Then you could see a small lump being absorbed into Buzzwole's seemingly hard proboscis.

"Buzz!"

Immediately after eating, Buzzwole jumped up from the ground, excitedly posing and styling again.

"Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!"

After posing for a while and finding Johan wasn't responding at all, it reluctantly stopped.

This time it took the box of energy cubes and... slurp slurp went to town with its proboscis.

In a few blinks, an entire box of energy cubes was completely consumed.

But this amount seemed insufficient for Buzzwole.

After all, this was a being that could drain the famous big eater Snorlax in one go.

"Buzz..."

It looked hopefully at Johan.

Seeing this, Johan smiled.

However, he didn't immediately take out more energy cubes, instead using a negotiating tone:

"Buzzwole, as you can see, the Ultra Wormhole is very unstable and about to close."

"Buzz?!"

Buzzwole suddenly turned its head, discovering... its way home was gone!

Home was gone?!

Just as it was about to explode, Johan continued: "Don't get excited. I can send you back, but it'll take some time."

"Buzz?"

"During this period, you'll have to listen to me. Of course, as payment, I'll provide food and even 'opponents.'"

He patted Urshifu beside him.

"Garruu! (´▽`)"

Buzzwole was delighted.

"Buzz! (´▽`)"

Perfect match! Perfect match!

"Of course, not just Urshifu."

Johan's Poké Balls flashed at his waist.

"Bangi! (_)"

"Draaa! (´▽`)"

"Regi~(ò_óˇ)"

"Regi~(ò_óˇ)"

Tyranitar, Dragonite, Regieleki, and Regidrago all flexed their muscles.

"Buzz!!"

This made Buzzwole ecstatic.

Great, all great—all strong opponents!

"What do you think?" Johan rested his hands on Tyranitar and Dragonite, smiling.

"Buzz! Buzz!"

Buzzwole stood obediently in place, nodding repeatedly.

Clearly, this was another "Tyranitar-type" simpleton.

What a good target—no, what a good training and sparring partner.

The only problem might be Buzzwole's appetite.

But no matter.

Wasn't Anabel in the Alola region as head of some "UB Task Force"?

This work could be reimbursed by the International Police.

He'd call Anabel later and ask—how much budget does it take to raise a mosquito?

"Then now, attention! Stand properly!" Johan took out another box of energy cubes and told Buzzwole.

"Buzz! (‵‵)"

Buzzwole flexed its arms, standing motionless in place.

Johan looked at the now somewhat stunned Tapu Koko and smiled:

"Now, is this acceptable?"

# 697: Tonight's Expenses Are All on 'Mr. Mosquito'! (Two-in-One Chapter)

The night was quiet and still.

Tapu Koko looked at Johan, remaining silent for a very long time.

Something felt so wrong about this...

Bzzt—

Suddenly, a golden arc of light leaped from Tapu Koko's body, appearing particularly jarring in the quiet night.

[I can agree to help you, but the 'Fairy Plate' is of great importance. I can only represent myself.]

Back then, all four of them had borrowed the "Fairy Plate" together. It wasn't something Tapu Koko could decide the fate of alone.

Moreover...

The "Fairy Plate" was related to a very important matter.

Johan expressed understanding about this point.

[Then I also have a request.] Tapu Koko suddenly said.

"Hmm?"

Johan could see the arcs of electricity on Tapu Koko's body becoming more and more obvious, and at this moment he seemed to understand its meaning.

[Come battle me!]

After speaking, without giving Johan a chance to voice doubts or objections, a terrifying electric current immediately surged forth.

The shell-like armor on Tapu Koko's body opened, and its body quickly descended, maintaining a height level with Johan's line of sight, its gaze sharp and expression serious.

Intersecting lightning instantly formed an Electric Terrain beneath their feet!

What was going on?

Seeing this scene, Hala and Professor Kukui couldn't help but want to step forward, but were stopped by Johan's raised hand.

"What's the situation with Teacher Johan?" Professor Kukui couldn't help asking.

Johan pursed his lips, "Probably... Tapu Koko's battle desire has come up."

Battle desire?

Hala and Kukui exchanged strange looks, but soon understood.

That's right.

Teacher Johan had successively battled with Island Kahuna Hala and Buzzwole. Although Tapu Koko only appeared after the Ultra Wormhole emerged, it had probably been observing since the festival began.

As a guardian deity full of curiosity and quite passionate about battles, this choice was unexpected but reasonable.

"Teacher Johan, this might be Tapu Koko's test for you. Such situations are rare but not unprecedented." Hala, as Island Kahuna, explained.

"I understand." Johan nodded.

In the original story, Tapu Koko had also challenged Ash.

Even after the Manalo Conference ended, during Ash's exhibition match with the Royal Masked Man (Professor Kukui), Tapu Koko appeared and temporarily became Kukui's sixth Pokémon.

It was precisely because of this exhibition match that Ash's first championship barely regained some credibility.

Understanding was one thing, and Johan had even prepared for the possibility of something like this happening, but when Tapu Koko actually looked him in the eye and issued a battle invitation, Johan couldn't help but grumble internally—

Was Tapu Koko also a card player?

Seeing that Tapu Koko had taken its stance but didn't continue, he understood it was waiting for Johan to summon a Pokémon.

Although Tapu Koko belonged to the so-called "Tier 3 legendary" category, and its base stats might even be lower than the legendary birds or beasts, underestimating it because of this would be truly disrespectful to the title of "Guardian Deity."

On Melemele Island, as long as Tapu Koko was willing, it could borrow the power of the entire island to unleash even stronger abilities.

This was identical to how some so-called "Tier 1 legendaries" could borrow and use "authority" or natural forces, except Tapu Koko was limited to the Alola region, limited to Melemele Island.

Therefore, Johan was quite serious about facing Tapu Koko.

But he had already prepared, so the Pokémon to send out didn't require much hesitation.

"Ninetales!"

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales leaped gracefully, landing in the Electric Terrain filled with electric current, its azure eyes looking at Tapu Koko as its nine tails spread open.

"Snow?"

Having retreated a good distance and realizing there might no longer be danger, and that this Teacher Johan who had defeated Island Kahuna Hala was going to battle the island guardian deity Tapu Koko, they carefully approached again.

The Alola region was famously hot, especially now in midsummer, yet snowflakes were falling?

But soon, the snowflakes became more and more numerous, larger and larger. In just a few breaths, a thin layer of snow had accumulated on the ground.

Snow!

Ninetales' displayed strength in normal conditions was roughly at the level of an ordinary Champion's main Pokémon and above, still a bit short of an ordinary Champion's ace Pokémon level. Perhaps this would be an opportunity!

Because after arriving on Melemele Island, Ninetales had told Johan that it sensed a special aura on this island.

Different from Xerneas's Fairy Aura, but... perhaps it could be helpful.

"Ninetales, Misty Terrain!"

"Oowoo!!"

A pink aura accompanied by Fairy-type energy spreading, quickly devouring and replacing Tapu Koko's Electric Terrain.

Electric Terrain could prevent Pokémon on the field from falling asleep, while Misty Terrain would prevent Pokémon on the field from falling into abnormal status conditions, thus avoiding the paralysis effects brought by Tapu Koko's Electric-type moves.

Additionally, without Electric Terrain, Electric-type moves lost their boost.

"Tapu?"

Tapu Koko looked deeply at Ninetales.

Its Electric Terrain had been so easily covered by Misty Terrain?

And this wind and snow made it feel strong coldness too.

"Tapu!"

Realizing that the Ninetales before it was definitely not easy to deal with, Tapu Koko became more serious and moved into action.

Bang!!

Tapu Koko's arm guards closed, completely enveloping its body while also presenting the "totem god" totem appearance for the first time.

Golden electric current instantly wrapped around it, then rushed toward Ninetales at extreme speed.

Wild Charge!

A fierce attack right from the start.

This showed how strong Tapu Koko's battle desire was.

"Block it!" Johan commanded calmly.

"Oowoo~"

Transparent screens appeared out of thin air, layer after layer manifesting, while an extremely solid ice wall materialized from nowhere, intercepting Tapu Koko's attack path.

Bang!!

Electric current collided head-on with the ice wall and Aurora Veil.

In an instant, ice shards and arc light scattered everywhere, and layers of Aurora Veil shattered accordingly.

Rumble—

Amid countless collision sounds, Tapu Koko's impact force grew weaker and weaker, until it stopped in front of an Aurora Veil, all electric current having dissipated.

"When did so many 'Aurora Veils' fall?"

Hala, witnessing this scene, looked somewhat bewildered.

Professor Kukui, who understood Johan's Pokémon somewhat and was more familiar with Ninetales' "cautious" personality, showed a slightly strange expression.

"There are probably even more 'Aurora Veils' that haven't been discovered."

Hala: "???"

Professor Kukui's words were soon confirmed.

Tapu Koko wasn't surprised or discouraged that one attack hadn't achieved the desired effect. If it could really defeat Johan's Pokémon so easily, it would be disappointed instead.

Therefore, it condensed electric current again, using its extreme speed to dart through the wind and snow. Ordinary people could only see a golden arc of light constantly jumping around the field.

However.

No matter how fast Tapu Koko was, no matter how tricky its angles, its attacks could always be blocked by Aurora Veils.

Simple Aurora Veils would be one thing, but there were especially many of them!

Having many would be fine too, but after breaking through the Aurora Veils, extremely solid ice walls would still appear.

Damn it, this was a battle, not playing a fortress-breaking game!

Actually, if one had sufficient understanding of Johan's Ninetales, while breaking through Ninetales' defense would be difficult, there were still some methods.

But Tapu Koko knew very little about Johan and his Ninetales.

Sometimes, the information gap could compensate for strength differences to a certain extent.

Bang!!

Tapu Koko's attack hit another wall.

This was hitting a wall in the truest sense.

"Tapu!"

At this point, Tapu Koko was somewhat angry.

Clearly a nine-tailed fox, but fighting like a turtle?

This wasn't the battle it wanted at all.

Very frustrating!

Extremely frustrating!

The key point was that it couldn't stop, because once it stopped, Ninetales would certainly take advantage of the pause to create even more Aurora Veils.

"Tapu!!"

Tapu Koko's frustration and anger accumulated, shrieking out, the lightning on its body seemingly completely dispersing, but the next moment, a pink-like electric current emerged from its body.

Immediately after.

Tapu Koko landed on the ground, heavily striking the earth.

In an instant.

A shockwave accompanied by pink electric current, centered on where Tapu Koko struck the ground, frantically spread outward in all directions.

Rumble!!

The ground shook, earthen barriers rose thunderously, as if the earth itself was venting Tapu Koko's fury.

Nature's Madness!

This was the signature move exclusive to the island guardian deities, also representing their control and use of island power.

Wherever the island's fury passed, whether it was the ice walls Ninetales had erected or the Aurora Veils it had condensed, all shattered under this impact.

After all, this was divine wrath, already surpassing the power that ordinary Pokémon could possess.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales had blocked Tapu Koko several times, making it return empty-handed each time, but this didn't mean Tapu Koko hadn't put pressure on Ninetales.

It's just that this pressure was still within Ninetales' tolerance range.

But this time.

As ice walls and Aurora Veils shattered in succession, the Nature's Madness approaching with crushing force made Ninetales feel much greater pressure, even threat!

And Ninetales had always been primarily cautious and steady, rarely placing itself in a "high-pressure environment" it didn't particularly like.

However, in battles, anything could happen.

"Did you see clearly?" Johan's voice echoed in Ninetales' heart.

"Oowoo!"

Ninetales lowered its eyes, nodding seriously.

Johan smiled, but quickly put away his smile, waving his hand and saying in a deep voice: "Fairy Aura, Geomancy!"

Tapu Koko's Nature's Madness was also a Fairy-type move, also using the aura covering Melemele Island, identical to the Fairy Aura of the Fairy-type legendary Xerneas.

Ninetales lifted its paw, mimicking Tapu Koko's action, striking the ground three times!

Boom!!

Instantly, centered on Ninetales, a surge of vigorous life energy accompanied by Fairy Aura spread outward.

Thump! Thump thump—

The aura veins hidden within the earth seemed to be captured by Ninetales, and an aura with a different appearance from Tapu Koko's Nature's Madness but essentially somewhat similar surged forth.

Hm?

Seeing this scene and feeling the changes in Melemele Island's aura, Tapu Koko froze.

What was this?

Copycat?

"That's..." Professor Kukui in the distance also paused.

Hala was quite familiar with this feeling. After brief bewilderment, he continued: "Totem Aura?"

From Ninetales' body, at that moment, as an Island Kahuna, he sensed the Totem Aura that only Totem Pokémon possessed.

Boom!!

Nature's Madness swept over, the shockwave brutally rushing past Ninetales, finally completely engulfing it.

However.

When the fierce impact dispersed, although Ninetales in the ruins was obviously in much worse condition and looked somewhat disheveled, its eyes had become even brighter.

"Oowoo~~"

Ninetales raised its head, howling out, its tails swaying like leaves, wisps of aura moving with the tail movements, and Ninetales' momentum began surging wildly.

Geomancy granted Ninetales massive boosts to Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed.

More importantly.

Ninetales' overall strength had obviously improved to some extent, as if crossing some important threshold.

At this moment, Hala's expression became somewhat dazed.

He felt...

At this moment before him, there seemed to be not one guardian deity, but two?

The difference was just that one controlled more, and one controlled... less.

What was going on?

[You—] Tapu Koko suddenly stopped its actions, staring at Johan and Ninetales with an indescribable expression.

[This isn't reasonable!]

Johan and Ninetales exchanged glances, and he said directly with a smile:

"Xerneas taught it. Don't worry about it."

Tapu Koko: "..."

"Still fighting?" Johan asked.

Tapu Koko opened its mouth, looked at Ninetales, then at Gengar who was carefully poking its big head out from behind Johan, its momentum immediately weakening as it said irritably:

[Not fighting! What's there to fight!]

It couldn't help grumbling internally... What was Xerneas doing, why did it teach everything?

Possibly feeling a bit unconvinced, Tapu Koko said again:

[Having ability is nothing, you need capability, background, influence...]

But halfway through speaking, it stopped with a somewhat complex expression.

Capability?

Weren't Ninetales and Urshifu enough to demonstrate capability?

Background?

Thinking of the pile of "credentials" Johan had just pulled out.

Influence?

Looking around at his Pokémon...

Nothing more to say.

[Fine, here you go.] Tapu Koko said irritably.

Johan's expression was strange, seeming to sense Tapu Koko's "indignation."

Speaking, under an energy wrapping, a Z-Crystal and a Z-Ring floated toward Johan.

Z-Ring?

Speaking of which.

Johan only now realized that when he had used Z-moves before, he had no Z-Ring, and hadn't even done the awkward dance. It was just like using a Key Stone—grabbing the Z-Crystal, injecting aura, then directly activating it.

Ultimately, Z-Crystals were just pure energy crystals. Using a Z-Ring and momentum dance was just one way to trigger Z-Crystal power.

Directly triggering with aura wasn't much different.

The pink Z-Crystal made Johan slightly surprised.

Fairy Z?

Not Electric Z after all.

Hala in the distance patted himself and looked helpless.

Great, it was indeed his newly made Z-Ring.

[When you want to meet them, I'll come again.]

After speaking, Tapu Koko transformed into a golden arc of light and disappeared into the night.

"Pretty reasonable to talk to." Looking in the direction Tapu Koko left, Johan gently stroked Ninetales' fur and smiled.

"Oowoo~"

Ninetales nodded approvingly.

"How is it?" Johan looked at his little Ninetales.

Ninetales' eyes curved, showing a gentle and confident smile.

"Good."

Although a bit troublesome, he was very satisfied with the results.

Not only because of Ninetales' strength improvement, but also because some of his speculations had been confirmed.

The Z-Crystals and Z-moves of the Alola region ultimately came from the special aura that Alola possessed.

Not just these, but even the Totem Pokémon unique to the Alola region, especially the "Totem Aura" these Totem Pokémon possessed, was essentially a use of the Alola region's aura.

After being granted aura power by the island guardian deities, some Pokémon would become Totem Pokémon, possessing "Totem Aura."

Tracing to the source, the unique aura of the Alola region, like the Galar Particles of the Galar region and the Terastal energy of the Paldea region, essentially originated from the light released by Necrozma—that is, Necrozma's power.

Coincidentally.

After Xerneas's care, Ninetales had to some extent mastered the technique of using aura.

This allowed Ninetales to learn a bit about using Alola's aura during its confrontation with Tapu Koko, turning it into its own power through Geomancy.

Although it didn't become a Totem Pokémon, it mastered abilities similar to Totem Pokémon.

The difference was that Totem Pokémon's Totem Aura was granted by guardian deities, while Ninetales intercepted it itself.

This was just one Melemele Island. What if Ninetales toured the other three islands too? Johan thought while rubbing his chin.

This trip to the Alola region wasn't in vain.

Even if he couldn't get the "Fairy Plate" in the short term, just this aura power had benefited Ninetales greatly.

At this point, it probably already had the strength of an ordinary Champion's ace Pokémon in normal conditions.

If it could absorb some aura from the other three islands, its strength would certainly improve further.

"Ka-kaah..."

Gengar, who had poked its head out from behind Johan, shrank its neck.

The only thing it was afraid of was Johan and Ninetales. This improvement in Ninetales' strength made the ghost feel pressure.

"Teacher Johan, because of the earlier emergency... this is Fighting Z." As Island Kahuna, Hala—having been defeated by Johan meant completing the "Grand Trial" in the island challenge, earning a Z-Crystal provided by the Island Kahuna.

Johan wasn't polite about it.

Fighting Z was one he didn't have and could be used with Urshifu.

Getting both Fairy Z and Fighting Z crystals at once was a huge profit.

"Island Kahuna Hala, Iki Town..." Johan looked somewhat embarrassedly at the ruins everywhere.

"It's fine." Hala laughed heartily. "Our people can restore this place quickly."

"I was going to say, if you need a construction team, I might be able to introduce some." Johan said.

"Oh?"

Team Rocket's "Rainbow Rocket Corporation" plan had already begun, and cooperation with Devon also had a relatively good start thanks to the premise of "Rainbow Rocket Entertainment."

Meanwhile, the town square that looked like complete ruins didn't affect the townspeople's continued celebration of the festival.

In their view, this was proof that the festival battles were intense and exciting enough.

Moreover.

They had not only seen the Island Kahuna's battle but also the island guardian deity's battle—definitely a day worth celebrating.

Melemele Island, the teacher dormitory arranged by Professor Kukui for Johan.

Although the Alola Pokémon School looked simple, the place was certainly large enough.

The teacher dormitory was a single-story bamboo building, filled with fragrance inside, quite giving a feeling of a southern island vacation.

And it wasn't just the bamboo building—outside the bamboo building was a large yard, enough for Johan and his Pokémon to move around freely.

At this moment, the little ones were playing in the yard, while Johan sat in a bamboo reclining chair, drinking sweet pineapple juice and making phone calls.

"Mosquito?"

On the other end of the phone was Anabel's voice with some confusion.

"It's one of the UBs your 'UB Task Force' is investigating. I've already sent you the information and data."

"UB?!"

Anabel's voice rose a few notes.

Along with some commotion from the phone, obviously Anabel was already looking at computer files.

At the same time, she said quickly:

"So the abnormal spatial fluctuation that occurred on Melemele Island today was encountered by Teacher Johan?"

As the "UB Task Force" specifically established to deal with Ultra Beasts, they naturally monitored Ultra Wormhole fluctuations in the Alola region at all times.

It's just that the Ultra Wormhole that appeared above Iki Town existed for too short a time. Their "UB Task Force" hadn't even had time to lock onto the location before the Ultra Wormhole disappeared.

At the time, they thought it was just ordinary spatial fluctuation like usual, never expecting an Ultra Beast had actually appeared?

Then she flipped through the data and saw Buzzwole's photo.

It really was a mosquito!

"Where is it now..." Anabel asked urgently.

"That's right, temporarily with me."

Johan looked at Buzzwole posing with "Buzz! Buzz!" while Tyranitar, Urshifu, Dragonite and others were learning, and turned away.

"Cough, quite well-behaved."

Well-behaved?

This was the first time Anabel had heard someone describe an Ultra Beast as "well-behaved."

But thinking about it.

Teacher Johan was a top-level Pokémon psychologist, called the "Soul Master of Pokémon." Being able to calm an Ultra Beast wasn't impossible.

"Phew—"

Anabel breathed a sigh of relief.

Good that it hadn't caused much destruction.

At the same time, she suddenly realized.

Perhaps she could have Teacher Johan help deal with these Ultra Beasts?

After all, so far, this mosquito combined with muscle mass was the only known Ultra Beast currently under human supervision and very peaceful.

"I plan to send this guy back when the next Ultra Wormhole opens." Johan said.

"No problem. I'll inform Teacher Johan immediately after getting information about Ultra Wormhole openings."

Anabel paused, then said again:

"As for the cost of feeding this UB... I'll report to headquarters. This will be covered by our 'UB Task Force' special budget."

Also being an International Police Inspector, Johan was the consultant type, half-appointed, who could naturally use Inspector authority when necessary, mobilizing all available forces.

But Anabel was different. She was an Inspector with real power, managing the highly valued "UB Task Force" with substantial special budget.

The typical type who could write and approve her own requisitions.

With the "UB Task Force" reimbursing, Johan had no pressure about temporarily feeding Buzzwole.

"Good, thanks for the trouble." Johan smiled.

"Teacher Johan, if conditions allow, could our experts have close contact with this UB and conduct more detailed investigation and understanding?" Anabel asked again.

With such a peaceful UB finally available, shouldn't they seize the opportunity?

The special Poké Balls being developed specifically for UBs were stuck at a crucial point. Perhaps this UB could help break through this difficulty.

After brief consideration, Johan said:

"Should be possible."

After a short pause, he added:

"Oh, Anabel, it personally told me its name is... Buzzwole."

Buzzwole?

"Alright."

Hanging up the phone.

Johan clapped his hands and called: "Time for a late-night snack!"

All the little ones, including Buzzwole, immediately rushed over.

While taking out food, Johan said: "Tonight's expenses are all on 'Mr. Mosquito'!"

Buzzwole paused.

Scratched its head.

Me?

Then seeing everyone's friendly gazes, Buzzwole immediately struck a muscle-showing pose.

"Buzz! (‵‵)"

Meanwhile.

Anabel looked at the information about Buzzwole on screen. After brief hesitation, she titled the file.

Code: UB02: Expansion, Name: Buzzwole

At this time, deep in some forest at night, in a very spacious tree hollow that had been hollowed out.

"James, hurry up, move faster!" Jessie pressed her voice to the limit, desperately pushing the crouching James from behind, urging frantically.

"Don't push me, I need to check the situation first."

James looked around, making sure that terrifying Bewear had really left.

"I said we shouldn't have taken shortcuts, meow."

No money earned, but lost their freedom instead.

"Wobb~aannaa—"

Wobbuffet was cut off mid-shout as Jessie, James, and Meowth simultaneously covered its mouth.

"Quiet, Wobbuffet!" Jessie scolded in a suppressed voice.

"Right, we finally managed—"

"Wobbuffet, why are you sweating so much, meow?" Meowth looked confused.

Wobbuffet, with its mouth covered, pointed toward the tree hollow entrance.

The trio seemed to finally realize something, slowly and stiffly turning their heads together.

They saw that "demonic" face with a cute pink head—Bewear.

For a moment, the trio including Wobbuffet were all drenched in sweat.

"Bear~"

Bewear waved, scooping up Jessie and Wobbuffet with one arm, hugging James and Meowth with the other, crawling into the tree hollow and lying down, gently stroking their heads as if petting dolls.

Sleep time!

Jessie: "What do we do?! (quietly)"

Meowth: "Requesting backup, meow! (quietly)"

James: "But what's with this soft, comfortable feeling?"

Wobbuffet: (≧ω≦)ゞ

"How about we sleep first? (quietly)" ×3

Soon.

Steady breathing sounds came from the tree hollow.

The next morning.

The grass was covered with dew, the sun playfully revealed half its head on the eastern sea surface, and the newborn dawn gazed down at the earth.

Knock knock—

Knocking sounds.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar immediately dropped its thoroughly cleaned plate and floated toward the door.

A woman with pure white hair, wearing goggles, draped in a white lab coat with a tight black work outfit underneath, about twenty-four or twenty-five years old, stood smiling at the door.

Seeing Gengar, the woman wasn't afraid but greeted friendly.

"Alola~"

"Ka-kaah~" Gengar also waved, but its gaze lingered on the woman's goggles, eyes spinning around.

"Gengar, who is it?" Johan, wearing a floral shirt and holding a frying pan and spatula, came to the door.

"Alola, Teacher Johan. I'm Burnet. Inspector Anabel said there's a living UB here for research."

Burnet?

Johan paused slightly.

Professor Kukui's childhood friend?

Looking at Burnet's capable appearance, then thinking of Kukui's Royal Masked Man look, Johan really wanted to ask... how is this fair?

Oh, I have Cynthia, so never mind.

"Alola, Dr. Burnet, please come in." Johan quickly welcomed her.

"Have you eaten breakfast? I'm just preparing some."

Burnet entered the bamboo house and immediately smiled: "May I? I've long heard that Teacher Johan's cooking is extraordinary. This time I have a chance to try it. Thank you for the trouble."

Burnet had an outgoing personality and wasn't reserved at all.

Johan really liked interacting with people with such cheerful personalities.

"Of course, just a moment."

With that, he turned back to the kitchen.

"Teacher Johan, can I see UB02: Expansion first? Oh, that's Buzzwole."

Just as Burnet was about to enter the kitchen to ask, she saw the "Gengar and Girls Keep Out" sign on the kitchen door and couldn't help laughing.

"Gengar, show Dr. Burnet the way." Johan said without turning back.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar made a welcoming gesture, leading Dr. Burnet to the backyard where Buzzwole was exercising.

Well, exercising by carrying Tyranitar in one hand and Dragonite in the other.

Seeing this scene, Dr. Burnet's mouth dropped open.

"Buzz!"

Seeing Gengar, Buzzwole put down the two big guys and struck a muscle-showing pose to greet them.

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar put on a serious expression, black mist surging around its body to simulate bulging biceps, also making a pose similar to Buzzwole's.

Buzzwole was delighted.

"Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!"

Continuously changing poses.

Then Buzzwole and Gengar both looked at Dr. Burnet.

Dr. Burnet had a drop of sweat fall from her forehead. After slight hesitation, she raised both arms...

"Buzz?"
