# 698: Tapu Bewear (×) Radiant Bear! (√) (Two-in-One Chapter)

Originally, after dealing with Tapu Koko, Johan planned to head to other islands to find the other guardian deities, then retrieve the "Fairy Plate" as quickly as possible.

But considering he had accepted the teacher's job after all.

And Dr. Burnet's research on Buzzwole also needed some time.

So...

Despite it being summer vacation, Johan seriously came to the Alola Pokémon School to teach!

Teaching a group of kids who weren't even ten years old about "Pokémon Psychology" would probably leave them dizzy and confused even if they listened.

So Johan chose the most basic and simple trainer knowledge...

"Teacher Johan!"

Energetic girl Mallow boldly raised her hand, and after getting Johan's permission, she stood up and said directly:

"I understand Bug-type beating Grass-type since bugs eat grass, but why can Bug-type also beat Psychic-type and Dark-type?"

See, this was the most basic knowledge Johan was teaching - the type effectiveness between Pokémon.

Facts proved that sometimes you really couldn't blame Ash for not remembering type effectiveness between Pokémon, because he wasn't alone in this.

Mallow continued:

"Can't Psychic-type users easily crush little bugs? Dark-types are so fierce, little bugs would get swatted flat with one hit, right?"

Don't say.

The questions Mallow raised were actually quite interesting, because Johan didn't know the answers either.

"And Bug-type also resists Ground-type and Fighting-type, which is so weird."

Johan: "..."

In a Pokémon world, explaining these things in a supposedly scientific way was indeed impossible.

"Good question." Johan waved at Mallow, indicating she could sit down.

Hearing Johan's "encouragement," Mallow immediately showed a smile.

"So next time, don't ask again."

Mallow: "???"

"Just kidding." Johan smiled.

After brief silence, laughter rang out in the classroom.

"So Mallow, are you afraid of bugs?" Johan asked, adding, "Like cockroaches, spiders and such."

Mallow honestly nodded.

"Yes!"

Girls being afraid of these little bugs was quite normal.

Not just these little girls - even someone like Johan would let out a high note if he suddenly saw a bug, or woke up with one that had fallen on him while sleeping.

"So why would you, a person so much bigger than a little bug, be afraid? One shoe stomp would definitely crush it, right?"

Mallow thought for a moment.

"That's true~"

But even so, fear was still fear.

"Don't think of Pokémon type effectiveness too scientifically, because the existence of Pokémon itself isn't scientific, and there's no need to force explanations for type effectiveness using our common sense."

"Oh~~"

All five kids nodded thoughtfully.

"Alright." Johan clapped his hands, drawing the five kids' attention again.

"That's all for classroom content. Today I'll take you to experience something different."

Something different?

The five children immediately became interested.

Johan smiled mysteriously.

"Get ready, we'll meet at the school gate in ten minutes."

The five kids, already fully prepared, watched Johan leisurely walk to the school gate with coconut juice, and Mallow couldn't wait to ask:

"Teacher Johan, what are we going to do?"

"Of course, take you to do what you most want to do." Johan smiled.

Kiawe: "Go battle?"

Mallow: "Go cook?"

Sophocles: "Go stargazing?"

Lana: "Go, go fishing?"

Lillie: "Go, go..."

Johan held his forehead.

No wonder trainers in the Pokémon world were all so good at side jobs.

"Take you to meet more Pokémon."

Hearing this, except for Lillie, the other four kids immediately became interested.

Honestly, as native trainers, who wouldn't want to go on wilderness adventures?

It's just that wild forests were too dangerous.

Even Professor Kukui had never taken them to truly wild and dangerous forests.

"I, I..." Lillie lowered her head.

She actually wanted to see more Pokémon too, and didn't want to spoil everyone's fun, but... she was also afraid of those Pokémon.

At this time, Johan gently patted Lillie's shoulder, and when she looked up, he gave her a very gentle smile.

"It's okay, I'm here."

"...Mm!"

"Let's go~!"

Johan was like a kid leader, wearing flip-flops, a wide sun hat, waving his hand and leading the kids away from school.

Not far away in the school building.

"You guys... Kukui, aren't you going with them?" Dr. Burnet looked at the cheerful Professor Kukui and Principal Samson Oak and couldn't help asking.

Samson Oak's face transformed.

"That's Johan, Nidoqueen's Queen!"

Professor Kukui had deeper understanding of Johan than Samson Oak, especially after yesterday's events, so he smiled and said:

"Look at the sky."

Dr. Burnet looked up following his gaze.

She saw Regieleki and Regidrago in the sky, one left and one right, acting as guardians.

Plus Ninetales' control over aura, Gengar's freedom in shadows, and a group of Pokémon...

"I'll go research Buzzwole instead."

Burnet also realized she had been worrying needlessly.

"Be careful, those are Paras spores. Though not fatal, accidentally getting poisoned or paralyzed would be suffering for yourself."

"So it's Paras..." Kiawe sheepishly withdrew his hand, looking at the red mushroom-like thing in front of him. He had thought it was something edible.

"Teacher Johan, what are you doing?"

Mallow crouched beside Johan, seeing him carefully digging up a plant with a small shovel.

"The vegetation here is too dense. Even with Alola's fertile soil and abundant sunlight, these overly crowded plants have difficulty growing. Removing some helps them grow better."

Johan explained while working.

The undeveloped Alola region was truly too "wealthy." Though it couldn't compare to Ballimere Lake plains, the resources were very abundant.

These weren't berry trees, but rather rare tea trees. Digging some back to plant on the island would give him his own tea field!

Then he could pick tea, process tea, and brew tea himself.

Anyway, these plants would struggle to grow if he didn't dig them up.

"I see." Mallow and the other kids understood.

"I'll teach you, watch carefully." Johan demonstrated once for the five kids.

"Did you learn?"

"We learned!" ×5

"Go get small shovels from Tinkaton, one each, and try it yourselves." Johan smiled.

"Great!"

Except for Mallow, they were all kids who had never tried this. Encountering something new, they didn't feel tired or dirty, just full of curiosity.

Even Lillie, despite being a young lady, was very enthusiastic.

It could even be said that Lillie was more enthusiastic than the other four.

Five more free laborers, wonderful~

Teaching and working at the same time - Johan couldn't help thinking he was truly awesome.

The rustling forest was bright and pleasant with sunshine, flowers blooming brilliantly. A group of Cutiefly danced among the flowers, stirring up petals and bringing fragrant aromas.

"Sophocles, don't go near there!"

Johan's aura let him keep watch over the five kids while staying busy.

"Eh?"

The chubby boy with a small shovel, sweating profusely, looked at Johan with some confusion.

"That's not a plant, it's a patch of Fomantis."

"Fomantis?"

The kids all gathered around curiously.

"Fomantis, the Sickle Grass Pokémon, Grass-type, Rotom!" The Rotom Pokédex displayed photos of this Pokémon.

"It really is!" Kiawe compared the photo in the Pokédex with what looked like flower buds clustered on the ground.

"So cute..." Lana said in her calm tone.

Lillie had already started backing away.

Johan smiled and supported Lillie's shoulder while saying: "Fomantis rest in sunlight during the day, using the leaves on their heads for photosynthesis. They really hate being disturbed while sleeping."

Lillie bit her lip, took out a notebook from her small bag, and seriously began taking notes.

Johan continued: "Though they look cute, Fomantis are actually quite dangerous Grass-type Pokémon. After basking in sunlight, their heads release scents similar to Sweet Scent, attracting Bug-type Pokémon to gather."

A brief pause.

"Whether Fomantis or their evolution Lurantis, both are carnivorous hunters. Rather than plants, they're more like mantises, Scyther."

Hearing this, the kids all stepped back, especially Sophocles, who looked relieved.

The Rotom Pokédex timely displayed photos of Lurantis.

Sensing the kids' tension, Johan smiled:

"A very interesting thing about Fomantis is that they sleep during the day, and when they wake up at night, they work hard to find suitable places to sleep the next day."

"So they're..." Lillie said quietly: "Either sleeping or on the way to sleep?"

"Exactly." Johan gave Lillie's summary full marks.

The originally somewhat nervous kids relaxed upon hearing this.

"Lurantis is also very beautiful." Mallow had a special fondness for Grass-type Pokémon.

"Teacher, are these light purple mushrooms also Paras?"

At this time, Kiawe made a new discovery, pointing at several light purple mushrooms under a tree.

Johan glanced and said:

"Those aren't. Mallow, Kiawe, collect these mushrooms."

The two were puzzled but followed Johan's instructions, putting the mushrooms in a small basket.

"If you see more along the way, collect them all. Tonight I'll make delicious mushroom soup for you."

Mallow's eyes immediately lit up, quickly reaching out: "Teacher Johan, let me help!"

Mallow was very serious about cooking and becoming a chef.

"No problem."

"So Teacher Johan, what exactly are these mushrooms..." Sophocles held up a magnifying glass, picking up a mushroom to study.

"Morelull." Johan said without turning back.

"Ah?" Sophocles was so startled he dropped it.

Weren't they going to eat Pokémon?

"The mushrooms on Morelull's head are very delicious ingredients."

Then the Rotom Pokédex fulfilled its purpose again, displaying photos of Morelull.

"So cute..." Mallow immediately fell in love with its appearance.

"Morelull, the Illuminating Pokémon, Grass and Fairy-type, Rotom!" the Rotom Pokédex said.

Johan also added: "Unlike Fomantis, Morelull are quite gentle Pokémon. They also sleep during the day and are active at night. At night, the mushrooms on their heads emit colorful faint light."

Straightening up, he put a newly dug small tea tree into Gengar's shadow.

"To avoid absorbing too many nutrients in the same place and causing surrounding plants to wither, Morelull change their roosting trees at night."

Putting the mushroom Sophocles dropped back in the basket.

"Many forest Pokémon love eating the mushrooms on Morelull's heads. When they move, they sometimes accidentally bump into things and drop mushrooms. These are what they dropped while moving."

"Similar to Tropius's bananas, Sunflora's seeds - all edible foods, no need to worry."

The kids showed expressions of "so that's how it is," and Lillie scribbled notes.

Johan smiled: "If you have insomnia at night, keeping a Morelull in your room will help you sleep soundly."

Specialized for insomniacs - the faint light Morelull emitted at night and their scattered spores both had sleep-promoting effects.

Then his expression became more serious.

"Though Morelull are gentle Pokémon and fine to encounter at night, if you meet their evolution Shiinotic at night, you must get away immediately."

Speaking, Gengar slowly emerged from the five kids' shadows behind them.

Johan's voice also became eerie.

"Legend says that people who got lost in forests where Shiinotic lived were confused by the flashing spores Shiinotic released, wandering for dozens of days unable to find an exit. When found, they were already skin and bones..."

"Ka-kaah!"

Gengar suddenly jumped out.

"Ahhhh!!!"

The kids all turned pale with fright, running behind Johan.

"Ka-kaah~ ()σ"

Gengar pointed at the kids, rolling on the ground with laughter.

"Shiinotic's spores drain life energy from their wrists, but if people or Pokémon were really in danger, they'd also use the same method to give life energy. Otherwise how could someone survive dozens of days?"

Johan also wore a teasing smile.

"Teacher Johan!!!"

The kids immediately got angry, realizing they'd been teased.

However, this surprise, joy, and anger made this outdoor trip extremely interesting.

Of course, taking this opportunity, Johan also dug up quite a few good things.

Eight wild tea trees total, and two Pineap Berry tree saplings.

Pineap Berry trees grew quite densely in the Alola region.

Pineap Berries could not only restore Pokémon's stamina but also stimulate their spirits to some extent, better for growth.

Supposedly, Pokémon that regularly ate Pineap Berries became smarter, though there was no way to verify this specifically.

One of the specialties at Mallow's family's Aina's Kitchen was Pineap Berry juice made with Pineap Berries and Honey, which had a different taste from regular pineapple juice.

Supposedly Mallow's father learned this from an Oranguru living in the forest.

On the way back.

The kids chattered about today's experiences or their past encounters.

"Teacher Johan, you don't know." Energetic girl Mallow talked the most. "When Lana and I were little, we accidentally got lost in the forest and were cared for by a Drampa before finally getting out."

"Mm!" Lana nodded in agreement.

When they were little, they got lost in the forest and encountered a Drampa. At first they were scared and ran around, even getting separated. Mallow even accidentally fell off a cliff.

Thanks to Drampa's help, both were able to escape safely.

"Then, quick quiz." Johan held up the Rotom Pokédex, displaying Drampa's photo.

"What is Drampa called when first born? What about when young?"

Kiawe was first to raise his hand.

"Drampa is of course called Young Drampa when first born, and Little Drampa when young!"

"Wrong!"

Chubby Sophocles rubbed his chin thoughtfully, denying Kiawe's answer while giving his own.

"'Drampa' already means old one. When first born it should be called Young Dragon, when young called Little Dragon!"

"Eh?"

Mallow and Lana looked at each other.

They felt... both answers seemed right, but also... not quite right.

"Young Drampa!"

"Young Dragon!"

Kiawe and Sophocles "confronted" each other.

Johan chuckled, looking at Lillie: "What do you think, Lillie?"

Lillie blinked her light blue eyes twice, looking up: "Drampa... whether first born or young, shouldn't they all be called Drampa?"

"Eh?!"

The other four kids exclaimed in unison.

Johan snapped his fingers, "Correct! You can make one small wish."

Lillie's cheeks flushed.

A wish?

She lowered her head thoughtfully.

Johan told the other four kids: "Don't get caught in word games. Drampa don't have evolutionary forms, so no matter how old, they're all called Drampa."

"Ka-kaah~~"

Gengar simulated whiskers, mimicking Drampa - no, should be called Gengar-pa.

Kiawe and Sophocles scratched their heads sheepishly.

Mallow said: "So Drampa... become 'elders' right from birth?"

Lana added: "Skip decades of detours."

Johan couldn't help chuckling.

So whether Pokémon fans from another world or kids in the Pokémon world, all were curious about Pokémon.

But one thing was universal.

That was love for Pokémon.

Before leaving the forest, Johan's phone suddenly rang.

The caller ID showed... the trio!

Hm?

These three guys...

After pressing answer, he heard:

"Jo-Johan-sensei, help! Save us!"

The three voices were suppressed.

"You guys..."

"Bear alert! It's bear alert—"

Before finishing, the call cut off.

Johan looked at his phone with a strange expression.

Bear alert?

Bewear?

The Alola region's "one true god"?

In the Alola region, any island guardian deities, any Ultra Beasts - all had to take detours in front of Tapu Bewear, the Bear God!

The "four true gods" of the Pokémon world: Pikachu gets stronger against strong opponents and weaker against weak ones, Psyduck's headaches suppress everything, Wobbuffet fears rebound from everything, and Bear God has no weaknesses!

In the Pokémon Sun and Moon anime, Bewear left an extremely deep impression and was Team Rocket trio's strongest, most solid shield.

No matter what huge trouble the trio caused, Bear God protected them and cleaned up their messes.

It could truly fly through the sky, burrow underground, dive into seas, and walk on waves - omnipotent.

Flying? Just jumping hard.

Swimming? Light-footed water walking became reality.

Even more exaggerated, this Bewear could match Buzzwole in strength, surpass Pheromosa in speed, and gain Oranguru's recognition for intelligence - truly Alola's ceiling.

Most importantly, it was actually a kind-hearted Pokémon overflowing with maternal love.

It might be the only Pokémon in the Alola region besides Necrozma and the sun/moon duo Solgaleo and Lunala whose strength surpassed Champion level.

It might even be one of the few wild Pokémon in the entire Pokémon world whose strength exceeded Champion level.

Regarding this "Bear God"...

Though Johan felt that without his "rescue," the trio would probably live quite comfortably.

But he was quite curious and wanted to meet this existence that would be "looked up to" even if called "Tapu Bewear" by the Tapu clan.

"Is there an emergency, Teacher Johan?" Mallow asked.

"Small matter."

Johan shook his head, putting away his phone.

"Let's go, I'll take you back first."

Small class sizes had their benefits.

If there were too many people, leaving campus to enter forests would become troublesome, and ordinary teachers might not have the strength to ensure students wouldn't encounter danger.

The travel faction versus academy faction debate the League had been having could be somewhat reconciled with this small class model.

Of course, the real dangers encountered by the travel faction couldn't be replaced, but the travel faction's mortality rate could be minimized.

After returning the five kids to Professor Kukui and promising Mallow he'd return before dinner to teach her mushroom soup, Johan turned and left school again, entering the forest.

In a forest somewhere on Melemele Island, inside a giant tree hollow.

"Delicious! Woo woo woo, so delicious!" Jessie ate berries and Honey, moved to tears.

"Although, but, however..."

James, hungry all day, was also eating heartily while mumbling indistinctly.

"So happy, meow~"

"Wobb~buffet~!"

They thought Bewear had come back to "deal with" them, but it returned carrying a pile of berries and a jar of Honey.

It even told them not to be polite and eat freely.

This made the trio, who had been frightened all day, extremely excited.

"Bear~"

Seeing the trio eating happily, Bewear reached out and gently patted each of their heads.

"What's it saying, Meowth?" Jessie asked.

"It's telling us... not to be afraid, eat with peace of mind, meow!" Meowth translated Bewear's words.

"What a good person!" James called out.

"But what if..." Jessie's movements gradually slowed, lowering her voice: "What if it wants to fatten us up?"

Instantly, James, Meowth, and Wobbuffet's eating movements stopped, their faces turning pale.

Gulp—

James swallowed.

"It's not... impossible..." James murmured.

"Bear~"

Bewear sat outside the tree hollow with arms around its knees, its unchanging face showing slight melancholy for the first time.

Meowth, who was being fearful, heard Bewear's words and paused.

"What's wrong?"

"Is it going to eat us?"

Jessie and James became extremely nervous, but Meowth's expression suddenly became complex.

"It said: If my child were still here, it would surely eat as well as you, meow..."

"Ch-child?"

"It's a mother?!"

Jessie and James couldn't help looking at each other.

Then they recalled Bewear hugging them before, sleeping together at night, and patting their heads after feeding them...

For a moment, James's expression became sad.

Even the usually tough Jessie had slightly red eyes, gritting her teeth:

"Damn it! Someone definitely stole Bewear's child!"

Such a strong Bewear - ordinary Pokémon hunters couldn't possibly steal its child in front of it.

James clenched his fists.

"How can anyone make a mother lose her child?!"

"Let's help it, meow?" Meowth said.

"Wobb~buffet!" Wobbuffet also showed seriousness for the first time.

Just as the trio made up their minds, Bewear outside the hollow suddenly stood up.

"Bear!"

"It says: There's someone, meow!" Meowth translated promptly.

Hm?

"Teacher Johan?!" Jessie and James shouted together.

They had secretly called Johan when Bewear wasn't paying attention.

They called Johan instead of Matori partly because Jessie didn't want to beg in front of Matori, and partly because they saw Urshifu at yesterday's "Full Moon Festival" in Iki Town, guessing Teacher Johan had come to Alola.

After all, Urshifu wasn't a common Pokémon.

The trio suddenly realized.

"Oh no! Teacher Johan and Bewear are going to fight."

James quickly tried to get up.

But Bewear had brought too many berries into the hollow, and their feet were already buried. They couldn't get up immediately.

Meanwhile in the forest.

In the dim forest, Shiinotic gradually emitted faint light, and Pikipek seemed to sense something, flapping their wings and flying high.

Johan, walking through the forest following GPS navigation, suddenly felt inexplicable pressure.

"Good grief."

He guessed it was probably Bewear approaching. "This oppressive feeling is more exaggerated than some legendary Pokémon."

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar also floated out from the shadows.

Even the usually playful purple chubby's expression became serious and solemn.

Crack—

A tree branch suddenly snapped.

Under a nearby tree, a fluffy figure suddenly appeared, standing silently by the tree, watching him.

Johan's heart skipped.

When did it appear?

"Oowoo!"

"Garruu!"

Ninetales and Urshifu stepped forward, standing in front of Johan, also sensing the enormous pressure from their opponent.

This pressure only occurred when facing some legendary Pokémon.

That Bewear just stood silently under the tree without moving, only slowly raising its arms toward Johan and his Pokémon, showing a smile and waving its hands.

For a moment, Johan broke into a cold sweat.

Don't look at Bewear's very friendly appearance now - this was actually its way of issuing a warning.

If they kept advancing, Bewear would consider them "enemies."

You know, even Ash, also a "power ceiling" of the Pokémon world, had his expression instantly change from child to adult when facing Bewear.

"Worthy of being a comedy character from a slice-of-life anime, a ceiling-level existence..."

Even facing Groudon, Johan hadn't been this nervous.

At least Groudon's hostility was visible to the naked eye, while Bewear... under its doll-like unchanging expression, no one knew when it might suddenly deliver a hook punch.

Getting hit once would probably splatter brain matter everywhere.

Johan tried hard to release goodwill through aura while signaling his Pokémon not to be nervous or show hostility.

However.

His aura received no response whatsoever.

Johan: "..."

"Bear!"

Bewear smiled broadly, gently waving its arms.

Bang!!

The extremely thick tree trunk beside it snapped.

"Garruu!"

Seeing this, Urshifu snorted two puffs of white air, lightly punching a nearby tree trunk.

Bang!!

That trunk also snapped.

"Bear! ^^"

Bewear's smile remained unchanged.

Johan: "..."

He pulled Ninetales, Urshifu, and Gengar back slowly while saying: "Bewear, don't misunderstand, we mean no harm."

However.

Bewear directly took a step, its figure suddenly disappearing.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu's expression tightened, breaking free from Johan's restraint while standing firm and throwing a punch!

Bang—

Two bear paws suddenly collided.

Boom!!!

Instantly, with them as the center, the ground directly collapsed, and a terrifying gust scattered in all directions, overturning surrounding trees and bushes.

"Bear?"

Bewear's smile slightly faded, showing some surprise.

Urshifu tensed up.

The next second.

Bewear exerted force again.

Bang—

Urshifu flew backward directly, crashing heavily into a tree trunk.

It could go toe-to-toe with Buzzwole, but facing Bewear, it couldn't match the sudden burst of power?

"Garruu!!"

Urshifu stood up fiercely, roaring skyward with high fighting spirit.

"Ka-kaah?"

Gengar showed interested expression, black mist spreading from its body.

Ninetales lightly exhaled, and the surrounding temperature plummeted.

"Bear!"

Bewear stood firm.

Facing Johan and his Pokémon, it gently beckoned, as if saying—come here.

"This is Bear God?" Johan murmured.

Tapu Bewear? (×)

Radiant Bear! (√)

Before his Pokémon and Bewear could attack, Johan suddenly shouted:

"I know where your child is!"

# 699: Bewear's Request (Two-in-One Chapter)

"Bear bear?"

Bewear, who was about to attack, suddenly stopped its movements and stared blankly at Johan.

Seeing this, Johan breathed a slight sigh of relief.

To be honest.

It wasn't that he was truly afraid of Bewear. He had seen so many legendary Pokémon - no matter how powerful Bear God was, could it really take on seven or nine at once?

Johan even felt that with Gengar using all its abilities, it should be able to have a fight with Bewear. It's just that one was Normal-type and one was Ghost-type, so neither could truly deal with the other.

Regarding Bewear, Johan actually held favorable feelings.

It was so good to the Team Rocket trio that from a certain perspective, it viewed the trio as half its children, half its companions.

Moreover, Bewear's kindness toward the trio was truly unreserved.

When the trio was blasted off by Ash, Bewear would come treading on the sunset, directly performing light-footed movement between tall buildings to take the trio away.

When the trio was about to fall into the sea, Bewear would perform water-walking to safely carry them away.

Even the number of times the trio shouted "What a terrible feeling" in the Alola region decreased several-fold.

Of course, Team Rocket trio was one aspect.

Another aspect was that Bewear was a mother who had been separated from her child.

A kind Pokémon with no great malice, whose child had gone missing and who occasionally had large emotional fluctuations, and whose strength was abnormally powerful - Johan really couldn't muster much ill will.

"Bear bear!"

Bewear immediately stepped forward several paces.

"Oowoo!"

"Garruu!"

Ninetales and Urshifu immediately took defensive stances, assuming protective postures.

"Teacher Johan!!" ×3

"Wobb~buffet—!!"

From a corner of the forest came the trio's voices.

"Don't fight! Teacher Johan, this Bewear is actually a good person!" James shouted.

"It just lost its own child!" Jessie also said.

Why was it that the trio, despite being villains and Team Rocket members, were actually not disliked by most Pokémon fans and were even liked by them?

It was because while the trio were indeed villains, their moral compass was often remarkably upright.

When truly involving matters that touched bottom lines and morality, the trio would display exceptionally righteous behavior.

Just like now.

"It says: How do you know, meow?" Meowth ran over while also serving as translator.

Johan patted Ninetales' head and Urshifu's shoulder, indicating they didn't need to worry anymore.

Regarding Bewear's child, Johan vaguely remembered... it should be in Aether Paradise within the Aether Foundation.

Aether Paradise was an artificial island built by the Aether Foundation at enormous cost.

And the Aether Foundation...

Johan currently maintained a wait-and-see attitude toward this organization.

After all, the Aether Foundation's portrayal in the anime was quite different from its portrayal in the games.

The main difference lay in the Aether Foundation's president, Lillie's mother Lusamine.

In the games and special manga, Lusamine's personality was extremely malicious - calling her yandere would be putting it lightly. She was obsessed with collecting Pokémon specimens and Ultra Beasts, with many innocent Pokémon being "collected" by her.

In the anime, Lusamine's personality was much better, changing from yandere to a... dignified and elegant positive character who lacked care for her own children, was occasionally a bit tsundere and narcissistic.

She not only established the "Ultra Guardians" but also provided Ash and others with large amounts of equipment and items, actively cooperating with League representatives like Professor Kukui and Dr. Burnet.

Since Johan currently couldn't determine Lusamine's situation, he couldn't easily characterize the Aether Foundation.

Actually, not just the Aether Foundation and Lusamine - there were also major differences between games/special manga and anime regarding the origin and background of the "Radiant God" Necrozma in the Alola region.

The specific situation would probably have to wait for later investigation and exploration.

Regarding the current situation, Johan took a deep breath and said:

"I probably know where your child is, with fairly high possibility, but the specific situation needs investigation before I can be certain."

"Bear bear..."

Bewear looked toward the trio.

Compared to the suddenly appearing Johan with powerful strength that even it could feel threatened by, obviously the trio they had spent time with, had a more "harmonious" relationship with, and were harmless, were more trustworthy.

"Teacher Johan is absolutely trustworthy!" James was the first to step out and support Johan.

"That's right!"

Jessie followed in agreement, her expression serious.

"Teacher Johan has helped many Pokémon before, including legendary Pokémon and powerful ones, meow." Meowth also expressed its stance.

Setting aside their superior-subordinate relationship with Teacher Johan, the three of them truly trusted and were grateful to Teacher Johan from the bottom of their hearts.

"Wobb~buffet~!"

Even Wobbuffet strongly supported Johan at this time.

Seeing the trio and even Wobbuffet so approving of Johan, Bewear gradually put away the somewhat sinister smile that appeared on its face under the light.

Watching Bewear's expression change, Johan felt somewhat emotional.

When had his words become less effective than the trio's when facing Pokémon...

However, ultimately, the trio could unexpectedly gain some Pokémon's favor, like this Bewear before them, which was related to their unique affinity with Pokémon.

"Bear~bear!"

Bewear spoke again.

Meowth promptly translated: "It asks if Teacher Johan can help it find its child? It has searched all of Melemele Island but hasn't seen its child."

Before Johan could answer, James immediately said:

"We'll help too!"

Jessie gritted her teeth, "Anyone who kidnaps someone else's child is absolutely unforgivable!"

Are you guys actually heroes or villains? Johan grumbled internally.

"Bear!"

Bewear was moved by the trio's words and immediately reached out to embrace the three plus Wobbuffet together, affectionately nuzzling them with its head.

"It hurts! It hurts so much!! It's going to break!"

"Help! Help... (soul floating out)"

Johan unconsciously stepped back half a pace.

Dragonite's hugs were already stimulating enough - in the entire Pokémon world, there weren't more than five people who could withstand Bewear's hugs.

Two of them were right here.

Perhaps this was also one of the reasons Bewear chose to trust the trio.

"Cough, I'll send people to help, but determining its location will probably require waiting a bit longer."

"Bear..."

Bewear nodded hesitantly.

Though it missed its child very much, having already waited this long, it didn't mind waiting a little more.

Johan also relaxed considerably.

No matter what, with the trio he had managed to establish some connection with Bewear.

With Bear God backing him up, even if Necrozma awakened now, he'd have some confidence even without calling for help.

"Of course, when necessary, I'll need their cooperation."

Johan pointed at the trio.

For infiltrating the Aether Foundation, no one was more suitable than the trio.

Regarding this, though Bewear was reluctant, it also expressed agreement.

After all, it would be responsible for the trio's safety.

"Teacher Johan, we can cooperate right now!" James said hurriedly, with Jessie and Meowth nodding repeatedly.

Johan smiled without responding.

Such a rare opportunity to not have to work, not face danger, and still have unlimited free food - shouldn't he let the trio "enjoy" this more?

Vacation time was precious.

He would talk to Matori about it.

"Oh right." Johan took out some food - energy cubes, Poffins, macarons, fresh cream cakes, and so on.

Since they'd already established a connection, might as well take the opportunity to get closer to Bear God.

"I brought some food. If you don't mind, shall we... eat together?"

"Bear bear?"

Bewear looked at the food in front of Johan, then at the trio in its arms who were already drooling.

Honestly, with Bewear's strength, it absolutely didn't lack food in this forest.

But this food was limited to berries, with at most some Honey added. Though the taste was quite good, eating too much got boring.

That's why Bewear often used Honey to trade with the Oranguru who ran a bar in the forest for things like Pineap Berry juice.

But the food in Oranguru's bar was quite different from what Johan had brought out.

A few minutes later.

"Mm! So delicious! Worthy of Teacher Johan!"

The trio and Johan's own Pokémon were eating enthusiastically. After hesitating briefly, Bewear also picked up a piece of fresh cream cake.

But after thinking about it.

It pulled out a jar of Honey from somewhere and offered it to Johan.

"Bear bear~"

This time without Meowth translating, Johan already understood its meaning.

Payment for the meal.

Or rather, an exchange.

Johan smiled: "As friends, this is my treat."

Friends?

Bewear looked at the trio, nodded, just put down the Honey then quickly picked it up again, placing it in front of Johan.

"Bear bear!"

This wasn't an exchange - it was treating Johan.

Hearing this, Johan couldn't help but laugh.

This Bear God... was really quite cute.

After that, Bewear truly relaxed and began eating.

You could tell it really liked the food Johan brought.

After all, he was an "energy cube succubus" - Johan was quite confident in these "universally effective" energy cubes.

He got up and sat beside Urshifu, gently patting his bear instructor's shoulder.

"Garruu?"

Facing Urshifu's questioning gaze, Johan smiled: "Still want to spar with Bewear?"

Urshifu laughed awkwardly and scratched its head.

As their trainer, how could Johan not understand his own Pokémon?

Earlier, Urshifu had been sent flying by Bewear's punch. Though it wasn't seriously injured, this obviously made Urshifu feel the gap between itself and Bewear.

This was the first time besides legendary Pokémon that Urshifu had felt such an obvious gap with another ordinary Pokémon.

"It's fine, there will be opportunities."

Why Bear God was so strong was impossible to explore.

Probably even Bewear itself couldn't explain it clearly.

This only proved that Pokémon, from a certain perspective, truly had infinite possibilities, and this Bewear was the best proof.

Copying Bear God's methods wasn't realistic, but learning from Bear God was still possible, especially for Urshifu.

If Buzzwole was an excellent sparring partner, then Bewear was definitely a good learning target.

"Garruu!"

Urshifu nodded seriously.

"Have some Honey, the freshest kind."

Johan placed the Honey Bewear had given him in front of Urshifu. For bears, they had little resistance to things like Honey.

"Garruu~!"

Bear instructor happily called out, grabbing a handful and stuffing it in its mouth.

Hm?

Watching the rapidly disappearing Honey, Johan suddenly had a thought.

If Bewear could stably collect Honey, didn't that mean it knew about the existence of Combee?

Johan's mind became active.

Looking toward Bewear, he discovered...

Gengar had somehow already sat beside Bewear.

Wrapping its arm around its neck with a familiar attitude.

Telling, or rather introducing, its "crew."

The word "crew" made Johan's face twitch slightly.

"Bear bear!"

Bewear seemed very happy to meet such a group of new friends and immediately opened its arms to hug Gengar.

However.

Its arms passed right through Gengar.

"Bear bear?"

Bewear looked confused.

"Ka-kaah~!" Gengar couldn't help giggling.

As a Ghost-type Pokémon, how could it be easily...

While it was still feeling smug, Bewear hugged it a second time.

Then it hugged Gengar solidly.

The purple chubby's round belly was instantly flattened, its entire state like compressed airflow - big head, big feet, small belly.

Gengar didn't notice its own changes, just looked at Bewear in surprise.

It clearly hadn't felt Bewear use any move like "Foresight."

Johan couldn't help laughing.

Shaking his head.

Bear God didn't follow basic rules. In the anime, the trio's Mimikyu was also casually grabbed and hugged by it.

"Bewear." Johan called out.

"Bear bear?"

Both Bewear and Gengar looked over.

"Where did you get this Honey? I don't want more, I just want to... provide some willing Combee with a new home."

First refusing the Honey Bewear offered again, Johan stated his purpose.

"Bear bear..."

Bewear scratched its head, looking at Gengar.

Gengar scratched its butt, returning to its original shape.

Then it briefly told Bewear about their island, or rather... Gengar's "kingdom"!

Gengar also enthusiastically invited Bewear to come play in its "kingdom" sometime.

Bewear immediately understood.

Then it stood up and waved at Johan.

The Pokémon and trio all followed with confusion.

Somewhere in a canyon in Melemele Island's forest.

"Bear bear!"

Bewear made a "shush" gesture, leaning against a rock. Johan looked in the direction it pointed.

He saw orange Combee that looked like three bees connected with part of a hive, flapping transparent wings and busily shuttling through the canyon.

They occasionally flew into a cave in the canyon, while more Combee flew out from the cave, happily flying somewhere else.

This cave was obviously the Combee's nest.

With so many Combee and their orderly appearance, there was clearly a queen bee in the cave - that is, the object of the Combee's loyalty, a Vespiquen.

Aside from anything else.

Just the number of these Combee alone meant ordinary people or Pokémon couldn't approach.

Only Bewear could freely move among them, taking Honey as needed, almost becoming the "currency" circulating in this forest.

"So many Combee, that Honey must be incredible, meow!" Meowth's eyes were already turning into "$" shapes.

"If we could take them all, we could exchange for quite a bit of funding, right?" Jessie couldn't help saying.

"Bear bear!"

But Bewear waved at them.

"It says: Take only what you eat, clearing everything out is very rude, meow." Meowth translated.

Johan's expression was strange.

Bewear understood sustainable development?

If it really emptied this cave's Honey all at once, this hive would definitely relocate the next day.

"Bear bear!"

Bewear pressed its palm downward.

"It says: You wait here, I'll go get some, and you watch for a chance to capture a few, meow." Meowth translated again.

Speaking, Bewear rolled up its sleeves, preparing to act.

But Johan quickly stopped it.

"Bewear, I mean Combee that need help or are willing to leave with me. These Combee are obviously loyal to their queen. If I forcibly capture them, what's the difference between me and whoever took your child?"

Hearing this, Bewear was obviously stunned, staring blankly at Johan.

"Teacher Johan, really, I'm crying, meow~" Meowth bit a handkerchief, looking moved.

"This is the Teacher Johan we know." James and Jessie also looked admiring.

Being praised by the trio made Johan feel a bit embarrassed.

"Bear bear!"

Just as he was about to turn around, Bewear suddenly "bear hugged," holding Johan firmly in its arms.

"No, wait, wait—" Johan's face changed drastically as he quickly called out.

However, Bewear gave him no chance, directly giving him a "gentle" bear hug.

"...moment..."

Johan felt Bewear's iron arms for the first time.

After a long while, Bewear affectionately nuzzled Johan's head, then finally let him go.

Gengar laughingly supported Johan, asking about his feelings.

Johan took two deep breaths, rubbing his waist before feeling like he'd come back to life.

Damn.

This treatment... better let the trio "enjoy" it.

However, it must be said that from this hug onward, Bewear truly officially accepted him.

Buzz buzz—

The commotion they caused, or rather Johan's cry of alarm, inevitably... attracted the Combee's attention, even the attention of the Vespiquen in the cave.

A fairly large Vespiquen with a skirt-like hive appearance, looking more like a wasp, flew out from the cave.

Its crimson eyes immediately noticed Bewear's extremely familiar figure.

"Buzz—!!"

Vespiquen immediately shrieked, countless Combee receiving orders and rapidly swarming toward them.

"They're coming! They're coming!" James's face changed drastically.

"Tea-Teacher Johan—"

Jessie looked to Johan for help, but saw him step back, avoiding Bewear's bear hug, then say:

"I'm fine, you take care of them."

With that, he turned and ran toward where they came from.

"Bear bear~"

Bewear nodded, then amidst the trio's screams, picked them up.

The next second.

Bang!!

The ground made a muffled groan, and Bewear shot toward the sky like a cannonball, faster than flying.

Johan looked up, watching the "airborne" Bewear and the trio's increasingly distant, elongated screams.

"Whoa. These days, who can't fly anyway..."

Gengar jumped.

Immediately floating up, spreading its arms.

Anyway, not this old man~

Some distance from the canyon, elsewhere in the forest.

A Poké Ball traced an arc through the air, precisely hitting a Combee and opening to emit red light, capturing it inside.

Without shaking three times, the Poké Ball "clicked" and locked.

Gengar gave Snivy a thumbs up.

"Sni~"

Snivy "disdainfully" curled its lip, using Vine Whip to pick up the Poké Ball and hand it to Johan.

Johan smiled and accepted it, looking at the trio whose hair was still in broom-like shapes, and Bewear standing nearby.

After understanding Johan's meaning, Bewear had taken them around this forest for a while before finding this small group of only four Combee.

Among these four Combee were one female and three males.

Male and female Combee were easy to distinguish - just look at whether the middle head of the three had a fringe-like structure.

Such groups with female Combee were necessarily not recognized by the Vespiquen, were small in number and difficult to survive. So when Johan proposed his idea, Snivy battled them.

Easy victory.

Then these four Combee accepted the "relocation" suggestion.

Though not many in number.

Having one female Combee meant extremely high potential for population growth.

When this female Combee evolved into Vespiquen, the entire Combee population would experience explosive growth.

The island's "industry" had gained another addition.

After doing this and confirming the trio's situation, Johan decided to return.

As for the trio...

Johan used "accompanying a spiritually wounded mother is an important mission" as the reason to "leave them to" Bewear.

Then under Bewear's waving farewell paws.

Amid the trio's "hoarse" farewells.

Johan fled from this "bear-infested" forest.

Night fell, in the cafeteria of Alola Pokémon School.

Mushroom soup gave off an enticing aroma.

"Home visits?!" ×5

The five kids' exclamations came from the cafeteria.

Johan leisurely sipped the fragrant, rich soup made from Morelull mushrooms, nodding slightly:

"Right, only through home visits can I better understand you while also learning about your daily life situations, to create better, more suitable study plans."

The five kids looked at each other.

More or less, they all saw a bit of fear in each other's eyes.

No student wasn't afraid of home visits.

Even the best students feared teachers or parents might say something unexpected.

"Don't be afraid, I'm just understanding your situations, not saying 'bad things' about you." Johan smiled reassuringly.

"We're afraid they'll say some 'shocking' things..." Sophocles mumbled quietly, with the others nodding in agreement.

But Johan had obviously already decided.

He said directly:

"Then let's start with you, Sophocles. Tomorrow, tomorrow we'll go to Ula'ula Island."

"Ah?!"

Chubby Sophocles nearly jumped from his chair, looking miserable: "Why start with me?"

The other kids immediately breathed sighs of relief.

As long as they weren't first.

Thus.

After dinner, the five kids "fled" the cafeteria, each calling home to make "arrangements."

Johan immediately felt the joy of teacher home visits.

No wonder his teachers used to do home visits every semester - so this was the feeling.

On the way back to his lodging, he called Anabel again.

Asking her about information on the Aether Foundation.

"Aether Foundation?"

Anabel was slightly confused but quickly said:

"I'll send you the materials later."

"The more secretive kind." Johan reminded.

Anabel paused, then replied again: "Alright."

As International Police, they naturally couldn't ignore such a behemoth in the Alola region as the Aether Foundation.

Even Anabel's "UB Task Force" inevitably needed to cooperate with the Aether Foundation when dealing with Ultra Beasts.

"Anabel, do you think the Aether Foundation is normal?" After hesitating for a while, Johan still asked this question.

For a moment, Anabel also fell silent.

Though she hadn't had much time for in-depth investigation, if she had to say...

Seeing Anabel didn't answer, Johan already understood.

"I see."

"Teacher Johan." Before hanging up, Anabel spoke again: "Perhaps you could go to Ula'ula Island and chat with Mr. Nanu."

Nanu, a retired International Police officer, now Island Kahuna of Ula'ula Island, with very rich experience and background, even having some connection with Boss Giovanni.

As one of the first to encounter Ultra Wormholes, plus his long residence in the Alola region, Nanu would probably understand the Aether Foundation better.

"I was going to go even if you didn't mention it."

Johan smiled: "Don't worry, I'm just investigating. Even if something really happens, I should be able to handle it."

With Bear God backing him up, he wasn't afraid.

Unless the Aether Foundation could assemble another "Rainbow Rocket" lineup...

Thinking this, Johan shook his head.

Impossible, absolutely impossible, no one could be that unlucky!

Mm.

Regarding Johan's words, Anabel naturally had complete confidence.

If even Teacher Johan couldn't handle it, probably not many people in the entire Pokémon world could.

After hanging up, Anabel quickly sent materials about the Aether Foundation.

The materials from International Police were much more detailed than what the official website provided, even mentioning the Aether Foundation's research into the "UB" existence and Ultra Wormholes.

"Just looking at these things, you can't tell much. Still need to make house calls."

Returning to his lodging.

"Buzz! (‵‵)"

Buzzwole was still showing off its muscles.

"Buzz!" Dr. Burnet had taken off her white lab coat, even undoing her tight outfit and tying it around her waist, revealing a crisp gray tank top.

Learning Buzzwole's method, she also flexed her minimal muscles.

Though she was a "weakling," having someone respond to it made Buzzwole very happy.

"Buzzwole, brought you something tasty."

Johan shook the bag in his hand. Besides mushroom soup and energy cubes, there was also the Honey Bewear had given him.

The Poké Balls at his waist opened, and his own Pokémon all rushed out together.

Then came their dinner time.

Johan emotionally touched his wallet.

Though only a day had passed, he really wanted to say Anabel's budget approval was a bit slow, not having the proper Hoenn style at all.

"Teacher Johan!" Dr. Burnet looked somewhat excited, her cheeks slightly flushed: "Perhaps we'll soon be able to develop special Poké Balls capable of capturing 'UBs'."

What was most troublesome about dealing with "UBs" or Ultra Beasts?

It was that even after defeating Ultra Beasts, there was no suitable way to contain them.

Having to wait for Ultra Wormholes to open, having enough opening time, and having Ultra Beasts conveniently defeated within the Ultra Wormhole range before sending them back...

This difficulty was harder than winning the lottery.

Moreover, these Ultra Beasts capable of passing through Ultra Wormholes were mostly very powerful, beyond ordinary trainers' ability to handle.

Even the currently friendly Buzzwole - if Johan hadn't defeated it earlier, where would this good behavior come from?

"Thank you for your hard work, Dr. Burnet." Johan said.

It seemed Beast Balls would soon be available.

"Thanks to you, Teacher Johan."

After speaking, Dr. Burnet left with today's collected data and materials.

With Johan back, she didn't need to continue watching Buzzwole.

"No need to see me out—"

Dr. Burnet left quickly.

Johan waved, opening his mouth to speak, but before he could ask his question, Dr. Burnet had disappeared from view.

"I wanted to ask if there would be bonuses..."

Sighing lightly.

Turning around, he saw his Pokémon, especially Gengar, Urshifu, and Dragonite, sneakily discussing something with Buzzwole.

"Buzz?"

Buzzwole seemed to hear something and looked especially excited.

But after just one call, Gengar pressed down its head, making a "shush" gesture, indicating it shouldn't make noise.

Then several little ones looked at Johan in unison. When they noticed Johan was also watching them, they all quickly and uniformly turned back.

Gathering together, whispering quietly.

Buzzwole obviously lacked experience, occasionally glancing carefully at Johan, but was quickly pressed back by Gengar and Urshifu together, finally becoming more "behaved."

As their trainer, Johan could guess what they were discussing just by thinking with his toes.

Still hiding from him...

Johan looked at Ninetales.

"Oowoo~"

Nearby Ninetales' tails gently spread, soon exhaling cold air that vaguely outlined Bewear's silhouette.

Good grief, they really had guts.

However, Johan wasn't worried about any accidents. His own Pokémon might not be able to handle Bewear, but Bewear couldn't handle them either.

More importantly, he had established a good relationship with Bewear.

What he was thinking more about now was...

"When Buzzwole returns to Ultra Space later, it won't develop a 'Gengar Outlaw Squad Ultra Space Branch,' will it?"

# 700: What, What a Big Trouble! (Two-in-One Chapter)

The next day.

Ula'ula Island.

This was the largest island in the Alola region. From a distance, you could see two towering peaks covered with thick snow, and besides the peaks, the island also had deserts, forests, and towns.

One of these two mountains was Mount Lanakila, the highest mountain in the Alola region.

It was also the location Professor Kukui had selected for the future Alola League headquarters.

The other was Mount Hokulani, which had a famous Hokulani Observatory - the only observatory in the Alola region. Its owner was Johan's student Sophocles' cousin, Molayne, who would become one of the Alola region's Elite Four in the future.

"Stop taking photos and watch ahead, Rotom - there are Wailmer!"

Several Wailmer like small hills leisurely swam past the sea ahead.

Rotom immediately stopped photographing and focused on driving the speedboat.

Actually, in the Alola region, Wailmer were also excellent maritime "transportation." The Pokémon school even had specialized courses for riding Wailmer.

"No chance today, but next time I go out I can borrow one from Professor Kukui."

Speedboats had their fun - Johan could experience surfing behind them, while riding Wailmer would be another kind of experience entirely.

"Approaching destination, Rotom!"

Though the Alola region consisted of four islands, the distances between them weren't actually far. They soon reached a port on Ula'ula Island.

However, the port they reached was much more run-down compared to Hau'oli City's port on Melemele Island.

Because they had arrived at "Po Town Port."

"Switch to Ula'ula Island map, Rotom."

After simply docking the speedboat at the port pier, Johan said.

"Understood, Rotom! Current location: Po Town!"

Po Town was once a fairly famous upscale town on Ula'ula Island, mostly consisting of detached villas for wealthy residents.

But current Po Town had become completely rundown, with the high walls surrounding the entire town covered in messy graffiti everywhere.

The reason it became like this had to do with a gang organization in the Alola region - Team Skull!

Johan's assessment of Team Skull was that they were the only villain organization that could compete with Team Yell in terms of embarrassment level.

Using "gang organization" was the best description for them. Even calling them an "evil organization" felt like an insult to Team Rocket.

Their leader was none other than Guzma, who had battled Johan before and had the nickname "Undefeated Emperor"!

A strong "emo family" vibe.

Guzma and Professor Kukui were both students of Melemele Island's Island Kahuna Hala, but Guzma's strength was much inferior to Professor Kukui's.

Roughly speaking, he was probably a bit stronger than some Gym Leaders but weaker than Elite Four members.

With the organization's leader having such strength, naturally the organization couldn't be much stronger - they just emphasized being "gangster-like."

Johan felt that Flint alone could easily steamroll this so-called Team Skull.

But gangs were troublesome precisely because while they might not be able to beat you, they could definitely disgust you.

So what was once a perfectly good Po Town had now clearly become Team Skull's territory.

"Obviously the most clearly kid-oriented first season anime, even the villain organization is so 'weak and powerless,' yet there's still the super-spec legendary crisis of Necrozma - this is very unreasonable..."

Johan grumbled internally while getting off the speedboat.

However, as soon as Johan disembarked, two Team Skull members wearing white bandanas, black face masks, and dressed in emo outfits immediately swaggered over.

"Hey!" One of them casually juggled a Poké Ball, saying: "Docking here costs 1,000 Pokédollars!"

Obviously, these two were specifically watching this rundown port.

1,000 Pokédollars?

Johan was amused.

He remembered when playing the games, when healing Pokémon at Po Town's Pokémon Center, he was actually charged money!

It was the first time he'd ever paid at a Pokémon Center in any Pokémon game he'd played.

Seeing Johan not responding but laughing instead, the other Team Skull member immediately said irritably:

"What are you laughing at? If you have money, pay up. If you don't, get lost!"

"Pay up, pay up." Johan smiled.

Dealing with gangs was troublesome.

You might easily defeat them here, but Johan could guarantee that in at most half an hour after he left, these two would definitely bring a group of small-time thugs and then...

Cover his speedboat inside and out with graffiti.

The Team Skull member who spoke first gave a "you know what's good for you" look.

Then Johan walked forward and lightly patted the palm he held out.

"10,000 Pokédollars, keep the change."

After speaking, he brushed past, leaving a piece of seaweed in the man's hand.

But these two Team Skull members seemed not to notice, or rather they treated this piece of seaweed as 10,000 Pokédollars.

They immediately forgot about Johan and ran off happily.

"Ka-kaah~"

After they left, Gengar leisurely floated out from the shadows, grinning and showing an evil smile.

"Mm, you look more like a bad guy than they do." Johan lightly patted Gengar and laughed, walking toward Po Town.

Johan actually wasn't very interested in this rundown town occupied by Team Skull.

But there was no choice.

Who told him that Ula'ula Island's Island Kahuna Nanu worked at the police station in this Po Town?

Po Town's streets were littered with garbage everywhere, and the walls and rundown houses around were covered with random graffiti.

Everywhere you could see stray cats and dogs, as well as Alolan form Meowth and even Persian unique to the Alola region.

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar's eyes lit up with excitement.

It seemed to see the best breeding ground for its "outlaw squad."

It felt these Alolan Meowth and Persian were particularly endearing.

All along the way, its eyes were spinning around, plotting its schemes.

Fortunately, they didn't encounter any more Team Skull members on the way to Po Town's police station, saving Johan considerable trouble.

Tak, tak—

Clear "tak tak" sounds came from inside the rundown police station.

Pushing the door open.

He saw a gray-haired man in an old police station uniform and flip-flops, about forty-something with a lazy expression, leaning against the counter, listlessly playing with his kendama.

"Mr. Nanu." Johan smiled and greeted him.

This lazy middle-aged man was Ula'ula Island's Island Kahuna, former International Police officer, Anabel and Looker's superior - Nanu.

Nanu didn't seem surprised by Johan's appearance.

Supporting himself on the counter with one hand while playing kendama with the other, he slightly raised his eyelids, glanced at Johan, then jerked his chin:

"There, the materials you wanted."

On the counter lay what could generously be called a document - with sloppy handwriting, wrinkled and even yellowing paper.

Obviously, Anabel had already informed Nanu of Johan's visit in advance.

"Thanks."

Johan didn't mind, picking up the document and simply flipping through it.

He had to admit, there was a reason Nanu had been able to reach the rank of Chief Inspector within the International Police - his abilities were very strong.

Having lived in the Alola region for over ten years, despite appearing lazy, he had actually investigated the Aether Foundation quite thoroughly.

The materials he provided were more detailed than what Anabel gave - or rather, they involved details that others wouldn't notice.

For example, Aether Foundation President Lusamine had undergone some subtle changes in both her working style and principles over several years.

Nanu had noticed this point.

He suspected it might be related to Lusamine's husband's disappearance.

Tak—

Nanu's kendama paused as he waved at Johan.

"That's about enough. You should hurry up and leave."

"Hm?" Johan was startled.

Nanu pursed his lips, walking toward a nearby reclining chair and saying lazily:

"According to what I've seen online, wherever you appear, nothing good happens."

Johan: "..."

"Though I can't say it's your fault, you definitely bring trouble, and I hate trouble most."

"Cough cough..."

This "incisive" summary made Johan feel embarrassed.

Did he want to encounter trouble?

Obviously trouble always came looking for him!

However, just as Johan was about to say something, he heard some commotion outside.

Nanu immediately looked at Johan expressionlessly, his gaze seeming to say "see?"

Johan looked completely bewildered.

No way, what does this have to do with me?

Nanu reluctantly stood up, playing with his kendama while opening the door, and heard:

"Old man! Can't you control your Meowth? They stole all our food!"

"That's right, old man, don't think you're so great just because you're an Island Kahuna! On Ula'ula Island, everything still depends on our 'Emperor'!"

"Old man, we're talking to you!"

Outside the door were clearly a group of Team Skull thugs.

On the nearby lawn, a group of gray-furred Meowth sat on the ground licking their paws, completely ignoring the shouting Team Skull members, leisurely watching the show.

Only when Nanu came out did they get up one by one, putting on harmless expressions.

Then while meowing softly, they gathered around Nanu's feet.

This scene immediately made the Team Skull members grit their teeth in anger.

If not for Nanu's protection, could this group of wild Meowth be so arrogant?

Regarding Nanu, though they spoke disrespectfully with unfriendly tones, they were still somewhat fearful.

They just acted tough on the surface because they felt backed by Guzma, not wanting to embarrass their "Emperor."

Nanu spun his kendama, looking at Johan.

At this moment, Johan was leaning against the doorframe with arms crossed, also watching the show.

Noticing Nanu's gaze, he grinned lightly, raised an eyebrow, seeming to say - see, who brought the trouble?

Nanu fell silent, somewhat troubled as he scratched his hair.

If not for Po Town having the cheapest housing prices, he wouldn't want to live here either. Team Skull wasn't powerful, but they were just a troublesome group.

And what he feared most was trouble.

Scratching his head again, he said to Johan: "You help me solve this, and I'll count it as passing your grand trial."

Johan pursed his lips.

"I'm not participating in any island challenge."

"I'll introduce you to the guardian deity." Nanu said again.

"Tapu Koko already arranged that."

"I'll tell you Anabel's background."

"Fall, my clearance level can access that information."

Nanu: "..."

How was this person so stubborn?

Johan smiled: "I'm actually quite curious how Mr. Nanu usually handles 'trouble.'"

His tone emphasized the word "trouble."

Nanu understood this was Johan "responding" to his earlier words.

"I'll tell you the location of the 'Never-Melt Ice.'" After a moment of silence, Nanu spoke again.

Johan raised an eyebrow.

Never-Melt Ice was a naturally formed product that worked similarly to an "Ice Stone" but was different - a creation of nature.

Some Pokémon, especially those that needed "Ice Stones" to evolve, had a chance to evolve without using an "Ice Stone" when near "Never-Melt Ice."

For many Ice-type Pokémon, "Never-Melt Ice" was quite attractive.

"Never-Melt Ice" could only be found in extremely cold places, actually existing in places like Sinnoh's Mount Coronet and Unova's Twist Mountain.

Mount Lanakila on Ula'ula Island naturally had some too.

This was also why many Crabrawler evolved into Crabominable after climbing Mount Lanakila.

Johan had Ninetales, and Ninetales only existed in the Alola region, even specifically only on Mount Lanakila. Nanu was betting Johan would go.

"Looks like Mr. Nanu knows me quite well." Johan said.

Otherwise he couldn't have said that about Johan bringing trouble.

Nanu chose silence.

Johan shrugged: "Plus a Dark-type Z-Crystal."

Might as well take what was offered.

Nanu immediately glared at him irritably, then said: "Take care of these Meowth."

This was the task he used to trouble Ash in the anime.

Because this group of Meowth living in Po Town honestly couldn't be calmed by anyone except him.

Otherwise Team Skull wouldn't have come looking for trouble.

Johan grinned.

"Deal."

He couldn't help muttering internally: Old fox.

Nanu was also grumbling internally: Little fox.

The Team Skull members naturally couldn't understand Johan and Nanu's exchange, but their behavior of ignoring them hurt these small-time thugs' self-esteem.

"Damn it!"

"Go, Golbat!"

"Go, Ekans!"

"Show them some pain, Hypno!"

"..."

For a moment, these Team Skull members angrily threw Poké Balls.

Then a bunch of Golbat, Ekans, Alolan Rattata, Alolan Raticate, Ariados, Gumshoos and other clearly baby Pokémon were summoned.

Look at this quality - how could Team Skull get on stage?

Johan wanted to take back his earlier words about Flint steamrolling Team Skull, feeling this was somewhat "insulting" to Flint. Even a small squad of elite Team Rocket members could probably handle this.

"Tyranitar." Johan threw a Poké Ball.

Having Snivy come would probably result in Snivy pulling his hair after the battle.

"Bangi!"

Tyranitar appeared with claws and fangs bared, its feet shaking the ground, arms stirring up sandstorm, the gloom seeming to blot out the sun.

Team Skull: "..."

Team Skull's Pokémon: "..."

We're supposed to fight this Tyranitar?

"Quick, go call Boss Guzma!"

"Bangi!!"

In no time, most of the Team Skull members' Pokémon were lying on the ground.

It wasn't Tyranitar's doing - the sandstorm alone had blown them into losing battle capability.

"Sandstorm has become a 'small fry cleaner.'" Johan rubbed his chin.

"Bangi?"

As the sandstorm faded, Tyranitar looked at Johan, scratching its head.

Still fighting?

"Not for now." Johan said.

"Bangi."

Tyranitar said "oh," nodded, sat on the ground and took out a pile of minerals, "munch munch" chomping away.

Watching from behind, Nanu's eye twitched as he commented: "Looks like you're not suited for Dark-types."

Great, he'd even gotten the same evaluation Nanu gave Ash.

Johan shrugged, not caring.

However, soon enough.

Surrounded by a group of Team Skull members, the imposing Guzma appeared at the police station entrance.

Seeing the mountain-like Tyranitar sitting on the ground, then the kendama-playing Nanu at the door and the yawning Johan, his expression immediately darkened.

He glanced around, then turned to leave.

"Let's go!"

"Boss Guzma, you have to stand up for us!"

"Boss Guzma?"

Guzma's face was dark.

Stand up for them?

Damn it, one was at least Champion level, one was at least Elite Four level - stand up for what?

If it was just Nanu, Guzma felt he could still hold his own, and he knew this "neighbor's" temperament fairly well - as long as you didn't go too far, it was fine.

But Teacher Johan?

Sinnoh's Team Galactic, Unova's Team Plasma, Kalos's Team Flare...

He wasn't some idiot with no knowledge of the outside world who'd never left the Alola region!

"Guzma!" Johan suddenly called out.

Hm?

Guzma stopped, frowning as he looked back.

He heard Johan say: "My boat is docked at the port. Please help keep an eye on it, thanks."

Guzma: "..."

He quickened his pace.

"He's so polite..."

"Could this person possibly... be Boss Guzma's friend?"

"No wonder! No wonder Boss Guzma turned and left - he didn't want to fight his friend."

"Boss Guzma is really, I'm crying, I'll follow Boss Guzma to the death!"

Team Skull came with great fanfare and left with great fanfare, leaving only sand and dust on the ground, and a bewildered Tyranitar.

Johan smiled lightly at Nanu, while Nanu glanced at the Meowth at his feet - the meaning was clear: there were still these Meowth.

"Gengar."

"Ka-kaah~!"

Gengar immediately floated out, giving those Alolan Meowth a very "friendly" smile.

Several Alolan Meowth immediately bristled.

Johan clearly understood these Meowth's situation.

As they say: it takes a bad guy to deal with bad guys.

No one was more suitable for "taking care of" them than Gengar.

"Ka-kaah!!"

Gengar laughed "maniacally."

Heaven helps this old man! Let this old man establish a "base" in Po Town!

As for these Meowth being docile on the surface but causing trouble behind the scenes, that was fine - Gengar was even better at causing trouble than they were.

Soon enough.

Inside the police station.

Nanu lay on his reclining chair playing kendama, while Johan sat in a chair drinking coffee and reading documents.

Gengar swaggered in, followed like a mother hen with chicks by a line of Meowth.

"Ka-kaah~"

It waved its big hand.

Sound off!

The Alolan Meowth lined up neatly, then began calling "Meow! Meow!" in count.

Nanu: "..."

He looked at Gengar and the Meowth, then at Johan sitting in the chair laughing silently while reading materials, and took a deep breath:

"Alright, I take back what I said earlier. You're actually... quite suited for Dark-type Pokémon."

Even though Gengar was a Ghost and Poison-type Pokémon.

Only Nanu, who clearly understood these Meowth's temperament, could appreciate how significant it was that Gengar had "tamed" this group of Meowth in just ten-plus minutes.

This guy... wasn't raising a group of "villains," was he? Nanu looked at Johan with endless suspicion.

Ding ling—

The door was pushed open again.

"They're so well-behaved today!"

A girl with flowing purple hair, wearing a tattered black-purple dress and gold armlets walked in.

Acerola!

Currently the captain in charge of the "Thrifty Megamart" trial site on Ula'ula Island, and future Elite Four member of the Alola League recommended by Nanu to Professor Kukui!

"Teacher Johan?" Acerola looked very surprised to see Johan.

"Acerola, Alola."

Johan smiled and greeted her.

Though they weren't very close, they knew each other.

In the last "Youth World Championship," Acerola had made it to the round of 16, ultimately losing to the "cheating" Caitlin.

"Alola!" Acerola bowed slightly.

Her relationship with Nanu was somewhat like master and disciple, so appearing here didn't surprise Johan.

From her shoulder behind her, a Mimikyu wearing a small red flower cautiously poked its head out, looking at Gengar.

"Ka-kaah~" Gengar grinned and greeted it, waving.

Mimikyu immediately retreated in fear.

"I might go to Malie Library this afternoon. Will you be there, Acerola?"

In Malie Library, there were some records about Necrozma. With Acerola's help as the librarian, he could find the documents he wanted to read faster.

"Mm!"

Acerola nodded: "After I finish asking Mr. Nanu questions, I'll head back. I still have to tell stories to children this afternoon."

Nanu wore an expression of "more trouble coming," irritably placing a worn map and a black Dark-type Z-Crystal on the counter.

"Your map and Dark Z, hurry up and leave." Nanu urged.

"Eh?" Acerola tilted her head: "Dark-type Z-Crystal? Is Teacher Johan here for the island challenge?"

"No." Johan smiled as he collected the items.

"Then no battle needed?"

Nanu and Johan spoke almost simultaneously: "Of course not!"

Both looked at each other.

Acerola covered her mouth and laughed: "Teacher Johan and Mr. Nanu have such good chemistry."

Johan: "..."

Nanu: "..."

"I'm leaving, Gengar."

"Ka-kaah~"

Gengar waved at its newly recruited "subordinates," giving encouraging looks.

This old man is going to "recruit" from other areas - the development of the Po Town squad is in your hands!

"Meow~"

"Meow~"

The Alolan Meowth looked reluctant, following step by step until Johan and Gengar left.

"This is really the first time I've seen them like anyone besides Mr. Nanu." Acerola said.

Then she placed some documents on the counter, smiling with crescent eyes:

"Mr. Nanu, the materials you requested."

Near noon.

"Phew—"

Only after Acerola left did Nanu seem to deflate as he lay back on his reclining chair.

Finally he could rest properly.

Beep beep!

However, before he could fully lie down, his phone rang.

"Never ending..." Nanu grumbled while taking out his phone. When he saw the caller ID, he fell silent.

Pressing answer.

From the phone came the voice of Team Rocket's leader - Giovanni.

"How was it?" Giovanni's tone was like chatting with an old friend: "Did you meet him? Is he really like you?"

Nanu's expression became serious for the first time.

After a long silence, he said: "If it's for his own good, I'd advise you to have less contact with him."

Giovanni on the other end also fell silent briefly, his tone remaining relaxed.

"Relax a bit, Nanu. The current situation is different from before."

Then his tone gradually deepened, with some emotion.

"He changed me."

"Changed you?" Nanu narrowed his eyes: "What does this have to do with you wanting Mount Lanakila's structural diagrams?"

"Didn't I hear that Alola is planning to build in that dangerous place? This is one of our current target projects."

Team Rocket building the Alola League headquarters for the Alola League?

If this were a few years ago, Nanu would have couldn't help but complain about what a century-joke this was.

But now...

"I've already sent it to your secretary. The rest - bidding, design and so on - depends on your own capabilities." Nanu said.

"Thanks."

The call ended.

Nanu held the phone for a long time without putting it down. After a while, he murmured:

"Like me? More like you, actually."

Ding ling—

A bicycle leisurely rode along Ula'ula Island's highway.

"Turn left ahead, Rotom!"

Leaving Po Town and getting what he wanted, Johan headed straight for Ruins of Abundance, passing through the path between Mount Hokulani and Mount Lanakila toward Haina Desert.

"Rotom, sand bike mode."

"Super! Transform! Rotom!"

The good thing about Rotom bikes was that they could basically adapt to many complex terrains - whether mountains, desert, or ice.

Haina Desert wasn't small, but fortunately it wasn't very dangerous.

Besides the most common Trapinch, you could often see Alolan Dugtrio with golden mustache-like hair.

Following navigation, he arrived unobstructed at the Ruins of Abundance.

It was located in a canyon deep in the desert, surrounded on three sides by towering rock walls, with a black cave entrance directly ahead amid the howling sand and dust.

However, though Johan's destination was the Ruins of Abundance, he had no intention of going inside.

His gaze moved from bottom to top, slowly looking toward the very top of the rock wall - at least over a hundred meters high, and almost completely vertical.

"This can really be climbed by hand?"

Johan pictured Ash climbing the rock wall bare-handed.

Shaking his head.

"Inhuman."

He threw a Poké Ball.

"Dragonite!"

"Draaa~~"

Climbing onto Dragonite's back, riding Dragonite, he quickly reached the top of this rock wall.

This was a very flat, wide platform with not only verdant grass but also a small lake.

Since Tapu Koko had given advance notice, Ula'ula Island's guardian deity Tapu Bulu shouldn't be hard to find...

Johan's gaze swept around.

"Found it!"

He quickly saw the Tapu Bulu lying by the lakeside, snoring as it rested!

It looked like a bull with only an upper body, black body, white nose ring, golden hooves like a bull's feet, and a red shell like a straw hat with a pair of black wooden horns like bull horns.

A long black tail with a golden bell at the tip.

It was said that when its bell swayed, it could make surrounding plants grow, bursting with vigorous life energy.

Tapu Bulu maintained survival by promoting plant growth, then absorbing energy from the plants.

This technique of using energy to stimulate plant growth then absorbing energy from plants was no less impressive than any "perpetual motion machine."

It was also the ability Johan most envied.

If his Pokémon could have this ability, why would he need to run around for money? He could also treat money like dirt.

Honestly.

Among the four guardian deities of the Alola region, Johan was most interested in and wanted to contact Tapu Bulu.

If he could get it to tour his little island once, the effect would be even better than Calyrex's cabbage head.

Not only could it stimulate plant growth, it could even make berry trees directly bear fruit - truly the number one legendary for farming!

Tapu Bulu's personality was very similar to Island Kahuna Nanu - lazy, trouble-averse, and fond of afternoon naps.

But if you underestimated Tapu Bulu because of this, you'd be making a big mistake.

Among the four guardian deities of the Alola region, Tapu Bulu was the only one that had ever shown its fury.

On Ula'ula Island, there was once a Tapu Village, which was later destroyed due to the villagers' contempt for guardian deity Tapu Bulu, earning its endless wrath.

Eventually Tapu Village was destroyed, and even the nearby Thrifty Megamart didn't escape.

So.

Never casually provoke honest people, because when honest people truly get angry, they can be more terrifying than most others.

"Draaa~"

Dragonite flapped its wings, carrying Johan toward where Tapu Bulu was sleeping.

Snore—snore—

The snoring Tapu Bulu seemed to sense something, opening one eye slightly to glance at Johan landing on the soft earth, its emerald eyes particularly calm.

"Tapu Bulu."

Approaching Tapu Bulu, Johan inexplicably felt a warm, drowsy, comfortable laziness that made him want to yawn and take an afternoon nap.

[Help me solve two troubles, and I'll agree to what Tapu Koko mentioned.]

Tapu Bulu's steady, calm voice echoed in Johan's mind.

Hm?

This was more proactive than Johan had imagined.

But two troubles?

He saw Tapu Bulu shift its heavy body, then flip over to lie on its stomach.

[First, help me scratch my back.]

Johan: "..."

What, what a big trouble!
